seg.0713d9ec51cd.t: नागुल चवितिक रेसिपी · करीब 12 टा बनैत अछि
seg.0713d9ec51cd.back: Recipe of Nagula Chavithi · makes about 12 pieces

seg.6a61d0d1cb9e.src: Chimmili for Nagula Chavithi ⟦1⟧(Sesame Jaggery Balls)⟦/1⟧

seg.4fea7db714b7.src: Chimmili is a small Telugu sweet of roasted sesame and jaggery, ground coarsely and rolled into balls. It is one of the offerings made on Nagula Chavithi in Karthika masam, along with chalimidi and the milk poured at the snake anthill (putta). Sesame and jaggery sweets like it are made again at Sankranti.
seg.4fea7db714b7.t: चिम्मिलि भूजल तिल आ गुड़ सँ बनल एकटा छोट तेलुगु मिठाइ अछि, जकरा मोट-मोट पीसि कऽ लड्डू बनाओल जाइत अछि। कार्तिक मासक नागुल चवितिमे चलिमिडि आ साँपक बाँबी (पुट्ट) पर ढारल जाइत दूधक संग ईहो चढ़ाओल जाइत अछि। संक्रान्तिमे सेहो एहने तिल-गुड़क मिठाइ फेर बनाओल जाइत अछि।
seg.4fea7db714b7.back: Chimmili is a small Telugu sweet made from roasted sesame and jaggery, which is ground coarsely and made into laddus. On Nagula Chavithi of the month of Kartika this too is offered along with chalimidi and the milk poured on the snake's anthill (putta). At Sankranti too, such sesame-jaggery sweets are made again.

seg.6e104d560e56.src: Roasted sesame gives it a nutty, toasty taste, and cane jaggery a caramel sweetness. The texture is soft and a little crumbly, and each ball is gone in two bites. This recipe makes about 12.
seg.6e104d560e56.t: भूजल तिल एकरा मेवा सन, भूजल स्वाद दैत अछि, आ कुसियारक गुड़ कैरामेल सन मिठास। ई नरम आ कनेक भुरभुरा होइत अछि, आ एकटा लड्डू दुइए कौरमे खतम भऽ जाइत अछि। एहि रेसिपी सँ करीब 12 टा बनैत अछि।
seg.6e104d560e56.back: Roasted sesame gives it a dry-fruit-like (nutty), roasted taste, and the sugarcane jaggery a caramel-like sweetness. It is soft and a little crumbly, and one laddu is finished in just two mouthfuls. This recipe makes about 12 pieces.

seg.9e72f273d4f2.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the roasted sesame to cool.
seg.9e72f273d4f2.t: कुल समयमे भूजल तिलकेँ सेराबऽ मे लागऽ बला 5 मिनट सेहो जोड़ल अछि।
seg.9e72f273d4f2.back: The total time also includes the 5 minutes taken to cool the roasted sesame.

seg.2097a0e593c6.src: Make chimmili at home: roast sesame till it crackles, grind coarsely, pulse with grated cane jaggery and cardamom, shape into balls.
seg.2097a0e593c6.t: घरमे चिम्मिलि बनाउ: तिलकेँ चटचटाय धरि भूजू, मोट-मोट पीसू, कद्दूकस कयल कुसियारक गुड़ आ इलायचीक संग मिक्सरमे थोड़-थोड़ चलाउ, आ लड्डू बनाउ।
seg.2097a0e593c6.back: Make chimmili at home: roast the sesame until it crackles, grind coarsely, run the mixer a little at a time with grated sugarcane jaggery and cardamom, and make laddus.

seg.ac56800c5ad4.src: ¾ cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed; soft jaggery binds best⟦/1⟧
seg.ac56800c5ad4.t: ¾ कप कद्दूकस कयल कुसियारक गुड़ ⟦1⟧हल्लुक दबा कऽ भरल; नरम गुड़ सभ सँ नीक जकाँ बान्हैत अछि⟦/1⟧
seg.ac56800c5ad4.back: ¾ cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧filled lightly pressed; soft jaggery binds best of all⟦/1⟧

seg.39c46fb56757.src: 1 tsp ghee, for greasing your palms
seg.39c46fb56757.t: 1 छोट चम्मच घी, हथेरीमे लगाबऽ लेल
seg.39c46fb56757.back: 1 small spoon ghee, for applying on palms

seg.ed775cba4fcf.src: Grate the jaggery and measure out the sesame before you start; once the sesame is roasted, the rest moves quickly.
seg.ed775cba4fcf.t: शुरू करबा सँ पहिने गुड़ कद्दूकस कऽ लिअ आ तिल नापि कऽ राखि लिअ; तिल भुजा गेलाक बाद बाकी काज जल्दी होइत अछि।
seg.ed775cba4fcf.back: Before starting, grate the jaggery and keep the sesame measured; after the sesame is roasted the remaining work goes fast.

seg.cfb9d281b47f.src: Heat a heavy kadai or pan on low heat for a minute. Add the sesame; no oil or ghee is needed.
seg.cfb9d281b47f.t: एकटा भारी कड़ाही वा पैनकेँ मद्धिम आँच पर एक मिनट गरम करू। तिल डालू; तेल वा घीक जरूरति नहि अछि।
seg.cfb9d281b47f.back: Heat a heavy kadai or pan on low flame for one minute. Add the sesame; there is no need of oil or ghee.

seg.89a51ce5355c.src: Dry-roast the sesame on a low flame till it crackles and turns light golden. Stir all the time; the seeds start to pop and smell nutty after 4–6 minutes. Do not let them turn brown.
seg.89a51ce5355c.t: तिलकेँ मद्धिम आँच पर बिना तेल-घीक भूजू, जा धरि ओ चटचटाय नहि लागय आ हल्लुक सुनहरा नहि भऽ जाय। लगातार चलबैत रहू; 4–6 मिनटक बाद दाना फुटऽ लगैत अछि आ मेवा सन गन्ध अबैत अछि। एकरा भूरा नहि होमऽ दिअ।
seg.89a51ce5355c.back: Roast the sesame on low flame without oil-ghee, until it starts to crackle and becomes light golden. Keep stirring continuously; after 4–6 minutes the seeds start to pop and a nutty smell comes. Do not let it become brown.

seg.999792547560.src: Tip the sesame onto a wide plate straight away so it stops browning. Cool it for about 5 minutes, until it is just warm to the touch.
seg.999792547560.t: तिलकेँ तुरंत एकटा चाकर थारीमे ढारि दिअ जाहि सँ ओ आर भूरा नहि हो। करीब 5 मिनट सेराबऽ दिअ, जा धरि छुला पर मात्र गुनगुना नहि रहि जाय।
seg.999792547560.back: Immediately pour the sesame into a wide plate so that it does not brown more. Let it cool about 5 minutes, until it is only lukewarm to the touch.

seg.77b614ea2f92.src: Grind the sesame coarsely in short pulses. Use the small jar of the mixer and pulse 3–4 times, a second or two at a time; stop while you can still see broken seeds.
seg.77b614ea2f92.t: तिलकेँ थोड़-थोड़ मिक्सर चला कऽ मोट-मोट पीसू। मिक्सरक छोट जार प्रयोग करू आ एक-दू सेकेंड कऽ 3–4 बेर चलाउ; जखन टूटल दाना एखनो देखाइत हो, तखने रोकि दिअ।
seg.77b614ea2f92.back: Grind the sesame coarsely running the mixer a little at a time. Use the small jar of the mixer and run 3–4 times for one-two seconds; stop while broken seeds are still visible.

seg.175aeced5810.src: Add the jaggery and cardamom; pulse till it comes together. This takes 4–6 more short pulses; scrape down the sides once. A pinch pressed between your fingers should hold its shape.
seg.175aeced5810.t: गुड़ आ इलायची डालू; मिश्रण जुटि जाय धरि चलाउ। एहिमे आओर 4–6 बेर थोड़-थोड़ चलाबऽ पड़ैत अछि; एक बेर कातमे लागल मिश्रण नीचाँ खसा दिअ। आँगुरक बीच दबाओल एक चुटकी मिश्रण अपन आकार धरने रहबाक चाही।
seg.175aeced5810.back: Add jaggery and cardamom; run until the mixture comes together. This needs another 4–6 short runs; once, push down the mixture stuck on the sides. A pinch of mixture pressed between the fingers should hold its shape.

seg.6f94cb46b9ab.src: If the mixture is too dry to hold, add 1–2 tsp more grated jaggery and pulse once or twice again.
seg.6f94cb46b9ab.t: जँ मिश्रण एतेक सुखल हो जे नहि बान्हय, तँ 1–2 छोट चम्मच आओर कद्दूकस कयल गुड़ डालि कऽ फेर एक-दू बेर चलाउ।
seg.6f94cb46b9ab.back: If the mixture is so dry that it does not bind, then add 1–2 small spoons more grated jaggery and run once or twice again.

seg.226f137c9449.src: Tip the mixture into a bowl and grease your palms lightly with ghee.
seg.226f137c9449.t: मिश्रणकेँ एकटा कटोरामे ढारू आ हथेरीमे हल्लुक घी लगाउ।
seg.226f137c9449.back: Pour the mixture into a bowl and apply a little ghee on the palms.

seg.ff3eb71729c2.src: Shape into small balls. Take a heaped tablespoon at a time, press it firmly in your fist, then roll it smooth. Work quickly while the mixture is still warm, as it turns crumbly when it cools.
seg.ff3eb71729c2.t: छोट-छोट लड्डू बनाउ। एक बेरमे एक भरल पैघ चम्मच लिअ, मुट्ठीमे कसि कऽ दबाउ, फेर घुमा कऽ चिक्कन करू। मिश्रण गरम रहिते जल्दी-जल्दी काज करू, किएक तँ सेरेला पर ई भुरभुरा भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.ff3eb71729c2.back: Make small laddus. Take one filled big spoon at a time, press tightly in the fist, then roll to make smooth. Work quickly while the mixture is warm, because on cooling it becomes crumbly.

seg.ee9e027268aa.src: Leave the balls on a plate until they cool completely, about 15 minutes, then store them in an airtight jar.
seg.ee9e027268aa.t: लड्डू सभकेँ थारी पर छोड़ि दिअ जा धरि पूरा सेरा नहि जाय, करीब 15 मिनट, फेर हवाबंद डिब्बामे राखू।
seg.ee9e027268aa.back: Leave the laddus on the plate until fully cooled, about 15 minutes, then keep in an airtight box.

seg.7fe633314020.src: Roast on a low flame and keep stirring; sesame goes from golden to burnt quickly, and burnt sesame tastes bitter.
seg.7fe633314020.t: मद्धिम आँच पर चलबैत भूजू; तिल सुनहरा सँ जल्दिये जरि जाइत अछि, आ जरल तिल तीत लगैत अछि।
seg.7fe633314020.back: Roast on low flame while stirring; sesame burns quickly from golden, and burnt sesame tastes bitter.

seg.d50b37351252.src: Grind in short pulses only; long runs turn sesame into an oily paste.
seg.d50b37351252.t: मात्र थोड़-थोड़ चला कऽ पीसू; बेसी देर चलेला सँ तिल तेलगर लेई बनि जाइत अछि।
seg.d50b37351252.back: Grind only running a little at a time; running a long time makes the sesame into an oily paste.

seg.75f5428655c4.src: Shape while the mixture is warm. If it turns crumbly, pulse it once more with a teaspoon of grated jaggery.
seg.75f5428655c4.t: मिश्रण गरम रहिते लड्डू बनाउ। जँ भुरभुरा भऽ जाय, तँ एक छोट चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल गुड़ डालि कऽ एक बेर फेर चलाउ।
seg.75f5428655c4.back: Make laddus while the mixture is hot. If it becomes crumbly, add one small spoon of grated jaggery and run once again.

seg.1d42a24453d2.src: Soft jaggery binds best. If yours is hard, grate it finely so it blends in evenly.
seg.1d42a24453d2.t: नरम गुड़ सभ सँ नीक जकाँ बान्हैत अछि। जँ अहाँक गुड़ कड़ा अछि, तँ महीन कद्दूकस करू जाहि सँ ओ एक समान मिलि जाय।
seg.1d42a24453d2.back: Soft jaggery binds best of all. If your jaggery is hard, grate it fine so that it mixes evenly.

seg.5a7ed16f4810.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for darker chimmili with a smoky sweetness.
seg.5a7ed16f4810.t: ताड़क गुड़: बेसी गाढ़ रंगक आ धुआँ सन मिठासबला चिम्मिलि लेल ओतबे कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़ प्रयोग करू।
seg.5a7ed16f4810.back: Palm jaggery: for chimmili of darker colour and with smoke-like sweetness use the same amount of grated palm jaggery.

seg.569a63f3cd17.src: Black sesame (nalla nuvvulu): roast and grind it the same way for darker, stronger-tasting balls.
seg.569a63f3cd17.t: कारी तिल (नल्ल नुव्वुलु): बेसी गाढ़ आ तेज स्वादबला लड्डू लेल एकरो ओहिना भूजू आ पीसू।
seg.569a63f3cd17.back: Black sesame (nalla nuvvulu): for laddus with deeper and sharper taste roast and grind this too the same way.

seg.da0d1a9b6378.src: Peanut or coconut: pulse in 2 tbsp roasted peanuts or grated dry coconut with the jaggery.
seg.da0d1a9b6378.t: मूँगफली वा नारियल: गुड़क संग 2 पैघ चम्मच भूजल मूँगफली वा कद्दूकस कयल सुखल नारियल डालि कऽ चलाउ।
seg.da0d1a9b6378.back: Peanut or coconut: add 2 big spoons of roasted peanuts or grated dried coconut along with the jaggery and run.

seg.32d41fc0994e.src: Without a mixer: pound the warm sesame and jaggery together in a stone mortar (rolu) until the mixture holds, then shape.
seg.32d41fc0994e.t: बिना मिक्सरक: गरम तिल आ गुड़केँ पाथरक ओखरि (रोलु) मे संग-संग कुटू, जा धरि मिश्रण बान्हय नहि लागय, फेर लड्डू बनाउ।
seg.32d41fc0994e.back: Without a mixer: pound the hot sesame and jaggery together in a stone mortar (rolu), until the mixture starts to bind, then make laddus.

seg.2fa9aaef4425.src: On Nagula Chavithi morning, offer chimmili with milk at the snake anthill (putta) or in your puja, then share them as prasadam. They also go well with evening tea.
seg.2fa9aaef4425.t: नागुल चवितिक भोरमे साँपक बाँबी (पुट्ट) पर वा अपन पूजामे दूधक संग चिम्मिलि चढ़ाउ, फेर प्रसादक रूपमे बाँटू। साँझक चाहक संग सेहो ई नीक लगैत अछि।
seg.2fa9aaef4425.back: On the morning of Nagula Chavithi offer chimmili with milk at the snake's anthill (putta) or in your own puja, then distribute as prasad. It also tastes good with evening tea.

seg.bd50831bbb3f.src: Keeps a week in an airtight jar. Store the jar at room temperature, in a dry place.
seg.bd50831bbb3f.t: हवाबंद डिब्बामे एक सप्ताह धरि ठीक रहैत अछि। डिब्बाकेँ कोठलीक तापमान पर, सुखल जगहमे राखू।
seg.bd50831bbb3f.back: Stays fine in an airtight box up to one week. Keep the box at room temperature, in a dry place.

seg.4023b0de08bd.src: Why is my chimmili not holding together?
seg.4023b0de08bd.t: हमर चिम्मिलि किएक नहि बन्हाइत अछि?
seg.4023b0de08bd.back: Why does my chimmili not bind?

seg.7fed90d1ebe0.src: The sesame may be under-ground, or the mixture may have cooled. Pulse it once more with 1–2 tsp extra grated jaggery and shape it while it is still warm.
seg.7fed90d1ebe0.t: भऽ सकैत अछि जे तिल ठीक सँ नहि पिसायल हो, वा मिश्रण सेरा गेल हो। 1–2 छोट चम्मच आओर कद्दूकस कयल गुड़ डालि कऽ एक बेर फेर चलाउ आ गरम रहिते लड्डू बनाउ।
seg.7fed90d1ebe0.back: It may be that the sesame was not ground properly, or the mixture has cooled. Add 1–2 small spoons more grated jaggery, run once again and make laddus while hot.

seg.694d2b416f39.src: Why does my chimmili taste bitter?
seg.694d2b416f39.t: हमर चिम्मिलि किएक तीत लगैत अछि?
seg.694d2b416f39.back: Why does my chimmili taste bitter?

seg.d0ee77d0957e.src: The sesame was roasted too dark. Roast it on a low flame only until it crackles and turns light golden, then tip it onto a plate at once so it stops browning.
seg.d0ee77d0957e.t: तिल बेसी गाढ़ धरि भुजा गेल। तिलकेँ मद्धिम आँच पर मात्र तखन धरि भूजू जा धरि ओ चटचटाय नहि लागय आ हल्लुक सुनहरा नहि भऽ जाय, फेर तुरंत थारीमे ढारि दिअ जाहि सँ ओ आर भूरा नहि हो।
seg.d0ee77d0957e.back: The sesame got roasted too dark. Roast the sesame on low flame only until it starts to crackle and becomes light golden, then immediately pour onto a plate so that it does not brown more.

seg.30d31a37acfa.src: Can I use palm jaggery instead of cane jaggery?
seg.30d31a37acfa.t: की कुसियारक गुड़क बदला ताड़क गुड़ प्रयोग कऽ सकैत छी?
seg.30d31a37acfa.back: Can I use palm jaggery instead of sugarcane jaggery?

seg.77afe99f558c.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The chimmili will be darker, with a deeper, slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.77afe99f558c.t: हँ। ओतबे कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़ (ताटि बेल्लम) प्रयोग करू। चिम्मिलि बेसी गाढ़ रंगक होयत, आ मिठास बेसी गहींर, कनेक धुआँ सन।
seg.77afe99f558c.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (tati bellam). The chimmili will be darker in colour, and the sweetness deeper, a little smoke-like.

seg.4b090c2ce3d3.src: Filter coffee is how many Telugu homes start the day: a strong decoction dripped through a steel filter, topped up with hot milk and frothed between a tumbler and davara. This version is sweetened with grated palm jaggery (thati bellam) in place of sugar.
seg.4b090c2ce3d3.t: बहुत रास तेलुगु घरमे दिनक शुरुआत फिल्टर कॉफी सँ होइत अछि: स्टीलक फिल्टर सँ टपकल कड़गर डिकॉक्शन, ओहिमे गरम दूध मिला कऽ टम्बलर आ दवराक बीच ढारि-ढारि झाग उठाओल जाइत अछि। एहिमे चीनीक बदला कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़ (ताटि बेल्लम) सँ मीठ कयल गेल अछि।
seg.4b090c2ce3d3.back: In many Telugu homes the day starts with filter coffee: strong decoction dripped from a steel filter, hot milk mixed into it and froth raised by pouring back and forth between tumbler and davara. In this it has been sweetened with grated palm jaggery (tati bellam) instead of sugar.

seg.cff6d2079da1.src: Palm jaggery gives the cup a deep, slightly smoky caramel sweetness that sits well with the bitterness of the decoction. Once the decoction is ready it takes about 5 minutes, and it suits a slow morning as much as an evening break.
seg.cff6d2079da1.t: ताड़क गुड़ कपकेँ गहींर, कनेक धुआँ सन कैरामेल मिठास दैत अछि, जे डिकॉक्शनक तितपनक संग नीक जकाँ मेल खाइत अछि। डिकॉक्शन तैयार भेलाक बाद करीब 5 मिनट लगैत अछि, आ ई फुरसतिक भोर लेल ओतबे नीक अछि जतबा साँझक विश्राम लेल।
seg.cff6d2079da1.back: Palm jaggery gives the cup a deep, slightly smoke-like caramel sweetness, which matches well with the bitterness of the decoction. After the decoction is ready it takes about 5 minutes, and it is as good for a leisurely morning as for evening rest.

seg.814efc526088.src: 5 minutes if your decoction is already made.
seg.814efc526088.t: जँ डिकॉक्शन पहिने सँ बनल अछि तँ 5 मिनट।
seg.814efc526088.back: 5 minutes if the decoction is already made.

seg.9ad0a1e24d76.src: Boil the milk, add it to the decoction, then stir in grated palm jaggery off the heat. Froth it between tumbler and davara.
seg.9ad0a1e24d76.t: दूध खौलाउ, डिकॉक्शनमे मिलाउ, फेर आँच सँ उतारि कऽ कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़ घोरू। टम्बलर आ दवराक बीच ढारि कऽ झाग उठाउ।
seg.9ad0a1e24d76.back: Boil the milk, mix into the decoction, then take off the flame and dissolve grated palm jaggery. Pour between tumbler and davara to raise froth.

seg.927b924ff51d.src: 2 tbsp filter coffee powder ⟦1⟧enough decoction for 2–3 cups⟦/1⟧
seg.927b924ff51d.t: 2 पैघ चम्मच फिल्टर कॉफी पाउडर ⟦1⟧2–3 कप लेल पर्याप्त डिकॉक्शन⟦/1⟧
seg.927b924ff51d.back: 2 big spoons filter coffee powder ⟦1⟧decoction sufficient for 2–3 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.8aa60818ccf8.src: ½ cup water, just off the boil
seg.8aa60818ccf8.t: ½ कप पानि, खौलि कऽ एखने उतारल
seg.8aa60818ccf8.back: ½ cup water, boiled and just taken off

seg.95409b9d346e.src: 2 tbsp filter coffee decoction ⟦1⟧from above; 3 tbsp for a stronger cup⟦/1⟧
seg.95409b9d346e.t: 2 पैघ चम्मच फिल्टर कॉफीक डिकॉक्शन ⟦1⟧ऊपर बनाओल; कड़गर कप लेल 3 पैघ चम्मच⟦/1⟧
seg.95409b9d346e.back: 2 big spoons filter coffee decoction ⟦1⟧made above; 3 big spoons for a strong cup⟦/1⟧

seg.7b8c0f7e922a.t: 1–2 छोट चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़ ⟦1⟧स्वाद अनुसार⟦/1⟧
seg.7b8c0f7e922a.back: 1–2 small spoons grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧according to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.95d91fecafcb.src: Make the decoction: put 2 tbsp filter coffee powder in the top chamber of a South Indian coffee filter, set the perforated press on it and pour in ½ cup water just off the boil. Cover and leave it to drip for 10–15 minutes.
seg.95d91fecafcb.t: डिकॉक्शन बनाउ: दक्षिण भारतीय कॉफी फिल्टरक ऊपरका भागमे 2 पैघ चम्मच फिल्टर कॉफी पाउडर डालू, ओहि पर छेदबला प्रेस राखू आ एखने खौलल ½ कप पानि ढारू। झाँपि कऽ 10–15 मिनट धरि टपकऽ दिअ।
seg.95d91fecafcb.back: Make the decoction: put 2 big spoons of filter coffee powder in the upper part of a South Indian coffee filter, place the holed press on it and pour ½ cup of just-boiled water. Cover and let it drip for 10–15 minutes.

seg.9024c8716b54.src: While it drips, grate the palm jaggery finely so it dissolves in seconds.
seg.9024c8716b54.t: जा धरि टपकैत अछि, ताड़क गुड़ महीन कद्दूकस कऽ लिअ, जाहि सँ ओ किछुए सेकेंडमे घुलि जाय।
seg.9024c8716b54.back: While it drips, grate the palm jaggery fine, so that it dissolves within a few seconds.

seg.24689e3dd311.src: Pour the milk into a small saucepan and set it on medium heat.
seg.24689e3dd311.t: दूधकेँ एकटा छोट तसलामे ढारू आ मध्यम आँच पर राखू।
seg.24689e3dd311.back: Pour the milk into a small pan (tasla) and put on medium flame.

seg.4d8e3042dc81.src: Bring the milk to a boil. As soon as it froths up the sides of the pan, switch off the heat.
seg.4d8e3042dc81.t: दूध खौलाउ। जहाँ ओ बरतनक कात धरि उफनाय, आँच बन्न कऽ दिअ।
seg.4d8e3042dc81.back: Boil the milk. As soon as it boils up to the edge of the vessel, turn off the flame.

seg.a124a0d34983.src: Pour the decoction into a tumbler and add the hot milk. Use 2 tbsp decoction for a mild cup and 3 tbsp for a strong one.
seg.a124a0d34983.t: डिकॉक्शनकेँ टम्बलरमे ढारू आ गरम दूध मिलाउ। हल्लुक कप लेल 2 पैघ चम्मच आ कड़गर कप लेल 3 पैघ चम्मच डिकॉक्शन प्रयोग करू।
seg.a124a0d34983.back: Pour the decoction into the tumbler and mix the hot milk. Use 2 big spoons of decoction for a light cup and 3 big spoons for a strong cup.

seg.85570720618b.src: Let it stand for about a minute, so the milk is just off the boil.
seg.85570720618b.t: करीब एक मिनट ओहिना रहऽ दिअ, जाहि सँ दूधक उफान कनेक कम भऽ जाय।
seg.85570720618b.back: Let it stay as it is for about a minute, so that the milk's boiling-up reduces a little.

seg.eacea0d7cf43.src: Stir in the palm jaggery off the heat. Keep stirring for 20–30 seconds, until no grains are left at the bottom of the tumbler.
seg.eacea0d7cf43.t: आँच सँ हटा कऽ ताड़क गुड़ घोरू। 20–30 सेकेंड धरि चलबैत रहू, जा धरि टम्बलरक तरमे कोनो दाना नहि बचय।
seg.eacea0d7cf43.back: Remove from the flame and dissolve the palm jaggery. Keep stirring for 20–30 seconds, until no granule remains at the bottom of the tumbler.

seg.08b600da2ef8.src: Taste, and add a little more jaggery if you like it sweeter.
seg.08b600da2ef8.t: चीखू, आ जँ बेसी मीठ पसिन्न अछि तँ कनेक आओर गुड़ मिलाउ।
seg.08b600da2ef8.back: Taste, and if you like it sweeter mix a little more jaggery.

seg.878b0d8d7eeb.src: Pour between tumbler and davara to froth. Hold the tumbler high and pour into the davara, then back again, 3–4 times, until a light foam sits on top.
seg.878b0d8d7eeb.t: झाग उठेबाक लेल टम्बलर आ दवराक बीच ढारू। टम्बलरकेँ ऊँच पकड़ि कऽ दवरामे ढारू, फेर घुरा कऽ, 3–4 बेर, जा धरि ऊपर हल्लुक झाग नहि बैसि जाय।
seg.878b0d8d7eeb.back: To raise froth pour between tumbler and davara. Holding the tumbler high pour into the davara, then back, 3–4 times, until a light froth settles on top.

seg.653390b95f57.src: Serve straight away, in the tumbler set inside the davara.
seg.653390b95f57.t: तुरंत परसू, दवराक भीतर राखल टम्बलरमे।
seg.653390b95f57.back: Serve immediately, in the tumbler placed inside the davara.

seg.33aca43ebf99.src: Add jaggery after the milk is off the boil so it does not split.
seg.33aca43ebf99.t: दूधक उफान कम भेलाक बादे गुड़ मिलाउ, जाहि सँ दूध नहि फाटय।
seg.33aca43ebf99.back: Mix the jaggery only after the milk's boiling-up has reduced, so that the milk does not curdle.

seg.60404da43771.src: Grate the jaggery finely: fine shreds dissolve in seconds, while lumps sink and stay at the bottom of the tumbler.
seg.60404da43771.t: गुड़ महीन कद्दूकस करू: महीन टुकड़ी किछुए सेकेंडमे घुलि जाइत अछि, मुदा ढेला डूबि कऽ टम्बलरक तरमे रहि जाइत अछि।
seg.60404da43771.back: Grate the jaggery fine: fine bits dissolve within a few seconds, but lumps sink and stay at the bottom of the tumbler.

seg.ca883342300e.src: Palm jaggery has a deep, slightly smoky sweetness, so start with 1 tsp and add more to taste.
seg.ca883342300e.t: ताड़क गुड़क मिठास गहींर, कनेक धुआँ सन होइत अछि, तेँ 1 छोट चम्मच सँ शुरू करू आ स्वाद अनुसार बढ़ाउ।
seg.ca883342300e.back: Palm jaggery's sweetness is deep, a little smoke-like, so start from 1 small spoon and increase according to taste.

seg.d7c0084f5cc6.src: A steel tumbler and davara keep the coffee hot and make frothing easy; a mug and a jug work too.
seg.d7c0084f5cc6.t: स्टीलक टम्बलर आ दवरा कॉफीकेँ गरम रखैत अछि आ झाग उठायब सहज बनबैत अछि; मग आ जग सँ सेहो काज चलि जाइत अछि।
seg.d7c0084f5cc6.back: A steel tumbler and davara keep the coffee hot and make raising froth easy; work gets done with a mug and jug too.

seg.1b917ac5fc8c.src: Cane jaggery: use the same amount of grated cane jaggery for a lighter, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.1b917ac5fc8c.t: कुसियारक गुड़: बेसी हल्लुक, कैरामेल सन मिठास लेल ओतबे कद्दूकस कयल कुसियारक गुड़ प्रयोग करू।
seg.1b917ac5fc8c.back: Sugarcane jaggery: for a lighter, caramel-like sweetness use the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery.

seg.0ada954bebfe.src: Palm jaggery tea: make your usual milk tea, switch off the heat, wait a minute, then stir in the palm jaggery the same way.
seg.0ada954bebfe.t: ताड़क गुड़क चाह: अपन सदाक दूधबला चाह बनाउ, आँच बन्न करू, एक मिनट रुकू, फेर ओहिना ताड़क गुड़ घोरू।
seg.0ada954bebfe.back: Palm jaggery tea: make your usual milk tea, turn off the flame, wait one minute, then dissolve palm jaggery the same way.

seg.6512d133d4c0.src: No coffee filter: dissolve 1 tsp instant coffee in 2 tbsp hot water and use it in place of the decoction.
seg.6512d133d4c0.t: कॉफी फिल्टर नहि अछि: 2 पैघ चम्मच गरम पानिमे 1 छोट चम्मच इंस्टेंट कॉफी घोरि कऽ डिकॉक्शनक बदला प्रयोग करू।
seg.6512d133d4c0.back: No coffee filter: dissolve 1 small spoon instant coffee in 2 big spoons hot water and use instead of decoction.

seg.e9e80ce83cf6.src: Serve hot after a breakfast of idli, dosa or upma, or in the evening with biscuits or murukulu.
seg.e9e80ce83cf6.t: इडली, डोसा वा उपमाक जलखैक बाद, वा साँझमे बिस्कुट वा मुरुकुलुक संग गरमे-गरम परसू।
seg.e9e80ce83cf6.back: Serve piping hot after a breakfast of idli, dosa or upma, or in the evening with biscuits or murukulu.

seg.97817ad1f29f.src: Make each cup as you need it; coffee reheated after the jaggery goes in can split. Keep extra decoction covered at room temperature and use it within the day.
seg.97817ad1f29f.t: हर कप जखन चाही तखने बनाउ; गुड़ पड़लाक बाद फेर सँ गरम कयल कॉफी फाटि सकैत अछि। बचल डिकॉक्शन झाँपि कऽ कोठलीक तापमान पर राखू आ ओही दिन प्रयोग कऽ लिअ।
seg.97817ad1f29f.back: Make each cup just when wanted; coffee reheated after jaggery is added can curdle. Keep leftover decoction covered at room temperature and use it the same day.

seg.ea4f4072538a.src: Why did my coffee curdle when I added palm jaggery?
seg.ea4f4072538a.t: ताड़क गुड़ मिलेला पर हमर कॉफी किएक फाटि गेल?
seg.ea4f4072538a.back: Why did my coffee curdle on mixing palm jaggery?

seg.180a2670ead3.src: Jaggery stirred into milk that is still boiling can make it split. Take the milk off the heat, let it stand for about a minute, then stir in the grated jaggery.
seg.180a2670ead3.t: जे दूध एखनो खौलि रहल अछि, ओहिमे गुड़ घोरला सँ दूध फाटि सकैत अछि। दूधकेँ आँच सँ उतारू, करीब एक मिनट रहऽ दिअ, फेर कद्दूकस कयल गुड़ घोरू।
seg.180a2670ead3.back: Dissolving jaggery in milk that is still boiling can curdle the milk. Take the milk off the flame, let it stay about one minute, then dissolve the grated jaggery.

seg.2b9449407096.src: Can I use cane jaggery instead of palm jaggery?
seg.2b9449407096.t: की ताड़क गुड़क बदला कुसियारक गुड़ प्रयोग कऽ सकैत छी?
seg.2b9449407096.back: Can I use sugarcane jaggery instead of palm jaggery?

seg.890ae3e15593.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery. The coffee tastes lighter and more like caramel, while palm jaggery gives a deeper, slightly smoky cup.
seg.890ae3e15593.t: हँ। ओतबे कद्दूकस कयल कुसियारक गुड़ प्रयोग करू। कॉफीक स्वाद बेसी हल्लुक आ कैरामेल सन होइत अछि, जखन कि ताड़क गुड़ बेसी गहींर, कनेक धुआँ सन स्वाद दैत अछि।
seg.890ae3e15593.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery. The coffee's taste becomes lighter and caramel-like, whereas palm jaggery gives a deeper, slightly smoke-like taste.

seg.e4c92d1c8a42.src: How much palm jaggery should I add to one cup of coffee?
seg.e4c92d1c8a42.t: एक कप कॉफीमे कतेक ताड़क गुड़ मिलाबी?
seg.e4c92d1c8a42.back: How much palm jaggery should I mix in one cup of coffee?

seg.43a5dfb10340.src: 1 to 2 tsp of grated palm jaggery for 1 cup of milk and 2 tbsp of decoction. Start with 1 tsp, taste, and add more if you like.
seg.43a5dfb10340.t: 1 कप दूध आ 2 पैघ चम्मच डिकॉक्शन लेल 1 सँ 2 छोट चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़। 1 छोट चम्मच सँ शुरू करू, चीखू, आ मोन हो तँ आओर मिलाउ।
seg.43a5dfb10340.back: For 1 cup milk and 2 big spoons decoction, 1 to 2 small spoons grated palm jaggery. Start from 1 small spoon, taste, and if you wish mix more.

seg.2ba4fb9452bb.src: Can I make palm jaggery coffee without a coffee filter?
seg.2ba4fb9452bb.t: की कॉफी फिल्टरक बिना ताड़क गुड़क कॉफी बना सकैत छी?
seg.2ba4fb9452bb.back: Can I make palm jaggery coffee without a coffee filter?

seg.23f63da2d908.src: Yes. Dissolve 1 tsp instant coffee in 2 tbsp hot water, use it in place of the decoction and follow the same steps.
seg.23f63da2d908.t: हँ। 2 पैघ चम्मच गरम पानिमे 1 छोट चम्मच इंस्टेंट कॉफी घोरू, डिकॉक्शनक बदला प्रयोग करू आ ओही डेग सभक पालन करू।
seg.23f63da2d908.back: Yes. Dissolve 1 small spoon instant coffee in 2 big spoons hot water, use instead of decoction and follow the same steps.

seg.4fce579abe5f.src: తాటి బెల్లం కాఫీ · Palm Jaggery Coffee Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.4fce579abe5f.t: తాటి బెల్లం కాఫీ · ताड़क गुड़क कॉफीक रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.4fce579abe5f.back: తాటి బెల్లం కాఫీ · Recipe of palm jaggery coffee | 1acrefarms

seg.08ada9e6791e.src: తాటి బెల్లం కాఫీ. Palm jaggery coffee (thati bellam coffee), the Andhra way: filter decoction, hot milk and grated palm jaggery stirred in off the heat. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.08ada9e6791e.t: తాటి బెల్లం కాఫీ. ताड़क गुड़क कॉफी (ताटि बेल्लम कॉफी), आन्ध्रक तरीका सँ: फिल्टर डिकॉक्शन, गरम दूध आ आँच सँ उतारि कऽ घोरल कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़। डेग-डेग विधि, सुझाव आ बेर-बेर पूछल जाइत प्रश्न।
seg.08ada9e6791e.back: తాటి బెల్లం కాఫీ. Palm jaggery coffee (tati bellam coffee), in the Andhra way: filter decoction, hot milk and grated palm jaggery dissolved after taking off the flame. Step-by-step method, tips and frequently asked questions.

seg.0fc7db27d3fc.src: Palm Jaggery Coffee: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.0fc7db27d3fc.t: ताड़क गुड़क कॉफी: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.0fc7db27d3fc.back: Palm jaggery coffee: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.6f7677a99e8c.t: 1–2 छोट चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़

seg.1143d51ba236.src: Paramannam is the rice-and-milk sweet that Telugu homes cook for festivals and pujas: rice simmered slowly in milk until soft and creamy, then sweetened. Bellam paramannam, made with jaggery, is a common naivedyam at Diwali, Sankranti and Varalakshmi Vratham, offered at the puja and then shared at the festive meal.
seg.1143d51ba236.t: परमान्नम चाउर आ दूधक मिठाइ अछि, जे तेलुगु घरमे पावनि-तिहार आ पूजा लेल बनाओल जाइत अछि: चाउरकेँ दूधमे धीरे-धीरे पकाओल जाइत अछि जा धरि ओ नरम आ मलाईदार नहि भऽ जाय, फेर मीठ कयल जाइत अछि। गुड़ सँ बनल बेल्लम परमान्नम दिवाली, संक्रान्ति आ वरलक्ष्मी व्रतम्‌मे चढ़ाओल जाइत एकटा आम नैवेद्य अछि, जे पूजामे चढ़ा कऽ फेर पावनिक भोजमे बाँटल जाइत अछि।
seg.1143d51ba236.back: Paramannam is a sweet of rice and milk, which is made in Telugu homes for festivals and puja: the rice is cooked slowly in milk until it becomes soft and creamy, then made sweet. Bellam paramannam made with jaggery is a common naivedyam offered at Diwali, Sankranti and Varalakshmi Vratam, which after offering in puja is then distributed at the festival meal.

seg.360051f42785.src: Cane jaggery turns it a light caramel colour and gives a rounder, toffee-like sweetness. Ghee-fried cashews and a little cardamom finish it. This recipe serves 4.
seg.360051f42785.t: कुसियारक गुड़ एकरा हल्लुक कैरामेल रंगक बना दैत अछि आ भरल-पुरल, टॉफी सन मिठास दैत अछि। अन्तमे घीमे भूजल काजू आ कनेक इलायची पड़ैत अछि। ई रेसिपी 4 लोक लेल अछि।
seg.360051f42785.back: Sugarcane jaggery makes it a light caramel colour and gives a rich, toffee-like sweetness. At the end cashews roasted in ghee and a little cardamom go in. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.04a51f6c83e4.src: Total includes the 5-minute rest before the jaggery goes in.
seg.04a51f6c83e4.t: कुल समयमे गुड़ मिलेबा सँ पहिने 5 मिनट छोड़बाक समय सेहो जोड़ल अछि।
seg.04a51f6c83e4.back: The total time also includes the 5 minutes of leaving it before mixing jaggery.

seg.fd8f49fce13b.src: Cook rice in milk till creamy, rest it 5 minutes, then stir in grated cane jaggery. Finish with ghee-fried cashews and cardamom.
seg.fd8f49fce13b.t: चाउरकेँ दूधमे मलाईदार होबा धरि पकाउ, 5 मिनट छोड़ि दिअ, फेर कद्दूकस कयल कुसियारक गुड़ घोरू। अन्तमे घीमे भूजल काजू आ इलायची डालू।
seg.fd8f49fce13b.back: Cook the rice in milk until creamy, leave 5 minutes, then dissolve grated sugarcane jaggery. At the end add cashews roasted in ghee and cardamom.

seg.1c0f194a4451.src: ½ cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori or another short-grain rice, about 100 g⟦/1⟧
seg.1c0f194a4451.t: ½ कप चाउर ⟦1⟧सोना मसूरी वा कोनो आन छोट दानाक चाउर, करीब 100 g⟦/1⟧
seg.1c0f194a4451.back: ½ cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masuri or any other short-grain rice, about 100 g⟦/1⟧

seg.8f34922ee281.src: 4 cups milk ⟦1⟧about 1 litre; whole milk gives the creamiest result⟦/1⟧
seg.8f34922ee281.t: 4 कप दूध ⟦1⟧करीब 1 लीटर; फुल क्रीम दूध सँ सभ सँ बेसी मलाईदार बनैत अछि⟦/1⟧
seg.8f34922ee281.back: 4 cups milk ⟦1⟧about 1 litre; full cream milk makes it the most creamy⟦/1⟧

seg.ee0c3b96837f.src: ¾ cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed; up to 2 tbsp more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.ee0c3b96837f.t: ¾ कप कद्दूकस कयल कुसियारक गुड़ ⟦1⟧हल्लुक दबा कऽ भरल; बेसी मीठ पसिन्न हो तँ 2 पैघ चम्मच धरि आओर⟦/1⟧
seg.ee0c3b96837f.back: ¾ cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧filled lightly pressed; if you like it sweeter, up to 2 big spoons more⟦/1⟧

seg.fa014766d2bf.src: ½ tsp cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 4–5 pods⟦/1⟧
seg.fa014766d2bf.t: ½ छोट चम्मच इलायची बुकनी ⟦1⟧वा 4–5 टा इलायचीक कूटल दाना⟦/1⟧
seg.fa014766d2bf.back: ½ small spoon cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or crushed seeds of 4–5 cardamoms⟦/1⟧

seg.480e0a7d227f.src: Wash the rice in 2–3 changes of water until the water runs almost clear, then drain it well.
seg.480e0a7d227f.t: चाउरकेँ 2–3 बेर पानि बदलि कऽ धोउ, जा धरि पानि करीब-करीब साफ नहि निकलय, फेर नीक जकाँ पानि निथारि दिअ।
seg.480e0a7d227f.back: Wash the rice changing the water 2–3 times, until the water comes out nearly clean, then drain the water well.

seg.d5b0fc46818a.src: Pour the milk into a heavy-bottomed pan and bring it to a boil on medium heat, about 8–10 minutes. Stir now and then so it does not catch at the bottom.
seg.d5b0fc46818a.t: दूधकेँ भारी तरबला बरतनमे ढारू आ मध्यम आँच पर खौलाउ, करीब 8–10 मिनट। बीच-बीचमे चलबैत रहू जाहि सँ तरमे नहि लागय।
seg.d5b0fc46818a.back: Pour the milk into a heavy-bottomed vessel and boil on medium flame, about 8–10 minutes. Keep stirring now and then so that it does not stick at the bottom.

seg.b8f9c8c6758b.src: Add the drained rice to the boiling milk and turn the heat to low.
seg.b8f9c8c6758b.t: निथारल चाउर खौलैत दूधमे डालू आ आँच मद्धिम कऽ दिअ।
seg.b8f9c8c6758b.back: Add the drained rice to the boiling milk and turn the flame low.

seg.9ae9baab76d7.src: Cook the washed rice in the milk on a low flame till soft and creamy, about 30 minutes. Stir often, scraping the bottom and sides of the pan each time.
seg.9ae9baab76d7.t: धोल चाउरकेँ दूधमे मद्धिम आँच पर नरम आ मलाईदार होबा धरि पकाउ, करीब 30 मिनट। बेर-बेर चलाउ, हर बेर बरतनक तर आ कात खरोचैत।
seg.9ae9baab76d7.back: Cook the washed rice in milk on low flame until soft and creamy, about 30 minutes. Stir again and again, each time scraping the bottom and sides of the vessel.

seg.ec1509a08b4c.src: Check the rice: a grain should mash easily between your fingers, and the milk should have thickened slightly. For a creamier paramannam, lightly mash a few grains against the side of the pan.
seg.ec1509a08b4c.t: चाउर जाँचू: एकटा दाना आँगुरक बीच सहजहि मसलि जेबाक चाही, आ दूध कनेक गाढ़ भऽ गेल हेबाक चाही। बेसी मलाईदार परमान्नम लेल किछु दानाकेँ बरतनक कात सँ सटा कऽ हल्लुक मसलि दिअ।
seg.ec1509a08b4c.back: Check the rice: one grain should mash easily between the fingers, and the milk should have become a little thick. For a creamier paramannam, press some grains against the side of the vessel and mash lightly.

seg.d8ba0a82f4ec.src: Switch off and let it rest 5 minutes. This brings the milk below the boil, so the jaggery will not split it.
seg.d8ba0a82f4ec.t: आँच बन्न कऽ 5 मिनट छोड़ि दिअ। एहि सँ दूध खौलबाक तापमान सँ नीचाँ आबि जाइत अछि, तेँ गुड़ सँ दूध नहि फाटत।
seg.d8ba0a82f4ec.back: Turn off the flame and leave 5 minutes. With this the milk comes below boiling temperature, so the jaggery will not curdle the milk.

seg.ca16c98d9b18.src: Stir in the jaggery till it melts, about 1–2 minutes, keeping the pan off the heat.
seg.ca16c98d9b18.t: बरतनकेँ आँच सँ हटा कऽ राखैत, गुड़ घोरू जा धरि ओ गलि नहि जाय, करीब 1–2 मिनट।
seg.ca16c98d9b18.back: Keeping the vessel off the flame, dissolve the jaggery until it melts, about 1–2 minutes.

seg.74412a8cc141.src: Taste, and stir in a little more grated jaggery if you want it sweeter.
seg.74412a8cc141.t: चीखू, आ जँ बेसी मीठ चाही तँ कनेक आओर कद्दूकस कयल गुड़ घोरि दिअ।
seg.74412a8cc141.back: Taste, and if you want it sweeter dissolve a little more grated jaggery.

seg.92b56df40ea6.src: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat.
seg.92b56df40ea6.t: एकटा छोट पैनमे मध्यम सँ कम आँच पर घी गरम करू।
seg.92b56df40ea6.back: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium-to-low flame.

seg.1bb1f411e4d0.src: Fry the cashews in ghee; add with the cardamom. Stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding the raisins for the last few seconds until they puff up. Pour the nuts and ghee into the paramannam, sprinkle in the cardamom powder and stir.
seg.1bb1f411e4d0.t: काजूकेँ घीमे भूजू; इलायचीक संग डालू। काजूकेँ सुनहरा होबा धरि चलाउ, करीब 1 मिनट, अन्तिम किछु सेकेंडमे किशमिश डालि दिअ जा धरि ओ फूलि नहि जाय। काजू-किशमिश आ घी परमान्नममे ढारू, इलायची बुकनी छिड़कू आ चलाउ।
seg.1bb1f411e4d0.back: Roast the cashews in ghee; add with the cardamom. Stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, in the last few seconds add the raisins until they swell. Pour the cashew-raisins and ghee into the paramannam, sprinkle cardamom powder and stir.

seg.e10b7192c157.src: Serve warm. Paramannam thickens as it stands; loosen it with a few spoons of warm milk, off the heat, if needed.
seg.e10b7192c157.t: गुनगुना परसू। राखल रहला पर परमान्नम गाढ़ भऽ जाइत अछि; जरूरति हो तँ आँच सँ बाहरे किछु चम्मच गुनगुना दूध मिला कऽ पातर करू।
seg.e10b7192c157.back: Serve lukewarm. On standing, paramannam becomes thick; if needed, off the flame mix a few spoons of lukewarm milk and make it thin.

seg.d30196cf6b28.src: Jaggery goes in off the heat so the milk does not split.
seg.d30196cf6b28.t: गुड़ आँच सँ हटेलाक बाद पड़ैत अछि, जाहि सँ दूध नहि फाटय।
seg.d30196cf6b28.back: The jaggery goes in after removing from the flame, so that the milk does not curdle.

seg.d4a9c2ee09bf.src: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and scrape the bottom each time you stir; milk catches easily during the long simmer.
seg.d4a9c2ee09bf.t: भारी तरबला बरतन प्रयोग करू आ हर बेर चलबैत काल तर खरोचू; बेसी देर धरि मद्धिम आँच पर पकबैत काल दूध सहजहि तरमे लागि जाइत अछि।
seg.d4a9c2ee09bf.back: Use a heavy-bottomed vessel and scrape the bottom each time while stirring; while cooking a long time on low flame milk easily sticks at the bottom.

seg.a01441abc0b6.src: Cook the rice until fully soft before the jaggery goes in; the grains do not soften further once it is sweetened.
seg.a01441abc0b6.t: गुड़ मिलेबा सँ पहिने चाउरकेँ पूरा नरम होबा धरि पकाउ; मीठ भेलाक बाद दाना आर नरम नहि होइत अछि।
seg.a01441abc0b6.back: Before mixing jaggery cook the rice until fully soft; after it becomes sweet the grains do not become softer.

seg.688b80a32383.src: Grate the jaggery finely so it melts in the hot milk without going back on the stove.
seg.688b80a32383.t: गुड़ महीन कद्दूकस करू जाहि सँ ओ चूल्हा पर फेर रखने बिना गरम दूधमे गलि जाय।
seg.688b80a32383.back: Grate the jaggery fine so that it melts in the hot milk without putting it back on the stove.

seg.7bf8faca62b8.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for a darker colour and a deeper, smoky sweetness.
seg.7bf8faca62b8.t: ताड़क गुड़: बेसी गाढ़ रंग आ बेसी गहींर, धुआँ सन मिठास लेल ओतबे कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़ प्रयोग करू।
seg.7bf8faca62b8.back: Palm jaggery: for darker colour and deeper, smoke-like sweetness use the same amount of grated palm jaggery.

seg.6672d2210281.src: Pesarapappu paramannam: dry-roast 2 tbsp split moong dal until light golden, wash it and cook it with the rice.
seg.6672d2210281.t: पेसरपप्पु परमान्नम: 2 पैघ चम्मच मूँगक दालि हल्लुक सुनहरा होबा धरि बिना तेल-घीक भूजू, धो कऽ चाउरक संग पकाउ।
seg.6672d2210281.back: Pesarapappu paramannam: roast 2 big spoons of moong dal without oil-ghee until light golden, wash and cook with the rice.

seg.cd25d9fb2a56.src: Coconut: fry 2 tbsp thin slivers of dry coconut in the ghee along with the cashews.
seg.cd25d9fb2a56.t: नारियल: सुखल नारियलक 2 पैघ चम्मच पातर-पातर टुकड़ी काजूक संग घीमे भूजू।
seg.cd25d9fb2a56.back: Coconut: roast 2 big spoons of thin pieces of dried coconut in ghee with the cashews.

seg.988ab75b5ccb.src: Serve warm as naivedyam at the Diwali or Lakshmi puja, then as the sweet at the festive meal. Some like it chilled the next day.
seg.988ab75b5ccb.t: दिवाली वा लक्ष्मी पूजामे नैवेद्यक रूपमे गुनगुना चढ़ाउ, फेर पावनिक भोजमे मिठाइक रूपमे परसू। किछु लोककेँ अगिला दिन ठंढा कऽ कऽ खाएब नीक लगैत अछि।
seg.988ab75b5ccb.back: At Diwali or Lakshmi puja offer it lukewarm as naivedyam, then serve as a sweet at the festival meal. Some people like eating it chilled the next day.

seg.4a60d211f14d.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. It sets thick when chilled; stir in a little warm milk, off the heat, before serving.
seg.4a60d211f14d.t: बचल परमान्नम झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे राखू आ 2 दिनक भीतर खा लिअ। ठंढा भेला पर ई गाढ़ जमि जाइत अछि; परसबा सँ पहिने आँच सँ बाहरे कनेक गुनगुना दूध मिला कऽ चलाउ।
seg.4a60d211f14d.back: Cover the leftover paramannam and keep in the fridge and eat within 2 days. On becoming cold it sets thick; before serving, off the flame mix a little lukewarm milk and stir.

seg.2949774c7efb.src: Why did my paramannam curdle after adding jaggery?
seg.2949774c7efb.t: गुड़ मिलेलाक बाद हमर परमान्नम किएक फाटि गेल?
seg.2949774c7efb.back: Why did my paramannam curdle after mixing jaggery?

seg.283626ae50fc.src: Jaggery stirred into milk that is still on the heat or boiling can make it split. Switch off, let the paramannam rest for about 5 minutes, then stir in the grated jaggery.
seg.283626ae50fc.t: जे दूध एखनो आँच पर अछि वा खौलि रहल अछि, ओहिमे गुड़ घोरला सँ दूध फाटि सकैत अछि। आँच बन्न करू, परमान्नमकेँ करीब 5 मिनट छोड़ि दिअ, फेर कद्दूकस कयल गुड़ घोरू।
seg.283626ae50fc.back: Dissolving jaggery in milk that is still on the flame or boiling can curdle the milk. Turn off the flame, leave the paramannam about 5 minutes, then dissolve grated jaggery.

seg.7df6976d1e83.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The paramannam turns darker and tastes deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7df6976d1e83.t: हँ। ओतबे कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़ (ताटि बेल्लम) प्रयोग करू। परमान्नम बेसी गाढ़ रंगक भऽ जाइत अछि आ स्वाद बेसी गहींर, कनेक धुआँ सन होइत अछि।
seg.7df6976d1e83.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (tati bellam). The paramannam becomes darker in colour and the taste deeper, a little smoke-like.

seg.6ac2cfc26fb7.src: Which rice is best for paramannam?
seg.6ac2cfc26fb7.t: परमान्नम लेल कोन चाउर सभ सँ नीक अछि?
seg.6ac2cfc26fb7.back: Which rice is best for paramannam?

seg.ead18bc39c32.src: A short-grain rice such as sona masoori cooks soft and creamy in milk. Long-grain basmati keeps its grains separate and gives a thinner paramannam.
seg.ead18bc39c32.t: सोना मसूरी सन छोट दानाक चाउर दूधमे नरम आ मलाईदार पकैत अछि। लम्बा दानाक बासमतीक दाना अलग-अलग रहैत अछि आ परमान्नम पातर बनैत अछि।
seg.ead18bc39c32.back: Short-grain rice like Sona Masuri cooks soft and creamy in milk. Grains of long-grain basmati stay separate and the paramannam becomes thin.

seg.2baf5cc4ec36.src: How do I fix paramannam that has become too thick?
seg.2baf5cc4ec36.t: बेसी गाढ़ भऽ गेल परमान्नमकेँ कोना ठीक करी?
seg.2baf5cc4ec36.back: How do I fix paramannam that has become too thick?

seg.9ffeabf346fa.src: Stir in a few spoons of warm milk, off the heat, until it loosens. It thickens as it cools, so stop when it is a little thinner than you want.
seg.9ffeabf346fa.t: आँच सँ बाहरे किछु चम्मच गुनगुना दूध मिला कऽ चलाउ, जा धरि ओ पातर नहि भऽ जाय। सेराइत-सेराइत ई गाढ़ होइत अछि, तेँ जखन अहाँक चाही ताहि सँ कनेक पातर हो, तखने रुकि जाउ।
seg.9ffeabf346fa.back: Off the flame mix a few spoons of lukewarm milk and stir, until it becomes thin. As it cools it thickens, so stop when it is a little thinner than you want.

seg.43e6183ba82c.back: బెల్లం పరమాన్నం · Recipe of bellam paramannam | 1acrefarms

seg.8b09026bfd65.src: బెల్లం పరమాన్నం. Bellam paramannam for Diwali: rice slow-cooked in milk and sweetened with cane jaggery off the heat, finished with ghee-fried cashews. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs. Serves 4.
seg.8b09026bfd65.t: బెల్లం పరమాన్నం. दिवाली लेल बेल्लम परमान्नम: दूधमे धीरे-धीरे पकाओल चाउर, आँच सँ उतारि कऽ कुसियारक गुड़ सँ मीठ कयल, अन्तमे घीमे भूजल काजू डालल। डेग-डेग विधि, सुझाव आ बेर-बेर पूछल जाइत प्रश्न। 4 लोक लेल।
seg.8b09026bfd65.back: బెల్లం పరమాన్నం. Bellam paramannam for Diwali: rice cooked slowly in milk, sweetened with sugarcane jaggery after taking off the flame, cashews roasted in ghee added at the end. Step-by-step method, tips and frequently asked questions. For 4 people.

seg.cf8cab3618d9.src: Bellam Paramannam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.cf8cab3618d9.t: बेल्लम परमान्नम: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.cf8cab3618d9.back: Bellam paramannam: 1acrefarms's recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.5fbc274b0656.src: Pasupu paalu is warm milk simmered with a little turmeric and a pinch of black pepper, then sweetened with jaggery. It is an everyday cup in many Telugu homes, made on cool evenings and often through Karthika masam, the month of Somavaram (Monday) pujas and evening lamps.
seg.5fbc274b0656.t: पसुपु पालु गरम दूध अछि, जकरा कनेक हरदि आ एक चुटकी कारी मरीचक संग धीमा आँच पर पकाओल जाइत अछि, फेर गुड़ सँ मीठ कयल जाइत अछि। बहुत रास तेलुगु घरमे ई रोजक एक कप अछि, जे ठंढा साँझमे आ प्रायः कार्तिक मास भरि बनाओल जाइत अछि, जे सोमवारम् (सोम दिन) क पूजा आ साँझक दीपक मास अछि।
seg.5fbc274b0656.back: Pasupu palu is hot milk, which is cooked on slow flame with a little turmeric and a pinch of black pepper, then made sweet with jaggery. In many Telugu homes it is the daily one cup, which is made on cold evenings and mostly throughout the month of Kartika, which is the month of Somavaram (Monday) puja and evening lamps.

seg.7d5fe2bc79e0.src: The turmeric turns the milk golden and gives it an earthy, slightly bitter edge, the pepper adds a little heat, and the jaggery rounds it off with a caramel sweetness. This recipe makes one cup in about 5 minutes.
seg.7d5fe2bc79e0.t: हरदि दूधकेँ सुनहरा बना दैत अछि आ माटि सन, कनेक तीत स्वाद दैत अछि, मरीच कनेक तीखापन जोड़ैत अछि, आ गुड़ कैरामेल सन मिठास सँ स्वादकेँ पूरा करैत अछि। एहि रेसिपी सँ करीब 5 मिनटमे एक कप बनैत अछि।
seg.7d5fe2bc79e0.back: Turmeric makes the milk golden and gives an earthy, slightly bitter taste, pepper adds a little sharpness, and jaggery completes the taste with a caramel-like sweetness. This recipe makes one cup in about 5 minutes.

seg.8e4df121a859.src: Simmer milk with turmeric and a pinch of pepper, switch off, then stir in a spoon of jaggery.
seg.8e4df121a859.t: दूधमे हरदि आ एक चुटकी मरीच डालि कऽ धीमा आँच पर पकाउ, आँच बन्न करू, फेर एक चम्मच गुड़ घोरू।
seg.8e4df121a859.back: Add turmeric and a pinch of pepper to the milk and cook on slow flame, turn off the flame, then dissolve a spoon of jaggery.

seg.33cd5776caaf.src: ¼ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Turmeric Powder or Hill Turmeric Powder⟦/1⟧
seg.33cd5776caaf.t: ¼ छोट चम्मच हरदि बुकनी ⟦1⟧हरदि बुकनी वा पहाड़ी हरदि बुकनी⟦/1⟧
seg.33cd5776caaf.back: ¼ small spoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧turmeric powder or hill turmeric powder⟦/1⟧

seg.f1056c625241.src: A pinch of black pepper ⟦1⟧powdered or crushed⟦/1⟧
seg.f1056c625241.t: एक चुटकी कारी मरीच ⟦1⟧बुकनी वा कूटल⟦/1⟧
seg.f1056c625241.back: A pinch of black pepper ⟦1⟧powder or crushed⟦/1⟧

seg.bc417c4b3691.src: 1 tsp grated palm or cane jaggery ⟦1⟧or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.bc417c4b3691.t: 1 छोट चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क वा कुसियारक गुड़ ⟦1⟧वा स्वाद अनुसार⟦/1⟧
seg.bc417c4b3691.back: 1 small spoon grated palm or sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧or according to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.12c1bae1db56.t: एक चुटकी इलायची बुकनी (मोन हो तँ)
seg.12c1bae1db56.back: A pinch of cardamom powder (if you wish)

seg.1a51e1f06af0.src: Sweeten it with ⟦1⟧Palm Jaggery⟦/1⟧ or ⟦2⟧Cane Jaggery⟦/2⟧.

seg.b0b3cf3b3c0d.src: Pour the milk into a small steel saucepan.
seg.b0b3cf3b3c0d.back: Pour the milk into a small steel pan (tasla).

seg.94d57531a741.src: Add the turmeric and pepper (and the cardamom, if using) and stir until no specks of turmeric float on top. They mix in more evenly before the milk is heated.
seg.94d57531a741.t: हरदि आ मरीच (आ इलायची, जँ डालि रहल छी) डालू आ तखन धरि चलाउ जा धरि ऊपर हरदिक कोनो कण नहि तैरय। दूध गरम करबा सँ पहिने डालला सँ ई बेसी एक समान मिलैत अछि।
seg.94d57531a741.back: Add turmeric and pepper (and cardamom, if you are adding) and stir until no turmeric particle floats on top. Adding before heating the milk, these mix more evenly.

seg.9da3932c6508.src: Set the pan on medium-low heat. Warm the milk with the turmeric and pepper; simmer 2 minutes. Once small bubbles appear around the edge, turn the heat to low and let it bubble gently.
seg.9da3932c6508.t: बरतनकेँ मध्यम सँ कम आँच पर राखू। हरदि आ मरीचक संग दूध गरम करू; 2 मिनट धीमा आँच पर पकाउ। जहाँ कातमे छोट-छोट बुलबुला देखाइ, आँच मद्धिम कऽ दिअ आ धीरे-धीरे खदकऽ दिअ।
seg.9da3932c6508.back: Put the vessel on medium-to-low flame. Heat the milk with turmeric and pepper; cook 2 minutes on slow flame. As soon as small bubbles show at the edges, turn the flame low and let it simmer gently.

seg.c66cb9336ef5.src: Stir now and then and keep an eye on the pan, as milk rises fast once it boils. If it starts to climb, lift the pan off the heat for a few seconds.
seg.c66cb9336ef5.t: बीच-बीचमे चलाउ आ बरतन पर नजरि राखू, किएक तँ खौलला पर दूध जल्दी उफनैत अछि। जँ ऊपर चढ़ऽ लागय, तँ बरतनकेँ किछु सेकेंड लेल आँच सँ उठा लिअ।
seg.c66cb9336ef5.back: Stir now and then and keep an eye on the vessel, because on boiling milk boils over quickly. If it starts rising up, lift the vessel off the flame for a few seconds.

seg.b567bc0c93c9.src: It is ready when the milk is an even golden yellow and the raw smell of turmeric has gone.
seg.b567bc0c93c9.t: जखन दूध एक समान सुनहरा पीयर भऽ जाय आ हरदिक काँच गन्ध चलि जाय, तखन ई तैयार अछि।
seg.b567bc0c93c9.back: When the milk becomes an even golden yellow and the raw smell of turmeric goes, then it is ready.

seg.6e16c50d7c2a.src: Switch off and wait a minute. The milk drops just below the boil, so the jaggery will not split it.
seg.6e16c50d7c2a.t: आँच बन्न कऽ एक मिनट रुकू। दूध खौलबाक तापमान सँ कनेक नीचाँ आबि जाइत अछि, तेँ गुड़ सँ दूध नहि फाटत।
seg.6e16c50d7c2a.back: Turn off the flame and wait one minute. The milk comes a little below boiling temperature, so the jaggery will not curdle the milk.

seg.aa0d1bcf6802.src: For a smooth cup, pour the milk through a fine sieve into a tumbler or mug.
seg.aa0d1bcf6802.t: चिक्कन कप लेल, दूधकेँ महीन छलनी सँ छानि कऽ टम्बलर वा मगमे ढारू।
seg.aa0d1bcf6802.back: For a smooth cup, strain the milk through a fine strainer and pour into a tumbler or mug.

seg.862cac523844.src: Stir in the jaggery and serve warm. Stir for 20–30 seconds, until it dissolves, and taste for sweetness.
seg.862cac523844.t: गुड़ घोरू आ गुनगुना परसू। 20–30 सेकेंड धरि चलाउ, जा धरि घुलि नहि जाय, आ मिठास चीखि लिअ।
seg.862cac523844.back: Dissolve the jaggery and serve lukewarm. Stir for 20–30 seconds, until it dissolves, and taste the sweetness.

seg.1d9b9ec736a8.src: Strain through a fine sieve if you like it smooth.
seg.1d9b9ec736a8.t: जँ चिक्कन पसिन्न अछि तँ महीन छलनी सँ छानि लिअ।
seg.1d9b9ec736a8.back: If you like it smooth, strain with a fine strainer.

seg.018366193ef3.src: Add the jaggery only after switching off; jaggery stirred into boiling milk can split it.
seg.018366193ef3.t: आँच बन्न केलाक बादे गुड़ डालू; खौलैत दूधमे गुड़ घोरला सँ दूध फाटि सकैत अछि।
seg.018366193ef3.back: Add jaggery only after turning off the flame; dissolving jaggery in boiling milk can curdle the milk.

seg.0e783ba83473.src: Use a steel pan and spoon; turmeric stains plastic and wood.
seg.0e783ba83473.t: स्टीलक बरतन आ चम्मच प्रयोग करू; हरदि प्लास्टिक आ काठ पर दाग छोड़ैत अछि।
seg.0e783ba83473.back: Use a steel vessel and spoon; turmeric leaves stains on plastic and wood.

seg.dc2a0c79ccd5.src: Making more? Use the same amounts for each cup of milk.
seg.dc2a0c79ccd5.t: बेसी बना रहल छी? हर कप दूध लेल ओतबे मात्रा प्रयोग करू।
seg.dc2a0c79ccd5.back: Making more? Use the same quantity for each cup of milk.

seg.485f68415013.src: Hill turmeric: use Hill Turmeric Powder (konda pasupu) in place of turmeric powder, in the same amount.
seg.485f68415013.t: पहाड़ी हरदि: हरदि बुकनीक बदला ओतबे मात्रामे पहाड़ी हरदि बुकनी (कोंडा पसुपु) प्रयोग करू।
seg.485f68415013.back: Hill turmeric: instead of turmeric powder use the same quantity of hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu).

seg.01ec7a142032.src: Palm or cane jaggery: palm jaggery gives a deeper, slightly smoky sweetness; cane jaggery a lighter, caramel one.
seg.01ec7a142032.t: ताड़क वा कुसियारक गुड़: ताड़क गुड़ बेसी गहींर, कनेक धुआँ सन मिठास दैत अछि; कुसियारक गुड़ बेसी हल्लुक, कैरामेल सन।
seg.01ec7a142032.back: Palm or sugarcane jaggery: palm jaggery gives a deeper, slightly smoke-like sweetness; sugarcane jaggery lighter, caramel-like.

seg.15b67235d087.src: Milder cup: leave out the pepper and add a pinch of cardamom powder instead.
seg.15b67235d087.t: कम तीख कप: मरीच नहि डालू आ ओकर बदला एक चुटकी इलायची बुकनी डालू।
seg.15b67235d087.back: Less pungent cup: do not add pepper and instead of it add a pinch of cardamom powder.

seg.d80219c8a51f.src: Serve warm in a tumbler or mug, on a cool evening or after the Karthika Somavaram puja.
seg.d80219c8a51f.t: ठंढा साँझमे वा कार्तिक सोमवारम्‌क पूजाक बाद टम्बलर वा मगमे गुनगुना परसू।
seg.d80219c8a51f.back: Serve lukewarm in a tumbler or mug on a cold evening or after the Kartika Somavaram puja.

seg.ac04ffd1d51a.src: Make it as you need it and drink it warm. Reheating after the jaggery is in can split the milk.
seg.ac04ffd1d51a.t: जखन चाही तखने बनाउ आ गुनगुने पीबू। गुड़ पड़लाक बाद फेर गरम केला सँ दूध फाटि सकैत अछि।
seg.ac04ffd1d51a.back: Make it just when wanted and drink it lukewarm. Reheating after jaggery goes in can curdle the milk.

seg.c758e61dd102.src: Why did my pasupu paalu curdle?
seg.c758e61dd102.t: हमर पसुपु पालु किएक फाटि गेल?
seg.c758e61dd102.back: Why did my pasupu palu curdle?

seg.d5f9c6fb2e27.src: Jaggery stirred into milk that is still boiling can make it split. Switch off the heat, wait about a minute, then stir in the grated jaggery.
seg.d5f9c6fb2e27.t: जे दूध एखनो खौलि रहल अछि, ओहिमे गुड़ घोरला सँ दूध फाटि सकैत अछि। आँच बन्न करू, करीब एक मिनट रुकू, फेर कद्दूकस कयल गुड़ घोरू।
seg.d5f9c6fb2e27.back: Dissolving jaggery in milk that is still boiling can curdle the milk. Turn off the flame, wait about one minute, then dissolve grated jaggery.

seg.df4dbdd3102b.src: How much turmeric should I use for one cup of milk?
seg.df4dbdd3102b.t: एक कप दूध लेल कतेक हरदि प्रयोग करी?
seg.df4dbdd3102b.back: How much turmeric should I use for one cup of milk?

seg.3ec50124bdd7.src: ¼ tsp turmeric powder for 1 cup (about 240 ml) of milk. More than that makes the taste sharp and earthy.
seg.3ec50124bdd7.t: 1 कप (करीब 240 ml) दूध लेल ¼ छोट चम्मच हरदि बुकनी। एहि सँ बेसी देला सँ स्वाद तेज आ माटि सन भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.3ec50124bdd7.back: ¼ small spoon turmeric powder for 1 cup (about 240 ml) milk. Giving more than this makes the taste strong and earthy.

seg.3dc4d1edd4f9.src: Can I skip the black pepper?
seg.3dc4d1edd4f9.t: की कारी मरीच छोड़ि सकैत छी?
seg.3dc4d1edd4f9.back: Can I leave out the black pepper?

seg.166b3a44e11d.src: Yes. The pepper adds a little heat to the taste; leave it out, or use a pinch of cardamom instead, for a milder cup.
seg.166b3a44e11d.t: हँ। मरीच स्वादमे कनेक तीखापन जोड़ैत अछि; कम तीख कप लेल एकरा छोड़ि दिअ, वा ओकर बदला एक चुटकी इलायची डालू।
seg.166b3a44e11d.back: Yes. Pepper adds a little sharpness to the taste; for a less pungent cup leave it out, or instead add a pinch of cardamom.

seg.2184adfd31b0.src: Should I use palm jaggery or cane jaggery?
seg.2184adfd31b0.t: ताड़क गुड़ प्रयोग करी वा कुसियारक गुड़?
seg.2184adfd31b0.back: Should I use palm jaggery or sugarcane jaggery?

seg.ef65c3a9d015.src: Either works, 1 tsp grated per cup. Palm jaggery tastes deeper and slightly smoky; cane jaggery is lighter and more like caramel.
seg.ef65c3a9d015.t: दुनू चलत, प्रति कप 1 छोट चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल। ताड़क गुड़क स्वाद बेसी गहींर आ कनेक धुआँ सन होइत अछि; कुसियारक गुड़ बेसी हल्लुक आ कैरामेल सन।
seg.ef65c3a9d015.back: Both will do, 1 small spoon grated per cup. Palm jaggery's taste is deeper and a little smoke-like; sugarcane jaggery lighter and caramel-like.

seg.5094f960d9a4.src: Bellam in a Telugu kitchen usually means one of two things: cheruku bellam, made from sugarcane juice, or thati bellam, made from the sap of the palmyra palm. FSSAI treats them as two separate products, each with its own standard.
seg.5094f960d9a4.t: तेलुगु भनसाघरमे बेल्लमक मतलब प्रायः दूमे सँ एक होइत अछि: कुसियारक रस सँ बनल चेरुकु बेल्लम, वा ताड़क गाछक रस सँ बनल ताटि बेल्लम। FSSAI दुनूकेँ दू अलग-अलग उत्पाद मानैत अछि, आ दुनूक अपन-अपन मानक अछि।
seg.5094f960d9a4.back: In the Telugu kitchen bellam usually means one of two: cheruku bellam made from sugarcane juice, or tati bellam made from the sap of the palm tree. FSSAI considers both as two separate products, and both have their own standard.

seg.13fd9611c493.src: They can look alike in a lump, but they taste different and suit different dishes. Here is how to tell them apart, which to use where, and how to keep them. There is a full Telugu section further down.
seg.13fd9611c493.t: ढेलामे दुनू एक्के सन देखा सकैत अछि, मुदा स्वाद अलग होइत अछि आ अलग-अलग व्यंजनमे नीक लगैत अछि। एतय देखू जे दुनूकेँ कोना चिन्हब, कोन कतय प्रयोग करब, आ कोना राखब। नीचाँ एकटा पूरा तेलुगु खण्ड सेहो अछि।
seg.13fd9611c493.back: In lumps both can look the same, but the taste is different and they suit different dishes. Here see how to recognise the two, which to use where, and how to store. Below there is also a full Telugu section.

seg.124d6789cba2.src: ⟦1⟧Our two jaggeries⟦/1⟧Left: cane jaggery from the Chittoor and Anakapalli cane belts. Right: palm jaggery from the Godavari delta. Both packed in Narasaraopet.
seg.124d6789cba2.t: ⟦1⟧हमर दू तरहक गुड़⟦/1⟧बामा: चित्तूर आ अनकापल्लीक कुसियार क्षेत्रक कुसियारक गुड़। दहिना: गोदावरी डेल्टाक ताड़क गुड़। दुनू नरसरावपेटमे पैक कयल।
seg.124d6789cba2.back: ⟦1⟧Our two kinds of jaggery⟦/1⟧Left: sugarcane jaggery from the sugarcane areas of Chittoor and Anakapalli. Right: palm jaggery from the Godavari delta. Both packed in Narasaraopet.

seg.70c115199d4c.src: Cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) is boiled-down sugarcane juice with a mellow, caramel sweetness: the one for payasam, pongal and chimmili. Palm jaggery (thati bellam) is boiled-down palmyra sap, darker and deeper in taste: a favourite in filter coffee and tea. You can swap one for the other gram for gram; start with a little less palm jaggery. Keep both in an airtight jar.
seg.70c115199d4c.t: कुसियारक गुड़ (चेरुकु बेल्लम) कुसियारक रसकेँ खौला कऽ गाढ़ कऽ बनैत अछि, एकर मिठास कोमल, कैरामेल सन होइत अछि: पायसम, पोंगल आ चिम्मिलि लेल यैह। ताड़क गुड़ (ताटि बेल्लम) ताड़क रसकेँ खौला कऽ गाढ़ कऽ बनैत अछि, रंग बेसी गाढ़ आ स्वाद बेसी गहींर: फिल्टर कॉफी आ चाहमे बहुतो लोकक पसिन्न। एककेँ दोसरक बदला ग्राम-ग्राम बराबर लऽ सकैत छी; ताड़क गुड़ कनेक कम सँ शुरू करू। दुनूकेँ हवाबंद डिब्बामे राखू।
seg.70c115199d4c.back: Sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) is made by boiling and thickening sugarcane juice, its sweetness is mild, caramel-like: this one for payasam, pongal and chimmili. Palm jaggery (tati bellam) is made by boiling and thickening palm sap, colour darker and taste deeper: the liking of many people in filter coffee and tea. You can take one in place of the other gram for gram equal; start palm jaggery from a little less. Keep both in an airtight box.

seg.82f772f29b90.src: Payasam, pongal, paramannam, chimmili, chikki, laddu
seg.82f772f29b90.t: पायसम, पोंगल, परमान्नम, चिम्मिलि, चिक्की, लड्डू
seg.82f772f29b90.back: Payasam, pongal, paramannam, chimmili, chikki, laddu

seg.db3bddd4a4fc.src: Cane jaggery is made wherever sugarcane grows: the juice is pressed out of the cane and boiled down in open pans. In Andhra Pradesh, Anakapalli has the second largest jaggery market in India.
seg.db3bddd4a4fc.t: जतय-जतय कुसियार उपजैत अछि, ओतय कुसियारक गुड़ बनैत अछि: कुसियार पेरि कऽ रस निकालल जाइत अछि आ खुजल कड़ाहमे खौला कऽ गाढ़ कयल जाइत अछि। आन्ध्र प्रदेशक अनकापल्लीमे भारतक दोसर सभ सँ पैघ गुड़ बजार अछि।
seg.db3bddd4a4fc.back: Wherever sugarcane grows, there sugarcane jaggery is made: sugarcane is crushed to extract juice and boiled in an open kadai to thicken it. Anakapalli in Andhra Pradesh has India's second biggest jaggery market.

seg.31988f9e86fc.src: Palm jaggery is made from the sap of the palmyra palm, thati chettu in Telugu. The sap is called neera, or thati neera, and it is boiled down until it sets.
seg.31988f9e86fc.t: ताड़क गुड़ ताड़क गाछक रस सँ बनैत अछि, जकरा तेलुगुमे ताटि चेट्टु कहल जाइत अछि। एहि रसकेँ नीरा, वा ताटि नीरा कहल जाइत अछि, आ एकरा जमय धरि खौलाओल जाइत अछि।
seg.31988f9e86fc.back: Palm jaggery is made from the sap of the palm tree, which in Telugu is called tati chettu. This sap is called neera, or tati neera, and it is boiled until it sets.

seg.7231a4f0bd69.src: Payasam, sweet pongal and ⟦1⟧bellam paramannam⟦/1⟧: cane jaggery.
seg.7231a4f0bd69.t: पायसम, मीठ पोंगल आ ⟦1⟧बेल्लम परमान्नम⟦/1⟧: कुसियारक गुड़।
seg.7231a4f0bd69.back: Payasam, sweet pongal and ⟦1⟧bellam paramannam⟦/1⟧: sugarcane jaggery.

seg.2b10b5036017.src: Filter coffee and tea: palm jaggery. Its deeper taste stands up to the decoction; try our ⟦1⟧palm jaggery coffee⟦/1⟧.
seg.2b10b5036017.t: फिल्टर कॉफी आ चाह: ताड़क गुड़। एकर गहींर स्वाद डिकॉक्शनमे दबैत नहि अछि; हमर ⟦1⟧ताड़क गुड़क कॉफी⟦/1⟧ बना कऽ देखू।
seg.2b10b5036017.back: Filter coffee and tea: palm jaggery. Its deep taste is not suppressed in decoction; make our ⟦1⟧palm jaggery coffee⟦/1⟧ and see.

seg.39f0609ee4de.src: ⟦1⟧Pasupu paalu⟦/1⟧: either one, as you like it.
seg.39f0609ee4de.t: ⟦1⟧पसुपु पालु⟦/1⟧: दुनूमे सँ कोनो, जेना पसिन्न हो।
seg.39f0609ee4de.back: ⟦1⟧Pasupu palu⟦/1⟧: any of the two, as you like.

seg.46fffb385af6.src: Use the same weight. Palm jaggery tastes stronger, so start with a little less and add more to taste.
seg.46fffb385af6.t: ओतबे वजन प्रयोग करू। ताड़क गुड़क स्वाद तेज होइत अछि, तेँ कनेक कम सँ शुरू करू आ स्वाद अनुसार बढ़ाउ।
seg.46fffb385af6.back: Use the same weight. Palm jaggery's taste is strong, so start from a little less and increase according to taste.

seg.8a98e07b6f1e.src: In milk, coffee or tea, add either jaggery after the milk is off the boil, so the milk does not split.
seg.8a98e07b6f1e.t: दूध, कॉफी वा चाहमे, दूधक उफान कम भेलाक बादे कोनो गुड़ मिलाउ, जाहि सँ दूध नहि फाटय।
seg.8a98e07b6f1e.back: In milk, coffee or tea, mix any jaggery only after the milk's boiling-up has reduced, so that the milk does not curdle.

seg.6788faade30c.src: Keep jaggery in an airtight jar in a cool, dry place.
seg.6788faade30c.t: गुड़केँ हवाबंद डिब्बामे ठंढा, सुखल जगहमे राखू।
seg.6788faade30c.back: Keep jaggery in an airtight box in a cool, dry place.

seg.5ea00ae441ac.src: Use a dry spoon or knife. Jaggery takes in moisture from the air and turns sticky.
seg.5ea00ae441ac.t: सुखल चम्मच वा चक्कू प्रयोग करू। गुड़ हवा सँ नमी सोखि लैत अछि आ चिपचिपा भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.5ea00ae441ac.back: Use a dry spoon or knife. Jaggery absorbs moisture from the air and becomes sticky.

seg.1d7ae0c59b87.src: If it sets hard, grate it.
seg.1d7ae0c59b87.t: जँ कड़ा भऽ जाय, तँ कद्दूकस कऽ लिअ।
seg.1d7ae0c59b87.back: If it becomes hard, grate it.

seg.8be6c65e90d5.src: Use it within the best-before date on the pack.
seg.8be6c65e90d5.t: पैकेट पर लिखल बेस्ट-बिफोर तारीखक भीतर प्रयोग करू।
seg.8be6c65e90d5.back: Use within the best-before date written on the packet.

seg.cc5783126657.src: Is palm jaggery the same as karupatti?
seg.cc5783126657.t: की ताड़क गुड़ आ करुपट्टि एके अछि?
seg.cc5783126657.back: Are palm jaggery and karupatti the same?

seg.f7071649dddd.src: Yes. Karupatti is the Tamil name for jaggery made from palmyra sap. In Telugu it is thati bellam, and in Hindi taad ka gud.
seg.f7071649dddd.t: हँ। करुपट्टि ताड़क रस सँ बनल गुड़क तमिल नाम अछि। तेलुगुमे एकरा ताटि बेल्लम, आ हिन्दीमे ताड़ का गुड़ कहल जाइत अछि।
seg.f7071649dddd.back: Yes. Karupatti is the Tamil name of jaggery made from palm sap. In Telugu it is called tati bellam, and in Hindi taad ka gud.

seg.a591ce90fac8.src: Is gud the same as jaggery?
seg.a591ce90fac8.t: की गुड़ आ जैगरी एके अछि?
seg.a591ce90fac8.back: Are gud and jaggery the same?

seg.9e04d6270c92.src: Yes. Gud, or gur, is the Hindi word for jaggery, and bellam is the Telugu one. On its own it usually means cane jaggery.
seg.9e04d6270c92.t: हँ। गुड़, वा गुर, जैगरीक हिन्दी शब्द अछि, आ बेल्लम तेलुगु शब्द। असगर कहला पर एकर मतलब प्रायः कुसियारक गुड़ होइत अछि।
seg.9e04d6270c92.back: Yes. Gud, or gur, is the Hindi word for jaggery, and bellam the Telugu word. When said alone its meaning is usually sugarcane jaggery.

seg.e531a25812a8.src: Why has my jaggery gone sticky?
seg.e531a25812a8.t: हमर गुड़ किएक चिपचिपा भऽ गेल?
seg.e531a25812a8.back: Why did my jaggery become sticky?

seg.cc79285bfadd.src: It has taken in moisture from the air, which happens faster in humid weather. Move it to an airtight jar and use a dry spoon.
seg.cc79285bfadd.t: ई हवा सँ नमी सोखि लेलक अछि, जे उमस भरल मौसममे बेसी जल्दी होइत अछि। एकरा हवाबंद डिब्बामे राखू आ सुखल चम्मच प्रयोग करू।
seg.cc79285bfadd.back: It has absorbed moisture from the air, which happens faster in humid weather. Keep it in an airtight box and use a dry spoon.

seg.1bdcd09c5ca0.src: Can I use palm jaggery in payasam?
seg.1bdcd09c5ca0.t: की पायसममे ताड़क गुड़ प्रयोग कऽ सकैत छी?
seg.1bdcd09c5ca0.back: Can I use palm jaggery in payasam?

seg.8ba95d799ac9.src: Yes. It gives a darker colour and a deeper taste. Add it off the heat, as you would cane jaggery.
seg.8ba95d799ac9.t: हँ। ई बेसी गाढ़ रंग आ बेसी गहींर स्वाद दैत अछि। कुसियारक गुड़ जकाँ, आँच सँ उतारि कऽ मिलाउ।
seg.8ba95d799ac9.back: Yes. It gives darker colour and deeper taste. Like sugarcane jaggery, mix it after taking off the flame.

seg.0a3e09b58f4e.back: Delivery is free on two or more packets, so you can taste and try both.
