seg.abda31761e23.src: Plain answers to what buyers ask us, starting with how to check turmeric powder at home.
seg.abda31761e23.t: ग्राहक हमरा सँ जे पूछैत छथि, तकर सीधा-सादा जवाब, घरमे हरदि बुकनी कोना जाँची, एतय सँ शुरू।
seg.abda31761e23.back: Simple answers to what customers ask us, starting from here: how to check turmeric powder at home.

seg.2b6b229e651e.src: FSSAI's standard says turmeric powder must be free from added colouring matter, including lead chromate, and from foreign starch. Its testing manual lists what inspectors check turmeric for: added dyes such as metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.
seg.2b6b229e651e.t: FSSAI क मानक कहैत अछि जे हरदि बुकनीमे लेड क्रोमेट समेत कोनो मिलाओल रंग पदार्थ, आ बाहरी स्टार्च नहि हेबाक चाही। एकर परीक्षण पुस्तिकामे लिखल अछि जे निरीक्षक हरदिमे की-की जाँचैत छथि: मेटानिल येलो सन मिलाओल रंग, लेडक लवण, आ खड़िया बुकनी।
seg.2b6b229e651e.back: FSSAI's standard says that turmeric powder should not have any added colouring matter including lead chromate, or foreign starch. Its testing manual writes what inspectors check in turmeric: added colours like metanil yellow, salts of lead, and chalk (khadiya) powder.

seg.b27088069a9d.src: Some of this you can check in your kitchen, and some only a lab can find. This guide covers both, plus two popular tests that do not work for turmeric. Try them on any turmeric you buy, ours included.
seg.b27088069a9d.t: एहिमे सँ किछु अहाँ अपन भनसाघरमे जाँचि सकैत छी, आ किछु मात्र लैब पता लगा सकैत अछि। ई गाइड दुनूक बात करैत अछि, संगहि दू टा चर्चित परीक्षण सेहो जे हरदि पर काज नहि करैत अछि। जे कोनो हरदि कीनी, हमरो, ओहि पर ई जाँच कऽ देखू।
seg.b27088069a9d.back: Some of these you can check in your own kitchen, and some only a lab can detect. This guide talks of both, along with two popular tests which do not work on turmeric. Whatever turmeric you buy, ours too, do this check on it and see.

seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.src: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water with the powder settled at the bottom. Right: strong yellow water with yellow trails running down from the powder.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.t: हरदिक जाँचक बाद पानिक दू टा गिलास। बामा: हल्लुक पीयर पानि, बुकनी तरमे बैसल। दहिना: गाढ़ पीयर पानि, बुकनी सँ नीचाँ दिस पीयर धारी बहैत।
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.back: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: light yellow water, powder settled at the bottom. Right: deep yellow water, yellow streaks flowing downward from the powder.

seg.c8b6eb5f9530.src: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled and the water is pale yellow. Right: strong yellow trails ran from the powder as it sank, and the water turned deep yellow. That one is worth a lab test.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.t: ⟦1⟧पानिक जाँच⟦/1⟧बामा: बुकनी तरमे बैसि गेल अछि आ पानि हल्लुक पीयर अछि। दहिना: डूबैत काल बुकनी सँ गाढ़ पीयर धारी निकलल, आ पानि गाढ़ पीयर भऽ गेल। ओकरा लैबमे जँचायब उचित अछि।
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.back: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled at the bottom and the water is light yellow. Right: while sinking, deep yellow streaks came out of the powder, and the water became deep yellow. It is proper to get that tested in a lab.

seg.a7363cc3fa37.src: Sprinkle a teaspoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it settle without stirring. Turmeric sinks and leaves the water pale yellow; water that turns strong yellow straight away points to added colour. This check cannot find lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer, use a food testing lab. Skip the iodine test: turmeric is starchy to begin with.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.t: एक गिलास पानि पर एक छोट चम्मच हरदि छिड़कू आ बिना चलेने बैसऽ दिअ। हरदि डूबि जाइत अछि आ पानि हल्लुक पीयर रहैत अछि; जे पानि तुरंत गाढ़ पीयर भऽ जाय, ओ मिलाओल रंग दिस इशारा करैत अछि। ई जाँच लेड क्रोमेट वा खड़िया नहि पकड़ि सकैत अछि, तेँ पक्का जवाब लेल खाद्य परीक्षण लैबक सहायता लिअ। आयोडिन परीक्षण नहि करू: हरदिमे शुरुए सँ स्टार्च होइत अछि।
seg.a7363cc3fa37.back: Sprinkle one small spoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it sit without stirring. The turmeric sinks and the water stays light yellow; water that becomes deep yellow immediately points toward added colour. This check cannot catch lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer take the help of a food testing lab. Do not do the iodine test: turmeric has starch from the beginning.

seg.34d6f989bfaf.src: Such as metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not allow added colour in turmeric.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.t: जेना मेटानिल येलो, जे फीका हरदिकेँ चमकदार देखा सकैत अछि। FSSAI हरदिमे रंग मिलेबाक अनुमति नहि दैत अछि।
seg.34d6f989bfaf.back: Such as metanil yellow, which can make pale turmeric look bright. FSSAI does not permit mixing colour in turmeric.

seg.042cabe54b01.src: Lead chromate and other lead salts
seg.042cabe54b01.t: लेड क्रोमेट आ लेडक आन लवण
seg.042cabe54b01.back: Lead chromate and other salts of lead

seg.8310b11eab8b.src: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not allow it in turmeric at all.
seg.8310b11eab8b.t: लेड क्रोमेट पेंटमे प्रयोग होइत एकटा पीयर रंग अछि। 2019 आ 2024 मे प्रकाशित, स्टैनफोर्डक अगुआइमे भेल अध्ययन दक्षिण एशियाक किछु भागक हरदिमे एकरा पौलक। FSSAI हरदिमे एकर कनिको अनुमति नहि दैत अछि।
seg.8310b11eab8b.back: Lead chromate is a yellow colour used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from some parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not permit it at all in turmeric.

seg.4278e7c5416c.src: A cheap white powder that adds weight.
seg.4278e7c5416c.t: वजन बढ़बऽ बला सस्ता उज्जर बुकनी।
seg.4278e7c5416c.back: Cheap white powder that increases weight.

seg.5a8b446bbce0.src: Flour or starch from other crops. FSSAI's standard rules it out too.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.t: आन फसिलक आटा वा स्टार्च। FSSAI क मानक एकरो मना करैत अछि।
seg.5a8b446bbce0.back: Flour or starch of other crops. FSSAI's standard forbids this too.

seg.1b1af7f63ffd.src: Fill a clear glass with water at room temperature.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.t: एकटा पारदर्शी गिलासमे कोठलीक तापमानक पानि भरू।
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.back: Fill a transparent glass with room-temperature water.

seg.653731f2ed6f.src: Sprinkle one level teaspoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.
seg.653731f2ed6f.t: ऊपर सँ एक समतल छोट चम्मच हरदि बुकनी छिड़कू। चलाउ नहि।
seg.653731f2ed6f.back: Sprinkle one level small spoon of turmeric powder from above. Do not stir.

seg.ea5b43cf8436.src: Watch the first minute as the powder sinks. Look for coloured trails running down from it.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.t: बुकनी डूबैत काल पहिल एक मिनट देखू। ओहि सँ नीचाँ दिस बहैत रंगीन धारी तकू।
seg.ea5b43cf8436.back: Watch the first one minute while the powder sinks. Look for coloured streaks flowing downward from it.

seg.e37698aaa3fb.src: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass against a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.t: 15 सँ 20 मिनट धरि छोड़ि दिअ। फेर गिलासकेँ उज्जर देबाल वा कागजक पन्नाक आगाँ पकड़ि कऽ तरमे बैसल बुकनीक ऊपरका पानि देखू।
seg.e37698aaa3fb.back: Leave for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass in front of a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the powder settled at the bottom.

seg.e8937cebf136.src: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom
seg.e8937cebf136.back: Light yellow water, powder at the bottom

seg.256ce5cf303d.src: Strong yellow trails, or deep yellow water within minutes
seg.256ce5cf303d.t: गाढ़ पीयर धारी, वा किछुए मिनटमे गाढ़ पीयर पानि
seg.256ce5cf303d.back: Deep yellow streaks, or deep yellow water within a few minutes

seg.ce06c8148072.src: Possible added colour. Stop using that batch and get it tested.
seg.ce06c8148072.t: रंग मिलाओल भऽ सकैत अछि। ओहि बैचक प्रयोग बन्न करू आ जँचबाउ।
seg.ce06c8148072.back: Colour may have been added. Stop using that batch and get it tested.

seg.53d9c5db264d.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and only tints the water. Dyes such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water fast.
seg.53d9c5db264d.t: ⟦1⟧ई किएक काज करैत अछि।⟦/1⟧ हरदिक अपन पीयर रंग, करक्यूमिन, पानिमे मुश्किल सँ घुलैत अछि, तेँ बुकनी डूबि जाइत अछि आ पानिकेँ मात्र हल्लुक रंगैत अछि। मेटानिल येलो सन रंग सहजहि घुलि जाइत अछि आ पानिकेँ जल्दी रंगि दैत अछि।
seg.53d9c5db264d.back: ⟦1⟧Why this works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow colour, curcumin, dissolves in water with difficulty, so the powder sinks and colours the water only lightly. Colours like metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water quickly.

seg.af4442c6e910.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk do not dissolve in water either, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.af4442c6e910.t: ⟦1⟧ई की छोड़ि दैत अछि।⟦/1⟧ लेड क्रोमेट आ खड़िया सेहो पानिमे नहि घुलैत अछि, तेँ एहि सभ सँ मिलल हरदि एहि जाँचमे पास भऽ सकैत अछि। मात्र लैब परीक्षणे पक्का कऽ सकैत अछि जे ई सभ नहि अछि।
seg.af4442c6e910.back: ⟦1⟧What this leaves out.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk also do not dissolve in water, so turmeric mixed with these can pass this check. Only a lab test can confirm that these are not there.

seg.a8b61850b87d.src: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Cloudy is fine; a clear, strong yellow is what to look for.
seg.a8b61850b87d.t: बहुत महीन बुकनी किछु काल धरि पानिकेँ धमिल राखि सकैत अछि। धमिल होएब ठीक अछि; देखबाक बात अछि साफ, गाढ़ पीयर रंग।
seg.a8b61850b87d.back: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for some time. Being cloudy is fine; the thing to look for is a clear, deep yellow colour.

seg.c3455d1f4c96.src: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric
seg.c3455d1f4c96.t: जाँच 2: जँ अहाँ समूचा हरदि कीनैत छी
seg.c3455d1f4c96.back: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric

seg.3d4e366bb488.src: Snap a finger of dried turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through, so the inside should look much like the outside. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull core can mean colour was added to the surface. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.
seg.3d4e366bb488.t: सुखल हरदिक एकटा गाँठ बीच सँ तोड़ू। हरदि भीतर धरि पीयर-नारंगी होइत अछि, तेँ भीतरका भाग बाहरी भाग सन देखेबाक चाही। फीका वा धमिल भीतरी भागक ऊपर चमकदार पीयर छिलका होअय तँ सतह पर रंग मिलाओल भऽ सकैत अछि। एहि विषयमे बेचनिहार सँ पूछू, वा जँचबाउ।
seg.3d4e366bb488.back: Break one dried turmeric knob from the middle. Turmeric is yellow-orange right to the inside, so the inner part should look like the outer part. If there is a bright yellow peel over a pale or dull inner part, colour may have been added on the surface. Ask the seller about this, or get it tested.

seg.4c4dc95561d2.src: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested for spotting flour in turmeric. But turmeric is starchy itself, so it turns blue-black either way. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.t: स्टार्च सँ भेंट भेला पर आयोडिन नील-कारी भऽ जाइत अछि, आ हरदिमे आटा पकड़बा लेल एकर सलाह प्रायः देल जाइत अछि। मुदा हरदिमे अपनहि स्टार्च होइत अछि, तेँ दुनू हालतमे नील-कारी भऽ जाइत अछि। ताहि लेल FSSAI क अपन पुस्तिका आयोडिन परीक्षणक प्रयोग हरदि छोड़ि आन बुकनी मसाला लेल करैत अछि।
seg.4c4dc95561d2.back: On meeting starch iodine becomes blue-black, and its advice is often given for catching flour in turmeric. But turmeric itself has starch, so in both cases it becomes blue-black. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for ground spices other than turmeric.

seg.fc16ff8016e3.src: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.t: हरदिमे लेड, मेटानिल येलो आ खड़िया लेल FSSAI क परीक्षणमे गाढ़ हाइड्रोक्लोरिक वा सल्फ्यूरिक एसिडक प्रयोग होइत अछि। ई एसिड चमड़ी आ आँखि जरा दैत अछि। एकर जगह भनसाघर नहि, लैब अछि।
seg.fc16ff8016e3.back: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. Their place is not the kitchen, it is the lab.

seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.src: For a sure answer: a food testing lab
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.t: पक्का जवाब लेल: खाद्य परीक्षण लैब
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.back: For a sure answer: a food testing lab

seg.1883beca4d73.src: A NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and for added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.
seg.1883beca4d73.t: NABL मान्यता प्राप्त खाद्य परीक्षण लैब हरदिमे लेड आ मिलाओल रंगक जाँच कऽ सकैत अछि। लैब सँ पूछू जे कतेक नमूना चाही, बुकनीकेँ ओकर सील बन्न पैकेटमे वा साफ सील बन्न थैलीमे राखू, आ पैकेट पर छपल बैच नम्बर लिखि लिअ। FSSAI अपन वेबसाइट पर अधिसूचित खाद्य परीक्षण लैबक सूची प्रकाशित करैत अछि।
seg.1883beca4d73.back: An NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and added colours. Ask the lab how much sample is needed, keep the powder in its sealed packet or in a clean sealed bag, and write down the batch number printed on the packet. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.

seg.456379c75c24.src: Read the pack before you buy

seg.ff7951e2f36b.src: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.t: FSSAI लाइसेंस वा पंजीकरण नम्बर। एकरा FSSAI क FoSCoS वेबसाइट पर ताकि सकैत छी।
seg.ff7951e2f36b.back: FSSAI licence or registration number. You can search it on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.

seg.476e4849c1d8.src: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.
seg.476e4849c1d8.t: जे बनौलक वा पैक केलक, तकर नाम आ पता।
seg.476e4849c1d8.back: Name and address of whoever made or packed it.

seg.beee8eda6466.src: Net quantity, MRP, a batch or lot number, and a best-before date.
seg.beee8eda6466.t: नेट मात्रा, MRP, बैच वा लॉट नम्बर, आ बेस्ट-बिफोर तारीख।
seg.beee8eda6466.back: Net quantity, MRP, batch or lot number, and best-before date.

seg.f9270fd96202.src: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps you compare like with like.
seg.f9270fd96202.t: कतय उपजल। अलग-अलग क्षेत्रक हरदिक रंग अलग होइत अछि, तेँ क्षेत्रक नाम लिखल हो तँ एक तरहक हरदिक तुलना ओही तरहक हरदि सँ करबामे मदति भेटैत अछि।
seg.f9270fd96202.back: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so if the region's name is written it helps in comparing one kind of turmeric with the same kind of turmeric.

seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.src: Keep the pack zipped shut, or move the powder to a dry, airtight jar.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.t: पैकेटक जिप बन्न राखू, वा बुकनीकेँ सुखल, हवाबंद डिब्बामे राखू।
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.back: Keep the packet's zip closed, or keep the powder in a dry, airtight box.

seg.bb4d61f86b55.src: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes turmeric lumpy.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.t: सुखल चम्मच प्रयोग करू। भीजल चम्मचे हरदिमे ढेला बनबैत अछि।
seg.bb4d61f86b55.back: Use a dry spoon. A wet spoon itself makes lumps in turmeric.

seg.a92c022ff52e.src: Keep it out of direct sunlight, which fades the colour.
seg.a92c022ff52e.t: सोझ रौद सँ बचा कऽ राखू, रौद रंगकेँ फीका कऽ दैत अछि।
seg.a92c022ff52e.back: Keep protected from direct sun, sun makes the colour pale.

seg.6911ce63edde.src: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?
seg.6911ce63edde.t: की बहुत चमकदार पीयर हरदि खराब संकेत अछि?
seg.6911ce63edde.back: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?

seg.a0ce62cee740.src: Not by itself. Colour changes with the variety, where it was grown and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. What matters is colour that leaves the powder too easily, as in the water check.
seg.a0ce62cee740.t: असगर एहि सँ नहि। रंग किस्म, उपजबाक जगह, आ कोना सुखाओल आ पीसल गेल, ताहि सँ बदलैत अछि, तेँ हरदि-हरदिमे बहुत अन्तर होइत अछि। देखबाक बात ई अछि जे रंग बुकनी सँ बड्ड सहजे छुटैत अछि कि नहि, जेना पानि बला जाँचमे देखाइत अछि।
seg.a0ce62cee740.back: Not from this alone. Colour changes with variety, place of growing, and how it was dried and ground, so there is much difference from turmeric to turmeric. The thing to see is whether the colour comes off the powder very easily or not, as seen in the water check.

seg.e8cc5edbb092.src: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.t: की पानिक जाँच सँ ई पता चलि सकैत अछि जे हरदिमे लेड नहि अछि?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.back: Can it be known from the water check that there is no lead in turmeric?

seg.37eb38df9ce8.src: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.t: नहि। लेड क्रोमेट पानिमे नहि घुलैत अछि, तेँ पानिक जाँच ओकरा नहि देखि सकैत अछि। मात्र लैब परीक्षण देखि सकैत अछि।
seg.37eb38df9ce8.back: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can see it.

seg.4c0bb3e9657c.t: हरदिमे ढेला किएक बनि जाइत अछि?
seg.4c0bb3e9657c.back: Why do lumps form in turmeric?

seg.2b76cd3e665b.src: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder take in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack sealed.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.t: नमीक कारणे। भीजल चम्मच वा खुजल पैकेट सँ बुकनी पानि सोखि लैत अछि। सुखल चम्मच सँ ढेला फोड़ू आ पैकेट बन्न राखू।
seg.2b76cd3e665b.back: Because of moisture. From a wet spoon or an open packet the powder absorbs water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the packet closed.

seg.87fe2929801d.src: What should I do if a check looks wrong?
seg.87fe2929801d.t: जँ कोनो जाँचमे गड़बड़ी लागय तँ की करी?
seg.87fe2929801d.back: What should I do if something seems wrong in any check?

seg.e83aba6cc6df.src: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.t: ओहि बैचक प्रयोग बन्न करू, पैकेट राखि लिअ, आ बैच नम्बरक संग बेचनिहार सँ सम्पर्क करू। FSSAI क Food Safety Connect ऐपक माध्यमे शिकायत सेहो कऽ सकैत छी। जँ हमर अछि, तँ पैकेट आ गिलासक फोटो हमरा WhatsApp करू।
seg.e83aba6cc6df.back: Stop using that batch, keep the packet, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also complain through FSSAI's Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, then WhatsApp us a photo of the packet and the glass.

seg.1dd4194330b1.src: Try these checks on ours too. If anything looks off, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number from the pack.
seg.1dd4194330b1.t: हमरो हरदि पर ई जाँच कऽ देखू। जँ किछु ठीक नहि लागय, तँ पैकेटक बैच नम्बरक संग एकटा फोटो ⟦1⟧हमरा WhatsApp करू⟦/1⟧।
seg.1dd4194330b1.back: Do these checks on our turmeric too and see. If something does not seem right, then ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the packet's batch number.

seg.f803aad7e26d.src: Turmeric Adulteration Test at Home (Haldi, Pasupu) | 1acrefarms
seg.f803aad7e26d.back: Checking adulteration in turmeric at home (haldi, pasupu) | 1acrefarms

seg.7d95509f17be.src: How to check turmeric powder (haldi, pasupu) at home: the water check, what it misses, why the iodine test does not work on turmeric, and when you need a lab.
seg.7d95509f17be.t: घरमे हरदि बुकनी (हल्दी, पसुपु) कोना जाँची: पानिक जाँच, ई की छोड़ि दैत अछि, आयोडिन परीक्षण हरदि पर किएक काज नहि करैत अछि, आ कखन लैबक जरूरति अछि।
seg.7d95509f17be.back: How to check turmeric powder (haldi, pasupu) at home: the water check, what it leaves out, why the iodine test does not work on turmeric, and when a lab is needed.

seg.d25dae4babde.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Andhra Kodi Kura · Andhra Chicken Curry
seg.d25dae4babde.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · आन्ध्र कोडी कूरा · आन्ध्र चिकन करी
seg.d25dae4babde.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Andhra Kodi Koora · Andhra chicken curry

seg.91bce9460ade.src: Kodi kura is the chicken curry that fills Andhra homes on a Sunday afternoon: bone-in chicken marinated in chilli and turmeric, cooked down in a gravy of deep-golden onions and tomatoes, and finished with garam masala. It goes to the table with hot rice, and the leftovers with dosa or chapati at night.
seg.91bce9460ade.t: कोडी कूरा ओ चिकन करी अछि जे रविदिन दुपहरियामे आन्ध्रक घर-घरमे बनैत अछि: हड्डीबला चिकन मरचाइ आ हरदिमे मसाला लगा कऽ राखल, गाढ़ सोनहुला पियाउज आ टमाटरक ग्रेवीमे पकाओल, आ अन्तमे गरम मसाला। ई गरम भातक संग परसल जाइत अछि, आ बचल तरकारी राति कऽ डोसा वा रोटीक संग।
seg.91bce9460ade.back: Kodi koora is that chicken curry which is made on Sunday afternoon in Andhra homes: bone-in chicken kept marinated in chilli and turmeric, cooked in a deep golden onion and tomato gravy, and garam masala at the end. It is served with hot rice, and the leftover curry at night with dosa or roti.

seg.2422ebb922bc.src: The heat here comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli that gives Andhra curries their bite and bright red colour, with our turmeric powder in the marinade. This recipe serves 4 and is properly fiery; the tips say how to scale it down.
seg.2422ebb922bc.t: एकर तीखपन हमर तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी सँ अबैत अछि, गुंटूरक ओ बड्ड तीख मरचाइ जे आन्ध्रक तरकारीकेँ ओकर झाँस आ चटक लाल रंग दैत अछि; मसालामे हमर हरदि बुकनी सेहो अछि। ई रेसिपी 4 लोक लेल अछि आ सच्चे बड्ड तीख अछि; सुझावमे लिखल अछि जे तीख कोना कम करी।
seg.2422ebb922bc.back: Its heat comes from our Teja chilli powder, that very hot chilli of Guntur which gives Andhra curries their bite and bright red colour; our turmeric powder is also in the masala. This recipe is for 4 people and is truly very hot; the tips say how to reduce the heat.

seg.6037465ed8d2.src: Total includes 30 minutes for the marinade.
seg.6037465ed8d2.t: कुल समयमे मसाला लगा कऽ रखबाक 30 मिनट सेहो जोड़ल अछि।
seg.6037465ed8d2.back: The total time also includes 30 minutes of keeping it marinated.

seg.9cb820880217.src: Marinate chicken in curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, then cook it in a deep-golden onion and tomato gravy. Finish with garam masala and coriander leaves.
seg.9cb820880217.t: चिकनकेँ दही, तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी, हरदि बुकनी आ नोनमे लपेटि कऽ राखू, फेर गाढ़ सोनहुला पियाउज आ टमाटरक ग्रेवीमे पकाउ। अन्तमे गरम मसाला आ धनियाँ पात डालू।
seg.9cb820880217.back: Keep the chicken coated in curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, then cook in a deep golden onion and tomato gravy. At the end add garam masala and coriander leaves.

seg.d35e8cdc661c.src: 750 g chicken ⟦1⟧bone-in, curry-cut pieces, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.d35e8cdc661c.t: 750 g चिकन ⟦1⟧हड्डीबला, करी-कट टुकड़ा, धोइ कऽ नीक जकाँ पानि निथारल⟦/1⟧
seg.d35e8cdc661c.back: 750 g chicken ⟦1⟧bone-in, curry-cut pieces, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧

seg.c84970cf7b6f.t: ½ कप दही ⟦1⟧गाढ़, फेंटि कऽ चिक्कन कयल⟦/1⟧

seg.9e9cb51b1458.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat⟦/1⟧
seg.9e9cb51b1458.t: 2 छोट चम्मच तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी ⟦1⟧बड्ड तीख; मध्यम तीख लेल 1 छोट चम्मच लिअ⟦/1⟧
seg.9e9cb51b1458.back: 2 teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for medium heat take 1 teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.9654088d205e.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧plus more to taste at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.9654088d205e.t: 1 छोट चम्मच नोन ⟦1⟧आ अन्तमे स्वाद अनुसार आओर⟦/1⟧
seg.9654088d205e.back: 1 teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧and more to taste at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.fff6117cc0f5.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual Andhra choice⟦/1⟧
seg.fff6117cc0f5.t: 3 पैघ चम्मच तेल ⟦1⟧आन्ध्रमे बेसी मूँगफलीक तेल चलैत अछि⟦/1⟧
seg.fff6117cc0f5.back: 3 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧in Andhra groundnut oil is mostly used⟦/1⟧

seg.de3654151f5d.t: 3 लौंग, 2 छोट इलायची, 1 इंच दालचीनीक टुकड़ा ⟦1⟧समूचा⟦/1⟧
seg.de3654151f5d.back: 3 cloves, 2 green cardamoms, 1-inch piece of cinnamon ⟦1⟧whole⟦/1⟧

seg.4a1335d92ae2.t: 2 टा पैघ पियाउज ⟦1⟧महीन काटल, करीब 2 कप⟦/1⟧

seg.3347559a7b17.src: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for a thinner gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.t: 1 कप गरम पानि ⟦1⟧पातर ग्रेवी लेल कनेक आओर⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.back: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for a thin gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.cf5fbb1e5375.t: ⟦1⟧सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी⟦/1⟧ सँ सेहो नीक बनैत अछि।
seg.cf5fbb1e5375.back: It also turns out well with ⟦1⟧Sannam chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge if your kitchen is hot.
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.t: चिकनमे दही, तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी, हरदि बुकनी आ नोन मलि दिअ। 30 मिनट राखि दिअ। जँ भनसाघर गरम अछि तँ बर्तन झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे राखू।
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.back: Rub curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt into the chicken. Keep it for 30 minutes. If the kitchen is hot, cover the vessel and keep it in the fridge.

seg.217eb90c7dac.src: Heat the oil in a heavy pan or kadai on medium heat. Add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
seg.217eb90c7dac.t: भारी कड़ाही वा पैनमे मध्यम आँच पर तेल गरम करू। लौंग, इलायची आ दालचीनी डालू आ किछु सेकेंड छनछनाय दिअ।
seg.217eb90c7dac.back: Heat oil in a heavy kadai or pan on medium heat. Add cloves, cardamom and cinnamon and let them sizzle for a few seconds.

seg.41164e7a534a.src: Add the onions, green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.41164e7a534a.t: पियाउज, हरियर मरचाइ आ करी पात डालू।
seg.41164e7a534a.back: Add onion, green chillies and curry leaves.

seg.127dbd26bc4d.src: Fry the onions in oil till deep golden. This takes 12–15 minutes on medium heat; stir often so they brown evenly without burning.
seg.127dbd26bc4d.t: पियाउजकेँ तेलमे गाढ़ सोनहुला होबा धरि भूजू। मध्यम आँच पर एहिमे 12–15 मिनट लगैत अछि; बेर-बेर चलाबैत रहू जाहि सँ बिनु जरने एक समान भूर भऽ जाय।
seg.127dbd26bc4d.back: Fry the onion in the oil until deep golden. On medium heat this takes 12–15 minutes; keep stirring often so that it turns evenly brown without burning.

seg.3fa3e9f33095.src: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomatoes, and cook till soft. Fry the paste for 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then cook the tomatoes for 5–6 minutes, mashing them, until they break down and oil shows at the edges.
seg.3fa3e9f33095.t: आदी-लहसुनक पेस्ट डालू, फेर टमाटर, आ नरम होबा धरि पकाउ। पेस्टकेँ 1 मिनट भूजू जा धरि काँच गन्ध नहि चलि जाय, फेर टमाटरकेँ 5–6 मिनट मसलैत पकाउ, जा धरि ओ गलि नहि जाय आ किनार पर तेल नहि देखाय लागय।
seg.3fa3e9f33095.back: Add the ginger-garlic paste, then the tomatoes, and cook until soft. Fry the paste for 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then cook the tomatoes for 5–6 minutes while mashing, until they break down and oil starts to show at the edges.

seg.24dbd7dfd784.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds.
seg.24dbd7dfd784.t: धनियाँ बुकनी मिला कऽ 30 सेकेंड भूजू।
seg.24dbd7dfd784.back: Mix in coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds.

seg.461e7a0a9c22.src: Add the chicken and cook covered on medium heat till no pink remains near the bone. Fry it uncovered for the first 5 minutes until the pieces turn opaque, then pour in the hot water, cover and cook for about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
seg.461e7a0a9c22.t: चिकन डालू आ झाँपि कऽ मध्यम आँच पर पकाउ, जा धरि हड्डी लग कोनो गुलाबी नहि रहि जाय। पहिल 5 मिनट बिनु झाँपने भूजू जा धरि टुकड़ा अपारदर्शी नहि भऽ जाय, फेर गरम पानि डालू, झाँपू आ करीब 20 मिनट पकाउ, बीच-बीचमे चलबैत रहू।
seg.461e7a0a9c22.back: Add the chicken and cook covered on medium heat, until no pink remains near the bone. Fry uncovered for the first 5 minutes until the pieces become opaque, then add hot water, cover and cook about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.

seg.22f96ed1f76e.src: Check a thick piece: the chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.
seg.22f96ed1f76e.t: एकटा मोट टुकड़ा जाँचू: चिकन तखन पाकल अछि जखन हड्डी लग कोनो गुलाबी नहि रहय आ रस साफ बहय। ग्रेवी चीखू आ जरूरति हो तँ नोन डालू।
seg.22f96ed1f76e.back: Check one thick piece: the chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juice runs clear. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.

seg.f10b1f5ae914.src: Stir in garam masala and coriander leaves. Simmer 3 minutes, uncovered, until the gravy is as thick as you like and a red film of oil floats on top.
seg.f10b1f5ae914.t: गरम मसाला आ धनियाँ पात मिलाउ। बिनु झाँपने 3 मिनट धीमा आँच पर पकाउ, जा धरि ग्रेवी अहाँक पसिन्नक गाढ़ नहि भऽ जाय आ ऊपर तेलक लाल परत नहि तैरय लागय।
seg.f10b1f5ae914.back: Mix in garam masala and coriander leaves. Cook uncovered on low heat for 3 minutes, until the gravy becomes as thick as you like and a red layer of oil starts floating on top.

seg.a7c73631b2ca.src: Switch off and rest the curry for 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the flavour comes together.
seg.a7c73631b2ca.t: आँच बन्द करू आ परसबा सँ पहिने तरकारीकेँ 10 मिनट राखि दिअ; ग्रेवी बैसि जाइत अछि आ स्वाद मिलि जाइत अछि।
seg.a7c73631b2ca.back: Turn off the heat and let the curry rest 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the flavours blend.

seg.0b948e3072fa.src: Brown the onions deep golden; the gravy's colour and body come from them.
seg.0b948e3072fa.t: पियाउजकेँ गाढ़ सोनहुला भूजू; ग्रेवीक रंग आ गाढ़पन ओकरे सँ अबैत अछि।
seg.0b948e3072fa.back: Fry the onion deep golden; the colour and thickness of the gravy come from it.

seg.e0365adcf1bf.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium curry use 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder for red colour with gentler heat.
seg.e0365adcf1bf.t: तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी बड्ड तीख अछि। मध्यम तीख तरकारी लेल 1 छोट चम्मच लिअ, वा लाल रंग आ कम तीख लेल सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी प्रयोग करू।
seg.e0365adcf1bf.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium-hot curry take 1 teaspoon, or use Sannam chilli powder for red colour and less heat.

seg.57940a63282d.src: Use bone-in pieces; the bones give the gravy its depth.
seg.57940a63282d.t: हड्डीबला टुकड़ा लिअ; हड्डी सँ ग्रेवीमे गहींर स्वाद अबैत अछि।
seg.57940a63282d.back: Take bone-in pieces; the bone gives deep flavour to the gravy.

seg.4f9718c3bc6f.src: Let the oil separate from the tomato masala before the chicken goes in, or the gravy tastes raw.
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.t: चिकन डालबा सँ पहिने टमाटरक मसाला सँ तेल अलग होमय दिअ, नहि तँ ग्रेवीक स्वाद काँच लागत।
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.back: Let the oil separate from the tomato masala before adding the chicken, otherwise the gravy will taste raw.

seg.164627c386b7.src: Kobbari kodi kura: grind 3 tbsp grated coconut with 1 tbsp poppy seeds and a little water, and stir the paste in with the garam masala for a richer gravy.
seg.164627c386b7.t: कोब्बरी कोडी कूरा: 3 पैघ चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल नारियल, 1 पैघ चम्मच पोस्तादाना आ कनेक पानि संग पीसू, आ गाढ़ ग्रेवी लेल ई पेस्ट गरम मसालाक संग मिला दिअ।
seg.164627c386b7.back: Kobbari Kodi Koora: grind 3 tablespoons grated coconut, 1 tablespoon poppy seeds with a little water, and mix this paste in with the garam masala for a thick gravy.

seg.7d79f857440a.src: Ground masala: dry-roast 1 tbsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp fennel seeds, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, grind, and use instead of the coriander powder and garam masala.
seg.7d79f857440a.t: पिसल मसाला: 1 पैघ चम्मच साबुत धनियाँ, 1 छोट चम्मच सौंफ, 3 लौंग आ दालचीनीक एकटा छोट टुकड़ा बिनु तेलक भूजि कऽ पीसू, आ धनियाँ बुकनी आ गरम मसालाक बदला ई प्रयोग करू।
seg.7d79f857440a.back: Ground masala: dry-roast without oil 1 tablespoon whole coriander, 1 teaspoon fennel, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon and grind, and use this instead of coriander powder and garam masala.

seg.ea1fd7a2c573.src: Pressure cooker: after adding the chicken and water, cook for 2 whistles and let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.t: प्रेशर कुकर: चिकन आ पानि डाललाक बाद 2 सीटी धरि पकाउ आ प्रेशर अपने उतरय दिअ।
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.back: Pressure cooker: after adding chicken and water, cook up to 2 whistles and let the pressure release by itself.

seg.8b4376996905.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, the Sunday way. It also goes well with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.
seg.8b4376996905.t: रविदिन जकाँ, भापमे पाकल भात आ एक चम्मच घीक संग गरम-गरम परसू। रोटी, डोसा वा रागी संगटिक संग सेहो नीक लगैत अछि।
seg.8b4376996905.back: Like on Sunday, serve piping hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee. It is also good with roti, dosa or ragi sangati.

seg.45cb0a9558e6.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. The curry tastes deeper the next day.
seg.45cb0a9558e6.t: झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे 2 दिन धरि राखू; भीतर धरि नीक जकाँ भाप उठय एहन गरम करू। अगिला दिन तरकारीक स्वाद आओर गहींर लगैत अछि।
seg.45cb0a9558e6.back: Keep covered in the fridge up to 2 days; reheat until it steams well right through. The next day the curry's flavour feels even deeper.

seg.bc11ae48bfcf.src: How do I make Andhra chicken curry less spicy?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.t: आन्ध्र चिकन करीकेँ कम तीख कोना बनाउ?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.back: How to make Andhra chicken curry less hot?

seg.aaa9ea580a50.src: Cut the Teja chilli powder to 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder, which gives the same red colour with gentler heat. A spoon of curd stirred in at the end also softens the bite.
seg.aaa9ea580a50.t: तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी घटा कऽ 1 छोट चम्मच करू, वा सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी प्रयोग करू जे ओहने लाल रंग दैत अछि मुदा कम तीख। अन्तमे एक चम्मच दही मिलेला सँ सेहो झाँस कम होइत अछि।
seg.aaa9ea580a50.back: Reduce Teja chilli powder to 1 teaspoon, or use Sannam chilli powder which gives the same red colour but less heat. Mixing in a spoon of curd at the end also reduces the bite.

seg.fe399a2a853e.src: Why is Andhra chicken curry so spicy?
seg.fe399a2a853e.t: आन्ध्र चिकन करी एतेक तीख किएक होइत अछि?
seg.fe399a2a853e.back: Why is Andhra chicken curry so hot?

seg.ada87f188506.src: Andhra cooking uses Guntur chillies such as Teja, which are much hotter than the chilli powder used in most other regional curries. The heat is part of the dish.
seg.ada87f188506.t: आन्ध्रक भानसमे तेजा सन गुंटूरक मरचाइ लागैत अछि, जे आन क्षेत्रक बेसी तरकारीमे प्रयोग होइत मरचाइ बुकनी सँ बहुत बेसी तीख होइत अछि। तीखपन एहि व्यंजनक हिस्सा अछि।
seg.ada87f188506.back: Andhra cooking uses Guntur chillies like Teja, which are much hotter than the chilli powder used in most curries of other regions. The heat is part of this dish.

seg.fc940ab96cce.src: How do I know the chicken is cooked through?
seg.fc940ab96cce.t: कोना बुझब जे चिकन भीतर धरि पाकि गेल?
seg.fc940ab96cce.back: How to know the chicken is cooked through inside?

seg.1445f73d2fc1.src: Cut into the thickest piece near the bone. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear.
seg.1445f73d2fc1.t: हड्डी लगक सभ सँ मोट टुकड़ा काटि कऽ देखू। चिकन तखन पाकल अछि जखन हड्डी लग कोनो गुलाबी नहि रहय आ रस साफ बहय।
seg.1445f73d2fc1.back: Cut the thickest piece near the bone and look. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juice runs clear.

seg.736c9b09bcd3.src: Can I make kodi kura without curd?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.t: की बिनु दहीक कोडी कूरा बना सकैत छी?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.back: Can I make kodi koora without curd?

seg.f9ab2afc44b4.src: Yes. Marinate the chicken with the chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tbsp lemon juice, and add one more tomato to the gravy.
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.t: हँ। चिकनमे मरचाइ बुकनी, हरदि बुकनी, नोन आ 1 पैघ चम्मच नेबोक रस लगा कऽ राखू, आ ग्रेवीमे एकटा टमाटर बेसी डालू।
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.back: Yes. Marinate the chicken with chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and add one extra tomato to the gravy.

seg.49c9832aa59a.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · Andhra Kodi Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.t: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · आन्ध्र कोडी कूराक रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.back: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · Andhra Kodi Koora recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.dcb6c98b640e.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. The Andhra Sunday chicken curry: chicken marinated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.
seg.dcb6c98b640e.t: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. आन्ध्रक रविदिनबला चिकन करी: तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी आ हरदि बुकनीमे लपेटल चिकन, गरम मसालाक संग गाढ़ पियाउज-टमाटरक ग्रेवीमे पकाओल।
seg.dcb6c98b640e.back: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. Andhra's Sunday chicken curry: chicken coated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a thick onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.

seg.979d83e76a0e.src: Andhra Kodi Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.979d83e76a0e.t: आन्ध्र कोडी कूरा: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.979d83e76a0e.back: Andhra Kodi Koora: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.dd8d5de6151e.t: 3 लौंग, 2 छोट इलायची, 1 इंच दालचीनीक टुकड़ा
seg.dd8d5de6151e.back: 3 cloves, 2 green cardamoms, 1-inch piece of cinnamon

seg.d04209f30de4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Bellam Pongali · Gud Wala Meetha Pongal
seg.d04209f30de4.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · बेल्लम पोंगली · गुड़ वाला मीठा पोंगल
seg.d04209f30de4.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Bellam Pongali · sweet pongal with jaggery

seg.b79702dac541.src: Bellam pongali is the sweet pongal that Telugu homes cook on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal cooked very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and enriched with ghee. It is offered as naivedyam before the festive meal, and it is also the prasadam at many temples and Friday pujas.
seg.b79702dac541.t: बेल्लम पोंगली ओ मीठ पोंगल अछि जे तेलुगु घरमे संक्रान्तिक भोरमे बनैत अछि: चाउर आ भूजल मूँग दालि खूब नरम पकाओल, फेर गुड़ सँ मीठ आ घी सँ भरपूर कयल। पाबनिक भोजन सँ पहिने एकरा नैवेद्यम रूपमे चढ़ाओल जाइत अछि, आ बहुत रास मन्दिर आ शुक्र दिनक पूजामे ई प्रसादम सेहो होइत अछि।
seg.b79702dac541.back: Bellam pongali is that sweet pongal which is made in Telugu homes on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal cooked very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and enriched with ghee. Before the festival meal it is offered as naivedyam, and in many temples and in Friday puja it is also the prasadam.

seg.17053455adbb.src: Cane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and a round, toffee-like sweetness, and ghee-fried whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack add the crunch. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17053455adbb.t: कुसियारक गुड़ सँ एकर रंग हल्लुक भूर आ मिठास भरल, टॉफी सन होइत अछि, आ हमर जीडिपप्पु पैकेटक घीमे तरल समूचा काजू कुरकुरापन दैत अछि। ई रेसिपी 4 लोक लेल अछि।
seg.17053455adbb.back: Sugarcane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and a full, toffee-like sweetness, and whole cashews fried in ghee from our Jeedipappu packet give crunch. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.50377f017e4e.src: Cook time is for a pressure cooker; allow about 15 minutes more in a pot.
seg.50377f017e4e.t: पकाबऽक समय प्रेशर कुकरक हिसाब सँ अछि; पतीलमे करीब 15 मिनट बेसी लागत।
seg.50377f017e4e.back: The cooking time is based on a pressure cooker; in a pot it will take about 15 minutes more.

seg.b323962ddab1.src: Cook roasted moong dal and rice till very soft, stir in melted cane jaggery and simmer till glossy. Finish with ghee-fried cashews, raisins and cardamom.
seg.b323962ddab1.t: भूजल मूँग दालि आ चाउर खूब नरम होबा धरि पकाउ, गलाओल कुसियारक गुड़ मिलाउ आ चमकदार होबा धरि धीमा आँच पर पकाउ। अन्तमे घीमे तरल काजू, किसमिस आ इलायची डालू।
seg.b323962ddab1.back: Cook roasted moong dal and rice until very soft, mix in melted sugarcane jaggery and cook on low heat until glossy. At the end add cashews fried in ghee, raisins and cardamom.

seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.src: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧split yellow moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.t: ¼ कप मूँग दालि ⟦1⟧पीयर फूटल मूँग दालि (पेसरपप्पु), करीब 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.back: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧yellow split moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.9f8bf29ce704.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed, about 150 g; a little more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.t: 1 कप कद्दूकस कयल कुसियारक गुड़ ⟦1⟧हल्लुक दबा कऽ भरल, करीब 150 g; बेसी मीठ पसिन्न हो तँ कनेक आओर⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.back: 1 cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly pressed and filled, about 150 g; a little more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧

seg.8dff8f977372.src: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧to melt the jaggery⟦/1⟧

seg.c9f89d999d7a.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram) ⟦1⟧optional; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.t: एक चुटकी खएबा योग्य कपूर (पच्च कर्पूरम) ⟦1⟧मन हो तँ; बहुत छोट चुटकी⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.back: A pinch of edible camphor (pachcha karpuram) ⟦1⟧if you wish; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧

seg.a6184e3e789c.src: Roast the moong dal till light golden, then cook it with the rice till very soft and mushy. Start by dry-roasting the dal in a pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot on low heat, stirring, until it smells nutty and turns light golden, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.a6184e3e789c.t: मूँग दालि हल्लुक सोनहुला होबा धरि भूजू, फेर चाउरक संग खूब नरम आ गलल होबा धरि पकाउ। शुरूमे प्रेशर कुकर वा भारी तलीबला पतीलमे धीमा आँच पर दालिकेँ बिनु तेलक भूजू, चलबैत रहू, जा धरि ओहि सँ भुनल मेवा सन गन्ध नहि आबय आ हल्लुक सोनहुला नहि भऽ जाय, करीब 3–4 मिनट।
seg.a6184e3e789c.back: Roast the moong dal until light golden, then cook with the rice until very soft and mushy. First, in a pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot, dry-roast the dal without oil on low heat, stirring, until it smells like roasted nuts and becomes light golden, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.03597768c72a.src: Add the rice to the roasted dal, wash both together in 2–3 changes of water, and drain.
seg.03597768c72a.t: भूजल दालिमे चाउर डालू, दुनूकेँ संग 2–3 बेर पानि बदलि कऽ धोउ, आ पानि निथारि लिअ।
seg.03597768c72a.back: Add the rice to the roasted dal, wash both together changing the water 2–3 times, and drain the water.

seg.1c139f802ab6.src: Add the 3 cups water. Pressure cook for 4–5 whistles on medium heat and let the pressure drop on its own, or simmer covered in a pot for 25–30 minutes, adding a splash of hot water if it dries out.
seg.1c139f802ab6.t: 3 कप पानि डालू। मध्यम आँच पर 4–5 सीटी धरि प्रेशर कुकरमे पकाउ आ प्रेशर अपने उतरय दिअ, वा पतीलमे झाँपि कऽ 25–30 मिनट धीमा आँच पर पकाउ; सुखय लागय तँ कनेक गरम पानि डालि दिअ।
seg.1c139f802ab6.back: Add 3 cups water. Pressure-cook on medium heat for 4–5 whistles and let the pressure release by itself, or in a pot cook covered on low heat for 25–30 minutes; if it starts drying add a little hot water.

seg.5c9fcb8182ea.src: Open and mash the rice and dal lightly with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.t: खोलू आ करछुलक पाछू सँ चाउर आ दालिकेँ हल्लुक मसलि दिअ। ई नरम आ दलिया सन हेबाक चाही, सुखल नहि।
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.back: Open and lightly mash the rice and dal with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.

seg.41870045e57c.src: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and pour it into the rice. Warm the jaggery and water in a small pan on low heat, stirring, just until it dissolves, about 2–3 minutes; it does not need to boil.
seg.41870045e57c.t: गुड़केँ ¼ कप पानिमे गला कऽ चाउरमे ढारि दिअ। एकटा छोट बर्तनमे धीमा आँच पर गुड़ आ पानि चलबैत गरम करू, बस घुलबा धरि, करीब 2–3 मिनट; खौलेबाक जरूरति नहि।
seg.41870045e57c.back: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and pour into the rice. In a small vessel heat jaggery and water on low heat while stirring, just until dissolved, about 2–3 minutes; no need to boil.

seg.ca9ed938d301.src: Simmer, stirring, till thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; stir in 2 tbsp ghee. Keep the heat low and stir all the way to the bottom, as the pongali catches easily once the jaggery is in.
seg.ca9ed938d301.t: चलबैत धीमा आँच पर पकाउ जा धरि गाढ़ आ चमकदार नहि भऽ जाय, 5–7 मिनट; 2 पैघ चम्मच घी मिलाउ। आँच धीमा राखू आ तली धरि चलबैत रहू, किएक तँ गुड़ पड़लाक बाद पोंगली जल्दी तलीमे सटि जाइत अछि।
seg.ca9ed938d301.back: Cook on low heat while stirring until it becomes thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; mix in 2 tablespoons ghee. Keep the heat low and keep stirring to the bottom, because after jaggery goes in the pongali quickly sticks to the bottom.

seg.58e11747230d.src: Taste, and stir in a little more melted jaggery if you want it sweeter.
seg.58e11747230d.t: चीखू, आ बेसी मीठ चाही तँ कनेक आओर गलाओल गुड़ मिला दिअ।
seg.58e11747230d.back: Taste, and if you want it sweeter mix in a little more melted jaggery.

seg.9eabfb77c3db.src: Fry the cashews in the rest of the ghee; add with the cardamom. Heat the remaining 2 tbsp ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat and stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding the raisins for the last few seconds until they puff up.
seg.9eabfb77c3db.t: बाकी घीमे काजू तरू; इलायचीक संग डालू। एकटा छोट बर्तनमे मध्यम-धीमा आँच पर बचल 2 पैघ चम्मच घी गरम करू आ काजू सोनहुला होबा धरि चलाउ, करीब 1 मिनट; अन्तिम किछु सेकेंडमे किसमिस डालू जा धरि ओ फूलि नहि जाय।
seg.9eabfb77c3db.back: Fry cashews in the remaining ghee; add with the cardamom. In a small vessel heat the remaining 2 tablespoons ghee on medium-low heat and stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute; add raisins in the last few seconds until they puff up.

seg.4f12a8dd8723.src: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle in the cardamom powder and the camphor, if using, and stir well.
seg.4f12a8dd8723.t: काजू, किसमिस आ घी पोंगली पर ढारि दिअ, इलायची बुकनी आ जँ लैत छी तँ कपूर छीटू, आ नीक जकाँ मिलाउ।
seg.4f12a8dd8723.back: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle cardamom powder and, if you are using it, camphor, and mix well.

seg.25eb1725b7f2.src: Switch off and serve warm. Pongali thickens as it stands; loosen it with a few spoons of hot water if needed.
seg.25eb1725b7f2.t: आँच बन्द करू आ गरम-गरम परसू। राखल रहला सँ पोंगली गाढ़ भऽ जाइत अछि; जरूरति हो तँ किछु चम्मच गरम पानि डालि कऽ पातर करू।
seg.25eb1725b7f2.back: Turn off the heat and serve piping hot. On standing the pongali thickens; if needed thin it by adding a few spoons of hot water.

seg.d8d20508ad3b.src: Cook the rice and dal fully soft; they stop softening once the jaggery goes in.
seg.d8d20508ad3b.t: चाउर आ दालि पूरा नरम पकाउ; गुड़ पड़लाक बाद ओ आओर नरम नहि होइत अछि।
seg.d8d20508ad3b.back: Cook the rice and dal fully soft; after the jaggery goes in they do not get any softer.

seg.c5408f916731.src: Roasting the moong dal gives pongali its nutty smell; keep the heat low so it turns golden, not brown.
seg.c5408f916731.t: मूँग दालि भुजला सँ पोंगलीमे भुनल मेवा सन गन्ध अबैत अछि; आँच धीमा राखू जाहि सँ ओ सोनहुला हो, भूर नहि।
seg.c5408f916731.back: Roasting the moong dal gives the pongali a roasted-nut smell; keep the heat low so that it is golden, not brown.

seg.5ed9375ff107.src: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and keep stirring once the jaggery is in; it catches and burns quickly.
seg.5ed9375ff107.t: भारी तलीबला बर्तन लिअ आ गुड़ पड़लाक बाद चलबैत रहू; ई जल्दी सटि कऽ जरि जाइत अछि।
seg.5ed9375ff107.back: Take a heavy-bottomed vessel and keep stirring after the jaggery goes in; it quickly sticks and burns.

seg.92b31a616baa.src: Take the pongali off the heat while it is still a little loose; it sets as it cools.
seg.92b31a616baa.t: पोंगली कनेक ढील रहिते आँच सँ उतारि लिअ; ठंढ़ाइत-ठंढ़ाइत ई जमि जाइत अछि।
seg.92b31a616baa.back: Take the pongali off the heat while it is still a little loose; it sets as it cools.

seg.1c14403a599f.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for a darker pongali with a deeper, smoky sweetness.
seg.1c14403a599f.t: ताड़क गुड़: बेसी गाढ़ रंगक, गहींर आ धुआँ सन मिठासबला पोंगली लेल ओतबे कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़ प्रयोग करू।
seg.1c14403a599f.back: Palm jaggery: for a darker-coloured pongali with a deep, smoky sweetness, use the same amount of grated palm jaggery.

seg.d1a4e19c923c.src: Chakkera pongali: use ¾ cup sugar in place of the jaggery for a pale, sugar-sweet version.
seg.d1a4e19c923c.t: चक्केर पोंगली: गुड़क बदला ¾ कप चीनी लिअ, एहि सँ हल्लुक रंगक, चीनीक मिठासबला पोंगली बनैत अछि।
seg.d1a4e19c923c.back: Chakkera pongali: instead of jaggery take ¾ cup sugar, this makes a lighter-coloured pongali with sugar sweetness.

seg.44acc6e45d4b.src: Offer it as naivedyam on Sankranti morning, then serve it warm with the festive meal, alongside pulihora and garelu.
seg.44acc6e45d4b.t: संक्रान्तिक भोरमे एकरा नैवेद्यम रूपमे चढ़ाउ, फेर पाबनिक भोजनमे पुलिहोरा आ गारेलुक संग गरम-गरम परसू।
seg.44acc6e45d4b.back: On Sankranti morning offer it as naivedyam, then serve piping hot in the festival meal with pulihora and garelu.

seg.b4e15a70f8c8.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm with a splash of hot water and a little ghee, stirring, before serving.
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.t: बचल पोंगली झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे राखू आ 2 दिनक भीतर खा लिअ। परसबा सँ पहिने कनेक गरम पानि आ थोड़ घी डालि, चलबैत गरम करू।
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.back: Keep leftover pongali covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Before serving, add a little hot water and a little ghee and heat while stirring.

seg.70c91f153ba8.src: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?
seg.70c91f153ba8.t: पोंगली आ चक्केर पोंगलीमे की अन्तर अछि?
seg.70c91f153ba8.back: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?

seg.75f25d8f552a.src: Pongali on its own often means the savoury version made with pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are the sweet versions, made with sugar or jaggery.
seg.75f25d8f552a.t: खाली पोंगली कहला सँ बेसी काल ओ नमकीन पोंगली बुझल जाइत अछि जे गोलमरिच आ जीर सँ बनैत अछि। चक्केर पोंगली आ बेल्लम पोंगली मीठ रूप अछि, जे चीनी वा गुड़ सँ बनैत अछि।
seg.75f25d8f552a.back: Saying just pongali is mostly understood as the savoury pongali which is made with black pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are sweet versions, made with sugar or jaggery.

seg.94d3b2adcbef.src: Can I make bellam pongali in a pressure cooker?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.t: की बेल्लम पोंगली प्रेशर कुकरमे बना सकैत छी?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.back: Can I make bellam pongali in a pressure cooker?

seg.269aace6e2a8.src: Yes. Cook the roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water for 4–5 whistles, let the pressure drop on its own, then add the melted jaggery and simmer in the open cooker.
seg.269aace6e2a8.t: हँ। भूजल दालि आ चाउरकेँ 3 कप पानिक संग 4–5 सीटी धरि पकाउ, प्रेशर अपने उतरय दिअ, फेर गलाओल गुड़ डालि कऽ खुजल कुकरमे धीमा आँच पर पकाउ।
seg.269aace6e2a8.back: Yes. Cook the roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water for 4–5 whistles, let the pressure release by itself, then add melted jaggery and cook on low heat in the open cooker.

seg.cd439685b7b5.src: Why did my pongali turn hard after cooling?
seg.cd439685b7b5.t: ठंढ़ा भेलाक बाद हमर पोंगली कड़ा किएक भऽ गेल?
seg.cd439685b7b5.back: Why did my pongali become hard after cooling?

seg.696811a7ce7d.src: Pongali sets as it cools, and simmering too long after the jaggery goes in makes it firmer. Take it off while it is still a little loose, and loosen leftovers with hot water.
seg.696811a7ce7d.t: ठंढ़ाइत-ठंढ़ाइत पोंगली जमि जाइत अछि, आ गुड़ पड़लाक बाद बेसी काल धरि पकेला सँ आओर कड़ा भऽ जाइत अछि। कनेक ढील रहिते उतारि लिअ, आ बचल पोंगलीकेँ गरम पानि सँ पातर करू।
seg.696811a7ce7d.back: The pongali sets as it cools, and cooking too long after jaggery goes in makes it even harder. Take it off while still a little loose, and thin leftover pongali with hot water.

seg.b0499dbc1bd0.src: Can I use palm jaggery for pongali?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.t: की पोंगली लेल ताड़क गुड़ प्रयोग कऽ सकैत छी?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.back: Can I use palm jaggery for pongali?

seg.7ee832015d30.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The pongali turns darker and tastes deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7ee832015d30.t: हँ। ओतबे कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़ (ताटि बेल्लम) प्रयोग करू। पोंगली बेसी गाढ़ रंगक होइत अछि आ स्वाद बेसी गहींर आ कनेक धुआँ सन।
seg.7ee832015d30.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The pongali becomes darker in colour and the taste deeper and a little smoky.

seg.978f1b90a63e.src: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked soft, sweetened with cane jaggery and finished with ghee-fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.978f1b90a63e.t: బెల్లం పొంగలి. संक्रान्ति लेल बेल्लम पोंगली: चाउर आ भूजल मूँग दालि नरम पकाओल, कुसियारक गुड़ सँ मीठ कयल आ अन्तमे घीमे तरल काजू। 4 लोक लेल।
seg.978f1b90a63e.back: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked soft, sweetened with sugarcane jaggery and cashews fried in ghee at the end. For 4 people.

seg.ad0644e2314c.src: Bellam Pongali: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.ad0644e2314c.t: बेल्लम पोंगली: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.ad0644e2314c.back: Bellam Pongali: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram)
seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.t: एक चुटकी खएबा योग्य कपूर (पच्च कर्पूरम)
seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.back: A pinch of edible camphor (pachcha karpuram)

seg.79401823a930.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.t: आन्ध्र चेपला पुलुसु ⟦1⟧(आन्ध्रक इमलीबला माछक झोर)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra's tamarind fish curry)⟦/1⟧

seg.0fff539adaed.src: Chepala pulusu is the tamarind fish curry of coastal Andhra, made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick fish steaks simmered in a sour, red tamarind gravy with onions, green chillies and curry leaves. It is a Sunday lunch dish, and many homes cook it in a clay pot and keep it for the next day, when the gravy has soaked into the fish.
seg.0fff539adaed.t: चेपला पुलुसु तटीय आन्ध्रक इमलीबला माछक झोर अछि, जे गोदावरी जिला सभमे खास मनोयोग सँ बनैत अछि: माछक मोट टुकड़ा खट्टा, लाल इमलीक ग्रेवीमे पियाउज, हरियर मरचाइ आ करी पातक संग धीमा आँच पर पकाओल। ई रविदिनक दुपहरियाक व्यंजन अछि, आ बहुत घरमे एकरा माटिक हाँड़ीमे बना कऽ अगिला दिन लेल राखल जाइत अछि, जखन ग्रेवी माछमे पैसि जाइत अछि।
seg.0fff539adaed.back: Chepala pulusu is coastal Andhra's tamarind fish curry, made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick fish pieces cooked on low heat in a sour, red tamarind gravy with onion, green chilli and curry leaves. It is a Sunday-afternoon dish, and in many homes it is made in a clay pot and kept for the next day, when the gravy soaks into the fish.

seg.17fc336d9c12.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the marinade and the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its deep red colour and a steady heat that balances the tamarind. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17fc336d9c12.t: हमर हरदि बुकनी मसालामे आ ग्रेवीमे दुनूमे पड़ैत अछि। सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी पुलुसुकेँ गाढ़ लाल रंग आ एक समान तीख दैत अछि जे इमलीक खट्टापनकेँ सम्हारैत अछि। ई रेसिपी 4 लोक लेल अछि।
seg.17fc336d9c12.back: Our turmeric powder goes both into the marinade and into the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu a deep red colour and an even heat which balances the sourness of the tamarind. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.4ba98eee496a.src: Prep includes the 15-minute marinade. The curry tastes even better after resting a few hours.
seg.4ba98eee496a.t: तैयारीमे मसाला लगा कऽ रखबाक 15 मिनट जोड़ल अछि। किछु घंटा राखल रहला पर झोरक स्वाद आओर नीक लगैत अछि।
seg.4ba98eee496a.back: Prep includes 15 minutes of keeping it marinated. After resting a few hours the curry tastes even better.

seg.aed84f9a20f5.src: Marinate fish with salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry onions and spices, boil them in tamarind water, then simmer the fish gently in the gravy without stirring.
seg.aed84f9a20f5.t: माछमे नोन, हरदि आ मरचाइ बुकनी लगा कऽ राखू, पियाउज आ मसाला भूजू, इमलीक पानिमे खौलाउ, फेर बिनु चलौने माछकेँ ग्रेवीमे धीमा आँच पर पकाउ।
seg.aed84f9a20f5.back: Marinate the fish with salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry onion and masala, boil in tamarind water, then cook the fish in the gravy on low heat without stirring.

seg.5ce3c9cccf94.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.t: 500 g माछक टुकड़ा ⟦1⟧कड़ा माछ, मोट टुकड़ामे काटल: रोहु (बोच्चा), कोरमीनु (सौरा) वा सुरमई (वंजरम)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish, cut into thick pieces: rohu (bochcha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.23a800982a03.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.t: 40 g इमली ⟦1⟧नेबो जतेक पैघ गोला, 2 कप गुनगुन पानिमे 15 मिनट भिजाओल⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a ball as big as a lemon, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.f8dec19a56f9.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ tsp for the marinade, ¼ tsp for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.t: ½ छोट चम्मच हरदि बुकनी ⟦1⟧¼ छोट चम्मच मसाला लगाबऽ लेल, ¼ छोट चम्मच ग्रेवी लेल⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ teaspoon for marinating, ¼ teaspoon for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.c78341163232.src: 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 tsp for the marinade, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.t: 2 पैघ चम्मच सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी ⟦1⟧1 छोट चम्मच मसाला लगाबऽ लेल, बाकी ग्रेवी लेल⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.back: 2 tablespoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon for marinating, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.bcbd97cd906a.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.t: 1 छोट चम्मच नोन ⟦1⟧ग्रेवी लेल, वा स्वाद अनुसार⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.back: 1 teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.ba6dcf57651d.t: ⟦1⟧तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी⟦/1⟧ सँ सेहो नीक बनैत अछि।
seg.ba6dcf57651d.back: It also turns out well with ⟦1⟧Teja chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.2fafef6b8781.src: Wash the fish pieces gently in water two or three times and drain them well.
seg.2fafef6b8781.t: माछक टुकड़ाकेँ पानिमे दू-तीन बेर हल्लुक हाथ सँ धोउ आ नीक जकाँ पानि निथारि लिअ।
seg.2fafef6b8781.back: Wash the fish pieces in water two or three times with a gentle hand and drain the water well.

seg.cf370c2b1459.src: Rub the fish with salt, turmeric and 1 tsp chilli powder; rest 15 minutes. Use 1 tsp salt and ¼ tsp of the turmeric powder for the marinade.
seg.cf370c2b1459.t: माछमे नोन, हरदि आ 1 छोट चम्मच मरचाइ बुकनी मलू; 15 मिनट राखि दिअ। मसाला लेल 1 छोट चम्मच नोन आ ¼ छोट चम्मच हरदि बुकनी लिअ।
seg.cf370c2b1459.back: Rub salt, turmeric and 1 teaspoon chilli powder into the fish; leave for 15 minutes. For the marinade take 1 teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon turmeric powder.

seg.0c7defd6c85a.src: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its water and strain it. You should have about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.
seg.0c7defd6c85a.t: भिजाओल इमलीकेँ ओकरे पानिमे नीक जकाँ निचोड़ू आ छानि लिअ। करीब 2 कप पातर इमलीक पानि हेबाक चाही।
seg.0c7defd6c85a.back: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its own water and strain it. There should be about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.

seg.a8777ed4c461.src: Heat the oil in a wide pan or clay pot on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds and cumin seeds and let them splutter, taking care that the fenugreek does not turn dark.
seg.a8777ed4c461.t: चाकर पैन वा माटिक हाँड़ीमे मध्यम आँच पर तेल गरम करू। मेथी, सरिसो आ जीर डालू आ चटकय दिअ; ध्यान राखू जे मेथी करिया नहि होअय।
seg.a8777ed4c461.back: Heat oil on medium heat in a wide pan or clay pot. Add fenugreek, mustard and cumin and let them crackle; take care that the fenugreek does not turn black.

seg.e87b5c1bcc02.src: Fry the onions, chillies and curry leaves in oil till soft; add the spice powders. Fry the onions about 6–8 minutes until soft and light golden, add the ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, the remaining Sannam chilli powder and the coriander powder and stir for 30 seconds.
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.t: पियाउज, मरचाइ आ करी पातकेँ तेलमे नरम होबा धरि भूजू; मसाला बुकनी डालू। पियाउजकेँ करीब 6–8 मिनट भूजू जा धरि नरम आ हल्लुक सोनहुला नहि भऽ जाय, आदी-लहसुनक पेस्ट आ टमाटर डालि 2 मिनट पकाउ, फेर बचल हरदि बुकनी, बचल सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी आ धनियाँ बुकनी डालि 30 सेकेंड चलाउ।
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.back: Fry onion, chillies and curry leaves in the oil until soft; add the masala powders. Fry the onion for about 6–8 minutes until soft and light golden, add ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, remaining Sannam chilli powder and coriander powder and stir 30 seconds.

seg.61e849535fa9.src: Pour in the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes till the oil rises. Add the salt for the gravy; the raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy slightly thick.
seg.61e849535fa9.t: इमलीक पानि ढारू आ तेल ऊपर आबय धरि 10 मिनट खौलाउ। ग्रेवी लेल नोन डालू; इमलीक काँच गन्ध चलि जेबाक चाही आ ग्रेवी कनेक गाढ़ हेबाक चाही।
seg.61e849535fa9.back: Pour in the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes until oil comes to the top. Add salt for the gravy; the raw smell of tamarind should go and the gravy should become slightly thick.

seg.65cb3d6833cd.src: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, as the fish will take in some of it.
seg.65cb3d6833cd.t: ग्रेवी चीखू। ई साफ-साफ खट्टा, नोनगर आ तीख हेबाक चाही, किएक तँ माछ ओहिमे सँ किछु सोखि लेत।
seg.65cb3d6833cd.back: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, because the fish will absorb some of it.

seg.fc6f288cacf9.src: Slide in the fish and simmer covered 10–12 minutes; swirl, do not stir. Lay the pieces in one layer, spoon gravy over them and keep the heat low.
seg.fc6f288cacf9.t: माछ धीरे सँ डालू आ झाँपि कऽ 10–12 मिनट धीमा आँच पर पकाउ; बर्तन घुमाउ, चम्मच सँ नहि चलाउ। टुकड़ा एक परतमे राखू, ऊपर सँ ग्रेवी ढारू आ आँच धीमा राखू।
seg.fc6f288cacf9.back: Add the fish gently and cook covered on low heat for 10–12 minutes; swirl the vessel, do not stir with a spoon. Keep the pieces in one layer, pour gravy over the top and keep the heat low.

seg.9fed4db6e81b.src: Check one piece at the thickest part: the fish is cooked when the flesh is white or opaque right through and comes away from the bone easily.
seg.9fed4db6e81b.t: एकटा टुकड़ाक सभ सँ मोट भाग जाँचू: माछ तखन पाकल अछि जखन मासु भीतर धरि उज्जर वा अपारदर्शी भऽ जाय आ हड्डी सँ आसानी सँ छुटि जाय।
seg.9fed4db6e81b.back: Check the thickest part of one piece: the fish is cooked when the flesh turns white or opaque right through and comes off the bone easily.

seg.8a5166c34dc3.src: Sprinkle the coriander leaves, switch off and let the pulusu rest at least 30 minutes, covered, before serving.
seg.8a5166c34dc3.t: धनियाँ पात छीटू, आँच बन्द करू आ परसबा सँ पहिने पुलुसुकेँ झाँपि कऽ कम सँ कम 30 मिनट राखि दिअ।
seg.8a5166c34dc3.back: Sprinkle coriander leaves, turn off the heat and keep the pulusu covered for at least 30 minutes before serving.

seg.c6819a9980cc.src: Swirl the pan instead of stirring so the fish stays whole.
seg.c6819a9980cc.t: चलेबाक बदला बर्तन घुमाउ जाहि सँ माछ साबुत रहय।
seg.c6819a9980cc.back: Swirl the vessel instead of stirring so that the fish stays whole.

seg.1333bb67a0a8.src: Pick a firm fish with thick steaks; thin fillets break up in the long simmer.
seg.1333bb67a0a8.t: मोट टुकड़ाबला कड़ा माछ चुनू; पातर फिले देर धरि पकेला सँ टूटि जाइत अछि।
seg.1333bb67a0a8.back: Choose firm fish with thick pieces; thin fillets break when cooked long.

seg.dd6f5d867621.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat. Use 1½ tbsp for a milder pulusu, or the full 2 tbsp for the usual Andhra heat.
seg.dd6f5d867621.t: सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी मध्यम तीख दैत अछि। कम तीख पुलुसु लेल 1½ पैघ चम्मच लिअ, वा आन्ध्रक सामान्य तीख लेल पूरा 2 पैघ चम्मच।
seg.dd6f5d867621.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. For a less hot pulusu take 1½ tablespoons, or the full 2 tablespoons for usual Andhra heat.

seg.6196c7ae078f.src: Boil the tamarind gravy well before the fish goes in; once the fish is in, you cannot cook it much longer without it breaking.
seg.6196c7ae078f.t: माछ डालबा सँ पहिने इमलीक ग्रेवी नीक जकाँ खौला लिअ; माछ पड़लाक बाद ओकरा बेसी काल नहि पका सकैत छी, नहि तँ टूटि जायत।
seg.6196c7ae078f.back: Boil the tamarind gravy well before adding the fish; after the fish goes in you cannot cook it long, otherwise it will break.

seg.cadf91d0b4a1.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu, use 1 tbsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam in the gravy. Teja is very hot; start with 2 tsp if unsure.
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.t: तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी: बेसी तीख पुलुसु लेल ग्रेवीमे सन्नमक बदला 1 पैघ चम्मच तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी लिअ। तेजा बड्ड तीख अछि; पक्का नहि होइ तँ 2 छोट चम्मच सँ शुरू करू।
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu take 1 tablespoon Teja chilli powder in the gravy instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot; if unsure start with 2 teaspoons.

seg.1639b09f9df2.src: Royyala pulusu: use 400 g cleaned prawns and simmer only 5–6 minutes, until they turn pink and curl.
seg.1639b09f9df2.t: रोय्याला पुलुसु: 400 g साफ कयल झींगा लिअ आ मात्र 5–6 मिनट धीमा आँच पर पकाउ, जा धरि ओ गुलाबी भऽ कऽ मुड़ि नहि जाय।
seg.1639b09f9df2.back: Royyala pulusu: take 400 g cleaned prawns and cook only 5–6 minutes on low heat, until they turn pink and curl.

seg.f5f2c78097e7.src: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer, Godavari homes add slices of raw mango and use less tamarind.
seg.f5f2c78097e7.t: मामिडिकाया पुलुसु: गर्मीमे गोदावरीक घरमे काँच आमक फाँक डालल जाइत अछि आ इमली कम लेल जाइत अछि।
seg.f5f2c78097e7.back: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer in Godavari homes raw mango slices are added and less tamarind is taken.

seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.src: Serve with hot steamed rice and sliced onions. Many Godavari homes serve it the next day, when the flavours have settled.
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.t: गरम भापमे पाकल भात आ काटल पियाउजक संग परसू। गोदावरीक बहुत घरमे एकरा अगिला दिन परसल जाइत अछि, जखन स्वाद बैसि जाइत अछि।
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.back: Serve with hot steamed rice and chopped onion. In many Godavari homes it is served the next day, when the flavour settles.

seg.ec67fc31e8d9.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring.
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.t: बचल झोर झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे राखू आ 2 दिनक भीतर खा लिअ। पैनमे बिनु चलौने धीरे-धीरे गरम करू।
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.back: Keep leftover curry covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat slowly in a pan without stirring.

seg.3fb4609a3953.src: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?
seg.3fb4609a3953.t: चेपला पुलुसु लेल कोन माछ सभ सँ नीक अछि?
seg.3fb4609a3953.back: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?

seg.81c757cf9b6b.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), murrel (korameenu), catla or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.81c757cf9b6b.t: मोट टुकड़ामे काटल कड़ा नदी वा समुद्रक माछ: रोहु (बोच्चा), सौरा (कोरमीनु), भाकुर वा सुरमई। काँटबला छोट माछ सेहो चलैत अछि मुदा हल्लुक हाथ सँ सम्हारऽ पड़ैत अछि।
seg.81c757cf9b6b.back: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick pieces: rohu (bochcha), murrel (korameenu), catla or seer fish. Small bony fish also work but need handling with a gentle hand.

seg.1d2170a88905.src: Why does chepala pulusu taste better the next day?
seg.1d2170a88905.t: चेपला पुलुसु अगिला दिन बेसी स्वादिष्ट किएक लगैत अछि?
seg.1d2170a88905.back: Why does chepala pulusu taste better the next day?

seg.566bd302c316.src: Resting gives the fish time to soak up the tamarind and chilli gravy, and the sourness and heat even out. That is why many homes cook it in the morning for dinner or the next day.
seg.566bd302c316.t: राखल रहला सँ माछकेँ इमली आ मरचाइक ग्रेवी सोखबाक समय भेटैत अछि, आ खट्टापन आ तीख एक समान भऽ जाइत अछि। तेँ बहुत घरमे एकरा भोरे राति लेल वा अगिला दिन लेल बनाओल जाइत अछि।
seg.566bd302c316.back: On resting the fish gets time to absorb the tamarind and chilli gravy, and the sourness and heat become even. So in many homes it is made in the morning for night or for the next day.

seg.53fa2d1b73d6.src: How do I stop the fish from breaking in the curry?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.t: झोरमे माछ टूटय नहि, ताहि लेल की करी?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.back: What to do so the fish does not break in the curry?

seg.adc2b712af00.src: Use thick steaks, add them only after the gravy has boiled, keep the heat low and swirl the pan instead of stirring with a spoon.
seg.adc2b712af00.t: मोट टुकड़ा लिअ, ग्रेवी खौललाक बादे डालू, आँच धीमा राखू आ चम्मच सँ चलेबाक बदला बर्तन घुमाउ।
seg.adc2b712af00.back: Take thick pieces, add them only after the gravy has boiled, keep the heat low and swirl the vessel instead of stirring with a spoon.

seg.9f483b378e98.src: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?
seg.9f483b378e98.back: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?

seg.f77f33d6b7c5.src: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups of warm water. Use a little less if you add tomato or raw mango.
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.t: करीब 40 g, नेबो जतेक पैघ गोला, 2 कप गुनगुन पानिमे भिजाओल। टमाटर वा काँच आम डालैत छी तँ कनेक कम लिअ।
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.back: About 40 g, a ball as big as a lemon, soaked in 2 cups lukewarm water. If you add tomato or raw mango take a little less.

seg.d9010e0c2ca6.src: చేపల పులుసు · Andhra Fish Curry Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.t: చేపల పులుసు · आन्ध्र माछक झोरक रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.back: చేపల పులుసు · Andhra fish curry recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.03c44db05afe.src: చేపల పులుసు. Godavari-style fish curry: fish simmered in a tangy tamarind gravy with onions, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. Serves 4, with tips and FAQs.
seg.03c44db05afe.t: చేపల పులుసు. गोदावरी तरीकाक माछक झोर: पियाउज, हमर हरदि आ सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनीक संग खट्टा इमलीक ग्रेवीमे धीमा आँच पर पकाओल माछ। 4 लोक लेल, सुझाव आ प्रश्नोत्तरक संग।
seg.03c44db05afe.back: చేపల పులుసు. Godavari-style fish curry: fish cooked on low heat in a sour tamarind gravy with onion, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. For 4 people, with tips and Q&A.

seg.d8b8fe1085c2.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.t: आन्ध्र चेपला पुलुसु (आन्ध्रक इमलीबला माछक झोर) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra's tamarind fish curry) · 1acrefarms

seg.244c08d4fc5c.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.244c08d4fc5c.t: आन्ध्र चेपला पुलुसु: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.244c08d4fc5c.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.fabe2a976262.src: Gongura mamsam is mutton cooked with gongura, the sour sorrel leaf that Andhra, and Guntur above all, treats as its own. The mutton is cooked soft with chilli and turmeric, then simmered with gongura that has been sauteed down to a dark, tangy paste, until the curry is thick and the oil rises to the top.
seg.fabe2a976262.t: गोंगुरा मामसम गोंगुराक संग पकाओल मटन अछि; गोंगुरा ओ खट्टा पात अछि जकरा आन्ध्र, आ सभ सँ बेसी गुंटूर, अपन मानैत अछि। मटनकेँ मरचाइ आ हरदिक संग नरम पकाओल जाइत अछि, फेर गाढ़ रंगक, खट्टा पेस्ट बनबा धरि भूजल गोंगुराक संग धीमा आँच पर पकाओल जाइत अछि, जा धरि तरकारी गाढ़ नहि भऽ जाय आ तेल ऊपर नहि आबि जाय।
seg.fabe2a976262.back: Gongura mamsam is mutton cooked with gongura; gongura is that sour leaf which Andhra, and most of all Guntur, considers its own. The mutton is cooked tender with chilli and turmeric, then cooked on low heat with gongura fried until it becomes a dark, sour paste, until the curry thickens and oil comes to the top.

seg.a26e996a46c7.src: Gongura's sharp sourness needs strong heat to stand up to it, and that comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli, with our turmeric powder alongside. Serves 4 with rice.
seg.a26e996a46c7.t: गोंगुराक तेज खट्टापनक आगू टिकबा लेल कड़गर तीख चाही, आ ओ हमर तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी सँ अबैत अछि, गुंटूरक बड्ड तीख मरचाइ, संगमे हमर हरदि बुकनी। भातक संग 4 लोक लेल।
seg.a26e996a46c7.back: To stand up to gongura's sharp sourness a strong heat is needed, and it comes from our Teja chilli powder, Guntur's very hot chilli, along with our turmeric powder. For 4 people with rice.

seg.18985156497a.src: Pressure-cook mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then simmer it with an onion masala and sauteed gongura leaves till thick and the oil floats on top.
seg.18985156497a.t: मटनकेँ तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी, हरदि बुकनी आ आदी-लहसुनक पेस्टक संग प्रेशर कुकरमे पकाउ, फेर पियाउजक मसाला आ भूजल गोंगुरा पातक संग गाढ़ होबा धरि आ तेल ऊपर तैरबा धरि धीमा आँच पर पकाउ।
seg.18985156497a.back: Cook the mutton in a pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then cook on low heat with the onion masala and fried gongura leaves until thick and until oil floats on top.

seg.b4cc59b185d3.src: 750 g mutton ⟦1⟧bone-in curry cut, washed and drained⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.t: 750 g मटन ⟦1⟧हड्डीबला करी-कट, धोइ कऽ पानि निथारल⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.back: 750 g mutton ⟦1⟧bone-in curry-cut, washed and drained⟦/1⟧

seg.b66b468c45f7.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), picked from the stems, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.t: 4 कप गोंगुरा पात ⟦1⟧करीब 2 मुट्ठा (150 g), डाँट सँ तोड़ल, धोइ कऽ नीक जकाँ पानि निथारल⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), plucked from stems, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧

seg.9d6372d75a2f.src: 4 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9d6372d75a2f.t: 4 पैघ चम्मच तेल ⟦1⟧बेसी मूँगफलीक तेल चलैत अछि⟦/1⟧
seg.9d6372d75a2f.back: 4 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is mostly used⟦/1⟧

seg.c89b5d92359a.src: Put the mutton in a pressure cooker with the Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and leave for 15 minutes.
seg.c89b5d92359a.t: मटनकेँ प्रेशर कुकरमे तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी, हरदि बुकनी, आदी-लहसुनक पेस्ट आ नोनक संग राखू, नीक जकाँ मिलाउ आ 15 मिनट छोड़ि दिअ।
seg.c89b5d92359a.back: Put the mutton in a pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and leave for 15 minutes.

seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.src: Pressure-cook the mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add the 1½ cups water and cook for 5–6 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.t: मटनकेँ तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी, हरदि, आदी-लहसुनक पेस्ट, नोन आ पानिक संग प्रेशर कुकरमे पकाउ। 1½ कप पानि डालू आ मध्यम आँच पर 5–6 सीटी धरि पकाउ, फेर प्रेशर अपने उतरय दिअ।
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.back: Cook the mutton in a pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add 1½ cups water and cook on medium heat for 5–6 whistles, then let the pressure release by itself.

seg.c084351b01db.src: Open the cooker and check a piece: the mutton is done when it is tender and pulls away from the bone easily with a spoon. If not, cook for 1–2 more whistles.
seg.c084351b01db.t: कुकर खोलू आ एकटा टुकड़ा जाँचू: मटन तखन पाकल अछि जखन नरम भऽ जाय आ चम्मच सँ हड्डी सँ आसानी सँ छुटि जाय। नहि तँ 1–2 सीटी आओर पकाउ।
seg.c084351b01db.back: Open the cooker and check one piece: the mutton is cooked when it becomes tender and comes off the bone easily with a spoon. Otherwise cook 1–2 more whistles.

seg.80af0da3b5a1.src: While the mutton cooks, heat the 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium heat.
seg.80af0da3b5a1.t: मटन पकैत रहय ताबत एकटा पैनमे मध्यम आँच पर 1 पैघ चम्मच तेल गरम करू।
seg.80af0da3b5a1.back: While the mutton cooks, heat 1 tablespoon oil in a pan on medium heat.

seg.c59d6a34def2.src: Saute the gongura with green chillies in a little oil till it melts to a dark paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir often and mash the leaves with the back of the spoon as they wilt.
seg.c59d6a34def2.t: गोंगुराकेँ हरियर मरचाइक संग कनेक तेलमे भूजू जा धरि ओ गलि कऽ गाढ़ रंगक पेस्ट नहि बनि जाय। एहिमे 8–10 मिनट लगैत अछि; बेर-बेर चलाउ आ पात मौलाइत जाय तँ चम्मचक पाछू सँ मसलैत रहू।
seg.c59d6a34def2.back: Fry the gongura with green chillies in a little oil until it breaks down into a dark-coloured paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir often and keep mashing with the back of a spoon as the leaves wilt.

seg.37056d0dd9cf.src: Heat the 4 tbsp oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon.
seg.37056d0dd9cf.t: भारी कड़ाहीमे मध्यम आँच पर 4 पैघ चम्मच तेल गरम करू आ लौंग, इलायची आ दालचीनी डालू।
seg.37056d0dd9cf.back: Heat 4 tablespoons oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add cloves, cardamom and cinnamon.

seg.26a945a9fad3.src: Fry the onions with whole spices till golden. Add the curry leaves with the onions, and give them 10–12 minutes, stirring often.
seg.26a945a9fad3.t: पियाउजकेँ साबुत मसालाक संग सोनहुला होबा धरि भूजू। पियाउजक संग करी पात डालू, आ बेर-बेर चलबैत 10–12 मिनट भूजू।
seg.26a945a9fad3.back: Fry the onion with the whole spices until golden. Add curry leaves with the onion, and fry 10–12 minutes stirring often.

seg.4dd72cc1abd0.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds. Add the mutton and its stock, then the gongura.
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.t: धनियाँ बुकनी मिला कऽ 30 सेकेंड भूजू। मटन आ ओकर झोर डालू, फेर गोंगुरा।
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.back: Mix in coriander powder and fry 30 seconds. Add the mutton and its stock, then the gongura.

seg.46f5f6c735ac.src: Simmer till thick and the oil floats on top. Keep the heat low, stir now and then, and allow 12–15 minutes. Taste and adjust the salt now, once the sourness of the gongura is in.
seg.46f5f6c735ac.t: गाढ़ होबा धरि आ तेल ऊपर तैरबा धरि धीमा आँच पर पकाउ। आँच धीमा राखू, बीच-बीचमे चलाउ, आ 12–15 मिनट लागय दिअ। गोंगुराक खट्टापन मिलि गेलाक बाद एखन चीखि कऽ नोन ठीक करू।
seg.46f5f6c735ac.back: Cook on low heat until thick and until oil floats on top. Keep the heat low, stir now and then, and let it take 12–15 minutes. Now that the gongura's sourness has blended in, taste and adjust salt.

seg.0abf0f798bd3.src: Stir in garam masala. Cook 2 more minutes, then switch off and rest for 10 minutes before serving.
seg.0abf0f798bd3.t: गरम मसाला मिलाउ। 2 मिनट आओर पकाउ, फेर आँच बन्द करू आ परसबा सँ पहिने 10 मिनट राखि दिअ।
seg.0abf0f798bd3.back: Mix in garam masala. Cook 2 minutes more, then turn off the heat and let rest 10 minutes before serving.

seg.c57eb6bfb001.src: Taste after the gongura goes in; its sourness varies from bunch to bunch.
seg.c57eb6bfb001.t: गोंगुरा डाललाक बाद चीखू; ओकर खट्टापन एक मुट्ठा सँ दोसर मुट्ठामे अलग होइत अछि।
seg.c57eb6bfb001.back: Taste after adding gongura; its sourness differs from one bunch to another.

seg.5544823d42b4.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or Sannam chilli powder; do not cut it out entirely, or the gongura tastes flat and sour.
seg.5544823d42b4.t: तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी बड्ड तीख अछि। मध्यम तीख लेल 1 छोट चम्मच लिअ, वा सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी; एकदम नहि छोड़ू, नहि तँ गोंगुरा फीका आ खाली खट्टा लागत।
seg.5544823d42b4.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat take 1 teaspoon, or Sannam chilli powder; do not leave it out completely, otherwise the gongura will taste flat and only sour.

seg.62683a58a9fd.src: Do not use an aluminium pan for the gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and darkens the curry. Use steel or cast iron.
seg.62683a58a9fd.t: गोंगुरा लेल एल्युमिनियमक बर्तन नहि लिअ; ओकर खट्टापन धातुक संग मिलि कऽ तरकारीकेँ करिया कऽ दैत अछि। स्टील वा लोहाक बर्तन लिअ।
seg.62683a58a9fd.back: Do not use an aluminium vessel for gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and turns the curry black. Use a steel or iron vessel.

seg.d036336075e5.src: If the gongura is very sour, add 1 more onion to the masala to balance it.
seg.d036336075e5.t: जँ गोंगुरा बहुत खट्टा अछि तँ सन्तुलन लेल मसालामे 1 टा पियाउज आओर डालू।
seg.d036336075e5.back: If the gongura is very sour, add 1 more onion to the masala for balance.

seg.8faa3986eaa2.src: Gongura chicken: use 750 g bone-in chicken, skip the pressure cooker and cook it covered in the masala for 20–25 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone, before the gongura goes in.
seg.8faa3986eaa2.t: गोंगुरा चिकन: 750 g हड्डीबला चिकन लिअ, प्रेशर कुकर नहि लगाउ, आ गोंगुरा डालबा सँ पहिने मसालामे झाँपि कऽ 20–25 मिनट पकाउ, जा धरि हड्डी लग कोनो गुलाबी नहि रहि जाय।
seg.8faa3986eaa2.back: Gongura chicken: take 750 g bone-in chicken, do not use the pressure cooker, and cook covered in the masala for 20–25 minutes before adding gongura, until no pink remains near the bone.

seg.2ebce7872a6e.src: Gongura royyalu: use 500 g cleaned prawns, add them after the onions and cook 5–6 minutes, just until they turn pink and curl, then add the gongura.
seg.2ebce7872a6e.t: गोंगुरा रोय्यालु: 500 g साफ कयल झींगा लिअ, पियाउजक बाद डालू आ 5–6 मिनट पकाउ, बस जा धरि ओ गुलाबी भऽ कऽ मुड़ि नहि जाय, फेर गोंगुरा डालू।
seg.2ebce7872a6e.back: Gongura royyalu: take 500 g cleaned prawns, add after the onion and cook 5–6 minutes, just until they turn pink and curl, then add gongura.

seg.7f3c45600b1c.src: Red chilli gongura: fry 6 dried red chillies with the gongura and grind them together for a darker, sharper curry.
seg.7f3c45600b1c.t: लाल मरचाइबला गोंगुरा: गोंगुराक संग 6 टा सुखल लाल मरचाइ भूजू आ संगे पीसि लिअ; तरकारी बेसी गाढ़ रंगक आ बेसी झाँसगर होयत।
seg.7f3c45600b1c.back: Red-chilli gongura: fry 6 dried red chillies with the gongura and grind together; the curry will be darker in colour and more fiery.

seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte. A plain raw onion on the side is the Guntur way.
