seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.t: भापमे पाकल भात आ एक चम्मच घीक संग, वा जोन्ना रोट्टेक संग गरम-गरम परसू। संगमे एकटा सादा काँच पियाउज, यैह गुंटूरक तरीका अछि।
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.back: Serve piping hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte. Alongside, a plain raw onion; this is the Guntur way.

seg.a4e072616940.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. Like most sour curries, it tastes better the next day.
seg.a4e072616940.t: झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे 3 दिन धरि राखू; भीतर धरि नीक जकाँ भाप उठय एहन गरम करू। बेसी खट्टा तरकारी जकाँ, ईहो अगिला दिन बेसी स्वादिष्ट लगैत अछि।
seg.a4e072616940.back: Keep covered in the fridge up to 3 days; reheat until it steams well right through. Like most sour curries, this too tastes better the next day.

seg.056a57b2c0f8.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.50430ec58f61.src: Gongura is sorrel leaves, also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, pitwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and cook down to a dark paste.
seg.50430ec58f61.t: गोंगुरा सॉरेल पात अछि, जकरा रोजेल वा रेड सॉरेल सेहो कहल जाइत अछि (मराठीमे अंबाडी, हिन्दीमे पितवा)। पात खट्टा होइत अछि आ पकि कऽ गाढ़ रंगक पेस्ट बनि जाइत अछि।
seg.50430ec58f61.back: Gongura is sorrel leaf, also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, pitwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and on cooking become a dark-coloured paste.

seg.c813168eb832.src: Can I use gongura pickle instead of gongura leaves?
seg.c813168eb832.t: की गोंगुरा पातक बदला गोंगुराक अचार प्रयोग कऽ सकैत छी?
seg.c813168eb832.back: Can I use gongura pickle instead of gongura leaves?

seg.e1453431b91a.src: Yes, in a pinch. Stir in 3–4 tbsp gongura pickle in place of the sauteed leaves and cut down the salt and chilli powder, since the pickle already has both.
seg.e1453431b91a.t: हँ, काज चलेबा लेल। भूजल पातक बदला 3–4 पैघ चम्मच गोंगुराक अचार मिलाउ आ नोन आ मरचाइ बुकनी घटा दिअ, किएक तँ अचारमे दुनू पहिने सँ अछि।
seg.e1453431b91a.back: Yes, to manage. Instead of fried leaves mix in 3–4 tablespoons gongura pickle and reduce salt and chilli powder, because the pickle already has both.

seg.13ee618e3c36.src: How long should I pressure-cook mutton for gongura mamsam?
seg.13ee618e3c36.t: गोंगुरा मामसम लेल मटनकेँ प्रेशर कुकरमे कतेक काल पकाउ?
seg.13ee618e3c36.back: How long to pressure-cook mutton for gongura mamsam?

seg.5888ba63831a.src: About 5–6 whistles on medium heat for bone-in curry-cut mutton. It is done when the meat pulls away from the bone easily; older mutton may need 1–2 more whistles.
seg.5888ba63831a.t: हड्डीबला करी-कट मटन लेल मध्यम आँच पर करीब 5–6 सीटी। मासु जखन हड्डी सँ आसानी सँ छुटय लागय तँ पाकल अछि; पुरान खस्सीक मासुकेँ 1–2 सीटी आओर लागि सकैत अछि।
seg.5888ba63831a.back: For bone-in curry-cut mutton about 5–6 whistles on medium heat. The meat is cooked when it starts coming off the bone easily; meat of an older goat may need 1–2 more whistles.

seg.5f47c430018f.src: How do I make gongura mutton less spicy?
seg.5f47c430018f.t: गोंगुरा मटनकेँ कम तीख कोना बनाउ?
seg.5f47c430018f.back: How to make gongura mutton less hot?

seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and use 2 green chillies. Keep some heat, as it balances the sourness of the gongura.
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.t: 1 छोट चम्मच तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी लिअ वा ओकर बदला सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी, आ 2 टा हरियर मरचाइ लिअ। किछु तीख राखू, किएक तँ ओ गोंगुराक खट्टापनकेँ सम्हारैत अछि।
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.back: Take 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder or Sannam chilli powder instead, and take 2 green chillies. Keep some heat, because it balances gongura's sourness.

seg.df5186f8f459.src: గోంగూర మాంసం. Gongura mutton, the Guntur way: mutton cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then simmered with sour sorrel leaves till thick.
seg.df5186f8f459.t: గోంగూర మాంసం. गुंटूरक तरीकाक गोंगुरा मटन: तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी आ हरदि बुकनीक संग पकाओल मटन, फेर खट्टा गोंगुरा पातक संग गाढ़ होबा धरि धीमा आँच पर पकाओल।
seg.df5186f8f459.back: గోంగూర మాంసం. Guntur-style gongura mutton: mutton cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then cooked on low heat with sour gongura leaves until thick.

seg.dffa96c4d761.src: Gongura Mamsam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.dffa96c4d761.t: गोंगुरा मामसम: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.dffa96c4d761.back: Gongura Mamsam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.a7dd4a4d025c.src: Gongura pachadi is the chutney Andhra is best known for: sour gongura (sorrel) leaves fried down in oil and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. Around Guntur and Palnadu it is on the table almost every day, mixed into hot rice with a spoon of ghee, with sliced onion on the side.
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी ओ चटनी अछि जाहि लेल आन्ध्र सभ सँ बेसी जानल जाइत अछि: खट्टा गोंगुरा पात तेलमे भूजि कऽ भूजल मसाला, लहसुन आ लाल मरचाइक संग पिसल। गुंटूर आ पल्नाडुक आसपास ई करीब रोज थारीमे रहैत अछि, गरम भात आ एक चम्मच घीमे सानल, संगमे काटल पियाउज।
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.back: Gongura pachadi is that chutney for which Andhra is known most of all: sour gongura leaves fried in oil and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. Around Guntur and Palnadu it is on the plate almost daily, mixed into hot rice and a spoon of ghee, with chopped onion alongside.

seg.73ddd8b1df98.src: Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the sharp heat that stands up to the sourness of the leaves. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6.
seg.73ddd8b1df98.t: तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी एकरा गाढ़ लाल रंग आ ओ तेज तीख दैत अछि जे पातक खट्टापनक आगू टिकैत अछि। ई रेसिपी सँ करीब 1½ कप बनैत अछि, 6 लोक लेल पूरा।
seg.73ddd8b1df98.back: Teja chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and that sharp heat which stands up to the sourness of the leaves. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6 people.

seg.1689d390a49e.src: Total includes cooling the leaves and spices before grinding.
seg.1689d390a49e.t: कुल समयमे पिसबा सँ पहिने पात आ मसाला ठंढ़ा करबाक समय सेहो जोड़ल अछि।
seg.1689d390a49e.back: The total time also includes the time to cool the leaves and spices before grinding.

seg.b4b21c43d6d9.src: Fry gongura leaves in oil till they turn to a dark mash, then grind them with roasted coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. Finish with a mustard and dal tempering.
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.t: गोंगुरा पातकेँ तेलमे भूजू जा धरि गाढ़ रंगक लेई नहि बनि जाय, फेर भूजल धनियाँ, मेथी, लहसुन, तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी आ नोनक संग पीसू। अन्तमे सरिसो आ दालिक छौंक दिअ।
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.back: Fry gongura leaves in oil until they become a dark-coloured paste, then grind with roasted coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. At the end give a tempering of mustard and dal.

seg.bc1f3c96e98a.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧picked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.t: 4 कप गोंगुरा पात ⟦1⟧2 टा पैघ मुट्ठा सँ तोड़ल, करीब 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧plucked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.e478a092b07c.src: 1 tbsp sesame oil ⟦1⟧gingelly oil, for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.t: 1 पैघ चम्मच तिलक तेल ⟦1⟧पात भुजबा लेल⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.back: 1 tablespoon sesame oil ⟦1⟧for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧

seg.b00132daaabc.src: ¼ tsp fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧menthulu; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.t: ¼ छोट चम्मच मेथी ⟦1⟧मेंतुलु; एहि सँ बेसी नहि, नहि तँ पच्चडी तीत भऽ जायत⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek ⟦1⟧menthulu; not more than this, otherwise the pachadi will become bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.c1657b10781a.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for a milder pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.t: 2 छोट चम्मच तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी ⟦1⟧बड्ड तीख; कम तीख पच्चडी लेल 1 छोट चम्मच लिअ⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.back: 2 teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for a less hot pachadi take 1 teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.7e344ce94138.t: ¾ छोट चम्मच नोन ⟦1⟧वा स्वाद अनुसार⟦/1⟧

seg.9c36418bdb13.t: 2 टा सुखल लाल मरचाइ ⟦1⟧दू टुकड़ा कयल⟦/1⟧

seg.69e8fc35d187.src: Pick the gongura leaves off the stems and wash them in 2–3 changes of water. Spread them on a cloth and pat them completely dry; water left on the leaves splutters in the oil and shortens how long the pachadi keeps.
seg.69e8fc35d187.t: गोंगुरा पात डाँट सँ तोड़ू आ 2–3 बेर पानि बदलि कऽ धोउ। कपड़ा पर पसारि कऽ थपथपा कऽ पूरा सुखा लिअ; पात पर बचल पानि तेलमे छिटकैत अछि आ पच्चडी कम दिन टिकैत अछि।
seg.69e8fc35d187.back: Pluck the gongura leaves from the stems and wash changing the water 2–3 times. Spread on a cloth and pat completely dry; water left on the leaves splutters in the oil and the pachadi keeps fewer days.

seg.1b214adb5a9c.src: Roast the coriander, cumin and fenugreek till fragrant; let them cool. Use a dry pan on low heat and stir all the time: the fenugreek should turn one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.
seg.1b214adb5a9c.t: धनियाँ, जीर आ मेथीकेँ सुगन्ध आबय धरि भूजू; ठंढ़ा होमय दिअ। धीमा आँच पर सुखल पैन लिअ आ लगातार चलबैत रहू: मेथी एक रंग गाढ़ हेबाक चाही, करीब 2 मिनट, मुदा भूर नहि।
seg.1b214adb5a9c.back: Roast coriander, cumin and fenugreek until fragrant; let cool. Take a dry pan on low heat and keep stirring constantly: the fenugreek should become one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.

seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.src: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 tbsp oil till they wilt to a dark mash, 6–8 minutes. Use a wide pan on medium heat and stir often; the leaves shrink fast, turn from green to a dull olive-brown, and almost all their water cooks off.
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.t: गोंगुरा पातकेँ 1 पैघ चम्मच तेलमे भूजू जा धरि मौला कऽ गाढ़ रंगक लेई नहि बनि जाय, 6–8 मिनट। मध्यम आँच पर चाकर पैन लिअ आ बेर-बेर चलाउ; पात जल्दी सिकुड़ैत अछि, हरियर सँ फीका जैतूनी-भूर भऽ जाइत अछि, आ करीब सभटा पानि सुखि जाइत अछि।
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.back: Fry gongura leaves in 1 tablespoon oil until they wilt and become a dark-coloured paste, 6–8 minutes. Take a wide pan on medium heat and stir often; the leaves shrink quickly, turn from green to dull olive-brown, and almost all the water dries up.

seg.adc2540067f6.src: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool completely, about 10 minutes.
seg.adc2540067f6.t: पातकेँ थारी पर पसारि दिअ आ पूरा ठंढ़ा होमय दिअ, करीब 10 मिनट।
seg.adc2540067f6.back: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool completely, about 10 minutes.

seg.78d34fa0267e.src: Grind the spices with the garlic, chilli powder and salt, then pulse in the leaves. Grind the roasted spices, the 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt to a coarse powder first.
seg.78d34fa0267e.t: मसालाकेँ लहसुन, मरचाइ बुकनी आ नोनक संग पीसू, फेर पात डालि कऽ थोड़-थोड़ चलाउ। पहिने भूजल मसाला, 6 टा लहसुनक कली, तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी आ नोनकेँ मोट बुकनी बना लिअ।
seg.78d34fa0267e.back: Grind the spices with garlic, chilli powder and salt, then add the leaves and pulse little by little. First make the roasted spices, 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt into a coarse powder.

seg.e84cadbb2f28.src: Add the cooled leaves and pulse 3–4 times to a coarse paste, without any water. Many Andhra homes pound it in a stone mortar (rolu) instead.
seg.e84cadbb2f28.t: ठंढ़ा पात डालू आ बिनु पानिक 3–4 बेर थोड़-थोड़ चला कऽ मोट पेस्ट बनाउ। आन्ध्रक बहुत घरमे एकर बदला एकरा पाथरक ओखरि (रोलु) मे कूटल जाइत अछि।
seg.e84cadbb2f28.back: Add the cooled leaves and pulse 3–4 times little by little without water to make a coarse paste. In many Andhra homes instead of this it is pounded in a stone mortar (rolu).

seg.c04597c43292.src: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. Add a pinch more salt if the sourness feels too sharp.
seg.c04597c43292.t: चीखू: ई खट्टा, तीख आ नीक नोनगर हेबाक चाही। खट्टापन बेसी तेज लागय तँ एक चुटकी नोन आओर डालू।
seg.c04597c43292.back: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. If the sourness feels too sharp add another pinch of salt.

seg.317793f8bd6d.src: Temper mustard, dals, red chillies and curry leaves in the rest of the oil; mix it in. Heat the 2 tbsp sesame oil in a small pan, let the mustard seeds crackle, fry the chana dal and urad dal till golden, then add the red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida for a few seconds. Pour it over the pachadi and stir well.
seg.317793f8bd6d.t: बचल तेलमे सरिसो, दालि, लाल मरचाइ आ करी पातक छौंक लगाउ; मिला दिअ। एकटा छोट बर्तनमे 2 पैघ चम्मच तिलक तेल गरम करू, सरिसो चटकय दिअ, चनाक दालि आ उड़िदक दालि सोनहुला होबा धरि भूजू, फेर लाल मरचाइ, कुचलल लहसुन, करी पात आ हींग डालि किछु सेकेंड भूजू। पच्चडी पर ढारि नीक जकाँ मिलाउ।
seg.317793f8bd6d.back: In the remaining oil temper mustard, dal, red chilli and curry leaves; mix in. In a small vessel heat 2 tablespoons sesame oil, let the mustard crackle, fry chana dal and urad dal until golden, then add red chilli, crushed garlic, curry leaves and hing and fry a few seconds. Pour over the pachadi and mix well.

seg.bd6dcf672985.src: Let the pachadi sit for 30 minutes if you can, so the flavours come together, then spoon it into a clean, dry glass jar.
seg.bd6dcf672985.t: भऽ सकय तँ पच्चडीकेँ 30 मिनट राखि दिअ जाहि सँ स्वाद मिलि जाय, फेर साफ, सुखल शीशाक बोइयाममे भरि दिअ।
seg.bd6dcf672985.back: If possible, keep the pachadi for 30 minutes so the flavours blend, then fill into a clean, dry glass jar.

seg.e0bb74b2a966.src: Dry the leaves fully before frying so the pachadi keeps longer.
seg.e0bb74b2a966.t: भुजबा सँ पहिने पात पूरा सुखा लिअ जाहि सँ पच्चडी बेसी दिन टिकय।
seg.e0bb74b2a966.back: Dry the leaves completely before frying so that the pachadi keeps more days.

seg.29688dc9fded.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a milder pachadi use 1 tsp, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.29688dc9fded.t: तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी बड्ड तीख अछि। कम तीख पच्चडी लेल 1 छोट चम्मच लिअ, वा आधा तेजा आ आधा सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी।
seg.29688dc9fded.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a less hot pachadi take 1 teaspoon, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.d1fa39431c01.src: Keep the fenugreek to ¼ tsp and roast it only one shade darker; more, or darker, makes the pachadi bitter.
seg.d1fa39431c01.t: मेथी ¼ छोट चम्मच धरि राखू आ मात्र एक रंग गाढ़ भूजू; बेसी मात्रा वा बेसी गाढ़ भुजला सँ पच्चडी तीत भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.d1fa39431c01.back: Keep fenugreek to ¼ teaspoon and roast only one shade darker; a larger amount or roasting darker makes the pachadi bitter.

seg.00435dc24e2d.src: Pulse, do not grind smooth: gongura pachadi should be coarse, with bits of leaf you can see.
seg.00435dc24e2d.t: थोड़-थोड़ चलाउ, चिक्कन नहि पीसू: गोंगुरा पच्चडी मोट हेबाक चाही, जाहिमे पातक टुकड़ा देखाइ दिअय।
seg.00435dc24e2d.back: Pulse little by little, do not grind smooth: gongura pachadi should be coarse, with pieces of leaf visible.

seg.70ea8f84244b.src: Do not skimp on the oil; the layer of oil on top helps the pachadi keep.
seg.70ea8f84244b.t: तेलमे कंजूसी नहि करू; ऊपरक तेलक परत सँ पच्चडी बेसी दिन टिकैत अछि।
seg.70ea8f84244b.back: Do not be stingy with oil; the layer of oil on top makes the pachadi keep more days.

seg.bd2018335c09.src: With onion: stir 1 small onion, finely chopped, into a portion just before serving, and eat it the same day.
seg.bd2018335c09.t: पियाउजक संग: परसबा सँ ठीक पहिने एक हिस्सामे 1 टा छोट पियाउज महीन काटि कऽ मिलाउ, आ ओही दिन खा लिअ।
seg.bd2018335c09.back: With onion: just before serving mix 1 small finely chopped onion into one portion, and eat it the same day.

seg.77f8d979d9c5.src: Whole red chillies: in place of the chilli powder, fry 12–15 dried red chillies in a little oil and grind them with the spices.
seg.77f8d979d9c5.t: साबुत लाल मरचाइ: मरचाइ बुकनीक बदला 12–15 टा सुखल लाल मरचाइ कनेक तेलमे भूजू आ मसालाक संग पीसि लिअ।
seg.77f8d979d9c5.back: Whole red chillies: instead of chilli powder fry 12–15 dried red chillies in a little oil and grind with the spices.

seg.98bf90687f81.src: Green chilli gongura: fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and cut the chilli powder to 1 tsp, for a sharper, greener heat.
seg.98bf90687f81.t: हरियर मरचाइबला गोंगुरा: पातक संग 6–8 टा हरियर मरचाइ भूजू आ मरचाइ बुकनी घटा कऽ 1 छोट चम्मच करू, एहि सँ तीख बेसी तेज आ हरियर मरचाइ सन होयत।
seg.98bf90687f81.back: Green-chilli gongura: fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and reduce chilli powder to 1 teaspoon; this makes the heat sharper and like green chilli.

seg.3ffc938ce36f.src: Mix a spoon into hot rice with ghee and eat with sliced raw onion on the side. It also goes well with dosa, idli and as a side on any Andhra meal plate.
seg.3ffc938ce36f.t: गरम भातमे घीक संग एक चम्मच सानू आ संगमे काटल काँच पियाउजक संग खाउ। डोसा, इडली संग आ आन्ध्रक कोनो भोजनक थारीमे संगमे सेहो नीक लगैत अछि।
seg.3ffc938ce36f.back: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with ghee and eat with chopped raw onion alongside. It is also good with dosa, idli and alongside in any Andhra meal plate.

seg.9b58b3a03e55.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks, always using a dry spoon. A thin layer of oil on top helps it keep.
seg.9b58b3a03e55.t: साफ, सुखल शीशाक बोइयाममे फ्रिजमे 2 सप्ताह धरि राखू, आ सदिखन सुखल चम्मच लगाउ। ऊपर तेलक पातर परत सँ ई बेसी दिन टिकैत अछि।
seg.9b58b3a03e55.back: Keep in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge up to 2 weeks, and always use a dry spoon. A thin layer of oil on top makes it keep more days.

seg.5fb383e7c1ab.src: What is gongura called in English?
seg.5fb383e7c1ab.t: अंग्रेजीमे गोंगुराकेँ की कहल जाइत अछि?
seg.5fb383e7c1ab.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.100f275734bd.src: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, often sold as sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking areas it is called ambadi.
seg.100f275734bd.t: गोंगुरा रोजेल गाछक पात अछि, जे बेसी काल सॉरेल पात वा रेड सॉरेल नाम सँ बिकाइत अछि। हिन्दी आ मराठी बजनिहार क्षेत्रमे एकरा अंबाडी कहल जाइत अछि।
seg.100f275734bd.back: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, which is mostly sold under the name sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking regions it is called ambadi.

seg.7f27f7848f6b.src: How do I make gongura pachadi less sour?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडीकेँ कम खट्टा कोना बनाउ?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.back: How to make gongura pachadi less sour?

seg.a8b5b3cafa35.src: Add a little more salt and chilli, or stir in 1 tsp grated jaggery. Frying the leaves down well also mellows their sourness.
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.t: कनेक आओर नोन आ मरचाइ डालू, वा 1 छोट चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल गुड़ मिलाउ। पातकेँ नीक जकाँ भुजला सँ सेहो ओकर खट्टापन नरम भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.back: Add a little more salt and chilli, or mix in 1 teaspoon grated jaggery. Frying the leaves well also softens their sourness.

seg.5bc83cd0bb23.src: Why is my gongura pachadi bitter?
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.t: हमर गोंगुरा पच्चडी तीत किएक अछि?
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.back: Why is my gongura pachadi bitter?

seg.bcbd736912c5.src: Usually too much fenugreek, or fenugreek roasted too dark. Keep it to ¼ tsp and stop roasting when it is one shade darker.
seg.bcbd736912c5.t: बेसी काल मेथी बेसी पड़ला सँ, वा मेथी बेसी गाढ़ भुजला सँ। ¼ छोट चम्मच धरि राखू आ एक रंग गाढ़ होइते भूजब बन्द करू।
seg.bcbd736912c5.back: Mostly from too much fenugreek, or from roasting the fenugreek too dark. Keep it to ¼ teaspoon and stop roasting as soon as it is one shade darker.

seg.f5ec54c6b341.src: How long does gongura pachadi last?
seg.f5ec54c6b341.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी कतेक दिन टिकैत अछि?
seg.f5ec54c6b341.back: How many days does gongura pachadi keep?

seg.693b158b80df.src: About 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry glass jar, if the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon. Outside the fridge, eat it within 2–3 days.
seg.693b158b80df.t: सुखल शीशाक बोइयाममे फ्रिजमे करीब 2 सप्ताह, जँ पात नीक जकाँ सुखाओल गेल हो आ अहाँ सदिखन सुखल चम्मच लगबैत होइ। फ्रिजक बाहर 2–3 दिनक भीतर खा लिअ।
seg.693b158b80df.back: About 2 weeks in a dry glass jar in the fridge, if the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon. Outside the fridge eat within 2–3 days.

seg.a8b7816171d1.src: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Gongura pachadi the Guntur way: sorrel leaves fried down, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder, then tempered. Serves 6.
seg.a8b7816171d1.t: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. गुंटूरक तरीकाक गोंगुरा पच्चडी: भूजल गोंगुरा पात, भूजल मसाला, लहसुन आ तेजा मरचाइ बुकनीक संग पिसल, फेर छौंक लगाओल। 6 लोक लेल।
seg.a8b7816171d1.back: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Guntur-style gongura pachadi: fried gongura leaves, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder, then tempered. For 6 people.

seg.de566b9f7c3e.src: Gongura Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.de566b9f7c3e.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.de566b9f7c3e.back: Gongura Pachadi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.70fd98f238a4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु ⟦1⟧(इमलीक ग्रेवीमे आन्ध्रक अंडा करी)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra's egg curry in tamarind gravy)⟦/1⟧

seg.dd0da0936d87.src: Kodi guddu pulusu is the Andhra egg curry that many homes make when there is no meat in the house: hard-boiled eggs simmered in a tangy gravy of tamarind and slow-fried onions. It is thinner and sourer than a North Indian egg curry, made to be mixed into plenty of hot rice.
seg.dd0da0936d87.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु आन्ध्रक अंडा करी अछि जे बहुत घरमे तखन बनैत अछि जखन घरमे मासु नहि रहैत अछि: उसनल अंडा इमली आ धीरे-धीरे भूजल पियाउजक खट्टा ग्रेवीमे धीमा आँच पर पकाओल। ई उत्तर भारतक अंडा करी सँ पातर आ बेसी खट्टा होइत अछि, खूब रास गरम भातमे सानि कऽ खाय लेल।
seg.dd0da0936d87.back: Kodi guddu pulusu is Andhra's egg curry which in many homes is made when there is no meat in the house: boiled eggs cooked on low heat in a sour gravy of tamarind and slowly fried onion. It is thinner and more sour than North Indian egg curry, for eating mixed into plenty of hot rice.

seg.27588d5a0d73.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its red colour and a steady medium heat, and our turmeric powder (Pasupu) gives the golden base. A little jaggery rounds off the sourness.
seg.27588d5a0d73.t: हमर सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी पुलुसुकेँ लाल रंग आ एक समान मध्यम तीख दैत अछि, आ हमर हरदि बुकनी (पसुपु) सोनहुला आधार दैत अछि। कनेक गुड़ खट्टापनकेँ सम्हारि दैत अछि।
seg.27588d5a0d73.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu red colour and an even medium heat, and our turmeric powder (pasupu) gives a golden base. A little jaggery balances the sourness.

seg.3c683c3f8074.src: Boil and slit the eggs. Fry onions, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, simmer, then cook the eggs in the gravy till it thickens.
seg.3c683c3f8074.t: अंडा उसनि कऽ चीरि लिअ। पियाउज भूजू, हरदि, सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी आ इमलीक पानि डालू, धीमा आँच पर पकाउ, फेर ग्रेवी गाढ़ होबा धरि ओहिमे अंडा पकाउ।
seg.3c683c3f8074.back: Boil the eggs and slit them. Fry onion, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, cook on low heat, then cook the eggs in it until the gravy thickens.

seg.8c348975674a.src: a pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (optional)⟦/1⟧
seg.8c348975674a.t: एक चुटकी हरदि बुकनी ⟦1⟧अंडा भुजबा लेल (मन हो तँ)⟦/1⟧
seg.8c348975674a.back: A pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (if you wish)⟦/1⟧

seg.3a31dc522e29.src: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups warm water⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.t: 20 g इमली ⟦1⟧नेबो जतेक पैघ गोला, 1½ कप गुनगुन पानिमे भिजाओल⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.back: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a ball as big as a lemon, soaked in 1½ cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.d56c07ca17af.t: 3 पैघ चम्मच तेल ⟦1⟧मूँगफली वा तिलक तेल⟦/1⟧

seg.5b3cff6eb38d.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; use 1½ tsp for milder⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.t: 2 छोट चम्मच सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी ⟦1⟧मध्यम तीख; कम तीख लेल 1½ छोट चम्मच लिअ⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; for less heat take 1½ teaspoons⟦/1⟧

seg.654942936ff6.t: 1 छोट चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल गुड़ ⟦1⟧मन हो तँ⟦/1⟧

seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.src: Soak the tamarind in the warm water for 15 minutes. Squeeze it well, strain and keep the tamarind water; discard the fibres and seeds.
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.t: इमलीकेँ गुनगुन पानिमे 15 मिनट भिजाउ। नीक जकाँ निचोड़ू, छानू आ इमलीक पानि राखि लिअ; रेशा आ बीया फेकि दिअ।
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.back: Soak the tamarind in lukewarm water for 15 minutes. Squeeze well, strain and keep the tamarind water; throw away the fibres and seeds.

seg.e7eefe0a36b0.src: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel them and make 3–4 shallow slits on each. Start them in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes from the boil, then cool them in water before peeling. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through.
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.t: अंडाकेँ 10 मिनट उसनू, छीलू आ हर अंडा पर 3–4 टा हल्लुक चीरा लगाउ। कोठलीक तापमानबला पानिमे चढ़ाउ, खौलबा सँ 10 मिनट गनू, फेर छीलबा सँ पहिने पानिमे ठंढ़ा करू। जर्दी भीतर धरि कड़ा आ हल्लुक पीयर हेबाक चाही।
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.back: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel and make 3–4 light slits on each egg. Put them on in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes from boiling, then cool in water before peeling. The yolk should be firm right through and light yellow.

seg.6747ea35bd7d.src: Optional: heat 1 tsp of the oil with the pinch of turmeric and roll the eggs in it for 2 minutes until lightly blistered. Keep aside.
seg.6747ea35bd7d.t: मन हो तँ: 1 छोट चम्मच तेलमे एक चुटकी हरदि गरम करू आ ओहिमे अंडाकेँ 2 मिनट घुमाउ जा धरि हल्लुक फोंका नहि पड़ि जाय। अलग राखि दिअ।
seg.6747ea35bd7d.back: If you wish: heat a pinch of turmeric in 1 teaspoon oil and roll the eggs in it for 2 minutes until light blisters form. Keep aside.

seg.9d3c50e45f8b.src: Heat the rest of the oil in a kadai on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds and let them turn light brown; they turn bitter if they go dark.
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.t: बाकी तेल कड़ाहीमे मध्यम आँच पर गरम करू। मेथी डालू आ हल्लुक भूर होमय दिअ; गाढ़ भेला पर ओ तीत भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.back: Heat the rest of the oil in a kadai on medium heat. Add fenugreek and let it turn light brown; when it goes dark it becomes bitter.

seg.c867d4469da7.src: Fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves and onions in the oil till soft and golden. Add the mustard seeds first and let them splutter, then the curry leaves, green chillies and asafoetida, then the onions for about 8 minutes.
seg.c867d4469da7.t: सरिसो, करी पात आ पियाउजकेँ तेलमे नरम आ सोनहुला होबा धरि भूजू। पहिने सरिसो डालू आ चटकय दिअ, फेर करी पात, हरियर मरचाइ आ हींग, फेर पियाउज करीब 8 मिनट धरि।
seg.c867d4469da7.back: Fry mustard, curry leaves and onion in the oil until soft and golden. First add mustard and let it crackle, then curry leaves, green chilli and hing, then onion for about 8 minutes.

seg.ae0272dd2475.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the coriander powder with the chilli powder so it fries for a few seconds first.
seg.ae0272dd2475.t: आँच धीमा करू। हरदि, सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी आ नोन डालू, फेर इमलीक पानि; 10 मिनट धीमा आँच पर पकाउ। धनियाँ बुकनी मरचाइ बुकनीक संगे मिलाउ जाहि सँ ओ पहिने किछु सेकेंड भुजा जाय।
seg.ae0272dd2475.back: Lower the heat. Add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; cook 10 minutes on low heat. Mix coriander powder in together with the chilli powder so that it first gets fried for a few seconds.

seg.01aeed8b749f.src: The raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy should look glossy. Add ½ cup water if it thickens too fast.
seg.01aeed8b749f.t: इमलीक काँच गन्ध चलि जेबाक चाही आ ग्रेवी चमकदार देखेबाक चाही। जँ बहुत जल्दी गाढ़ भऽ जाय तँ ½ कप पानि डालू।
seg.01aeed8b749f.back: The raw smell of tamarind should go and the gravy should look glossy. If it thickens too quickly add ½ cup water.

seg.74f1a1affff6.src: Slide in the eggs and simmer 5 minutes more till the gravy thickens. Spoon the gravy over the eggs now and then.
seg.74f1a1affff6.t: अंडा धीरे सँ डालू आ ग्रेवी गाढ़ होबा धरि 5 मिनट आओर धीमा आँच पर पकाउ। बीच-बीचमे अंडा पर ग्रेवी ढारैत रहू।
seg.74f1a1affff6.back: Add the eggs gently and cook 5 minutes more on low heat until the gravy thickens. Keep pouring gravy over the eggs now and then.

seg.299781c49104.src: Stir in the jaggery, taste and adjust the salt or sourness, and scatter the coriander leaves.
seg.299781c49104.t: गुड़ मिलाउ, चीखि कऽ नोन वा खट्टापन ठीक करू, आ धनियाँ पात छीटि दिअ।
seg.299781c49104.back: Mix in jaggery, taste and adjust salt or sourness, and sprinkle coriander leaves.

seg.d0ce3c2b157a.src: Switch off and let the pulusu rest for 10 minutes before serving so the eggs take on the gravy.
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.t: आँच बन्द करू आ परसबा सँ पहिने पुलुसुकेँ 10 मिनट राखि दिअ जाहि सँ अंडामे ग्रेवीक स्वाद पैसि जाय।
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.back: Turn off the heat and keep the pulusu 10 minutes before serving so that the gravy's flavour gets into the eggs.

seg.feebbb94999b.src: Slits let the tangy gravy into the eggs.
seg.feebbb94999b.t: चीरा लगेला सँ खट्टा ग्रेवी अंडाक भीतर पैसैत अछि।
seg.feebbb94999b.back: Making slits lets the sour gravy get inside the egg.

seg.98394356bb39.src: Cool the boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shells come off cleanly.
seg.98394356bb39.t: उसनल अंडाकेँ छीलबा सँ पहिने पानिमे ठंढ़ा करू; छिलका साफ उतरि जाइत अछि।
seg.98394356bb39.back: Cool the boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shell comes off cleanly.

seg.f4306708f8c5.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ tsp Teja chilli powder along with it.
seg.f4306708f8c5.t: सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी मध्यम तीख दैत अछि; बेसी तीख पुलुसु लेल संगमे ½ छोट चम्मच तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी डालू।
seg.f4306708f8c5.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ teaspoon Teja chilli powder along with it.

seg.fc1643db807e.src: Pulusu tastes better after it rests, and even more the next day, as the eggs soak up the tamarind.
seg.fc1643db807e.t: राखल रहला पर पुलुसु बेसी स्वादिष्ट लगैत अछि, आ अगिला दिन आओर, किएक तँ अंडा इमली सोखि लैत अछि।
seg.fc1643db807e.back: On resting the pulusu tastes better, and even more the next day, because the eggs absorb the tamarind.

seg.b19fe3919add.src: Tomato: add 1 chopped tomato after the onions for a softer, less sour gravy.
seg.b19fe3919add.t: टमाटर: बेसी नरम आ कम खट्टा ग्रेवी लेल पियाउजक बाद 1 टा काटल टमाटर डालू।
seg.b19fe3919add.back: Tomato: for a softer and less sour gravy add 1 chopped tomato after the onion.

seg.0d78d434249e.src: Sesame: stir in 1 tbsp roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes for a thicker, nutty gravy.
seg.0d78d434249e.t: तिल: बेसी गाढ़ आ भुनल मेवा सन ग्रेवी लेल अन्तिम 5 मिनटमे 1 पैघ चम्मच भूजल तिलक बुकनी मिलाउ।
seg.0d78d434249e.back: Sesame: for a thicker and roasted-nut-like gravy mix in 1 tablespoon roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes.

seg.e4adab31c02b.src: Mamidikaya: in summer, replace half the tamarind with a few pieces of raw mango cooked in the gravy.
seg.e4adab31c02b.t: मामिडिकाया: गर्मीमे आधा इमलीक बदला काँच आमक किछु टुकड़ा ग्रेवीमे पकाउ।
seg.e4adab31c02b.back: Mamidikaya: in summer, instead of half the tamarind cook a few pieces of raw mango in the gravy.

seg.bbf897873153.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, with a crisp fry or appadalu on the side. It also goes with chapati or dosa.
seg.bbf897873153.t: भापमे पाकल भात आ एक चम्मच घीक संग गरम-गरम परसू, संगमे कोनो कुरकुर भुजिया वा अप्पडालु। रोटी वा डोसाक संग सेहो चलैत अछि।
seg.bbf897873153.back: Serve piping hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, alongside some crispy fry or appadalu. It also goes with roti or dosa.

seg.7a5a4bbedfff.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu gently in a pan with a splash of water.
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.t: बचल पुलुसु झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे राखू आ 2 दिनक भीतर खा लिअ। पैनमे कनेक पानि डालि धीरे-धीरे गरम करू।
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.back: Keep leftover pulusu covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat slowly in a pan adding a little water.

seg.3dae693db30c.src: How long should I boil eggs for egg curry?
seg.3dae693db30c.t: अंडा करी लेल अंडा कतेक काल उसनू?
seg.3dae693db30c.back: How long to boil eggs for egg curry?

seg.2d6d1a298a24.src: About 10 minutes from the time the water boils. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through, with no runny centre, before the eggs go into the gravy.
seg.2d6d1a298a24.t: पानि खौलबा सँ करीब 10 मिनट। ग्रेवीमे डालबा सँ पहिने जर्दी भीतर धरि कड़ा आ हल्लुक पीयर हेबाक चाही, बीचमे कोनो पातर भाग नहि।
seg.2d6d1a298a24.back: About 10 minutes from the water boiling. Before adding to the gravy the yolk should be firm right through and light yellow, with no thin (runny) part in the middle.

seg.4abaae123f39.src: Why do you make slits on eggs for pulusu?
seg.4abaae123f39.t: पुलुसु लेल अंडा पर चीरा किएक लगाओल जाइत अछि?
seg.4abaae123f39.back: Why are slits made on eggs for pulusu?

seg.d3f5992ccd6e.src: Shallow slits let the tamarind gravy soak into the egg white. Without them the gravy stays on the surface and the egg tastes plain.
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.t: हल्लुक चीरा सँ इमलीक ग्रेवी अंडाक उज्जर भागमे पैसैत अछि। बिनु चीराक ग्रेवी ऊपरे रहि जाइत अछि आ अंडा फीका लगैत अछि।
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.back: Light slits let the tamarind gravy get into the egg white. Without slits the gravy stays on the surface and the egg tastes bland.

seg.7a591bf728ac.src: How do I reduce the sourness of the pulusu?
seg.7a591bf728ac.back: How to reduce the sourness of pulusu?

seg.0a2bf657f386.src: Simmer it a few minutes longer, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or stir in a little water. Use a smaller ball of tamarind next time.
seg.0a2bf657f386.t: किछु मिनट आओर धीमा आँच पर पकाउ, एक छोट चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल गुड़ डालू, वा कनेक पानि मिलाउ। अगिला बेर इमलीक छोट गोला लिअ।
seg.0a2bf657f386.back: Cook a few more minutes on low heat, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or mix in a little water. Next time take a smaller ball of tamarind.

seg.f9a34864523d.src: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?
seg.f9a34864523d.t: अंडा पुलुसु आ अंडा करीमे की अन्तर अछि?
seg.f9a34864523d.back: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?

seg.08bcae4f5075.src: Pulusu is a thinner, tangy tamarind gravy made to mix with rice. A regular egg curry is usually built on onion and tomato, with no tamarind and a thicker masala.
seg.08bcae4f5075.t: पुलुसु पातर, खट्टा इमलीक ग्रेवी अछि जे भातमे सानबा लेल बनैत अछि। सामान्य अंडा करी बेसी काल पियाउज आ टमाटर पर बनैत अछि, बिनु इमलीक आ बेसी गाढ़ मसालाक संग।
seg.08bcae4f5075.back: Pulusu is a thin, sour tamarind gravy made for mixing into rice. Ordinary egg curry is mostly based on onion and tomato, without tamarind and with thicker masala.

seg.6977652a1279.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Egg Pulusu Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.t: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · अंडा पुलुसुक रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.back: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Egg pulusu recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra egg curry: boiled eggs simmered in a tangy tamarind-onion gravy coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. Serves 4.
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.t: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु, आन्ध्रक अंडा करी: उसनल अंडा सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी आ हरदि सँ रंगल खट्टा इमली-पियाउजक ग्रेवीमे धीमा आँच पर पकाओल। 4 लोक लेल।
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.back: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra's egg curry: boiled eggs cooked on low heat in a sour tamarind-onion gravy coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. For 4 people.

seg.722d155a3c4f.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura ⟦1⟧(Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.722d155a3c4f.t: गुत्ति वंकाया कूरा ⟦1⟧(आन्ध्रक भरुआ भाँटाक तरकारी)⟦/1⟧
seg.722d155a3c4f.back: Gutti Vankaya Koora ⟦1⟧(Andhra's stuffed brinjal curry)⟦/1⟧

seg.00fde8f92a7e.src: Gutti vankaya kura is the stuffed brinjal curry that Andhra homes make for Sunday lunches, weddings and when guests come over. Small, round purple brinjals are slit, packed with a roasted peanut, sesame and coconut masala, and cooked slowly in oil until they turn soft and the masala clings to them.
seg.00fde8f92a7e.t: गुत्ति वंकाया कूरा भरुआ भाँटाक तरकारी अछि जे आन्ध्रक घरमे रविदिनक दुपहरियाक भोजन, बियाह आ पाहुन अयला पर बनैत अछि। छोट, गोल, बैंगनी भाँटाकेँ चीरि कऽ भूजल मूँगफली, तिल आ नारियलक मसाला भरल जाइत अछि, आ तेलमे धीरे-धीरे पकाओल जाइत अछि जा धरि ओ नरम नहि भऽ जाय आ मसाला ओहि पर सटि नहि जाय।
seg.00fde8f92a7e.back: Gutti vankaya koora is a stuffed brinjal curry made in Andhra homes for Sunday lunch, weddings and when guests come. Small, round, purple brinjals are slit and filled with a masala of roasted groundnut, sesame and coconut, and cooked slowly in oil until they become soft and the masala sticks to them.

seg.27fd58488499.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing its red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder rounds it off. Serve it with hot rice or chapati. This recipe serves 4.
seg.27fd58488499.t: हमर सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी भरावनकेँ लाल रंग आ मध्यम तीख दैत अछि, आ हरदि बुकनी स्वादकेँ पूरा करैत अछि। गरम भात वा रोटीक संग परसू। ई रेसिपी 4 लोक लेल अछि।
seg.27fd58488499.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder completes the flavour. Serve with hot rice or roti. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.dea818e2c052.src: Roast peanuts, sesame, dry coconut and coriander seeds, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, stuff small brinjals and cook them slowly in oil until soft.
seg.dea818e2c052.t: मूँगफली, तिल, सुखल नारियल आ साबुत धनियाँ भूजू, सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी, हरदि बुकनी आ नोनक संग पीसू, छोट भाँटामे भरू आ तेलमे नरम होबा धरि धीरे-धीरे पकाउ।
seg.dea818e2c052.back: Roast groundnut, sesame, dry coconut and whole coriander, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, stuff into small brinjals and cook slowly in oil until soft.

seg.1ba4509b5345.src: 3 tbsp peanuts ⟦1⟧raw, with or without skins⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.t: 3 पैघ चम्मच मूँगफली ⟦1⟧काँच, छिलका सहित वा बिनु छिलकाक⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.back: 3 tablespoons groundnuts ⟦1⟧raw, with or without skin⟦/1⟧

seg.8be0f88d515d.t: 3 पैघ चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल सुखल नारियल ⟦1⟧गरी⟦/1⟧

seg.b0b877b509dc.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.t: 2 छोट चम्मच सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी ⟦1⟧बेसी तीख तरकारी लेल 1 पैघ चम्मच धरि⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tablespoon for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧

seg.0dac3826b165.back: Tamarind as big as a marble ⟦1⟧seeds removed⟦/1⟧

seg.df2079b45203.src: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple ones⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.t: 12 टा छोट भाँटा ⟦1⟧करीब 500 g, छोट गोल बैंगनी⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.back: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple⟦/1⟧

seg.00abde42908e.t: 1 टा छोट पियाउज (मन हो तँ) ⟦1⟧महीन काटल⟦/1⟧

seg.3994d7458465.t: 2 पैघ चम्मच धनियाँ पात ⟦1⟧काटल, अन्तमे डालबा लेल⟦/1⟧
seg.3994d7458465.back: 2 tablespoons coriander leaves ⟦1⟧chopped, for adding at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.d56e638c12d0.src: Dry-roast the peanuts, sesame, coconut and coriander seeds; grind with the spices. Roast the peanuts first on medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes, then add the coriander seeds, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and the coconut for the last 30 seconds, until it is light golden. Let it cool.
seg.d56e638c12d0.t: मूँगफली, तिल, नारियल आ साबुत धनियाँ बिनु तेलक भूजू; मसालाक संग पीसू। पहिने मूँगफलीकेँ मध्यम-धीमा आँच पर 3–4 मिनट भूजू, फेर साबुत धनियाँ, जीर आ तिल डालि 1 मिनट, आ अन्तिम 30 सेकेंडमे नारियल, जा धरि हल्लुक सोनहुला नहि भऽ जाय। ठंढ़ा होमय दिअ।
seg.d56e638c12d0.back: Roast groundnut, sesame, coconut and whole coriander without oil; grind with the spices. First roast the groundnuts on medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes, then add whole coriander, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and the coconut in the last 30 seconds, until it becomes light golden. Let cool.

seg.26e4a965b3f7.src: In a mixer, grind the roasted mix with the garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind to a coarse powder without water. It should clump when pressed.
seg.26e4a965b3f7.t: मिक्सरमे भूजल मिश्रणकेँ लहसुन, सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी, हरदि बुकनी, नोन आ इमलीक संग बिनु पानिक मोट बुकनी बना लिअ। दबेला पर ई डल्ला बनि जेबाक चाही।
seg.26e4a965b3f7.back: In a mixer make the roasted mixture into a coarse powder without water with garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind. When pressed it should form a lump.

seg.5784e45d4bff.src: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little, leaving the stalk on.
seg.5784e45d4bff.t: भाँटा धोउ आ हरियर टोपी कनेक छाँटि दिअ, डाँट लागल रहय दिअ।
seg.5784e45d4bff.back: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little, leave the stalk attached.

seg.02665f13e5af.src: Slit each brinjal in a cross from the bottom, keeping the stem on, and pack in the stuffing. Cut about three-quarters of the way up so the four quarters stay joined at the top. Drop each one into a bowl of salted water as you go, then drain.
seg.02665f13e5af.t: हर भाँटाकेँ नीचाँ सँ क्रॉस आकारमे चीरू, डाँट लागल रहय, आ भरावन भरू। करीब तीन-चौथाइ धरि काटू जाहि सँ चारू भाग ऊपर जुड़ल रहय। काटैत-काटैत हर भाँटाकेँ नोनगर पानिक कटोरामे डालैत जाउ, फेर पानि निथारि लिअ।
seg.02665f13e5af.back: Slit each brinjal in a cross shape from the bottom, stalk attached, and fill the stuffing. Cut about three-quarters of the way so that the four sections stay joined at the top. As you cut, keep putting each brinjal into a bowl of salted water, then drain the water.

seg.498fc880430b.src: Press about 1 heaped tsp of stuffing into each brinjal. Keep the leftover stuffing aside.
seg.498fc880430b.t: हर भाँटामे करीब 1 भरल छोट चम्मच भरावन दबा कऽ भरू। बचल भरावन अलग राखि दिअ।
seg.498fc880430b.back: Press about 1 heaped teaspoon of stuffing into each brinjal. Keep the leftover stuffing aside.

seg.3daa0935ccba.src: Heat the oil in a wide, heavy pan on medium heat. Add the mustard seeds and, when they splutter, the curry leaves and onion, if using. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
seg.3daa0935ccba.t: चाकर, भारी पैनमे मध्यम आँच पर तेल गरम करू। सरिसो डालू आ चटकय लागय तँ करी पात आ, जँ लैत छी तँ, पियाउज डालू। पियाउजकेँ नरम होबा धरि भूजू, करीब 3 मिनट।
seg.3daa0935ccba.back: Heat oil in a wide, heavy pan on medium heat. Add mustard and when it starts to crackle add curry leaves and, if you are using it, onion. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.

seg.3a140b72d6a0.src: Place the stuffed brinjals in a single layer in the pan.
seg.3a140b72d6a0.t: भरल भाँटाकेँ पैनमे एक परतमे राखू।
seg.3a140b72d6a0.back: Place the stuffed brinjals in the pan in one layer.

seg.1ae98f10b6ed.src: Cook the brinjals in hot oil, covered, on a low flame, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the stuffing stays in, and cook for 15–18 minutes, until the skins wrinkle.
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.t: भाँटाकेँ गरम तेलमे झाँपि कऽ धीमा आँच पर पकाउ, हर 4–5 मिनट पर धीरे सँ उलटैत रहू। चम्मच वा चिमटा लगाउ जाहि सँ भरावन भीतर रहय, आ 15–18 मिनट पकाउ, जा धरि छिलका सिकुड़ि नहि जाय।
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.back: Cook the brinjals covered in the hot oil on low heat, gently turning every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so that the stuffing stays inside, and cook 15–18 minutes, until the skin shrinks.

seg.50530663a626.src: Add the leftover stuffing with ½ cup water; simmer till the brinjals are soft. Cover and cook on low for 8–10 minutes more, until the masala thickens and oil shows at the sides.
seg.50530663a626.t: बचल भरावन ½ कप पानिक संग डालू; भाँटा नरम होबा धरि धीमा आँच पर पकाउ। झाँपि कऽ धीमा आँच पर 8–10 मिनट आओर पकाउ, जा धरि मसाला गाढ़ नहि भऽ जाय आ किनार पर तेल नहि देखाय।
seg.50530663a626.back: Add the leftover stuffing with ½ cup water; cook on low heat until the brinjals are soft. Cook covered on low heat 8–10 minutes more, until the masala thickens and oil shows at the edges.

seg.2a2726cfebd5.src: Check doneness: a knife should slide through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Sprinkle the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.2a2726cfebd5.t: पाकल अछि कि नहि जाँचू: सभ सँ मोट भाँटामे चक्कू बिनु रोकने घुसि जेबाक चाही। धनियाँ पात छीटू आ आँच बन्द करू।
seg.2a2726cfebd5.back: Check if it is cooked: a knife should go into the thickest brinjal without resistance. Sprinkle coriander leaves and turn off the heat.

seg.c2e59cef6130.src: Keep the stalks on so the brinjals hold together while they cook and turn.
seg.c2e59cef6130.t: डाँट लागल रहय दिअ जाहि सँ पकबैत आ उलटैत काल भाँटा जुड़ल रहय।
seg.c2e59cef6130.back: Leave the stalk attached so that the brinjal stays joined while cooking and turning.

seg.15314c3b05cd.src: Pick small, glossy brinjals of the same size, so they cook evenly; large ones stay hard in the centre.
seg.15314c3b05cd.t: एक्के आकारक छोट, चमकदार भाँटा चुनू, जाहि सँ एक समान पाकय; पैघ भाँटा बीचमे कड़ा रहि जाइत अछि।
seg.15314c3b05cd.back: Choose small, shiny brinjals of the same size, so they cook evenly; large brinjals stay hard in the middle.

seg.208cff8b9d46.src: Roast the peanuts and sesame on medium-low heat; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.
seg.208cff8b9d46.t: मूँगफली आ तिल मध्यम-धीमा आँच पर भूजू; जरल तिल सँ सौंसे मसाला तीत भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.208cff8b9d46.back: Roast groundnut and sesame on medium-low heat; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.

seg.7779355bd06d.src: For a milder curry, use 1½ tsp Sannam chilli powder; for more heat, go up to 1 tbsp.
seg.7779355bd06d.t: कम तीख तरकारी लेल 1½ छोट चम्मच सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी लिअ; बेसी तीख लेल 1 पैघ चम्मच धरि।
seg.7779355bd06d.back: For a less hot curry take 1½ teaspoons Sannam chilli powder; for hotter up to 1 tablespoon.

seg.742d7eb81437.src: With onion masala: grind 1 small onion into the stuffing for a softer, slightly sweet gravy.
seg.742d7eb81437.t: पियाउजक मसालाक संग: बेसी नरम आ कनेक मीठ ग्रेवी लेल भरावनमे 1 टा छोट पियाउज पीसि दिअ।
seg.742d7eb81437.back: With onion masala: for a softer and slightly sweet gravy grind 1 small onion into the stuffing.

seg.abde9958c7fa.src: Without coconut: leave out the coconut and use 1 tbsp more peanuts and sesame.
seg.abde9958c7fa.t: बिनु नारियलक: नारियल छोड़ि दिअ आ मूँगफली आ तिल 1 पैघ चम्मच बेसी लिअ।
seg.abde9958c7fa.back: Without coconut: leave out the coconut and take 1 tablespoon more groundnut and sesame.

seg.b9a6b34c8c73.src: Gravy style: add 1 cup water in place of ½ cup in the last step for a thinner curry to mix into rice.
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.t: ग्रेवीबला: भातमे सानबा लेल पातर तरकारी चाही तँ अन्तिम चरणमे ½ कपक बदला 1 कप पानि डालू।
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.back: With gravy: if you want a thin curry for mixing into rice, in the last step add 1 cup water instead of ½ cup.

seg.80faf3a5e4b1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.t: भापमे पाकल भात आ एक चम्मच घीक संग, वा रोटी वा जोन्ना रोट्टेक संग गरम-गरम परसू।
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.back: Serve piping hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with roti or jonna rotte.

seg.9adac1f51f99.src: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm gently with a splash of water.
seg.9adac1f51f99.t: झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे राखू आ 2 दिनक भीतर खा लिअ। कनेक पानि डालि धीरे-धीरे गरम करू।
seg.9adac1f51f99.back: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat slowly adding a little water.

seg.83ffeb71bb2a.src: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.t: गुत्ति वंकाया लेल कोन भाँटा सभ सँ नीक अछि?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.back: Which brinjal is best for gutti vankaya?

seg.76c81f4beef2.src: Small, round purple brinjals about the size of an egg, with a glossy skin and green stalk. They cook through in the time the masala takes and hold the stuffing well.
seg.76c81f4beef2.t: अंडा जतेक पैघ छोट, गोल, बैंगनी भाँटा, चमकदार छिलका आ हरियर डाँटबला। मसाला पकबामे जतेक समय लगैत अछि ओतबेमे ई भीतर धरि पाकि जाइत अछि आ भरावन नीक जकाँ पकड़ि कऽ रखैत अछि।
seg.76c81f4beef2.back: Small, round, purple brinjals as big as an egg, with shiny skin and green stalk. In the time the masala takes to cook they get cooked right through and hold the stuffing well.

seg.71325f387d2a.src: How do I know the brinjals are cooked?
seg.71325f387d2a.t: कोना बुझब जे भाँटा पाकि गेल?
seg.71325f387d2a.back: How to know the brinjal is cooked?

seg.c65656faa952.src: The skins wrinkle and soften, and a knife slides through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Undercooked brinjals feel firm and spongy in the centre.
seg.c65656faa952.t: छिलका सिकुड़ि कऽ नरम भऽ जाइत अछि, आ सभ सँ मोट भाँटामे चक्कू बिनु रोकने घुसि जाइत अछि। काँच भाँटा बीचमे कड़ा आ स्पंज सन लगैत अछि।
seg.c65656faa952.back: The skin shrinks and becomes soft, and a knife goes into the thickest brinjal without resistance. Raw brinjal feels hard and spongy in the middle.

seg.297ebd94e89c.src: Can I make gutti vankaya without coconut?
seg.297ebd94e89c.t: की बिनु नारियलक गुत्ति वंकाया बना सकैत छी?
seg.297ebd94e89c.back: Can I make gutti vankaya without coconut?

seg.f9ad1045b4c1.src: Yes. Use 1 tbsp more peanuts and 1 tbsp more sesame seeds in place of the coconut; the masala tastes nuttier.
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.t: हँ। नारियलक बदला 1 पैघ चम्मच मूँगफली आ 1 पैघ चम्मच तिल बेसी लिअ; मसालाक स्वाद बेसी भुनल मेवा सन होयत।
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.back: Yes. Instead of coconut take 1 tablespoon more groundnut and 1 tablespoon more sesame; the masala's taste will be more like roasted nuts.

seg.534e126ba995.src: Why do my brinjals fall apart?
seg.534e126ba995.t: हमर भाँटा टूटि कऽ बिखरि किएक जाइत अछि?
seg.534e126ba995.back: Why do my brinjals break and fall apart?

seg.96bfe0b8ed06.src: The stalk was removed or the cross was cut all the way through. Keep the stalk on, stop the slit about a quarter from the top and turn them gently.
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.t: डाँट हटा देल गेल छल वा क्रॉस पूरा आर-पार काटि देल गेल छल। डाँट लागल रहय दिअ, ऊपर सँ करीब एक-चौथाइ पहिने चीरा रोकू आ धीरे सँ उलटू।
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.back: The stalk was removed or the cross was cut fully through. Leave the stalk attached, stop the slit about a quarter before the top and turn gently.

seg.69e1140e9c6e.t: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · गुत्ति वंकाया कूराक रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.back: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · Gutti Vankaya Koora recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.d09cc87e5fde.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals stuffed with roasted peanut, sesame and coconut, ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then slow-cooked in oil.
seg.d09cc87e5fde.t: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. भूजल मूँगफली, तिल आ नारियल भरल छोट भाँटा, सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी आ हरदि बुकनीक संग पिसल मसाला, फेर तेलमे धीरे-धीरे पकाओल।
seg.d09cc87e5fde.back: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals stuffed with roasted groundnut, sesame and coconut, masala ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then cooked slowly in oil.

seg.111c74722b7d.src: Jeedipappu pakodi is the cashew pakoda that Andhra sweet shops and homes fry for tea time, festivals and guests: whole cashews in a thin, spiced coat of besan and rice flour, fried till crisp. Made without onion, it keeps for days in a jar, so many homes fry a batch for Diwali and Sankranti visitors.
seg.111c74722b7d.t: जीडिपप्पु पकोडी काजूक पकौड़ी अछि जे आन्ध्रक मिठाइक दोकान आ घरमे चाहक बेर, पाबनि आ पाहुन लेल तरल जाइत अछि: समूचा काजू बेसन आ चाउरक चिक्कसक पातर, मसालेदार परतमे, कुरकुर होबा धरि तरल। बिनु पियाउजक बनैत अछि, तेँ बोइयाममे कतेको दिन टिकैत अछि, आ बहुत घरमे दिवाली आ संक्रान्तिक पाहुन लेल एक खेप तरि कऽ राखल जाइत अछि।
seg.111c74722b7d.back: Jeedipappu pakodi is cashew pakori which is fried in Andhra sweet shops and homes for tea time, festivals and guests: whole cashews in a thin, spicy coating of besan and rice flour, fried until crisp. It is made without onion, so it keeps many days in a jar, and in many homes a batch is fried and kept for Diwali and Sankranti guests.

seg.b4f22aebea20.src: Whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack stay crunchy inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe serves 4.
seg.b4f22aebea20.t: हमर जीडिपप्पु पैकेटक समूचा काजू परतक भीतर कुरकुर रहैत अछि, आ सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी मध्यम तीख आ गरम लाल रंग दैत अछि। ई रेसिपी 4 लोक लेल अछि।
seg.b4f22aebea20.back: The whole cashews of our Jeedipappu packet stay crisp inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.a21c4d5f661e.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and crisp.
seg.a21c4d5f661e.t: कुल समयमे पकोडीकेँ ठंढ़ा आ कुरकुर होमय लेल 5 मिनट जोड़ल अछि।
seg.a21c4d5f661e.back: The total time includes 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and crisp.

seg.0f4b2d277930.src: Toss whole cashews with besan, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle in just enough water to coat, and deep fry till golden and crisp.
seg.0f4b2d277930.t: समूचा काजूकेँ बेसन, चाउरक चिक्कस, सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी, नोन आ एक चम्मच गरम तेलक संग मिलाउ, बस परत चढ़बा जोगर पानि छीटू, आ सोनहुला आ कुरकुर होबा धरि खूब तेलमे तरू।
seg.0f4b2d277930.back: Mix whole cashews with besan, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle just enough water for the coating to stick, and deep-fry in plenty of oil until golden and crisp.

seg.d97defcf6bd2.src: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; split any very large ones in half⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.t: 1 कप समूचा काजू ⟦1⟧करीब 150 g; बहुत पैघ काजूकेँ आधा कऽ लिअ⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.back: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; halve very large cashews⟦/1⟧

seg.0fb432c2000d.src: ½ cup besan ⟦1⟧gram flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.t: ½ कप बेसन ⟦1⟧चनाक आटा, करीब 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.back: ½ cup besan ⟦1⟧gram flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.4530b28d3c24.src: 2 tbsp rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.t: 2 पैघ चम्मच चाउरक चिक्कस ⟦1⟧बेसी कुरकुर परत लेल⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.back: 2 tablespoons rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧

seg.069bf214d83d.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; add ½ tsp more for a hotter pakodi⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.t: 1 छोट चम्मच सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी ⟦1⟧मध्यम तीख; बेसी तीख पकोडी लेल ½ छोट चम्मच आओर डालू⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; for hotter pakodi add ½ teaspoon more⟦/1⟧

seg.40a2a51a64aa.t: ½ छोट चम्मच नोन ⟦1⟧वा स्वाद अनुसार⟦/1⟧

seg.c5de5bb5101e.src: 1 tbsp hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.t: 1 पैघ चम्मच गरम तेल ⟦1⟧तरबाक तेल सँ लेल⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.back: 1 tablespoon hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧

seg.a24adfc46507.src: 2–3 tbsp water ⟦1⟧sprinkled in a little at a time⟦/1⟧

seg.9a0fd1249b07.src: oil for deep frying ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9a0fd1249b07.t: खूब तेलमे तरबा लेल तेल ⟦1⟧बेसी मूँगफलीक तेल चलैत अछि⟦/1⟧
seg.9a0fd1249b07.back: Oil for deep-frying ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is mostly used⟦/1⟧

seg.8423a6481648.src: Rinse the cashews and drain them well; a slightly damp surface helps the flour stick.
seg.8423a6481648.t: काजू पखारि कऽ नीक जकाँ पानि निथारि लिअ; कनेक भीजल सतह पर आटा नीक जकाँ सटैत अछि।
seg.8423a6481648.back: Rinse the cashews and drain the water well; flour sticks well to a slightly wet surface.

seg.0d03259dc451.src: Heat the oil for deep frying in a kadai on medium heat.
seg.0d03259dc451.t: कड़ाहीमे मध्यम आँच पर तरबा लेल तेल गरम करू।
seg.0d03259dc451.back: Heat the frying oil in a kadai on medium heat.

seg.c7fa1a156718.src: Mix the besan, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and add the green chillies, coriander leaves and asafoetida at the same time.
seg.c7fa1a156718.t: बेसन, चाउरक चिक्कस, मरचाइ बुकनी, नोन, आदी-लहसुनक पेस्ट आ करी पात मिलाउ। चाकर कटोरा लिअ, आ संगे हरियर मरचाइ, धनियाँ पात आ हींग सेहो डालू।
seg.c7fa1a156718.back: Mix besan, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Take a wide bowl, and add green chilli, coriander leaves and hing along with them.

seg.346911fb291b.src: Rub in 1 tbsp hot oil, add the cashews and sprinkle water till the flour just coats them. Spoon the hot oil from the kadai with care and rub it into the flour mix with your fingertips first, then add the cashews and sprinkle the water 1 tbsp at a time, tossing, until the flour clings to every cashew. The mix should look like damp crumbs, not a batter.
seg.346911fb291b.t: 1 पैघ चम्मच गरम तेल मलू, काजू डालू आ ओतबे पानि छीटू जाहि सँ आटा बस ओकरा पर चढ़ि जाय। कड़ाही सँ गरम तेल सावधानी सँ चम्मचमे लिअ आ पहिने आंगुरक पोर सँ आटाक मिश्रणमे मलू, फेर काजू डालू आ एक बेरमे 1 पैघ चम्मच पानि छीटैत, उलटैत-पलटैत रहू, जा धरि हर काजू पर आटा सटि नहि जाय। मिश्रण भीजल भुरभुरा सन देखेबाक चाही, घोल सन नहि।
seg.346911fb291b.back: Rub in 1 tablespoon hot oil, add the cashews and sprinkle just enough water that the flour just coats them. Carefully take hot oil from the kadai in a spoon and first rub it into the flour mixture with your fingertips, then add the cashews and, sprinkling 1 tablespoon of water at a time, keep tossing, until flour sticks to every cashew. The mixture should look like wet crumbs, not like batter.

seg.05a50e3b5ae8.src: Check the oil: a pinch of the mix dropped in should rise to the top in 2–3 seconds with steady bubbles. If it browns at once, the oil is too hot.
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.t: तेल जाँचू: मिश्रणक एक चुटकी डालला पर 2–3 सेकेंडमे लगातार बुलबुलाक संग ऊपर आबि जेबाक चाही। जँ तुरन्त भूर भऽ जाय तँ तेल बेसी गरम अछि।
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.back: Check the oil: a pinch of the mixture dropped in should rise to the top in 2–3 seconds with steady bubbles. If it turns brown immediately the oil is too hot.

seg.f3e77b6c0f73.src: Drop small clusters into medium-hot oil. Pick up 3–4 coated cashews at a time with your fingers and let them fall loosely into the oil, without crowding the kadai.
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.t: मध्यम गरम तेलमे छोट-छोट गुच्छा डालू। आंगुर सँ एक बेरमे 3–4 टा परत चढ़ल काजू उठाउ आ ढील-ढाल तेलमे खसय दिअ, कड़ाहीमे भीड़ नहि करू।
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.back: Drop small clusters into medium-hot oil. With fingers pick up 3–4 coated cashews at a time and let them fall loosely into the oil, do not crowd the kadai.

seg.5e4bfdad4c05.src: Fry, turning, till golden and crisp, 5–6 minutes; drain on paper. The bubbles around the pakodi get smaller and slow down when they are done.
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.t: उलटैत-पलटैत सोनहुला आ कुरकुर होबा धरि तरू, 5–6 मिनट; कागज पर निकालू। पाकि गेला पर पकोडीक चारू कात बुलबुला छोट आ धीमा भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.back: Fry while turning until golden and crisp, 5–6 minutes; take out onto paper. When done, the bubbles around the pakodi become small and slow.

seg.eb1a58e02e89.src: Fry the rest in batches the same way, letting the oil come back to heat between batches.
seg.eb1a58e02e89.t: बाकी काजू ओहिना खेप-खेप कऽ तरू, आ हर खेपक बीच तेलकेँ फेर गरम होमय दिअ।
seg.eb1a58e02e89.back: Fry the rest of the cashews the same way in batches, and let the oil heat again between each batch.

seg.8ab193492427.src: Let the pakodi rest for 5 minutes on the paper; they crisp up further as they cool. Sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder over the top, if you like.
seg.8ab193492427.t: पकोडीकेँ कागज पर 5 मिनट राखि दिअ; ठंढ़ाइत-ठंढ़ाइत ओ आओर कुरकुर होइत अछि। मन हो तँ ऊपर सँ एक चुटकी नोन वा मरचाइ बुकनी छीटि दिअ।
seg.8ab193492427.back: Keep the pakodi on paper 5 minutes; as it cools it becomes even crisper. If you wish sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder on top.

seg.c8ded38fad10.src: Keep the batter thick and dry, not runny, or the pakodi turns soft.
seg.c8ded38fad10.t: घोल गाढ़ आ सुखल राखू, पातर नहि, नहि तँ पकोडी नरम भऽ जायत।
seg.c8ded38fad10.back: Keep the batter thick and dry, not thin, otherwise the pakodi will become soft.

seg.9670def7c10b.src: Fry on medium heat: cashews brown fast, and on high heat the coating colours before the cashew inside is toasted.
seg.9670def7c10b.t: मध्यम आँच पर तरू: काजू जल्दी भूर भऽ जाइत अछि, आ तेज आँच पर भीतरक काजू सेकाय सँ पहिने ऊपरक परत रंग पकड़ि लैत अछि।
seg.9670def7c10b.back: Fry on medium heat: cashews brown quickly, and on high heat the outer coating takes colour before the cashew inside is roasted.

seg.76602f605fc8.src: The spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crisp.
seg.76602f605fc8.t: आटामे मलल एक चम्मच गरम तेल सँ पकोडी हल्लुक आ कुरकुर बनैत अछि।
seg.76602f605fc8.back: A spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crisp.

seg.2494998e92ed.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a good red colour; use ½ tsp for children.
seg.2494998e92ed.t: सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी मध्यम तीख आ नीक लाल रंग दैत अछि; धिया-पुता लेल ½ छोट चम्मच लिअ।
seg.2494998e92ed.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat and a nice red colour; for children take ½ teaspoon.

seg.7f70d313349e.src: Hotter: replace half the Sannam chilli powder with Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.
seg.7f70d313349e.t: बेसी तीख: आधा सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनीक बदला तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी लिअ, जे बहुत बेसी तीख अछि।
seg.7f70d313349e.back: Hotter: instead of half the Sannam chilli powder take Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.

seg.2b2be3846a1d.src: With onion: add 1 small onion, thinly sliced, with the cashews for a softer, sweeter pakodi, and eat it the same day.
seg.2b2be3846a1d.t: पियाउजक संग: बेसी नरम आ मीठ पकोडी लेल काजूक संग 1 टा छोट पियाउज पातर-पातर काटि कऽ डालू, आ ओही दिन खा लिअ।
seg.2b2be3846a1d.back: With onion: for a softer and sweeter pakodi add 1 small thinly sliced onion with the cashews, and eat it the same day.

seg.7f852eddc8b5.src: Mint: add 2 tbsp chopped mint leaves along with the coriander leaves.
seg.7f852eddc8b5.t: पुदीना: धनियाँ पातक संग 2 पैघ चम्मच काटल पुदीनाक पात डालू।
seg.7f852eddc8b5.back: Mint: add 2 tablespoons chopped mint leaves with the coriander leaves.

seg.cd47edc05460.src: Serve warm with evening tea or filter coffee. They also go into lunch boxes or onto the side of a rice-and-pappu meal.
seg.cd47edc05460.t: साँझक चाह वा फिल्टर कॉफीक संग गरम-गरम परसू। टिफिन बक्सामे वा भात-पप्पुक भोजनक संगमे सेहो चलैत अछि।
seg.cd47edc05460.back: Serve piping hot with evening tea or filter coffee. It also goes in a tiffin box or alongside a rice-pappu meal.

seg.e2777b4dabb7.src: Once fully cooled, keep them in an airtight jar at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If they soften, warm them in a dry pan on low heat for 2–3 minutes.
seg.e2777b4dabb7.t: पूरा ठंढ़ा भेलाक बाद हवाबन्द बोइयाममे कोठलीक तापमान पर राखू आ 4–5 दिनक भीतर खा लिअ। नरम भऽ जाय तँ सुखल पैनमे धीमा आँच पर 2–3 मिनट गरम करू।
seg.e2777b4dabb7.back: After cooling completely keep in an airtight jar at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If it becomes soft heat in a dry pan on low heat for 2–3 minutes.

seg.f8c9120f7f67.src: Why did my cashew pakodi turn soft?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.t: हमर काजू पकोडी नरम किएक भऽ गेल?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.back: Why did my cashew pakodi become soft?

seg.346050614d3a.src: Too much water in the flour, or frying on low heat. Keep the mix like damp crumbs and fry on medium heat until the bubbles slow down.
seg.346050614d3a.t: आटामे बेसी पानि, वा धीमा आँच पर तरब। मिश्रण भीजल भुरभुरा सन राखू आ मध्यम आँच पर तरू जा धरि बुलबुला धीमा नहि भऽ जाय।
seg.346050614d3a.back: Too much water in the flour, or frying on low heat. Keep the mixture like wet crumbs and fry on medium heat until the bubbles slow down.

seg.921421ebf2c6.src: Should I soak cashews before making pakodi?
seg.921421ebf2c6.t: की पकोडी बनेबा सँ पहिने काजू भिजाबऽ पड़त?
seg.921421ebf2c6.back: Do I have to soak cashews before making pakodi?

seg.e6e487728264.src: No soak is needed. A quick rinse is enough to help the flour stick; cashews soaked for long lose some of their crunch.
seg.e6e487728264.t: भिजेबाक जरूरति नहि। आटा सटय ताहि लेल हल्लुक पखारब पर्याप्त अछि; बेसी काल भिजाओल काजूक कुरकुरापन किछु कम भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.e6e487728264.back: No need to soak. A light rinse is enough for the flour to stick; cashews soaked for long lose some of their crispness.

seg.905443e515e2.src: Can I make cashew pakodi without rice flour?
seg.905443e515e2.t: की बिनु चाउरक चिक्कसक काजू पकोडी बना सकैत छी?
seg.905443e515e2.back: Can I make cashew pakodi without rice flour?

seg.72a2c55cca9c.src: Yes. Use 2 tbsp more besan, or 1 tbsp cornflour. Rice flour gives the crispest coating, so the pakodi will be a little softer without it.
seg.72a2c55cca9c.t: हँ। 2 पैघ चम्मच बेसन बेसी लिअ, वा 1 पैघ चम्मच कॉर्नफ्लोर। चाउरक चिक्कस सँ सभ सँ बेसी कुरकुर परत बनैत अछि, तेँ ओकरा बिना पकोडी कनेक नरम होयत।
seg.72a2c55cca9c.back: Yes. Take 2 tablespoons more besan, or 1 tablespoon cornflour. Rice flour makes the crispest coating, so without it the pakodi will be a little softer.

seg.f129edc737b1.src: How long does cashew pakodi stay crisp?
seg.f129edc737b1.t: काजू पकोडी कतेक दिन कुरकुर रहैत अछि?
seg.f129edc737b1.back: How many days does cashew pakodi stay crisp?

seg.d73ef4b28b6d.src: About 4–5 days in an airtight jar, as long as it cools completely before it goes in.
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.t: हवाबन्द बोइयाममे करीब 4–5 दिन, जँ राखबा सँ पहिने पूरा ठंढ़ा भऽ गेल हो।
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.back: About 4–5 days in an airtight jar, if it had cooled completely before storing.

seg.62c3aa71c55a.src: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crisp cashew pakodi with whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack, besan, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.62c3aa71c55a.t: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. हमर जीडिपप्पु पैकेटक समूचा काजू, बेसन, चाउरक चिक्कस आ सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी सँ कुरकुर काजू पकोडी। डेग-डेग विधि, सुझाव आ प्रश्नोत्तर।
seg.62c3aa71c55a.back: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crisp cashew pakodi from the whole cashews of our Jeedipappu packet, besan, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and Q&A.

seg.f560ff3badb6.src: Jeedipappu Pakodi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.f560ff3badb6.t: जीडिपप्पु पकोडी: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.f560ff3badb6.back: Jeedipappu Pakodi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.a64f3158d8da.src: Upma is the everyday Andhra tiffin: semolina cooked soft in a seasoned water with onion, green chillies and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is the dressed-up version, with a good handful of cashews fried golden in ghee, the way it is made for guests, for festival mornings and at weddings, often served next to pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.
seg.a64f3158d8da.t: उपमा आन्ध्रक रोजुक जलखै अछि: पियाउज, हरियर मरचाइ आ करी पातक छौंकल पानिमे नरम पकाओल सूजी। जीडिपप्पु उपमा एकर सजल-धजल रूप अछि, घीमे सोनहुला तरल नीक मुट्ठी भरि काजूक संग, जेना पाहुन लेल, पाबनिक भोरमे आ बियाहमे बनैत अछि, बेसी काल पेसरट्टुक संग वा एक चम्मच चीनीक संग परसल।
seg.a64f3158d8da.back: Upma is Andhra's everyday breakfast: semolina cooked soft in water tempered with onion, green chilli and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is its dressed-up version, with a good handful of cashews fried golden in ghee, as made for guests, on festival mornings and at weddings, mostly served with pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.

seg.f9bc03f64077.src: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crunchy against the soft rava. It is on the table in about 25 minutes. This recipe serves 3.
seg.f9bc03f64077.t: हमर जीडिपप्पु काजू समूचा आ सादा अछि, तेँ एक समान तराइत अछि आ नरम सूजीक बीच कुरकुर रहैत अछि। करीब 25 मिनटमे थारीमे आबि जाइत अछि। ई रेसिपी 3 लोक लेल अछि।
seg.f9bc03f64077.back: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crisp amid the soft semolina. It comes to the plate in about 25 minutes. This recipe is for 3 people.

seg.5ef4d1713249.src: Roast rava, fry cashews in ghee, then temper and soften onion and chillies. Boil water with salt, stir in the rava, cover and finish with the cashews.
seg.5ef4d1713249.t: सूजी भूजू, काजू घीमे तरू, फेर छौंक लगा कऽ पियाउज आ मरचाइ नरम करू। नोन देल पानि खौलाउ, सूजी मिलाउ, झाँपू आ अन्तमे काजू डालू।
seg.5ef4d1713249.back: Roast the semolina, fry cashews in ghee, then temper and soften the onion and chilli. Boil salted water, mix in semolina, cover and add the cashews at the end.

seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.src: 1 cup bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium semolina (sooji), about 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.t: 1 कप बम्बई रवा ⟦1⟧मझोला सूजी, करीब 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.back: 1 cup Bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium semolina, about 170 g⟦/1⟧

seg.30102cb3f08b.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧use 2 cups for a firmer upma⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.t: 2½ कप पानि ⟦1⟧कड़ा उपमा लेल 2 कप लिअ⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧for a firm upma take 2 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.src: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halved, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.t: ¼ कप काजू ⟦1⟧समूचा वा आधा कयल, करीब 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.back: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halved, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.0e1b40869004.src: 3 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tbsp oil plus 1 tbsp ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.t: 3 पैघ चम्मच घी ⟦1⟧वा 2 पैघ चम्मच तेल आ 1 पैघ चम्मच घी⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.back: 3 tablespoons ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tablespoons oil and 1 tablespoon ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.07a870690b21.src: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit; use 3 for a hotter upma⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.t: 2 टा हरियर मरचाइ ⟦1⟧बीचमे चीरल; बेसी तीख उपमा लेल 3 टा लिअ⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.back: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit in the middle; for a hotter upma take 3⟦/1⟧

seg.46ba774a4c39.t: 2 पैघ चम्मच धनियाँ पात ⟦1⟧काटल, मन हो तँ⟦/1⟧
seg.46ba774a4c39.back: 2 tablespoons coriander leaves ⟦1⟧chopped, if you wish⟦/1⟧

seg.5fe03b6066ae.src: Chop the onion, ginger and coriander leaves, slit the green chillies, and measure out the water.
seg.5fe03b6066ae.t: पियाउज, आदी आ धनियाँ पात काटि लिअ, हरियर मरचाइ चीरि लिअ, आ पानि नापि कऽ राखू।
seg.5fe03b6066ae.back: Chop the onion, ginger and coriander leaves, slit the green chillies, and measure and keep the water.

seg.015e5d6ef88c.src: Roast the rava in a dry pan till it smells toasty, about 5 minutes. Keep it pale. Stir all the time on medium-low heat, then tip it onto a plate.
seg.015e5d6ef88c.t: सुखल पैनमे सूजीकेँ सेकल गन्ध आबय धरि भूजू, करीब 5 मिनट। रंग हल्लुके राखू। मध्यम-धीमा आँच पर लगातार चलाउ, फेर थारी पर उझलि दिअ।
seg.015e5d6ef88c.back: Roast the semolina in a dry pan until a toasted smell comes, about 5 minutes. Keep the colour light. Stir constantly on medium-low heat, then tip onto a plate.

seg.2ccb9bbfe373.src: Heat the ghee in a wide, heavy pan on medium-low heat.
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.t: चाकर, भारी पैनमे मध्यम-धीमा आँच पर घी गरम करू।
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.back: Heat ghee in a wide, heavy pan on medium-low heat.

seg.827cce77ebf1.src: Fry the cashews in the ghee till golden; lift them out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee in the pan.
seg.827cce77ebf1.t: काजूकेँ घीमे सोनहुला होबा धरि तरू; निकालि लिअ। एहिमे करीब 1–2 मिनट लगैत अछि; घी पैनेमे रहय दिअ।
seg.827cce77ebf1.back: Fry the cashews in ghee until golden; take them out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; leave the ghee in the pan.

seg.57b61920de4c.src: Temper mustard, dals and curry leaves. Soften the onion and chillies, add water and salt, and boil. Let the mustard seeds splutter and the dals turn light golden before the curry leaves go in, then add the ginger with the onion and cook for 3–4 minutes till the onion is soft.
seg.57b61920de4c.t: सरिसो, दालि आ करी पातक छौंक लगाउ। पियाउज आ मरचाइ नरम करू, पानि आ नोन डालू, आ खौलाउ। करी पात डालबा सँ पहिने सरिसो चटकय दिअ आ दालि हल्लुक सोनहुला होमय दिअ, फेर पियाउजक संग आदी डालू आ पियाउज नरम होबा धरि 3–4 मिनट पकाउ।
seg.57b61920de4c.back: Temper mustard, dal and curry leaves. Soften the onion and chilli, add water and salt, and boil. Before adding curry leaves let the mustard crackle and the dal turn light golden, then add ginger with the onion and cook 3–4 minutes until the onion is soft.

seg.be01d433ae80.src: Taste the water once it boils; it should taste a little salty, as the rava will take up the salt.
seg.be01d433ae80.t: पानि खौलला पर चीखू; ई कनेक नोनगर लागक चाही, किएक तँ सूजी नोन सोखि लेत।
seg.be01d433ae80.back: When the water boils, taste; it should taste a little salty, because the semolina will absorb salt.

seg.b99b11495ead.src: Turn the heat to low. Pour in the rava in a thin stream, stirring. Cover on low for 3 minutes; top with the cashews.
seg.b99b11495ead.t: आँच धीमा करू। चलबैत पातर धारमे सूजी ढारू। धीमा आँच पर 3 मिनट झाँपि दिअ; ऊपर सँ काजू डालू।
seg.b99b11495ead.back: Lower the heat. While stirring pour in the semolina in a thin stream. Cover for 3 minutes on low heat; add the cashews on top.

seg.fbf1f55f7751.src: Before adding the cashews, check the upma: the rava should be soft with no hard grains, and the upma should leave the sides of the pan. If it is still grainy, sprinkle in 2 tbsp hot water, cover and cook 1 minute more.
seg.fbf1f55f7751.t: काजू डालबा सँ पहिने उपमा जाँचू: सूजी नरम हेबाक चाही, कोनो कड़ा दाना नहि, आ उपमा पैनक किनार छोड़य लागय। जँ एखनो दानेदार अछि तँ 2 पैघ चम्मच गरम पानि छीटू, झाँपू आ 1 मिनट आओर पकाउ।
seg.fbf1f55f7751.back: Check the upma before adding the cashews: the semolina should be soft, no hard grains, and the upma should start leaving the sides of the pan. If it is still grainy sprinkle 2 tablespoons hot water, cover and cook 1 minute more.

seg.28e90add4ba6.src: Stir in the extra spoon of ghee and the coriander leaves, if using, along with most of the cashews.
seg.28e90add4ba6.t: अतिरिक्त एक चम्मच घी आ, जँ लैत छी तँ, धनियाँ पात, बेसी काजूक संग मिला दिअ।
seg.28e90add4ba6.back: Mix in an extra spoon of ghee and, if you are using them, coriander leaves, with most of the cashews.

seg.351e9512c914.src: Serve hot, with the rest of the cashews on top.
seg.351e9512c914.t: बचल काजू ऊपर राखि गरम-गरम परसू।
seg.351e9512c914.back: Serve piping hot with the remaining cashews on top.

seg.4643e12d303d.src: Pour the rava in a thin stream while stirring so no lumps form.
seg.4643e12d303d.t: चलबैत-चलबैत पातर धारमे सूजी ढारू जाहि सँ गुलठी नहि बनय।
seg.4643e12d303d.back: Pour the semolina in a thin stream while stirring so that lumps do not form.

seg.3c98bb62770b.src: Roasting the rava first keeps each grain separate; skip it and the upma turns sticky.
seg.3c98bb62770b.t: पहिने सूजी भुजला सँ हर दाना अलग रहैत अछि; ई छोड़ि देब तँ उपमा लसगर भऽ जायत।
seg.3c98bb62770b.back: Roasting the semolina first keeps every grain separate; if you skip this the upma will become sticky.

seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.src: Fry the cashews on medium-low heat and lift them out as soon as they turn golden; they keep darkening in the hot ghee.
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.t: काजू मध्यम-धीमा आँच पर तरू आ सोनहुला होइते निकालि लिअ; गरम घीमे ओ आओर गाढ़ होइत रहैत अछि।
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.back: Fry the cashews on medium-low heat and take them out as soon as golden; in hot ghee they keep getting darker.

seg.975560a8a158.src: Upma firms up as it stands, so take it off the heat when it is a little softer than you want.
seg.975560a8a158.t: राखल रहला सँ उपमा कड़ा होइत जाइत अछि, तेँ जतेक चाही ताहि सँ कनेक नरम रहिते आँच सँ उतारि लिअ।
seg.975560a8a158.back: On standing the upma keeps getting firmer, so take it off the heat while it is a little softer than you want.

seg.508f0ab3992d.src: Vegetable upma: add ½ cup chopped carrot, beans and green peas with the onion and cook them for 3–4 minutes before the water goes in.
seg.508f0ab3992d.t: तरकारीबला उपमा: पियाउजक संग ½ कप काटल गाजर, बीन्स आ हरियर मटर डालू आ पानि डालबा सँ पहिने 3–4 मिनट पकाउ।
seg.508f0ab3992d.back: Vegetable upma: with the onion add ½ cup chopped carrot, beans and green peas and cook 3–4 minutes before adding water.

seg.1742d7bd0e23.src: Tomato upma: add 1 chopped tomato after the onion and cook till soft before adding the water.
seg.1742d7bd0e23.t: टमाटर उपमा: पियाउजक बाद 1 टा काटल टमाटर डालू आ पानि डालबा सँ पहिने नरम होबा धरि पकाउ।
seg.1742d7bd0e23.back: Tomato upma: after the onion add 1 chopped tomato and cook until soft before adding water.

seg.1981c7f3fc60.src: Godhuma rava upma: use the same amount of wheat rava with 3 cups water and cook it covered for 5–6 minutes.
seg.1981c7f3fc60.t: गोधुमा रवा उपमा: ओतबे गहूमक दलिया 3 कप पानिक संग लिअ आ झाँपि कऽ 5–6 मिनट पकाउ।
seg.1981c7f3fc60.back: Godhuma rava upma: take the same amount of wheat dalia (broken wheat) with 3 cups water and cook covered 5–6 minutes.

seg.01300d94ad36.src: Serve hot as a breakfast tiffin with coconut chutney, allam pachadi or a spoon of sugar, or next to pesarattu for pesarattu upma.
seg.01300d94ad36.t: भोरक जलखैमे नारियलक चटनी, अल्लम पच्चडी वा एक चम्मच चीनीक संग, वा पेसरट्टु उपमा लेल पेसरट्टुक संग गरम-गरम परसू।
seg.01300d94ad36.back: For morning breakfast serve piping hot with coconut chutney, allam pachadi or a spoon of sugar, or with pesarattu for pesarattu upma.

seg.3316a3d82f44.src: Upma is best eaten hot, soon after it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and sprinkle with water before reheating.
seg.3316a3d82f44.t: उपमा बनेलाक तुरन्त बाद गरमे खेनाइ सभ सँ नीक। बचल उपमा झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे 1 दिन धरि राखू आ फेर गरम करबा सँ पहिने पानि छीटि दिअ।
seg.3316a3d82f44.back: Upma is best eaten hot right after making. Keep leftover upma covered in the fridge up to 1 day and sprinkle water before reheating.

seg.b53646711bf0.src: How do I make upma without lumps?
seg.b53646711bf0.back: How to make upma without lumps?

seg.429b54b4ab3a.src: Keep the water at a boil, turn the heat to low and pour in the rava in a thin stream with one hand while you stir with the other.
seg.429b54b4ab3a.t: पानि खौलैत राखू, आँच धीमा करू आ एक हाथ सँ पातर धारमे सूजी ढारू आ दोसर हाथ सँ चलबैत रहू।
seg.429b54b4ab3a.back: Keep the water boiling, lower the heat and pour the semolina in a thin stream with one hand and keep stirring with the other hand.

seg.0c2874233201.src: What is the right rava to water ratio for upma?
seg.0c2874233201.t: उपमा लेल सूजी आ पानिक सही अनुपात की अछि?
seg.0c2874233201.back: What is the right ratio of semolina and water for upma?

seg.91a8fe1a38a5.src: For a soft Andhra-style upma, use 2½ cups water to 1 cup bombay rava. Use 2 cups for a firmer, more separate upma.
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.t: आन्ध्र तरीकाक नरम उपमा लेल 1 कप बम्बई रवामे 2½ कप पानि लिअ। बेसी कड़ा आ खिलल उपमा लेल 2 कप लिअ।
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.back: For soft Andhra-style upma take 2½ cups water for 1 cup Bombay rava. For a firmer and fluffier upma take 2 cups.

seg.bd11a83d27d8.src: The rava was not roasted, or too much water went in. Roast the rava till it smells toasty, and stay close to 2½ cups water per cup.
seg.bd11a83d27d8.t: सूजी भूजल नहि गेल छल, वा पानि बेसी पड़ि गेल। सूजीकेँ सेकल गन्ध आबय धरि भूजू, आ हर कप पर करीब 2½ कप पानि राखू।
seg.bd11a83d27d8.back: The semolina was not roasted, or too much water went in. Roast the semolina until a toasted smell comes, and keep about 2½ cups water per cup.

seg.247181e411d9.src: When should I add cashews to upma?
seg.247181e411d9.back: When to add cashews to upma?

seg.83f262d9c56e.src: Fry them in the ghee first and lift them out, then stir them in at the end. Added early, they turn soft in the upma.
seg.83f262d9c56e.t: पहिने घीमे तरि कऽ निकालि लिअ, फेर अन्तमे मिलाउ। पहिने डालला सँ उपमामे ओ नरम भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.83f262d9c56e.back: First fry in ghee and take out, then mix in at the end. Adding them earlier makes them soft in the upma.

seg.8b57b24af158.src: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra rava upma with Jeedipappu cashews fried golden in ghee, a soft and quick morning tiffin. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs. Serves 3.
seg.8b57b24af158.t: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. घीमे सोनहुला तरल जीडिपप्पु काजूक संग आन्ध्रक सूजी उपमा, नरम आ झटपट बनयबला भोरक जलखै। डेग-डेग विधि, सुझाव आ प्रश्नोत्तर। 3 लोक लेल।
seg.8b57b24af158.back: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra semolina upma with Jeedipappu cashews fried golden in ghee, a soft and quick-to-make morning breakfast. Step-by-step method, tips and Q&A. For 3 people.

seg.661f01591624.src: Jeedipappu Upma: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.661f01591624.t: जीडिपप्पु उपमा: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.661f01591624.back: Jeedipappu Upma: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.992a8475993f.src: Kodi vepudu is the dry Andhra chicken fry: small pieces of chicken cooked in their own juices, then fried hard in oil with curry leaves, green chillies and a just-roasted masala until dark and sticky with spice. It is the starter at Andhra weddings and the side that sits next to rasam rice or pappu at home.
seg.992a8475993f.t: कोडी वेपुडु आन्ध्रक सुखल चिकन फ्राइ अछि: चिकनक छोट टुकड़ा अपने रसमे पकाओल, फेर करी पात, हरियर मरचाइ आ तुरत भूजल मसालाक संग तेलमे खूब भूजल, जा धरि गाढ़ रंगक आ मसाला सँ लसगर नहि भऽ जाय। ई आन्ध्रक बियाहमे पहिल व्यंजन होइत अछि आ घरमे रसम-भात वा पप्पुक संग परसल जाइत अछि।
seg.992a8475993f.back: Kodi vepudu is Andhra's dry chicken fry: small pieces of chicken cooked in their own juices, then fried well in oil with curry leaves, green chilli and freshly roasted masala, until dark-coloured and coated with masala. It is the first dish at Andhra weddings and at home is served with rasam-rice or pappu.
