seg.db90598234ea.src: Our Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the heat Andhra fries are known for, our turmeric powder goes into the marinade, and our whole cashew kernels, fried golden, go in at the end. Serves 4 as a side.
seg.db90598234ea.t: हमर तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी एकरा गाढ़ लाल रंग आ ओ तीख दैत अछि जाहि लेल आन्ध्रक भुजिया जानल जाइत अछि, हमर हरदि बुकनी मसालामे पड़ैत अछि, आ हमर समूचा काजू, सोनहुला तरल, अन्तमे पड़ैत अछि। संगमे परसबा लेल 4 लोक लेल।
seg.db90598234ea.back: Our Teja chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and that heat for which Andhra fries are known, our turmeric powder goes into the marinade, and our whole cashews, fried golden, go in at the end. For 4 people as a side.

seg.22b3994cc48a.src: Marinate chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook it in its own juices, then fry it dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and cashews.
seg.22b3994cc48a.t: चिकनकेँ तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी, हरदि बुकनी, आदी-लहसुनक पेस्ट आ नेबोमे लपेटि कऽ राखू, अपने रसमे पकाउ, फेर करी पात, हरियर मरचाइ, भूजल मसाला आ काजूक संग सुखल भूजू।
seg.22b3994cc48a.back: Keep the chicken coated in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook in its own juices, then dry-fry with curry leaves, green chilli, roasted masala and cashews.

seg.4cb33a348eb8.src: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut into 1-inch pieces; or 600 g small bone-in pieces⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.t: 500 g बिनु हड्डीक चिकन ⟦1⟧1 इंचक टुकड़ामे काटल; वा 600 g हड्डीबला छोट टुकड़ा⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.back: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut into 1-inch pieces; or 600 g small bone-in pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.57789012bc80.src: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashew kernels; halve any large ones⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.t: 15 टा काजू ⟦1⟧समूचा काजू; पैघकेँ आधा कऽ लिअ⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.back: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashews; halve the big ones⟦/1⟧

seg.444a0a15a466.t: 1 टा मझोला पियाउज (मन हो तँ) ⟦1⟧पातर-पातर काटल⟦/1⟧

seg.e43b68ea429f.t: 2 डाँट करी पात ⟦1⟧पात तोड़ल, करीब 30 टा⟦/1⟧

seg.8df3bc4567e3.src: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so the marinade sticks.
seg.8df3bc4567e3.t: चिकनकेँ कपड़ा सँ थपथपा कऽ सुखा लिअ जाहि सँ मसाला सटय।
seg.8df3bc4567e3.back: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so that the masala sticks.

seg.075327f4deca.src: Marinate the chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt, 30 minutes. Mix well with your hands so every piece is coated.
seg.075327f4deca.t: चिकनकेँ तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी, हरदि, आदी-लहसुनक पेस्ट, नेबोक रस आ नोनमे 30 मिनट लपेटि कऽ राखू। हाथ सँ नीक जकाँ मिलाउ जाहि सँ हर टुकड़ा पर मसाला चढ़ि जाय।
seg.075327f4deca.back: Keep the chicken coated in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt for 30 minutes. Mix well by hand so that masala coats every piece.

seg.63af904bba96.src: Meanwhile, dry-roast the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, cloves and cinnamon in a small pan on low heat until fragrant and a shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the fry masala.
seg.63af904bba96.t: ताबत साबुत धनियाँ, जीर, सौंफ, लौंग आ दालचीनीकेँ छोट पैनमे धीमा आँच पर बिनु तेलक भूजू जा धरि सुगन्ध नहि आबय आ एक रंग गाढ़ नहि भऽ जाय, करीब 2 मिनट। ठंढ़ा कऽ मोट बुकनी पीसि लिअ। यैह भुजियाक मसाला अछि।
seg.63af904bba96.back: Meanwhile dry-roast whole coriander, cumin, fennel, cloves and cinnamon without oil in a small pan on low heat until fragrant and one shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the fry masala.

seg.4406ac2e72fe.src: Put the chicken in a heavy kadai with no water, cover and set it on medium heat.
seg.4406ac2e72fe.t: चिकनकेँ बिनु पानिक भारी कड़ाहीमे राखू, झाँपू आ मध्यम आँच पर चढ़ाउ।
seg.4406ac2e72fe.back: Put the chicken in a heavy kadai without water, cover and put on medium heat.

seg.93ccca0c5178.src: Cook it covered in its own juices till no pink remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; the chicken releases water as it cooks.
seg.93ccca0c5178.t: झाँपि कऽ अपने रसमे पकाउ जा धरि कोनो गुलाबी नहि रहि जाय, करीब 12 मिनट। एक-दू बेर चलाउ; पकैत-पकैत चिकन पानि छोड़ैत अछि।
seg.93ccca0c5178.back: Cook covered in its own juices until no pink remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; as it cooks the chicken releases water.

seg.32f3a3f56679.src: Uncover and cook on high, stirring, until the liquid has almost dried up, 3–4 minutes. Tip the chicken out onto a plate and wipe the kadai.
seg.32f3a3f56679.t: झाँपन हटाउ आ तेज आँच पर चलबैत पकाउ, जा धरि पानि करीब सुखि नहि जाय, 3–4 मिनट। चिकन थारी पर निकालि लिअ आ कड़ाही पोछि लिअ।
seg.32f3a3f56679.back: Remove the lid and cook on high heat while stirring, until the water almost dries up, 3–4 minutes. Take the chicken out onto a plate and wipe the kadai.

seg.f3e846aa4edd.src: Heat the oil in the kadai on medium heat.
seg.f3e846aa4edd.t: कड़ाहीमे मध्यम आँच पर तेल गरम करू।
seg.f3e846aa4edd.back: Heat oil in the kadai on medium heat.

seg.e210c9534a07.src: Fry the cashews in oil till golden; lift out. They take under a minute, so stir them all the time and lift them out with a slotted spoon.
seg.e210c9534a07.t: काजूकेँ तेलमे सोनहुला होबा धरि तरू; निकालि लिअ। एक मिनटो नहि लगैत अछि, तेँ लगातार चलाउ आ झंझरा सँ निकालू।
seg.e210c9534a07.back: Fry the cashews in the oil until golden; take them out. It does not take even a minute, so stir constantly and take out with a slotted spoon.

seg.09e282d2e36f.src: Add the onion, if using, and fry until golden. Fry the green chillies and curry leaves. Stand back; the leaves crackle and spit.
seg.09e282d2e36f.t: जँ लैत छी तँ पियाउज डालू आ सोनहुला होबा धरि भूजू। हरियर मरचाइ आ करी पात भूजू। कनेक पाछू हटि जाउ; पात चटचटा कऽ छिटकैत अछि।
seg.09e282d2e36f.back: If you are using it, add onion and fry until golden. Fry green chillies and curry leaves. Step back a little; the leaves crackle and splutter.

seg.1fae224eb27a.src: Add the chicken and fry masala. Fry on high till dry and dark, then toss in the cashews. Keep tossing for 6–8 minutes, until the masala clings to the pieces and the edges turn dark and crisp.
seg.1fae224eb27a.t: चिकन आ भुजियाक मसाला डालू। तेज आँच पर सुखल आ गाढ़ रंगक होबा धरि भूजू, फेर काजू मिला दिअ। 6–8 मिनट धरि उलटैत-पलटैत रहू, जा धरि मसाला टुकड़ा पर सटि नहि जाय आ किनार गाढ़ आ कुरकुर नहि भऽ जाय।
seg.1fae224eb27a.back: Add the chicken and fry masala. Fry on high heat until dry and dark-coloured, then mix in the cashews. Keep tossing for 6–8 minutes, until the masala sticks to the pieces and the edges become dark and crisp.

seg.0b62f402945c.src: Taste, add salt if needed, scatter the coriander leaves and serve hot.
seg.0b62f402945c.t: चीखू, जरूरति हो तँ नोन डालू, धनियाँ पात छीटू आ गरम-गरम परसू।
seg.0b62f402945c.back: Taste, add salt if needed, sprinkle coriander leaves and serve piping hot.

seg.349c72ce839a.src: Fry it on high heat at the end so the masala clings to every piece.
seg.349c72ce839a.t: अन्तमे तेज आँच पर भूजू जाहि सँ मसाला हर टुकड़ा पर सटि जाय।
seg.349c72ce839a.back: At the end fry on high heat so that the masala sticks to every piece.

seg.d287ba2c2c11.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or swap in Sannam chilli powder for the red colour with less fire.
seg.d287ba2c2c11.t: तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी बड्ड तीख अछि। मध्यम तीख लेल 1 छोट चम्मच लिअ, वा लाल रंग आ कम झाँस लेल ओकर बदला सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी लिअ।
seg.d287ba2c2c11.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat take 1 teaspoon, or for red colour and less bite take Sannam chilli powder instead.

seg.a0ef9b138cd4.src: Cut the pieces small and even so they cook through at the same time and crisp up well in the fry.
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.t: टुकड़ा छोट आ एक बराबर काटू जाहि सँ सभ एक्के समयमे भीतर धरि पाकय आ भुजलामे नीक जकाँ कुरकुर हो।
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.back: Cut the pieces small and equal so that all cook through at the same time and get nicely crisp in the frying.

seg.d72b3c1c529a.src: Grind the fry masala just before you cook; the roasted spice smell is the soul of a good vepudu.
seg.d72b3c1c529a.t: भुजियाक मसाला पकेबा सँ ठीक पहिने पीसू; भूजल मसालाक गन्धे नीक वेपुडुक प्राण अछि।
seg.d72b3c1c529a.back: Grind the fry masala just before cooking; the smell of roasted masala is the soul of a good vepudu.

seg.62d6684e446e.src: Bone-in: use 600 g small bone-in pieces and cook them in their juices for 18–20 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone.
seg.62d6684e446e.t: हड्डीबला: 600 g हड्डीबला छोट टुकड़ा लिअ आ अपने रसमे 18–20 मिनट पकाउ, जा धरि हड्डी लग कोनो गुलाबी नहि रहि जाय।
seg.62d6684e446e.back: Bone-in: take 600 g small bone-in pieces and cook in their own juices 18–20 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone.

seg.6960fe7f3ff8.src: Kobbari vepudu: add 3 tbsp grated dry coconut to the fry with the masala and toss until it browns.
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.t: कोब्बरी वेपुडु: भुजलामे मसालाक संग 3 पैघ चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल सुखल नारियल डालू आ भूर होबा धरि उलटैत रहू।
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.back: Kobbari vepudu: in the frying add 3 tablespoons grated dry coconut with the masala and keep tossing until brown.

seg.afd92118eb80.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, then fry it the same way.
seg.afd92118eb80.t: मटन वेपुडु: 500 g बिनु हड्डीक मटनकेँ मसाला आ ½ कप पानिक संग प्रेशर कुकरमे 5–6 सीटी धरि पकाउ, फेर ओहिना भूजू।
seg.afd92118eb80.back: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the masala and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, then fry the same way.

seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.src: Serve hot as a side with rasam rice, pappu and rice or sambar rice, or on its own as a starter with sliced onion and lemon wedges.
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.t: रसम-भात, पप्पु-भात वा सांबर-भातक संग गरम-गरम परसू, वा काटल पियाउज आ नेबोक फाँकक संग असगरे स्टार्टर रूपमे।
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.back: Serve piping hot with rasam-rice, pappu-rice or sambar-rice, or on its own as a starter with chopped onion and lemon wedges.

seg.b7598301bd86.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Reheat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil until steaming hot all the way through; it crisps up again.
seg.b7598301bd86.t: झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे 2 दिन धरि राखू। गरम पैनमे किछु बुन्न तेलक संग भीतर धरि नीक जकाँ भाप उठय एहन गरम करू; ई फेर कुरकुर भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.b7598301bd86.back: Keep covered in the fridge up to 2 days. Reheat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil until it steams well right through; it becomes crisp again.

seg.551573b4b443.src: What is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry in Andhra?
seg.551573b4b443.t: आन्ध्रमे चिकन फ्राइ आ चिकन करीमे की अन्तर अछि?
seg.551573b4b443.back: What is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry in Andhra?

seg.dbeff7335e31.src: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juices, then fried until the masala coats it with no gravy. Kodi kura is a curry with an onion-tomato gravy for rice.
seg.dbeff7335e31.t: वेपुडु सुखल होइत अछि: चिकन अपने रसमे पकाओल जाइत अछि, फेर तखन धरि भूजल जाइत अछि जा धरि बिनु ग्रेवीक मसाला ओकरा पर चढ़ि नहि जाय। कोडी कूरा भात लेल पियाउज-टमाटरक ग्रेवीबला करी अछि।
seg.dbeff7335e31.back: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juices, then fried until the masala, without gravy, coats it. Kodi koora is a curry with onion-tomato gravy for rice.

seg.439aacfe8e34.src: Should I use boneless or bone-in chicken for vepudu?
seg.439aacfe8e34.t: वेपुडु लेल बिनु हड्डीक चिकन लिअ कि हड्डीबला?
seg.439aacfe8e34.back: Should I take boneless or bone-in chicken for vepudu?

seg.982f470b118d.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need about 8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.982f470b118d.t: दुनू चलैत अछि। बिनु हड्डीक जल्दी पकैत अछि आ बेसी कुरकुर होइत अछि; हड्डीबला छोट टुकड़ामे बेसी स्वाद होइत अछि मुदा अपने रसमे करीब 8 मिनट बेसी लगैत अछि।
seg.982f470b118d.back: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and becomes crisper; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but take about 8 minutes more in their own juices.

seg.ade697e78f9b.src: Cut open the thickest piece. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juices run clear.
seg.ade697e78f9b.t: सभ सँ मोट टुकड़ा काटि कऽ खोलू। चिकन तखन पाकल अछि जखन बीचमे (वा हड्डी लग) कोनो गुलाबी नहि रहय आ रस साफ बहय।
seg.ade697e78f9b.back: Cut open the thickest piece. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juice runs clear.

seg.eddd3046275b.src: How do I make kodi vepudu less spicy?
seg.eddd3046275b.t: कोडी वेपुडुकेँ कम तीख कोना बनाउ?
seg.eddd3046275b.back: How to make kodi vepudu less hot?

seg.9b5459aec9d6.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder, or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and slit only 2 green chillies. The cashews and curry leaves keep the flavour full.
seg.9b5459aec9d6.t: 1 छोट चम्मच तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी लिअ, वा ओकर बदला सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी, आ मात्र 2 टा हरियर मरचाइ चीरू। काजू आ करी पात सँ स्वाद भरल रहैत अछि।
seg.9b5459aec9d6.back: Take 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder, or Sannam chilli powder instead, and slit only 2 green chillies. The cashews and curry leaves keep it full of flavour.

seg.a00af5cf9954.src: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra Chicken Fry) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.t: కోడి వేపుడు · कोडी वेपुडु (आन्ध्रक चिकन फ्राइ) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.back: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra's chicken fry) | 1acrefarms

seg.1af4fbb646e3.src: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra chicken fry: chicken in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and our cashews.
seg.1af4fbb646e3.t: కోడి వేపుడు. आन्ध्रक चिकन फ्राइ: तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी आ हरदि बुकनीमे लपेटल चिकन, करी पात, हरियर मरचाइ, भूजल मसाला आ हमर काजूक संग सुखल भूजल।
seg.1af4fbb646e3.back: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra's chicken fry: chicken coated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, dry-fried with curry leaves, green chilli, roasted masala and our cashews.

seg.917dba1166ab.src: Kodi Vepudu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.917dba1166ab.t: कोडी वेपुडु: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.917dba1166ab.back: Kodi Vepudu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.f9771e2222df.src: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice tossed with a crackling tempering of peanuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard seeds, green chillies and curry leaves, then soured with lemon juice. It is the rice packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple days, and it is made in big batches for festivals and pujas.
seg.f9771e2222df.t: निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा आन्ध्रक घरक चटक पीयर नेबोबला भात अछि: पाकल भातमे मूँगफली, चनाक दालि, उड़िदक दालि, सरिसो, हरियर मरचाइ आ करी पातक चटचटाइत छौंक मिलाओल, फेर नेबोक रस सँ खट्टा कयल। ई ओ भात अछि जे रेल यात्रा, स्कूलक टिफिन बक्सा आ मन्दिर जयबाक दिन लेल बान्हल जाइत अछि, आ पाबनि आ पूजा लेल बड़का मात्रामे बनैत अछि।
seg.f9771e2222df.back: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice mixed with a crackling tempering of groundnut, chana dal, urad dal, mustard, green chilli and curry leaves, then made sour with lemon juice. It is the rice that is packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple-visit days, and is made in large quantities for festivals and puja.

seg.ac569e0882d5.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the hot oil for a few seconds, which turns every grain an even golden yellow and takes away its raw edge. This recipe serves 4.
seg.ac569e0882d5.t: हमर हरदि बुकनी किछु सेकेंड लेल गरम तेलमे पड़ैत अछि, जाहि सँ हर दाना एक समान सोनहुला पीयर भऽ जाइत अछि आ ओकर काँच स्वाद चलि जाइत अछि। ई रेसिपी 4 लोक लेल अछि।
seg.ac569e0882d5.back: Our turmeric powder goes into the hot oil for a few seconds, so every grain becomes evenly golden yellow and its raw taste goes. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.d194bee0cc5e.src: Total includes cooking the rice and a 15-minute rest so the flavours settle.
seg.d194bee0cc5e.t: कुल समयमे भात पकाएब आ स्वाद बैसय लेल 15 मिनट राखब सेहो जोड़ल अछि।
seg.d194bee0cc5e.back: The total time also includes cooking the rice and keeping it 15 minutes for the flavour to settle.

seg.1cfa4342f462.src: Fry peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and hing, then toss with cooled rice, salt and lemon juice.
seg.1cfa4342f462.t: मूँगफली, दालि, सरिसो, मरचाइ आ करी पात तेलमे भूजू, हरदि बुकनी आ हींग डालू, फेर ठंढ़ा भात, नोन आ नेबोक रसक संग मिलाउ।
seg.1cfa4342f462.back: Fry groundnut, dal, mustard, chilli and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and hing, then mix with cooled rice, salt and lemon juice.

seg.2561142fed2c.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; gives about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.t: 1 कप चाउर ⟦1⟧सोना मसूरी, करीब 200 g; पाकि कऽ करीब 3 कप होइत अछि⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masoori, about 200 g; cooked it becomes about 3 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.06ba75699134.src: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.t: 3 कप पाकल भात ⟦1⟧कनेक कड़ा पकाओल, दाना अलग-अलग⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.back: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked slightly firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧

seg.fbba93c11bc9.src: 3 tbsp lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; add more to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.t: 3 पैघ चम्मच नेबोक रस ⟦1⟧करीब 2 टा नेबो सँ; स्वाद अनुसार आओर डालू⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.back: 3 tablespoons lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; add more to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.e254f20f8f14.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.e254f20f8f14.t: 3 पैघ चम्मच तेल ⟦1⟧बेसी मूँगफलीक तेल चलैत अछि⟦/1⟧
seg.e254f20f8f14.back: 3 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is mostly used⟦/1⟧

seg.3165601826cb.t: 2 टा सुखल लाल मरचाइ ⟦1⟧दू टुकड़ा कयल⟦/1⟧

seg.985dfde69f06.t: 1 छोट चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल आदी ⟦1⟧मन हो तँ⟦/1⟧

seg.bc63d9715c03.src: Wash the rice and cook it with 2 cups of water until just done, so the grains stay separate. You need about 3 cups of cooked rice.
seg.bc63d9715c03.t: चाउर धोउ आ 2 कप पानिमे बस पाकय धरि पकाउ, जाहि सँ दाना अलग रहय। करीब 3 कप पाकल भात चाही।
seg.bc63d9715c03.back: Wash the rice and cook in 2 cups water just until done, so the grains stay separate. About 3 cups cooked rice is needed.

seg.adb2b75edafc.src: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool; add the salt. Fluff it with a fork and let it sit about 10 minutes until warm, not hot, so the grains do not break when mixed.
seg.adb2b75edafc.t: पाकल भात थारी पर पसारि कऽ ठंढ़ा होमय दिअ; नोन डालू। काँटा सँ खिला दिअ आ करीब 10 मिनट छोड़ि दिअ जा धरि गुनगुन नहि भऽ जाय, गरम नहि, जाहि सँ मिलबैत काल दाना नहि टूटय।
seg.adb2b75edafc.back: Spread the cooked rice on a plate and let it cool; add salt. Fluff with a fork and leave about 10 minutes until it becomes lukewarm, not hot, so that the grains do not break while mixing.

seg.e05322a3ed24.src: Heat the oil; fry the peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves. Start with the peanuts on medium heat and fry them about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins darken.
seg.e05322a3ed24.t: तेल गरम करू; मूँगफली, दालि, सरिसो, मरचाइ आ करी पात भूजू। पहिने मूँगफली मध्यम आँच पर करीब 2 मिनट भूजू जा धरि चटचटाय नहि लागय आ छिलका गाढ़ नहि भऽ जाय।
seg.e05322a3ed24.back: Heat oil; fry groundnut, dal, mustard, chilli and curry leaves. First fry the groundnuts on medium heat about 2 minutes until they start to crackle and the skins turn dark.

seg.542a4fea7b18.src: Add the chana dal and urad dal and fry until light golden, about 1 minute.
seg.542a4fea7b18.t: चनाक दालि आ उड़िदक दालि डालू आ हल्लुक सोनहुला होबा धरि भूजू, करीब 1 मिनट।
seg.542a4fea7b18.back: Add chana dal and urad dal and fry until light golden, about 1 minute.

seg.502483d7a042.src: Add the mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the dry red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves turn crisp.
seg.502483d7a042.t: सरिसो डालू आ चटकय दिअ, फेर सुखल लाल मरचाइ, हरियर मरचाइ, आदी आ करी पात डालू आ किछु सेकेंड भूजू जा धरि पात कुरकुर नहि भऽ जाय।
seg.502483d7a042.back: Add mustard and let it crackle, then add dried red chilli, green chilli, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves become crisp.

seg.6e856356980b.src: Stir in the turmeric powder and hing; switch off. Stir for 5–10 seconds only so the turmeric cooks in the hot oil without burning.
seg.6e856356980b.t: हरदि बुकनी आ हींग मिलाउ; आँच बन्द करू। मात्र 5–10 सेकेंड चलाउ जाहि सँ हरदि गरम तेलमे बिनु जरने पाकि जाय।
seg.6e856356980b.back: Mix in turmeric powder and hing; turn off the heat. Stir only 5–10 seconds so that the turmeric cooks in the hot oil without burning.

seg.dd6ccaf923d8.src: Pour over the rice, add the lemon juice and mix gently. Use your fingers or a flat spatula and lift the rice from below so every grain turns yellow without turning mushy.
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.t: भात पर ढारि दिअ, नेबोक रस डालू आ हल्लुक हाथ सँ मिलाउ। आंगुर वा चापट करछुल लिअ आ नीचाँ सँ भात उठबैत मिलाउ जाहि सँ हर दाना पीयर भऽ जाय मुदा गिलगिल नहि हो।
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.back: Pour over the rice, add lemon juice and mix with a gentle hand. Use fingers or a flat ladle and mix lifting the rice from below so that every grain turns yellow but does not become mushy.

seg.1bfc2c04d40e.src: Taste and add more salt or lemon juice if needed. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, as the flavour softens on standing.
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.t: चीखू आ जरूरति हो तँ आओर नोन वा नेबोक रस डालू। भात साफ-साफ खट्टा आ नोनगर लागक चाही, किएक तँ राखल रहला सँ स्वाद नरम भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.back: Taste and add more salt or lemon juice if needed. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, because on standing the flavour mellows.

seg.8cea6688d0fb.src: Cover and rest the pulihora for 15 minutes before serving so the rice takes in the lemon and tempering.
seg.8cea6688d0fb.t: परसबा सँ पहिने पुलिहोराकेँ झाँपि कऽ 15 मिनट राखि दिअ जाहि सँ भात नेबो आ छौंकक स्वाद सोखि लिअय।
seg.8cea6688d0fb.back: Before serving keep the pulihora covered 15 minutes so the rice absorbs the flavour of lemon and tempering.

seg.c1a7043ce357.src: Add the lemon juice off the heat so it stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice turns bitter.
seg.c1a7043ce357.t: नेबोक रस आँच सँ उतारि कऽ डालू जाहि सँ ओकर खट्टापन तेज रहय। पकाओल नेबोक रस तीत भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.c1a7043ce357.back: Add the lemon juice off the heat so that its sourness stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice becomes bitter.

seg.b634a4257b6c.src: Cook the rice slightly firm and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice turns pasty.
seg.b634a4257b6c.t: भात कनेक कड़ा पकाउ आ मिलेबा सँ पहिने ठंढ़ा होमय दिअ; गरम, नरम भात लेई सन भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.b634a4257b6c.back: Cook the rice slightly firm and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice becomes paste-like.

seg.a1d93274ea3f.src: Keep the turmeric powder in the oil for just a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and a bitter taste.
seg.a1d93274ea3f.t: हरदि बुकनी तेलमे मात्र किछु सेकेंड राखू; जरल हरदि सँ रंग करिया आ स्वाद तीत भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.a1d93274ea3f.back: Keep turmeric powder in the oil only a few seconds; burnt turmeric makes the colour black and the taste bitter.

seg.747474140bbf.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as the grains are already firm and separate.
seg.747474140bbf.t: भोरक बचल भात नीक चलैत अछि, किएक तँ ओकर दाना पहिने सँ कड़ा आ अलग-अलग रहैत अछि।
seg.747474140bbf.back: Leftover rice from the morning works well, because its grains are already firm and separate.

seg.7a379d805448.src: Cashews: fry 10 cashew halves with the peanuts for a festive pulihora.
seg.7a379d805448.t: काजू: पाबनिक पुलिहोरा लेल मूँगफलीक संग 10 टा आधा काजू तरू।
seg.7a379d805448.back: Cashew: for festival pulihora fry 10 halved cashews with the groundnuts.

seg.be93899ec308.src: Mamidikaya pulihora: in place of lemon juice, mix in 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.
seg.be93899ec308.t: मामिडिकाया पुलिहोरा: नेबोक रसक बदला छौंकक संग 1 कप कद्दूकस कयल काँच आम मिलाउ।
seg.be93899ec308.back: Mamidikaya pulihora: instead of lemon juice mix 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.

seg.867dba923c04.src: Grated coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the lemon juice for a milder rice.
seg.867dba923c04.t: कद्दूकस कयल नारियल: हल्लुक स्वादक भात लेल नेबोक रसक संग 2 पैघ चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल नारियल डालू।
seg.867dba923c04.back: Grated coconut: for a milder-tasting rice add 2 tablespoons grated coconut with the lemon juice.

seg.88b87529b506.src: Serve at room temperature with curd, a pickle or appadams. It is a classic tiffin-box and travel rice.
seg.88b87529b506.t: कोठलीक तापमान पर दही, अचार वा अप्पडमक संग परसू। ई टिफिन बक्सा आ यात्राक जानल-मानल भात अछि।
seg.88b87529b506.back: Serve at room temperature with curd, pickle or appadam. It is the well-known rice of tiffin boxes and journeys.

seg.9791f1c7a8e4.src: It keeps well at room temperature for about 6 hours, which is why it travels. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within a day.
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.t: ई कोठलीक तापमान पर करीब 6 घंटा नीक रहैत अछि, तेँ यात्रामे लऽ जाइत अछि। बचल भात झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे राखू आ एक दिनक भीतर खा लिअ।
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.back: It stays good about 6 hours at room temperature, so it is taken on journeys. Keep leftover rice covered in the fridge and eat within one day.

seg.c12ab7274709.src: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?
seg.c12ab7274709.t: हमर नेबोबला भात तीत किएक लगैत अछि?
seg.c12ab7274709.back: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?

seg.44b56d19b9fb.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Switch off the stove before the turmeric goes in, and add the lemon juice only to the rice, off the heat.
seg.44b56d19b9fb.t: या तँ नेबोक रस पकि गेल, वा हरदि तेलमे जरि गेल। हरदि डालबा सँ पहिने चूल्हि बन्द करू, आ नेबोक रस आँच सँ उतारि कऽ मात्र भातमे डालू।
seg.44b56d19b9fb.back: Either the lemon juice got cooked, or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Turn off the stove before adding turmeric, and add lemon juice only to the rice, off the heat.

seg.69e4bfb93ba8.src: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.t: पुलिहोरा आ नेबोबला भातमे की अन्तर अछि?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.back: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?

seg.f2f993f1b94b.src: Pulihora is the Telugu name for soured rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon version, quicker to make and lighter in colour.
seg.f2f993f1b94b.t: पुलिहोरा खट्टा भातक तेलुगु नाम अछि। चिंतपंडु पुलिहोरा इमलीक पेस्ट सँ खट्टा कयल जाइत अछि; निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा नेबोबला रूप अछि, जे जल्दी बनैत अछि आ रंगमे हल्लुक होइत अछि।
seg.f2f993f1b94b.back: Pulihora is the Telugu name for sour rice. Chintapandu pulihora is made sour with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon version, which is made quickly and is lighter in colour.

seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.src: How do I stop lemon rice from getting mushy?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.t: नेबोबला भात गिलगिल नहि हो, ताहि लेल की करी?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.back: What to do so lemon rice does not become mushy?

seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.src: Cook the rice a little firm with less water, cool it on a plate, and mix gently by lifting from below instead of pressing.
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.t: भात कम पानिमे कनेक कड़ा पकाउ, थारी पर ठंढ़ा करू, आ दबेबाक बदला नीचाँ सँ उठबैत हल्लुक हाथ सँ मिलाउ।
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.back: Cook the rice slightly firm in less water, cool on a plate, and mix with a gentle hand lifting from below instead of pressing.

seg.dd00224f5f94.src: How much lemon juice for 3 cups of rice?
seg.dd00224f5f94.t: 3 कप भात लेल कतेक नेबोक रस?
seg.dd00224f5f94.back: How much lemon juice for 3 cups rice?

seg.50f8efabb87e.src: About 3 tbsp, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add it slowly and taste, because lemons vary in sourness.
seg.50f8efabb87e.t: करीब 3 पैघ चम्मच, 2 टा मझोला नेबोक रस। धीरे-धीरे डालू आ चीखैत रहू, किएक तँ नेबोक खट्टापन अलग-अलग होइत अछि।
seg.50f8efabb87e.back: About 3 tablespoons, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add slowly and keep tasting, because lemon sourness varies.

seg.2d3c4d5f7608.src: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra lemon rice: cooled rice tossed with a peanut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.t: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. आन्ध्रक नेबोबला भात: ठंढ़ा भातमे मूँगफली आ दालिक छौंक, हमर हरदि बुकनी आ नेबोक रस मिलाओल। डेग-डेग विधि, सुझाव आ प्रश्नोत्तर।
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.back: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra's lemon rice: cooled rice mixed with a groundnut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and Q&A.

seg.5f0282fcd0a8.src: Nimmakaya Pulihora: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.t: निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.back: Nimmakaya Pulihora: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.8922ef1e3767.src: Pasupu annam is plain rice turned bright yellow with turmeric and tossed in a crackling tempering of mustard seeds, chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies, with fried cashews on top. Andhra homes make it for lunch boxes, for quick weekday meals and as a prasadam on puja days, often with the morning's leftover rice.
seg.8922ef1e3767.t: पसुपु अन्नम सादा भात अछि जे हरदि सँ चटक पीयर कयल जाइत अछि आ सरिसो, चनाक दालि, करी पात आ हरियर मरचाइक चटचटाइत छौंकमे मिलाओल जाइत अछि, ऊपर सँ तरल काजू। आन्ध्रक घरमे ई टिफिन, रोजुक झटपट भोजन आ पूजाक दिन प्रसादम रूपमे बनैत अछि, बेसी काल भोरक बचल भात सँ।
seg.8922ef1e3767.back: Pasupu annam is plain rice made bright yellow with turmeric and mixed in a crackling tempering of mustard, chana dal, curry leaves and green chilli, topped with fried cashews. In Andhra homes it is made for tiffin, as an everyday quick meal and as prasadam on puja days, mostly from the morning's leftover rice.

seg.510252086556.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) gives the rice its deep yellow colour and an earthy turmeric smell, so half a teaspoon is enough for 4. Whole cashews (Jeedipappu) fried in the same oil add the crunch.
seg.510252086556.t: हमर पहाड़ी हरदि बुकनी (कोंडा पसुपु) भातकेँ गाढ़ पीयर रंग आ माटि सन हरदिक गन्ध दैत अछि, तेँ 4 लोक लेल आधा छोट चम्मच पर्याप्त अछि। ओही तेलमे तरल समूचा काजू (जीडिपप्पु) कुरकुरापन दैत अछि।
seg.510252086556.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) gives the rice a deep yellow colour and an earthy turmeric aroma, so half a teaspoon is enough for 4 people. Whole cashews (jeedipappu) fried in the same oil give crunch.

seg.38badedc8d11.src: Total includes about 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool.
seg.38badedc8d11.t: कुल समयमे पाकल भात ठंढ़ा होमय लेल करीब 15 मिनट जोड़ल अछि।
seg.38badedc8d11.back: The total time includes about 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool.

seg.8ad70ebff643.src: Cook rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and toss in the rice.
seg.8ad70ebff643.t: भात पकाउ आ ठंढ़ा होमय दिअ। काजू, सरिसो, चनाक दालि, मरचाइ आ करी पात तेलमे भूजू, पहाड़ी हरदि बुकनी डालू आ भात मिला दिअ।
seg.8ad70ebff643.back: Cook the rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard, chana dal, chilli and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and mix in the rice.

seg.bc286f12f1ba.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; makes about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.t: 1 कप चाउर ⟦1⟧सोना मसूरी, करीब 200 g; पाकि कऽ करीब 3 कप बनैत अछि⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masoori, about 200 g; cooked it becomes about 3 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.06cd9d581aec.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.t: ½ छोट चम्मच पहाड़ी हरदि बुकनी ⟦1⟧कोंडा पसुपु⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.back: ½ teaspoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu⟦/1⟧

seg.399f19de4e13.src: 1 tbsp ghee (optional) ⟦1⟧stirred in at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.399f19de4e13.t: 1 पैघ चम्मच घी (मन हो तँ) ⟦1⟧अन्तमे मिलाओल⟦/1⟧
seg.399f19de4e13.back: 1 tablespoon ghee (if you wish) ⟦1⟧mixed in at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.afe3b0737680.t: ⟦1⟧हरदि बुकनी⟦/1⟧ सँ सेहो नीक बनैत अछि।
seg.afe3b0737680.back: It also turns out well with ⟦1⟧turmeric powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.53fcfe53b909.src: Wash the rice in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.53fcfe53b909.t: चाउरकेँ 2–3 बेर पानि बदलि कऽ धोउ आ पानि निथारि लिअ।
seg.53fcfe53b909.back: Wash the rice changing the water 2–3 times and drain the water.

seg.cdcf37be99e8.src: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate, then spread it on a plate to cool. Use 2 cups water to 1 cup rice in a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles), and fluff it with a fork before spreading it out.
seg.cdcf37be99e8.t: भात एहन पकाउ जे दाना अलग रहय, फेर थारी पर पसारि कऽ ठंढ़ा होमय दिअ। पतील वा प्रेशर कुकरमे (2 सीटी) 1 कप चाउरमे 2 कप पानि लिअ, आ पसारबा सँ पहिने काँटा सँ खिला दिअ।
seg.cdcf37be99e8.back: Cook the rice so that the grains stay separate, then spread on a plate and let cool. In a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles) take 2 cups water for 1 cup rice, and fluff with a fork before spreading.

seg.296995189451.src: Let the rice cool for about 15 minutes until it is just warm. Sprinkle the salt over it.
seg.296995189451.t: भातकेँ करीब 15 मिनट ठंढ़ा होमय दिअ जा धरि बस गुनगुन नहि रहि जाय। ऊपर सँ नोन छीटि दिअ।
seg.296995189451.back: Let the rice cool about 15 minutes until it is just lukewarm. Sprinkle salt on top.

seg.48839bd22983.src: Heat the oil in a wide kadai on medium heat.
seg.48839bd22983.t: चाकर कड़ाहीमे मध्यम आँच पर तेल गरम करू।
seg.48839bd22983.back: Heat oil in a wide kadai on medium heat.

seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.src: Fry the cashews in the oil till golden; lift out. Add mustard seeds and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they turn golden in about 1 minute.
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.t: काजूकेँ तेलमे सोनहुला होबा धरि तरू; निकालि लिअ। सरिसो आ चनाक दालि डालू। काजू थारी पर राखू; करीब 1 मिनटमे ओ सोनहुला भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.back: Fry the cashews in the oil until golden; take them out. Add mustard and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they turn golden in about 1 minute.

seg.0729c6efc94a.src: Once the mustard seeds splutter, add the urad dal and the dried red chillies and stir.
seg.0729c6efc94a.t: सरिसो चटकय लागय तँ उड़िदक दालि आ सुखल लाल मरचाइ डालि कऽ चलाउ।
seg.0729c6efc94a.back: When the mustard starts crackling add urad dal and dried red chilli and stir.

seg.2688182af66a.src: When the dal turns golden, add the chillies and curry leaves, then the turmeric on low heat. Add the ginger and asafoetida with the curry leaves, and stir the turmeric for only 5–10 seconds.
seg.2688182af66a.t: दालि सोनहुला भऽ जाय तँ मरचाइ आ करी पात डालू, फेर धीमा आँच पर हरदि। करी पातक संग आदी आ हींग डालू, आ हरदि मात्र 5–10 सेकेंड चलाउ।
seg.2688182af66a.back: When the dal turns golden add chilli and curry leaves, then turmeric on low heat. Add ginger and hing with the curry leaves, and stir the turmeric only 5–10 seconds.

seg.59fd9b87153d.src: Switch off the heat straight away so the turmeric does not burn.
seg.59fd9b87153d.t: तुरन्त आँच बन्द करू जाहि सँ हरदि नहि जरय।
seg.59fd9b87153d.back: Turn off the heat immediately so that the turmeric does not burn.

seg.15dc85e42ca1.src: Tip in the rice, cashews and salt and toss gently till evenly yellow. Use a flat spatula and lift and fold rather than pressing down, so the grains stay whole.
seg.15dc85e42ca1.t: भात, काजू आ नोन उझलि दिअ आ एक समान पीयर होबा धरि हल्लुक हाथ सँ मिलाउ। चापट करछुल लिअ आ दबेबाक बदला उठा-उठा कऽ उलटू, जाहि सँ दाना साबुत रहय।
seg.15dc85e42ca1.back: Tip in the rice, cashews and salt and mix with a gentle hand until evenly yellow. Use a flat ladle and turn by lifting instead of pressing, so the grains stay whole.

seg.b005e5771235.src: Taste for salt, stir in the ghee if using, cover and leave for 5 minutes before serving so the rice takes on the tempering.
seg.b005e5771235.t: नोन चीखू, जँ लैत छी तँ घी मिलाउ, झाँपू आ परसबा सँ पहिने 5 मिनट छोड़ि दिअ जाहि सँ भातमे छौंकक स्वाद पैसि जाय।
seg.b005e5771235.back: Taste for salt, if you are using it mix in ghee, cover and leave 5 minutes before serving so that the tempering's flavour gets into the rice.

seg.9bce1ed4dbee.src: Spread the rice to cool first so the grains do not break.
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.t: पहिने भात पसारि कऽ ठंढ़ा करू जाहि सँ दाना नहि टूटय।
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.back: First spread and cool the rice so that the grains do not break.

seg.1f9a348f8750.src: Add the turmeric on low heat and stir for only a few seconds; burnt turmeric turns the rice bitter.
seg.1f9a348f8750.t: हरदि धीमा आँच पर डालू आ मात्र किछु सेकेंड चलाउ; जरल हरदि सँ भात तीत भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.1f9a348f8750.back: Add turmeric on low heat and stir only a few seconds; burnt turmeric makes the rice bitter.

seg.394d01a50207.src: Hill turmeric powder colours strongly; start with ½ tsp for 1 cup of rice and add a pinch more only if you want a deeper yellow.
seg.394d01a50207.t: पहाड़ी हरदि बुकनी खूब रंग दैत अछि; 1 कप चाउर लेल ½ छोट चम्मच सँ शुरू करू आ बेसी गाढ़ पीयर चाही तँ मात्र एक चुटकी आओर डालू।
seg.394d01a50207.back: Hill turmeric powder gives a lot of colour; for 1 cup rice start with ½ teaspoon and if you want a deeper yellow add only one pinch more.

seg.505872469eb9.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as long as the grains are separate.
seg.505872469eb9.t: भोरक बचल भात नीक चलैत अछि, बस दाना अलग-अलग हेबाक चाही।
seg.505872469eb9.back: The morning's leftover rice works well, just the grains should be separate.

seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.src: Turmeric powder: our everyday Pasupu turmeric powder works the same way; use the same ½ tsp.
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.t: हरदि बुकनी: हमर रोजुक पसुपु हरदि बुकनी सेहो ओहिना काज करैत अछि; ओतबे ½ छोट चम्मच लिअ।
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.back: Turmeric powder: our everyday pasupu turmeric powder also works the same way; take the same ½ teaspoon.

seg.302f50dc74c9.src: Peanuts: fry 2 tbsp raw peanuts in the oil before the cashews for extra crunch.
seg.302f50dc74c9.t: मूँगफली: बेसी कुरकुरापन लेल काजू सँ पहिने तेलमे 2 पैघ चम्मच काँच मूँगफली तरू।
seg.302f50dc74c9.back: Groundnut: for more crunch fry 2 tablespoons raw groundnuts in the oil before the cashews.

seg.551f49339b3d.src: Lemon: squeeze in the juice of half a lemon with the rice for a tangy, pulihora-style rice.
seg.551f49339b3d.t: नेबो: खट्टा, पुलिहोरा सन भात लेल भातक संग आधा नेबोक रस निचोड़ि दिअ।
seg.551f49339b3d.back: Lemon: for a sour, pulihora-like rice squeeze the juice of half a lemon with the rice.

seg.6b9e9c07efba.src: Coconut: toss in 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the rice.
seg.6b9e9c07efba.t: नारियल: भातक संग 2 पैघ चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल नारियल मिलाउ।
seg.6b9e9c07efba.back: Coconut: mix 2 tablespoons grated coconut with the rice.

seg.d541a1d237fc.src: Serve warm or at room temperature with curd, appadalu or a dry potato fry. It also packs well for lunch boxes and travel.
seg.d541a1d237fc.t: गुनगुन वा कोठलीक तापमान पर दही, अप्पडालु वा सुखल आलूक भुजियाक संग परसू। टिफिन आ यात्रा लेल सेहो नीक जकाँ बान्हल जाइत अछि।
seg.d541a1d237fc.back: Serve lukewarm or at room temperature with curd, appadalu or a dry potato fry. It also packs well for tiffin and journeys.

seg.db97e1ae49fa.src: Best eaten the same day. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and warm them with a sprinkle of water.
seg.db97e1ae49fa.t: ओही दिन खेनाइ सभ सँ नीक। बचल भात झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे 1 दिन धरि राखू आ कनेक पानि छीटि कऽ गरम करू।
seg.db97e1ae49fa.back: Best eaten the same day. Keep leftover rice covered in the fridge up to 1 day and heat sprinkling a little water.

seg.54acb7b11b4c.src: How do you make pasupu annam?
seg.54acb7b11b4c.t: पसुपु अन्नम कोना बनाओल जाइत अछि?

seg.d99d12f26e71.src: Cook rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low heat for a few seconds, then toss in the rice with salt.
seg.d99d12f26e71.t: भात एहन पकाउ जे दाना अलग रहय आ ठंढ़ा होमय दिअ। काजू, सरिसो, चनाक दालि, मरचाइ आ करी पात तेलमे भूजू, धीमा आँच पर किछु सेकेंड लेल हरदि डालू, फेर नोनक संग भात मिला दिअ।
seg.d99d12f26e71.back: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard, chana dal, chilli and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low heat for a few seconds, then mix in the rice with salt.

seg.a4a87b4f7d63.src: How much turmeric powder goes into turmeric rice?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.t: हरदिबला भातमे कतेक हरदि बुकनी पड़ैत अछि?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.back: How much turmeric powder goes into turmeric rice?

seg.aa37527cdcfb.src: About ½ tsp for 1 cup of raw rice (about 3 cups cooked). Hill turmeric powder colours strongly, so start with less and add a pinch more if needed.
seg.aa37527cdcfb.t: 1 कप काँच चाउर (करीब 3 कप पाकल) लेल करीब ½ छोट चम्मच। पहाड़ी हरदि बुकनी खूब रंग दैत अछि, तेँ कम सँ शुरू करू आ जरूरति हो तँ एक चुटकी आओर डालू।
seg.aa37527cdcfb.back: About ½ teaspoon for 1 cup raw rice (about 3 cups cooked). Hill turmeric powder gives a lot of colour, so start with less and add one more pinch if needed.

seg.3d200fb0e6fc.src: Why is my turmeric rice bitter?
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.t: हमर हरदिबला भात तीत किएक अछि?
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.back: Why is my turmeric rice bitter?

seg.2c9da3559a42.src: The turmeric burnt in the hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low heat, stir for only a few seconds and switch off before tipping in the rice.
seg.2c9da3559a42.t: हरदि गरम तेलमे जरि गेल, वा बेसी पड़ि गेल। धीमा आँच पर डालू, मात्र किछु सेकेंड चलाउ आ भात उझलबा सँ पहिने आँच बन्द करू।
seg.2c9da3559a42.back: The turmeric burnt in hot oil, or too much went in. Add on low heat, stir only a few seconds and turn off the heat before tipping in the rice.

seg.36ca370ac0d9.src: Can I make pasupu annam with leftover rice?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.t: की बचल भात सँ पसुपु अन्नम बना सकैत छी?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.back: Can I make pasupu annam from leftover rice?

seg.71df75edcd26.src: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains works well. Break up any lumps with your fingers before tossing it in the tempering.
seg.71df75edcd26.t: हँ। अलग-अलग दानाबला बचल भात नीक चलैत अछि। छौंकमे मिलेबा सँ पहिने आंगुर सँ गुलठी फोड़ि दिअ।
seg.71df75edcd26.back: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains works well. Break up lumps with your fingers before mixing into the tempering.

seg.720281a9dc26.src: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra turmeric rice: cooked rice tossed in a mustard, chana dal and curry leaf tempering with hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.720281a9dc26.t: పసుపు అన్నం. पसुपु अन्नम, आन्ध्रक हरदिबला भात: पाकल भातमे सरिसो, चनाक दालि आ करी पातक छौंक, पहाड़ी हरदि बुकनी आ तरल काजू मिलाओल। 4 लोक लेल।
seg.720281a9dc26.back: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra's turmeric rice: cooked rice mixed with a tempering of mustard, chana dal and curry leaves, hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. For 4 people.

seg.a5bf108c0e27.src: Pasupu Annam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.a5bf108c0e27.t: पसुपु अन्नम: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.a5bf108c0e27.back: Pasupu Annam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.ed1a4a430aee.t: ½ छोट चम्मच पहाड़ी हरदि बुकनी

seg.cc1333072822.src: Ragi java is a pourable porridge of ragi flour cooked in water, a daily drink in many Andhra and Rayalaseema homes. The salted version is made with buttermilk; this sweet one is loosened with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and it is drunk warm from a steel tumbler at breakfast or in the evening.
seg.cc1333072822.t: रागी जावा पानिमे पकाओल रागी (मड़ुआ) क आटाक पातर लपसी अछि, जे आन्ध्र आ रायलसीमाक बहुत घरमे रोज पीबल जाइत अछि। नमकीन रूप मट्ठा सँ बनैत अछि; ई मीठ रूप दूध सँ पातर कयल आ गुड़ सँ मीठ कयल जाइत अछि, आ भोरक जलखैमे वा साँझमे स्टीलक गिलास सँ गरम-गरम पीबल जाइत अछि।
seg.cc1333072822.back: Ragi java is a thin porridge of ragi (finger millet) flour cooked in water, which is drunk daily in many homes of Andhra and Rayalaseema. The savoury version is made with buttermilk; this sweet version is thinned with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and is drunk piping hot from a steel glass at breakfast or in the evening.

seg.b29ec96bcd5c.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery suits the earthy taste of ragi and gives the java a toffee-brown colour. It takes about 15 minutes from start to finish. This recipe serves 2.
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.t: हमर ताटि बेल्लम ताड़क गुड़ रागीक माटि सन स्वादक संग नीक मेल खाइत अछि आ जावाकेँ टॉफी सन भूर रंग दैत अछि। शुरू सँ अन्त धरि करीब 15 मिनट लगैत अछि। ई रेसिपी 2 लोक लेल अछि।
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.back: Our thati bellam palm jaggery goes well with ragi's earthy taste and gives the java a toffee-like brown colour. Start to finish takes about 15 minutes. This recipe is for 2 people.

seg.f65620e4f5c4.src: Total includes the 2-minute rest before the jaggery goes in.
seg.f65620e4f5c4.t: कुल समयमे गुड़ डालबा सँ पहिने 2 मिनट रखबाक समय जोड़ल अछि।
seg.f65620e4f5c4.back: The total time includes 2 minutes of resting before adding jaggery.

seg.f0a8282433d4.src: Whisk ragi flour into water, cook it in boiling water till thick and glossy, then add milk. Off the heat, stir in palm jaggery and cardamom.
seg.f0a8282433d4.t: रागीक आटा पानिमे फेंटू, खौलैत पानिमे गाढ़ आ चमकदार होबा धरि पकाउ, फेर दूध डालू। आँच सँ उतारि कऽ ताड़क गुड़ आ इलायची मिलाउ।
seg.f0a8282433d4.back: Whisk ragi flour into water, cook in boiling water until thick and glossy, then add milk. Off the heat mix in palm jaggery and cardamom.

seg.41bd564147d7.src: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.t: ¼ कप रागीक आटा ⟦1⟧मड़ुआक आटा, करीब 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.back: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger-millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.d9504b3b8592.src: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup to mix the flour, 1 cup to boil⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.t: 2 कप पानि ⟦1⟧1 कप आटा घोरबा लेल, 1 कप खौलेबा लेल⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.back: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup for mixing the flour, 1 cup for boiling⟦/1⟧

seg.0570314748ee.src: 3 tbsp grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; add a spoon more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.t: 3 पैघ चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़ ⟦1⟧करीब 30 g; बेसी मीठ पसिन्न हो तँ एक चम्मच आओर⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.back: 3 tablespoons grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; one spoon more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧

seg.2b7de8d37fd0.src: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.
seg.2b7de8d37fd0.back: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.

seg.fce6db4082ef.src: Whisk the ragi flour into 1 cup water till smooth, with no lumps. Use a whisk or a fork and break up any lumps against the side of the bowl.
seg.fce6db4082ef.t: रागीक आटा 1 कप पानिमे चिक्कन होबा धरि फेंटू, कोनो गुलठी नहि रहय। फेंटनी वा काँटा लिअ आ कटोराक किनार पर दबा कऽ गुलठी फोड़ि दिअ।
seg.fce6db4082ef.back: Whisk ragi flour in 1 cup water until smooth, with no lumps. Use a whisk or fork and break lumps by pressing them against the side of the bowl.

seg.ac6b0e0e7003.src: Pour the remaining 1 cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan and set it on medium heat.
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.t: बचल 1 कप पानि भारी तलीबला बर्तनमे ढारू आ मध्यम आँच पर चढ़ाउ।
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.back: Pour the remaining 1 cup water into a heavy-bottomed vessel and put it on medium heat.

seg.ec55acf2b96a.src: Boil the other cup of water, pour in the ragi and stir on low heat till thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Stir the mix once more before pouring, as the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.
seg.ec55acf2b96a.t: दोसर कप पानि खौलाउ, रागी ढारू आ धीमा आँच पर गाढ़ आ चमकदार होबा धरि चलाउ, 6–8 मिनट। ढारबा सँ पहिने मिश्रणकेँ एक बेर फेर चला लिअ, किएक तँ आटा कटोराक तलीमे बैसि जाइत अछि।
seg.ec55acf2b96a.back: Boil the second cup of water, pour in the ragi and stir on low heat until thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Stir the mixture once more before pouring, because the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.

seg.d0f8efa78d43.src: Keep stirring all the time. The java is cooked when it turns from dull pinkish-brown to a darker, glossy brown and coats the back of the spoon.
seg.d0f8efa78d43.t: लगातार चलबैत रहू। जावा तखन पाकल अछि जखन फीका गुलाबी-भूर सँ गाढ़, चमकदार भूर भऽ जाय आ चम्मचक पाछू पर परत चढ़ि जाय।
seg.d0f8efa78d43.back: Keep stirring constantly. The java is cooked when it turns from dull pinkish-brown to deep, glossy brown and coats the back of a spoon.

seg.e7ef07a808c5.src: Add the milk and simmer 2 minutes. Switch off and rest 2 minutes. Stir once or twice while it simmers so it does not catch.
seg.e7ef07a808c5.t: दूध डालू आ 2 मिनट धीमा आँच पर पकाउ। आँच बन्द करू आ 2 मिनट राखि दिअ। पकैत काल एक-दू बेर चलाउ जाहि सँ तलीमे नहि सटय।
seg.e7ef07a808c5.back: Add milk and cook 2 minutes on low heat. Turn off the heat and let rest 2 minutes. Stir once or twice while cooking so that it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.8f86db3a6d08.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely while the java rests, so it melts quickly.
seg.8f86db3a6d08.t: जावा राखल रहय ताबत ताड़क गुड़ महीन कद्दूकस करू, जाहि सँ ओ जल्दी गलि जाय।
seg.8f86db3a6d08.back: While the java rests grate the palm jaggery finely, so that it melts quickly.

seg.9cad3a0176bc.src: Stir in the palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve warm. Stir till the jaggery has fully melted, then taste and add a little more if needed.
seg.9cad3a0176bc.t: ताड़क गुड़ आ इलायची मिलाउ। गरम-गरम परसू। गुड़ पूरा गलबा धरि चलाउ, फेर चीखू आ जरूरति हो तँ कनेक आओर डालू।
seg.9cad3a0176bc.back: Mix in palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve piping hot. Stir until the jaggery melts completely, then taste and add a little more if needed.

seg.a8de8fe6382d.src: Pour into tumblers or bowls. If it is too thick to drink, stir in a few spoons of warm milk.
seg.a8de8fe6382d.t: गिलास वा कटोरामे ढारू। पीबऽ लेल बेसी गाढ़ हो तँ किछु चम्मच गुनगुन दूध मिला दिअ।
seg.a8de8fe6382d.back: Pour into a glass or bowl. If too thick to drink mix in a few spoons of lukewarm milk.

seg.c3916a972329.src: Always mix the ragi flour in water first; flour added straight to boiling water forms lumps that do not break up.
seg.c3916a972329.t: रागीक आटा सदिखन पहिने पानिमे घोरू; सोझे खौलैत पानिमे डालल आटामे एहन गुलठी बनैत अछि जे नहि फुटैत अछि।
seg.c3916a972329.back: Always mix ragi flour in water first; flour added straight into boiling water forms lumps that do not break.

seg.966098732312.src: Do not rush the cooking; undercooked ragi tastes raw and floury.
seg.966098732312.t: पकेबामे हड़बड़ी नहि करू; काँच रागीक स्वाद काँच आ आटा सन लगैत अछि।
seg.966098732312.back: Do not rush the cooking; uncooked ragi tastes raw and floury.

seg.7c0f350f3691.src: For a thinner java to drink from a tumbler, use 2 tbsp ragi flour; for a spoonable porridge, use ⅓ cup.
seg.7c0f350f3691.t: गिलास सँ पीबऽ लेल पातर जावा चाही तँ 2 पैघ चम्मच रागीक आटा लिअ; चम्मच सँ खाय जोगर लपसी लेल ⅓ कप लिअ।
seg.7c0f350f3691.back: If you want thin java to drink from a glass take 2 tablespoons ragi flour; for a porridge to eat with a spoon take ⅓ cup.

seg.146636ba6c2e.src: With dry fruit: stir in a few chopped cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins at the end.
seg.146636ba6c2e.t: मेवाक संग: अन्तमे किछु काटल काजू वा बदाम आ एक चम्मच किसमिस मिलाउ।
seg.146636ba6c2e.back: With nuts: at the end mix in some chopped cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins.

seg.6fc3ada569ad.src: Without milk: cook the ragi in 2½ cups water and stir in the jaggery once it has stopped bubbling, for a thinner, darker java.
seg.6fc3ada569ad.t: बिनु दूधक: रागीकेँ 2½ कप पानिमे पकाउ आ खदकब बन्द भेलाक बाद गुड़ मिलाउ; जावा पातर आ गाढ़ रंगक होयत।
seg.6fc3ada569ad.back: Without milk: cook the ragi in 2½ cups water and mix in jaggery after the bubbling stops; the java will be thinner and darker in colour.

seg.639ea388ead3.src: Serve warm in a steel tumbler or bowl for breakfast, or as an evening drink with a few biscuits or murukulu. Some like it chilled in summer.
seg.639ea388ead3.t: भोरक जलखैमे स्टीलक गिलास वा कटोरामे गरम-गरम परसू, वा साँझमे किछु बिस्कुट वा मुरुकुलुक संग। किछु लोककेँ गर्मीमे ठंढ़ा पसिन्न अछि।
seg.639ea388ead3.back: Serve piping hot in a steel glass or bowl at breakfast, or in the evening with some biscuits or murukulu. Some people like it cold in summer.

seg.e770a9eec01e.src: Best drunk the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and stir in a little warm milk, off the heat, when reheating.
seg.e770a9eec01e.t: जाहि दिन बनय ओही दिन पीनाइ सभ सँ नीक। बचल जावा झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे 1 दिन धरि राखू आ फेर गरम करैत काल, आँच सँ उतारि कऽ, कनेक गुनगुन दूध मिलाउ।
seg.e770a9eec01e.back: Best drunk the day it is made. Keep leftover java covered in the fridge up to 1 day and when reheating, off the heat, mix in a little lukewarm milk.

seg.a10b6147a5ac.src: How do I make ragi java without lumps?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.t: बिनु गुलठीक रागी जावा कोना बनाउ?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.back: How to make ragi java without lumps?

seg.ca8628b7e082.src: Whisk the ragi flour into room-temperature water first until smooth, then pour this into boiling water while stirring all the time.
seg.ca8628b7e082.t: पहिने रागीक आटा कोठलीक तापमानबला पानिमे चिक्कन होबा धरि फेंटू, फेर एकरा लगातार चलबैत खौलैत पानिमे ढारू।
seg.ca8628b7e082.back: First whisk ragi flour in room-temperature water until smooth, then pour it into boiling water while stirring constantly.

seg.8bd78affc52d.src: How do I know ragi java is cooked?
seg.8bd78affc52d.t: कोना बुझब जे रागी जावा पाकि गेल?
seg.8bd78affc52d.back: How to know ragi java is cooked?

seg.9b05db7490cb.src: It turns darker and glossy, thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon, and no longer tastes floury. This takes about 6–8 minutes on low heat.
seg.9b05db7490cb.t: ई गाढ़ रंगक आ चमकदार भऽ जाइत अछि, एतेक गाढ़ भऽ जाइत अछि जे चम्मचक पाछू पर परत चढ़ि जाय, आ आब आटा सन स्वाद नहि लगैत अछि। धीमा आँच पर एहिमे करीब 6–8 मिनट लगैत अछि।
seg.9b05db7490cb.back: It becomes deep-coloured and glossy, becomes thick enough to coat the back of a spoon, and no longer tastes floury. On low heat this takes about 6–8 minutes.

seg.6d748d67adfb.src: Can I use palm jaggery in ragi java?
seg.6d748d67adfb.t: की रागी जावामे ताड़क गुड़ प्रयोग कऽ सकैत छी?
seg.6d748d67adfb.back: Can I use palm jaggery in ragi java?

seg.06e768643767.src: Yes. Grate the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a deeper colour and a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.06e768643767.t: हँ। ताड़क गुड़ (ताटि बेल्लम) महीन कद्दूकस करू आ चूल्हि बन्द कयलाक बाद मिलाउ, जाहि सँ दूध नहि फाटय। एहि सँ रंग बेसी गाढ़ आ मिठास कनेक धुआँ सन होइत अछि।
seg.06e768643767.back: Yes. Grate palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and mix in after turning off the stove, so that the milk does not curdle. This makes the colour darker and the sweetness a little smoky.

seg.9a71713417de.src: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?
seg.9a71713417de.t: रागी जावा आ रागी माल्टमे की अन्तर अछि?
seg.9a71713417de.back: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?

seg.c2632b6d0b4f.src: They are the same drink with different names. Ragi java is the Telugu name; ragi malt is what it is often called in shops and on menus.
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.t: दुनू एक्के पेय अछि, बस नाम अलग। रागी जावा तेलुगु नाम अछि; दोकान आ मेनूमे एकरा बेसी काल रागी माल्ट कहल जाइत अछि।
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.back: Both are the same drink, just different names. Ragi java is the Telugu name; in shops and menus it is mostly called ragi malt.

seg.6134777fbfa8.src: రాగి జావ · Sweet Ragi Java Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.t: రాగి జావ · मीठ रागी जावाक रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.back: రాగి జావ · Sweet ragi java recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.708e3c523d72.src: రాగి జావ. Sweet ragi java, the Andhra way: ragi flour cooked in water till glossy, loosened with milk and sweetened with Thati Bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.
seg.708e3c523d72.t: రాగి జావ. आन्ध्रक तरीकाक मीठ रागी जावा: रागीक आटा पानिमे चमकदार होबा धरि पकाओल, दूध सँ पातर आ ताटि बेल्लम ताड़क गुड़ सँ मीठ कयल। विधि आ सुझाव।
seg.708e3c523d72.back: రాగి జావ. Andhra-style sweet ragi java: ragi flour cooked in water until glossy, thinned with milk and sweetened with thati bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.

seg.2889ed2cf93b.src: Ragi Java: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.2889ed2cf93b.t: रागी जावा: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.2889ed2cf93b.back: Ragi Java: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.8ee2205b2e8b.t: 3 पैघ चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़

seg.671d48882eed.src: Iguru is the Andhra way of cooking meat or prawns down in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so the spices cling to every piece. Royyala iguru comes from the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari to Srikakulam, where prawns from the backwaters and the sea are a Sunday lunch with rice.
seg.671d48882eed.t: इगुरु आन्ध्रक ओ तरीका अछि जाहिमे मासु वा झींगाकेँ गाढ़ पियाउजक मसालामे करीब सुखबा धरि पकाओल जाइत अछि, जाहि सँ मसाला हर टुकड़ा पर सटि जाय। रोय्याला इगुरु तटीय जिला सभ सँ अबैत अछि, नेल्लोर सँ गोदावरी आ श्रीकाकुलम धरि, जतय खाड़ी आ समुद्रक झींगा भातक संग रविदिनक दुपहरियाक भोजन होइत अछि।
seg.671d48882eed.back: Iguru is that Andhra method in which meat or prawns are cooked in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so that the masala sticks to every piece. Royyala iguru comes from the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari and Srikakulam, where creek and sea prawns with rice are the Sunday-afternoon meal.

seg.ff39877dbdbd.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) goes on the prawns first and into the masala. Teja chilli powder brings the deep red colour and strong heat coastal homes like, so scale it to your table.
seg.ff39877dbdbd.t: हमर पहाड़ी हरदि बुकनी (कोंडा पसुपु) पहिने झींगा पर लगैत अछि आ फेर मसालामे पड़ैत अछि। तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी गाढ़ लाल रंग आ ओ कड़गर तीख दैत अछि जे तटीय घरमे पसिन्न कयल जाइत अछि, तेँ अपन घरक हिसाब सँ मात्रा राखू।
seg.ff39877dbdbd.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) first goes on the prawns and then into the masala. Teja chilli powder gives a deep red colour and that strong heat which is liked in coastal homes, so keep the amount to suit your home.

seg.885826f68de3.src: Prep includes cleaning the prawns and the 10-minute rest with turmeric.
seg.885826f68de3.t: तैयारीमे झींगा साफ करब आ हरदि लगा कऽ 10 मिनट रखबाक समय जोड़ल अछि।
seg.885826f68de3.back: Prep includes cleaning the prawns and keeping them 10 minutes with turmeric.

seg.cff5bbd725a6.src: Rub prawns with turmeric and salt. Fry onions and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala till it coats them.
seg.cff5bbd725a6.t: झींगामे हरदि आ नोन मलू। पियाउज आ आदी-लहसुनक पेस्ट भूजू, तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी आ धनियाँ बुकनी डालू, फेर झींगाकेँ मसालामे तखन धरि पकाउ जा धरि मसाला ओकरा पर चढ़ि नहि जाय।
seg.cff5bbd725a6.back: Rub turmeric and salt into the prawns. Fry onion and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala until the masala coats them.

seg.cf489166a3fd.src: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shelled and deveined, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.t: 500 g झींगा ⟦1⟧मझोला आकारक, छिलका आ करिया नस निकालल, साफ कयलाक बाद तौलल⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.back: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shell and black vein removed, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧

seg.141eb60cb009.src: ¾ tsp salt ⟦1⟧divided, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.t: ¾ छोट चम्मच नोन ⟦1⟧दू भागमे, वा स्वाद अनुसार⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.back: ¾ teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧in two parts, or to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.8c4c1b789de7.t: 3 पैघ चम्मच तेल ⟦1⟧बेसी मूँगफलीक तेल चलैत अछि⟦/1⟧
seg.8c4c1b789de7.back: 3 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is mostly used⟦/1⟧

seg.d4841433219c.t: 1 टा टमाटर (मन हो तँ) ⟦1⟧छोट, महीन काटल⟦/1⟧

seg.716dc45cf0b3.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu; ¼ tsp for the prawns, ¼ tsp for the masala⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.t: ½ छोट चम्मच पहाड़ी हरदि बुकनी ⟦1⟧कोंडा पसुपु; ¼ छोट चम्मच झींगा लेल, ¼ छोट चम्मच मसाला लेल⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.back: ½ teaspoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu; ¼ teaspoon for the prawns, ¼ teaspoon for the masala⟦/1⟧

seg.f7ec1e72abc0.src: 1½ tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat, ½ tsp for mild⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.t: 1½ छोट चम्मच तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी ⟦1⟧बड्ड तीख; मध्यम तीख लेल 1 छोट चम्मच, कम तीख लेल ½ छोट चम्मच⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.back: 1½ teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; 1 teaspoon for medium heat, ½ teaspoon for less heat⟦/1⟧

seg.fce641038ff4.src: Shell and devein the prawns, rinse them well and drain in a colander.
seg.fce641038ff4.t: झींगाक छिलका आ करिया नस निकालू, नीक जकाँ पखारू आ छन्नामे पानि निथारि लिअ।
seg.fce641038ff4.back: Remove the prawns' shell and black vein, rinse well and drain the water in a colander.

seg.152d1d89f6a5.src: Rub the prawns with half the turmeric and a little salt; set aside 10 minutes. Use ¼ tsp turmeric and ¼ tsp of the salt.
seg.152d1d89f6a5.t: झींगामे आधा हरदि आ कनेक नोन मलू; 10 मिनट अलग राखि दिअ। ¼ छोट चम्मच हरदि आ ¼ छोट चम्मच नोन लिअ।
seg.152d1d89f6a5.back: Rub half the turmeric and a little salt into the prawns; keep aside 10 minutes. Take ¼ teaspoon turmeric and ¼ teaspoon salt.

seg.9e027c56020d.src: Heat the oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the mustard seeds. When they splutter, add the green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.9e027c56020d.t: भारी कड़ाहीमे मध्यम आँच पर तेल गरम करू आ सरिसो डालू। चटकय लागय तँ हरियर मरचाइ आ करी पात डालू।
seg.9e027c56020d.back: Heat oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add mustard. When it starts to crackle add green chillies and curry leaves.

seg.5d608fabeb97.src: Fry the onions in the oil till golden, then the ginger-garlic paste till it smells cooked. The onions take about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the raw smell goes.
seg.5d608fabeb97.t: पियाउजकेँ तेलमे सोनहुला होबा धरि भूजू, फेर आदी-लहसुनक पेस्टकेँ पाकल गन्ध आबय धरि। पियाउजमे करीब 8–10 मिनट लगैत अछि; पेस्टमे करीब 1 मिनट, जा धरि काँच गन्ध नहि चलि जाय।
seg.5d608fabeb97.back: Fry the onion in the oil until golden, then the ginger-garlic paste until a cooked smell comes. The onion takes about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the raw smell goes.

seg.7677bdc79559.src: If using the tomato, add it now and cook until soft and pulpy, about 4 minutes.
seg.7677bdc79559.t: जँ टमाटर लैत छी तँ एखन डालू आ नरम आ गुद्दा सन होबा धरि पकाउ, करीब 4 मिनट।
seg.7677bdc79559.back: If you are using tomato add it now and cook until soft and pulpy, about 4 minutes.

seg.5aff56b73c8a.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the rest of the turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and stir so the spices do not catch.
seg.5aff56b73c8a.t: आँच धीमा करू। बचल हरदि, तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी आ धनियाँ बुकनी डालू; 1 मिनट भूजू। बचल नोन डालू आ चलबैत रहू जाहि सँ मसाला तलीमे नहि सटय।
seg.5aff56b73c8a.back: Lower the heat. Add the remaining turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and keep stirring so that the masala does not stick to the bottom.

seg.ba25fbb9cf98.src: Pour in the water and cook the masala on medium heat until the oil starts to separate at the edges, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.t: पानि ढारू आ मसालाकेँ मध्यम आँच पर पकाउ जा धरि किनार पर तेल अलग होमय नहि लागय, करीब 3–4 मिनट।
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.back: Pour in water and cook the masala on medium heat until oil starts to separate at the edges, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.e60a6389cdf2.src: Add the prawns and cook till they curl and turn pink, 5–6 minutes. Finish with garam masala. Stir often on medium-high heat so the masala dries and coats the prawns.
seg.e60a6389cdf2.t: झींगा डालू आ ओ मुड़ि कऽ गुलाबी होबा धरि पकाउ, 5–6 मिनट। अन्तमे गरम मसाला डालू। मध्यम-तेज आँच पर बेर-बेर चलाउ जाहि सँ मसाला सुखि कऽ झींगा पर चढ़ि जाय।
seg.e60a6389cdf2.back: Add the prawns and cook until they curl and turn pink, 5–6 minutes. At the end add garam masala. Stir often on medium-high heat so that the masala dries and coats the prawns.

seg.af87e48d1429.src: Check doneness: prawns are cooked when they are pink and opaque all the way through and curled into a loose C. Cut one open if unsure; there should be no grey, see-through centre.
seg.af87e48d1429.t: पाकल अछि कि नहि जाँचू: झींगा तखन पाकल अछि जखन ओ भीतर धरि गुलाबी आ अपारदर्शी भऽ जाय आ ढील C आकारमे मुड़ि जाय। पक्का नहि होइ तँ एकटा काटि कऽ देखू; बीचमे कोनो धूसर, पारदर्शी भाग नहि हेबाक चाही।
seg.af87e48d1429.back: Check if it is cooked: the prawns are cooked when they become pink and opaque right through and curl into a loose C shape. If unsure cut one and look; there should be no grey, translucent part in the middle.

seg.32e58c09609e.src: Taste for salt, scatter the coriander leaves and switch off. Do not keep cooking once the prawns are done, or they turn rubbery.
seg.32e58c09609e.t: नोन चीखू, धनियाँ पात छीटू आ आँच बन्द करू। झींगा पाकि गेलाक बाद पकबैत नहि रहू, नहि तँ ओ रबड़ सन भऽ जायत।
seg.32e58c09609e.back: Taste for salt, sprinkle coriander leaves and turn off the heat. Do not keep cooking after the prawns are cooked, otherwise they will become rubbery.

seg.89a9cb293875.src: Teja is very hot: 1½ tsp makes a fiery iguru the way coastal homes like it; use 1 tsp for medium heat, or ½ tsp for mild.
seg.89a9cb293875.t: तेजा बड्ड तीख अछि: 1½ छोट चम्मच सँ ओहन झाँसगर इगुरु बनैत अछि जेहन तटीय घरमे पसिन्न अछि; मध्यम तीख लेल 1 छोट चम्मच, वा कम तीख लेल ½ छोट चम्मच लिअ।
seg.89a9cb293875.back: Teja is very hot: 1½ teaspoons makes the fiery iguru liked in coastal homes; for medium heat take 1 teaspoon, or for less heat ½ teaspoon.

seg.095c6105ce36.src: Fry the onions until properly golden; the colour and body of an iguru come from well-browned onions.
seg.095c6105ce36.t: पियाउज ठीक सँ सोनहुला होबा धरि भूजू; इगुरुक रंग आ गाढ़पन नीक जकाँ भूर भेल पियाउज सँ अबैत अछि।
seg.095c6105ce36.back: Fry the onion until properly golden; the colour and thickness of the iguru come from well-browned onion.

seg.04fb6307d058.src: Prawns cook fast. A loose C shape means done; a tight O means overcooked and chewy.
seg.04fb6307d058.t: झींगा जल्दी पकैत अछि। ढील C आकार माने पाकि गेल; कसल O आकार माने बेसी पाकि कऽ चिमड़ भऽ गेल।
seg.04fb6307d058.back: Prawns cook quickly. A loose C shape means cooked; a tight O shape means overcooked and tough.

seg.a5e6a832090a.src: Pat the prawns dry after rinsing so they fry in the masala instead of stewing in water.
seg.a5e6a832090a.t: पखारलाक बाद झींगाकेँ थपथपा कऽ सुखा लिअ जाहि सँ ओ पानिमे उसनाइ नहि, मसालामे भुजाय।
seg.a5e6a832090a.back: After rinsing pat the prawns dry so that they fry in the masala rather than boil in water.

seg.4145e1ca56b5.src: Gongura royyalu: stir in ½ cup gongura leaves, wilted in a little oil and mashed, with the prawns.
seg.4145e1ca56b5.t: गोंगुरा रोय्यालु: झींगाक संग ½ कप गोंगुरा पात, कनेक तेलमे मौला कऽ मसलल, मिलाउ।
seg.4145e1ca56b5.back: Gongura royyalu: mix in ½ cup gongura leaves, wilted in a little oil and mashed, with the prawns.

seg.e52b316e5c51.src: Coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut or 3 tbsp thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes for a softer, richer masala.
seg.e52b316e5c51.t: नारियल: बेसी नरम आ भरल मसाला लेल अन्तिम 2 मिनटमे 2 पैघ चम्मच कद्दूकस कयल नारियल वा 3 पैघ चम्मच गाढ़ नारियलक दूध डालू।
seg.e52b316e5c51.back: Coconut: for a softer and fuller masala add 2 tablespoons grated coconut or 3 tablespoons thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes.

seg.fc55c7b1a788.src: Gravy style: add ¾ cup water after the prawns for a thinner royyala kura to pour over rice.
seg.fc55c7b1a788.t: ग्रेवीबला: भात पर ढारबा लेल पातर रोय्याला कूरा चाही तँ झींगाक बाद ¾ कप पानि डालू।
seg.fc55c7b1a788.back: With gravy: if you want a thin royyala koora to pour over rice, add ¾ cup water after the prawns.

seg.8ccb6d545dd0.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar rice. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.t: भापमे पाकल भात आ एक चम्मच घीक संग, वा रसम वा सांबर-भातक संग गरम-गरम परसू। रोटीक संग सेहो नीक लगैत अछि।
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.back: Serve piping hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar-rice. It is also good with roti.

seg.d51021b311d0.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Warm gently in a pan; long reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.d51021b311d0.t: बचल झींगा झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे राखू आ 1 दिनक भीतर खा लिअ। पैनमे धीरे-धीरे गरम करू; बेसी काल गरम केला सँ झींगा कड़ा भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.d51021b311d0.back: Keep leftover prawns covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Heat slowly in a pan; heating too long makes prawns hard.

seg.8381d6ac4e4f.src: How do I know when prawns are cooked?
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.t: कोना बुझब जे झींगा पाकि गेल?
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.back: How to know the prawns are cooked?

seg.45cd36ecb77b.src: They turn pink and opaque all the way through and curl into a loose C shape, usually in 5–6 minutes in the hot masala. A grey, see-through centre means they need a little longer.
seg.45cd36ecb77b.t: ओ भीतर धरि गुलाबी आ अपारदर्शी भऽ जाइत अछि आ ढील C आकारमे मुड़ि जाइत अछि, गरम मसालामे बेसी काल 5–6 मिनटमे। बीचमे धूसर, पारदर्शी भाग रहय तँ कनेक आओर पकाबऽ पड़त।
seg.45cd36ecb77b.back: They become pink and opaque right through and curl into a loose C shape, mostly in 5–6 minutes in hot masala. If a grey, translucent part remains in the middle, they need to cook a little more.

seg.2e4c4a4632d7.src: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.t: इगुरु आ वेपुडुमे की अन्तर अछि?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.back: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?

seg.1ee73f38a967.src: Iguru is cooked down in an onion masala until thick and almost dry, with the masala clinging to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, with less or no onion gravy, cooked until the prawns are crisp at the edges.
seg.1ee73f38a967.t: इगुरु पियाउजक मसालामे गाढ़ आ करीब सुखल होबा धरि पकाओल जाइत अछि, मसाला झींगा पर सटल रहैत अछि। वेपुडु भुजिया अछि, कम वा बिनु पियाउजक ग्रेवी, जा धरि झींगाक किनार कुरकुर नहि भऽ जाय ता धरि पकाओल।
seg.1ee73f38a967.back: Iguru is cooked in onion masala until thick and almost dry, the masala stays stuck to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, with little or no onion gravy, cooked until the prawns' edges become crisp.

seg.d248a2970455.src: How can I make royyala iguru less spicy?
seg.d248a2970455.t: रोय्याला इगुरुकेँ कम तीख कोना बनाउ?
seg.d248a2970455.back: How to make royyala iguru less hot?

seg.8c9c12b68361.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder for medium heat or ½ tsp for mild, and skip the green chillies. A tablespoon of curd or coconut milk at the end also softens the heat.
seg.8c9c12b68361.t: मध्यम तीख लेल 1 छोट चम्मच वा कम तीख लेल ½ छोट चम्मच तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी लिअ, आ हरियर मरचाइ छोड़ि दिअ। अन्तमे एक पैघ चम्मच दही वा नारियलक दूध सँ सेहो तीख नरम होइत अछि।
seg.8c9c12b68361.back: Take 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder for medium heat or ½ teaspoon for less heat, and leave out the green chillies. A tablespoon of curd or coconut milk at the end also softens the heat.

seg.d024c66a11b8.t: की फ्रोजन झींगा प्रयोग कऽ सकैत छी?

seg.9cd9740c2604.src: Yes. Thaw them in the fridge, drain them well and pat them dry before rubbing with turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.
seg.9cd9740c2604.t: हँ। फ्रिजमे पिघलाउ, नीक जकाँ पानि निथारू आ हरदि आ नोन मलबा सँ पहिने थपथपा कऽ सुखा लिअ। फ्रोजन झींगा बेसी पानि छोड़ैत अछि, तेँ मसाला कनेक बेसी काल पकाउ।
seg.9cd9740c2604.back: Yes. Thaw in the fridge, drain the water well and pat dry before rubbing in turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.

seg.0484ea984ed7.src: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, the coastal Andhra prawn roast: prawns cooked down in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and fiery Teja chilli powder. Serves 4.
seg.0484ea984ed7.t: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. रोय्याला इगुरु, तटीय आन्ध्रक झींगा रोस्ट: पहाड़ी हरदि बुकनी आ झाँसगर तेजा मरचाइ बुकनीक संग पियाउजक मसालामे पकाओल झींगा। 4 लोक लेल।
seg.0484ea984ed7.back: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, coastal Andhra's prawn roast: prawns cooked in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and fiery Teja chilli powder. For 4 people.

seg.1b1d6a89c215.src: Royyala Iguru: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.1b1d6a89c215.t: रोय्याला इगुरु: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.1b1d6a89c215.back: Royyala Iguru: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.965a1e93fb08.src: Sunnundalu are the urad dal laddus of Andhra: split urad dal roasted till nutty, ground fine with jaggery and pressed together with hot ghee. There is no cooking of syrup, so they come together in about half an hour. Andhra homes make a tin for Sankranti and Diwali, pack them for relatives travelling abroad, and keep them for an evening sweet with tea.
seg.965a1e93fb08.t: सुन्नुंडलु आन्ध्रक उड़िद दालिक लड्डू अछि: फूटल उड़िद दालि भुनल मेवा सन गन्ध आबय धरि भूजल, गुड़क संग महीन पिसल आ गरम घी सँ बान्हल। चाशनी नहि पकाबऽ पड़ैत अछि, तेँ करीब आधा घंटामे बनि जाइत अछि। आन्ध्रक घरमे संक्रान्ति आ दिवाली लेल एक डिब्बा बनैत अछि, विदेश जाइत सम्बन्धी लेल बान्हल जाइत अछि, आ साँझक चाहक संग मिठाइ लेल राखल जाइत अछि।
seg.965a1e93fb08.back: Sunnundalu are Andhra's urad dal laddus: split urad dal roasted until it smells like roasted nuts, ground fine with jaggery and bound with hot ghee. No syrup has to be cooked, so it is made in about half an hour. In Andhra homes a box is made for Sankranti and Diwali, packed for relatives going abroad, and kept as a sweet with evening tea.

seg.e564344550cd.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness that suits the roasted dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.
seg.e564344550cd.t: हमर ताटि बेल्लम ताड़क गुड़ सुन्नुंडलुकेँ गाढ़ भूर रंग आ भरल, कनेक धुआँ सन मिठास दैत अछि जे भूजल दालिक संग नीक मेल खाइत अछि। ई रेसिपी सँ करीब 15 टा लड्डू बनैत अछि।
seg.e564344550cd.back: Our thati bellam palm jaggery gives the sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a full, slightly smoky sweetness that goes well with roasted dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.

seg.b1400f429b2f.src: Total includes cooling the roasted dal before grinding.
seg.b1400f429b2f.t: कुल समयमे पिसबा सँ पहिने भूजल दालि ठंढ़ा करबाक समय सेहो जोड़ल अछि।
seg.b1400f429b2f.back: The total time also includes the time to cool the roasted dal before grinding.

seg.6c6369238635.src: Roast urad dal till golden, cool and grind fine, then grind in palm jaggery and cardamom. Mix with hot ghee and shape into laddus.
seg.6c6369238635.t: उड़िद दालि सोनहुला होबा धरि भूजू, ठंढ़ा कऽ महीन पीसू, फेर ताड़क गुड़ आ इलायचीक संग पीसू। गरम घीक संग मिलाउ आ लड्डू बनाउ।
seg.6c6369238635.back: Roast urad dal until golden, cool and grind fine, then grind with palm jaggery and cardamom. Mix with hot ghee and make laddus.

seg.890ddaaca185.src: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, skinless (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.t: 1 कप उज्जर उड़िद दालि ⟦1⟧फूटल, बिनु छिलकाक (मिनपप्पु), करीब 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.back: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, without skin (minappappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.06c2723f717d.src: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly packed; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.t: 1 कप कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़ ⟦1⟧करीब 180 g, हल्लुक दबा कऽ भरल; पहिने टुकड़ाकेँ कूटि वा कद्दूकस कऽ लिअ⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.back: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly pressed and filled; first pound or grate the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.25c886ef1375.src: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tbsp extra on hand⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.t: ½ कप घी ⟦1⟧गलाओल आ गरम; 1–2 पैघ चम्मच बेसी लग राखू⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.back: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tablespoons extra nearby⟦/1⟧

seg.99983266b588.src: Pick through the urad dal for any small stones. Do not wash it; it must stay dry for roasting.
seg.99983266b588.t: उड़िद दालि बीछि कऽ छोट-छोट पाथर निकालि दिअ। धोउ नहि; भुजबा लेल एकरा सुखल रहबाक चाही।
seg.99983266b588.back: Pick over the urad dal and remove small stones. Do not wash; it must be dry for roasting.

seg.2f2807ce216b.src: Put the dal in a heavy pan on a low flame.
seg.2f2807ce216b.t: दालि भारी पैनमे धीमा आँच पर राखू।
seg.2f2807ce216b.back: Put the dal in a heavy pan on low heat.

seg.65588a76c883.src: Dry-roast the urad dal on a low flame till golden and nutty, about 10 minutes. Stir all the time so every grain colours evenly; it should smell toasty and snap when you bite a grain.
seg.65588a76c883.t: उड़िद दालिकेँ धीमा आँच पर बिनु तेलक सोनहुला आ भुनल मेवा सन गन्ध आबय धरि भूजू, करीब 10 मिनट। लगातार चलाउ जाहि सँ हर दाना एक समान रंग पकड़य; एहि सँ सेकल गन्ध आबक चाही आ दाना दाँत सँ काटला पर कुरकुरा कऽ टूटक चाही।
seg.65588a76c883.back: Dry-roast the urad dal without oil on low heat until golden and smelling like roasted nuts, about 10 minutes. Stir constantly so that every grain takes an even colour; it should give a toasted smell and the grain should crunch and break when bitten.

seg.9e8dc23d38fa.src: Tip the dal onto a plate and spread it out. Cool it, then grind to a fine powder. Grind in short bursts so the mixer does not heat up, and sieve out any coarse bits to grind again.
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.t: दालि थारी पर उझलि कऽ पसारि दिअ। ठंढ़ा करू, फेर महीन बुकनी पीसू। थोड़-थोड़ कऽ चलाउ जाहि सँ मिक्सर गरम नहि हो, आ मोट दाना चालि कऽ फेर पीसू।
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.back: Tip the dal onto a plate and spread it. Cool, then grind to a fine powder. Pulse little by little so the mixer does not get hot, and sieve the coarse bits and grind again.

seg.edfa5bb66e59.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, or pound the pieces in a mortar, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.edfa5bb66e59.t: ताड़क गुड़ महीन कद्दूकस करू, वा टुकड़ाकेँ ओखरिमे कूटू आ कड़ा गुलठी फोड़ि दिअ।
seg.edfa5bb66e59.back: Grate the palm jaggery finely, or pound the pieces in a mortar and break hard lumps.

seg.fcf7bce21bc5.src: Add the jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder in the mixer jar. Grind in the jaggery and cardamom till evenly mixed. A few pulses are enough; tip it all into a wide bowl.
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.t: मिक्सरक जारमे दालिक बुकनीमे गुड़ आ इलायची बुकनी डालू। एक समान मिलबा धरि गुड़ आ इलायचीक संग पीसू। किछु बेर चलाएब पर्याप्त अछि; सभटा एकटा चाकर कटोरामे उझलि दिअ।
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.back: In the mixer jar add jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder. Grind with the jaggery and cardamom until evenly mixed. A few pulses are enough; tip everything into a wide bowl.

seg.1cd01dc31b1a.src: Melt the ghee in a small pan until it is hot but not smoking.
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.t: छोट बर्तनमे घी एतेक गरम करू जे गरम हो मुदा धुआँ नहि उठय।
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.back: Heat the ghee in a small vessel so that it is hot but not smoking.

seg.0b0ec921a239.src: Pour in the hot ghee, mix well and press into small balls. Start with most of the ghee, mix with a spoon, then use your hands once it is cool enough to touch.
seg.0b0ec921a239.t: गरम घी ढारू, नीक जकाँ मिलाउ आ छोट-छोट लड्डू बान्हू। पहिने बेसी घी डालू, चम्मच सँ मिलाउ, फेर छुबा जोगर ठंढ़ा भेला पर हाथ सँ।
seg.0b0ec921a239.back: Pour in the hot ghee, mix well and shape small laddus. First add most of the ghee, mix with a spoon, then by hand once cool enough to touch.

seg.0c005163369c.src: Take a small handful and squeeze it firmly in your fist, then roll it round between your palms. If it crumbles, add a spoon more hot ghee to the bowl and mix.
seg.0c005163369c.t: एक छोट मुट्ठी लिअ आ मुट्ठीमे कसि कऽ दबाउ, फेर हथेरीक बीच घुमा कऽ गोल करू। जँ भुरभुरा जाय तँ कटोरामे एक चम्मच आओर गरम घी डालि कऽ मिलाउ।
seg.0c005163369c.back: Take a small handful and press it tightly in your fist, then roll between the palms to make it round. If it crumbles add one more spoon of hot ghee to the bowl and mix.

seg.7ac27bb5fb12.src: Set the laddus on a plate to firm up for 15–20 minutes before storing.
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.t: रखबा सँ पहिने लड्डूकेँ थारी पर 15–20 मिनट कड़ा होमय दिअ।
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.back: Before storing let the laddus firm up on a plate for 15–20 minutes.

seg.591b2b7e4ef4.src: Roast the dal on a low flame so it cooks through without burning.
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.t: दालि धीमा आँच पर भूजू जाहि सँ ओ बिनु जरने भीतर धरि भुजा जाय।
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.back: Roast the dal on low heat so that it roasts right through without burning.

seg.07daa833e53a.src: Grind the dal only after it has cooled completely; warm dal turns pasty in the mixer.
seg.07daa833e53a.t: दालि पूरा ठंढ़ा भेलाक बादे पीसू; गरम दालि मिक्सरमे लेई सन भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.07daa833e53a.back: Grind the dal only after it is completely cool; hot dal turns paste-like in the mixer.

seg.33701abc66f0.src: Shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm; it binds best with the heat of the ghee.
seg.33701abc66f0.t: मिश्रण गरम रहिते लड्डू बान्हू; घीक गरमी सँ ई सभ सँ नीक बान्हैत अछि।
seg.33701abc66f0.back: Shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm; with the warmth of the ghee it binds best.

seg.b6fb58b6b287.src: Palm jaggery pieces vary in hardness, so grate or pound them small before they go into the mixer.
