seg.b6fb58b6b287.t: ताड़क गुड़क टुकड़ा अलग-अलग कड़ा होइत अछि, तेँ मिक्सरमे डालबा सँ पहिने कद्दूकस करू वा कूटि कऽ छोट कऽ लिअ।
seg.b6fb58b6b287.back: Palm jaggery pieces vary in hardness, so grate or pound them small before putting into the mixer.

seg.1797acff16a2.src: Cane jaggery: use the same amount of grated cane jaggery for a lighter colour and a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.1797acff16a2.t: कुसियारक गुड़: हल्लुक रंग आ कैरामेल सन मिठास लेल ओतबे कद्दूकस कयल कुसियारक गुड़ लिअ।
seg.1797acff16a2.back: Sugarcane jaggery: for a lighter colour and caramel-like sweetness take the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery.

seg.f95b0650add7.src: With skin: use black split urad dal with its skin for darker, grainier sunnundalu, the way some village homes make them.
seg.f95b0650add7.t: छिलका सहित: बेसी गाढ़ रंगक आ दानेदार सुन्नुंडलु लेल छिलका सहित करिया फूटल उड़िद दालि लिअ, जेना किछु गामक घरमे बनैत अछि।
seg.f95b0650add7.back: With skin: for darker-coloured and grainy sunnundalu take black split urad dal with skin, as made in some village homes.

seg.07498f6166e4.src: With sugar: use ¾ cup powdered sugar in place of the jaggery for pale, crisp-melting laddus.
seg.07498f6166e4.t: चीनीक संग: हल्लुक रंगक, कुरकुर आ मुँहमे घुलयबला लड्डू लेल गुड़क बदला ¾ कप पिसल चीनी लिअ।
seg.07498f6166e4.back: With sugar: for a lighter-coloured, crisp and melt-in-the-mouth laddu take ¾ cup powdered sugar instead of jaggery.

seg.8fea3a4a695f.src: Serve as an evening sweet with tea or coffee, or as part of the Sankranti and Diwali sweet plate.
seg.8fea3a4a695f.t: साँझमे चाह वा कॉफीक संग मिठाइ रूपमे, वा संक्रान्ति आ दिवालीक मिठाइक थारीमे परसू।
seg.8fea3a4a695f.back: Serve as a sweet with tea or coffee in the evening, or on the sweet plate of Sankranti and Diwali.

seg.83b4edc5c69d.src: Keep in an airtight steel tin at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In warm weather they keep longer in the fridge; let them come to room temperature before eating.
seg.83b4edc5c69d.t: हवाबन्द स्टीलक डिब्बामे कोठलीक तापमान पर राखू आ 2 सप्ताहक भीतर खा लिअ। गर्मीमे फ्रिजमे बेसी दिन टिकैत अछि; खेबा सँ पहिने कोठलीक तापमान पर आबय दिअ।
seg.83b4edc5c69d.back: Keep in an airtight steel box at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In summer it keeps longer in the fridge; let it come to room temperature before eating.

seg.c0ae9315eb0e.src: Why are my sunnundalu not holding shape?
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.t: हमर सुन्नुंडलु बन्हाइत किएक नहि अछि?
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.back: Why are my sunnundalu not binding?

seg.03c64235659e.src: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has cooled down. Warm a spoon or two of ghee, mix it in and shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm.
seg.03c64235659e.t: मिश्रणमे आओर गरम घी चाही, वा ओ ठंढ़ा भऽ गेल अछि। एक-दू चम्मच घी गरम करू, मिलाउ आ मिश्रण गरम रहिते लड्डू बान्हू।
seg.03c64235659e.back: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has gone cold. Heat a spoon or two of ghee, mix in and shape the laddus while the mixture is warm.

seg.c125d749f215.src: Can I make sunnundalu with palm jaggery?
seg.c125d749f215.t: की ताड़क गुड़ सँ सुन्नुंडलु बना सकैत छी?
seg.c125d749f215.back: Can I make sunnundalu with palm jaggery?

seg.7b13a91f65e1.src: Yes. Grate or pound the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and use the same amount as cane jaggery. The laddus turn darker and taste deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7b13a91f65e1.t: हँ। ताड़क गुड़ (ताटि बेल्लम) महीन कद्दूकस करू वा कूटू आ कुसियारक गुड़ जतबे लिअ। लड्डू बेसी गाढ़ रंगक होइत अछि आ स्वाद बेसी गहींर आ कनेक धुआँ सन।
seg.7b13a91f65e1.back: Yes. Grate or pound palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and take the same amount as sugarcane jaggery. The laddus become darker in colour and the taste deeper and a little smoky.

seg.946f64207639.back: How many days do sunnundalu keep?

seg.b2aed25ebff6.src: About 2 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature, and longer in the fridge. Use a dry spoon or dry hands to take them out.
seg.b2aed25ebff6.t: कोठलीक तापमान पर हवाबन्द डिब्बामे करीब 2 सप्ताह, आ फ्रिजमे बेसी दिन। निकालबा लेल सुखल चम्मच वा सुखल हाथ लगाउ।
seg.b2aed25ebff6.back: About 2 weeks in an airtight box at room temperature, and longer in the fridge. Use a dry spoon or dry hands to take them out.

seg.e750875c4912.src: Should I use urad dal with or without skin?
seg.e750875c4912.t: उड़िद दालि छिलका सहित लिअ कि बिनु छिलकाक?
seg.e750875c4912.back: Should I take urad dal with skin or without skin?

seg.b12320430e22.src: Both are made in Andhra. White skinless urad dal gives smooth, light brown laddus; black urad dal with skin gives darker, grainier ones.
seg.b12320430e22.t: आन्ध्रमे दुनू बनैत अछि। उज्जर बिनु छिलकाक उड़िद दालि सँ चिक्कन, हल्लुक भूर लड्डू बनैत अछि; छिलका सहित करिया उड़िद दालि सँ बेसी गाढ़ आ दानेदार।
seg.b12320430e22.back: Both are made in Andhra. White skinless urad dal makes smooth, light brown laddus; black urad dal with skin makes darker and grainier ones.

seg.d8e8e5770555.src: సున్నుండలు. Andhra sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with Thati Bellam palm jaggery and bound with hot ghee into laddus. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.d8e8e5770555.t: సున్నుండలు. आन्ध्रक सुन्नुंडलु: भूजल उड़िद दालि ताटि बेल्लम ताड़क गुड़क संग पिसल आ गरम घी सँ लड्डूमे बान्हल। डेग-डेग विधि, सुझाव आ प्रश्नोत्तर।
seg.d8e8e5770555.back: సున్నుండలు. Andhra's sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with thati bellam palm jaggery and bound into laddus with hot ghee. Step-by-step method, tips and Q&A.

seg.c61b125404d0.src: Sunnundalu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.c61b125404d0.t: सुन्नुंडलु: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.c61b125404d0.back: Sunnundalu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.02d0a5789a02.src: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of Andhra kitchens: ripe tomatoes cooked down in oil with roasted dals, then ground coarse with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. Many homes still grind it in the stone roti for a rough, spoonable texture, though a mixer in short pulses does the job. It goes with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.
seg.02d0a5789a02.t: टोमाटो पच्चडी आन्ध्रक भनसाघरक रोजुक चटनी अछि: पाकल टमाटर भूजल दालिक संग तेलमे गला कऽ पकाओल, फेर मरचाइ, लहसुन आ कनेक इमलीक संग मोट पिसल। बहुत घरमे एखनो एकरा पाथरक रोटि (सिलौट) पर पिसल जाइत अछि जाहि सँ मोट, चम्मच सँ लेबा जोगर बनावट होइत अछि, ओना मिक्सरमे थोड़-थोड़ चलेला सँ सेहो काज भऽ जाइत अछि। ई गरम भात आ घी, डोसा, इडली आ पेसरट्टुक संग चलैत अछि।
seg.02d0a5789a02.back: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of the Andhra kitchen: ripe tomatoes cooked down in oil with roasted dal, then ground coarse with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. In many homes it is still ground on a grinding stone (silauta) for a coarse, spoonable texture, though pulsing little by little in a mixer also works. It goes with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.

seg.7735dff0ccd2.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and steady, medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes in with the tomatoes. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.
seg.7735dff0ccd2.t: हमर सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी एकरा गाढ़ लाल रंग आ एक समान, मध्यम तीख दैत अछि, आ टमाटरक संग कनेक हरदि बुकनी पड़ैत अछि। ई रेसिपी सँ करीब 1½ कप बनैत अछि।
seg.7735dff0ccd2.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and an even, medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes in with the tomatoes. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.

seg.44c4d82a4524.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the tomatoes to cool before grinding.
seg.44c4d82a4524.t: कुल समयमे पिसबा सँ पहिने टमाटर ठंढ़ा होमय लेल 5 मिनट जोड़ल अछि।
seg.44c4d82a4524.back: The total time includes 5 minutes for the tomatoes to cool before grinding.

seg.827e4421a48d.src: Fry dals and methi in oil, cook tomatoes down with turmeric and salt, then grind coarsely with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.827e4421a48d.t: दालि आ मेथी तेलमे भूजू, टमाटरकेँ हरदि आ नोनक संग गला कऽ पकाउ, फेर सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी, लहसुन आ इमलीक संग मोट पीसू। अन्तमे सरिसो आ करी पातक छौंक दिअ।
seg.827e4421a48d.back: Fry dal and fenugreek in oil, cook the tomatoes down with turmeric and salt, then grind coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. At the end give a tempering of mustard and curry leaves.

seg.4171dd59d18a.t: 2 पैघ चम्मच तेल ⟦1⟧मूँगफली वा तिलक तेल⟦/1⟧

seg.826b52ef9f19.src: ¼ tsp methi seeds ⟦1⟧fenugreek seeds; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.t: ¼ छोट चम्मच मेथी ⟦1⟧मेथीक दाना; एहि सँ बेसी नहि, नहि तँ पच्चडी तीत भऽ जायत⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek ⟦1⟧fenugreek seeds; not more than this, otherwise the pachadi will become bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.src: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.t: 5 टा मझोला टमाटर ⟦1⟧करीब 500 g, पाकल आ लाल, काटल⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.back: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧

seg.29558a247c61.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.t: 2 छोट चम्मच सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी ⟦1⟧बेसी तीख पच्चडी लेल 1 पैघ चम्मच धरि⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tablespoon for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧

seg.f7c3bb463ff4.t: कंचा जतेक इमली ⟦1⟧करीब 5 g, बीया निकालल⟦/1⟧
seg.f7c3bb463ff4.back: Tamarind as big as a marble ⟦1⟧about 5 g, seeds removed⟦/1⟧

seg.2f8f5bd3f25f.t: ¼ कप धनियाँ पात (मन हो तँ) ⟦1⟧मोट-मोट काटल⟦/1⟧
seg.2f8f5bd3f25f.back: ¼ cup coriander leaves (if you wish) ⟦1⟧coarsely chopped⟦/1⟧

seg.2c1074e3a23e.src: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a kadai on medium-low heat.
seg.2c1074e3a23e.t: कड़ाहीमे मध्यम-धीमा आँच पर 2 पैघ चम्मच तेल गरम करू।
seg.2c1074e3a23e.back: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a kadai on medium-low heat.

seg.9d0674551be0.src: Fry the urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil till golden; lift them out. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir all the time, as methi burns fast and turns bitter.
seg.9d0674551be0.t: उड़िदक दालि, चनाक दालि आ मेथी तेलमे सोनहुला होबा धरि भूजू; निकालि लिअ। एहिमे 2–3 मिनट लगैत अछि; लगातार चलाउ, किएक तँ मेथी जल्दी जरि कऽ तीत भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.9d0674551be0.back: Fry urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in the oil until golden; take them out. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir constantly, because fenugreek burns quickly and turns bitter.

seg.4727da6f2a95.src: In the same oil, add the chopped tomatoes and stir for a minute on medium heat.
seg.4727da6f2a95.t: ओही तेलमे काटल टमाटर डालू आ मध्यम आँच पर एक मिनट चलाउ।
seg.4727da6f2a95.back: In the same oil add the chopped tomatoes and stir one minute on medium heat.

seg.8032f2a2778c.src: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt till soft and the juice dries up. Cover for the first 5 minutes, then cook uncovered, stirring now and then, about 12–15 minutes in all, until the tomatoes are pulpy and oil shows at the edges.
seg.8032f2a2778c.t: टमाटरकेँ हरदि आ नोनक संग नरम होबा धरि आ रस सुखबा धरि पकाउ। पहिल 5 मिनट झाँपि दिअ, फेर बिनु झाँपने बीच-बीचमे चलबैत पकाउ, कुल करीब 12–15 मिनट, जा धरि टमाटर गुद्दा सन नहि भऽ जाय आ किनार पर तेल नहि देखाय।
seg.8032f2a2778c.back: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt until soft and until the juice dries up. Cover for the first 5 minutes, then cook uncovered stirring now and then, about 12–15 minutes in all, until the tomatoes become pulpy and oil shows at the edges.

seg.d606b6ac13a2.src: Switch off, stir in the tamarind so it softens in the heat, and let everything cool for about 5 minutes.
seg.d606b6ac13a2.t: आँच बन्द करू, इमली मिलाउ जाहि सँ ओ गरमीमे नरम भऽ जाय, आ सभटा करीब 5 मिनट ठंढ़ा होमय दिअ।
seg.d606b6ac13a2.back: Turn off the heat, mix in the tamarind so that it softens in the heat, and let everything cool about 5 minutes.

seg.c1820dcae462.src: In the stone roti or a mixer jar, first grind the fried dals and methi to a coarse powder.
seg.c1820dcae462.t: पाथरक रोटि वा मिक्सरक जारमे पहिने तरल दालि आ मेथीकेँ मोट बुकनी पीसि लिअ।
seg.c1820dcae462.back: On the grinding stone or in a mixer jar first grind the fried dal and fenugreek to a coarse powder.

seg.f07d8b97d1db.src: Grind the dals, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes coarsely. In a mixer, add the garlic, chilli powder and cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and pulse 4–5 times without water; stop while it still has texture. Stir in the coriander leaves, if using.
seg.f07d8b97d1db.t: दालि, लहसुन, इमली, मरचाइ बुकनी आ टमाटर मोट पीसू। मिक्सरमे दालिक बुकनीमे लहसुन, मरचाइ बुकनी आ पाकल टमाटर डालू आ बिनु पानिक 4–5 बेर थोड़-थोड़ चलाउ; बनावट रहिते रोकि दिअ। जँ लैत छी तँ धनियाँ पात मिलाउ।
seg.f07d8b97d1db.back: Grind dal, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes coarse. In the mixer add garlic, chilli powder and cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and pulse 4–5 times without water; stop while there is still texture. If you are using it mix in coriander leaves.

seg.6675d75425f6.src: Taste and adjust: a pinch more salt, or a little more chilli powder pulsed in, if you want it hotter.
seg.6675d75425f6.t: चीखि कऽ ठीक करू: एक चुटकी आओर नोन, वा बेसी तीख चाही तँ कनेक आओर मरचाइ बुकनी डालि कऽ एक बेर चलाउ।
seg.6675d75425f6.back: Taste and adjust: add another pinch of salt, or if you want more heat a little more chilli powder, and pulse once.

seg.27426b7ca3c6.src: Spoon the pachadi into a bowl. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a small pan and add the mustard seeds; when they splutter, add the urad dal and fry until golden.
seg.27426b7ca3c6.t: पच्चडी एकटा कटोरामे निकालू। छोट बर्तनमे 1 पैघ चम्मच तेल गरम करू आ सरिसो डालू; चटकय लागय तँ उड़िदक दालि डालि सोनहुला होबा धरि भूजू।
seg.27426b7ca3c6.back: Take the pachadi out into a bowl. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a small vessel and add mustard; when it starts to crackle add urad dal and fry until golden.

seg.77131f9506c3.src: Add the red chillies, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir for a few seconds.
seg.77131f9506c3.t: लाल मरचाइ, हींग आ करी पात डालू आ किछु सेकेंड चलाउ।
seg.77131f9506c3.back: Add red chilli, hing and curry leaves and stir a few seconds.

seg.d4a4b9439500.src: Temper with mustard, red chillies and curry leaves; pour over. Mix it in just before serving.
seg.d4a4b9439500.t: सरिसो, लाल मरचाइ आ करी पातक छौंक लगाउ; ऊपर सँ ढारि दिअ। परसबा सँ ठीक पहिने मिलाउ।
seg.d4a4b9439500.back: Temper mustard, red chilli and curry leaves; pour over the top. Mix just before serving.

seg.0f23e6b9231e.src: Cook the tomatoes till the juice dries up so the pachadi keeps longer and does not taste raw.
seg.0f23e6b9231e.t: टमाटरक रस सुखबा धरि पकाउ जाहि सँ पच्चडी बेसी दिन टिकय आ काँच नहि लागय।
seg.0f23e6b9231e.back: Cook until the tomato juice dries up so that the pachadi keeps more days and does not taste raw.

seg.bad083b47507.src: Ripe, deep-red tomatoes give the best colour; if yours are sour, cut the tamarind to half.
seg.bad083b47507.t: पाकल, गाढ़ लाल टमाटर सँ सभ सँ नीक रंग अबैत अछि; जँ अहाँक टमाटर खट्टा अछि तँ इमली आधा कऽ दिअ।
seg.bad083b47507.back: Ripe, deep red tomatoes give the best colour; if your tomatoes are sour halve the tamarind.

seg.99bd4830d431.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: a coarse pachadi is how Andhra homes like it, and a smooth paste loses that texture.
seg.99bd4830d431.t: थोड़-थोड़ चलाउ, मिक्सर लगातार नहि चलाउ: आन्ध्रक घरमे मोट पच्चडी पसिन्न कयल जाइत अछि, आ चिक्कन पेस्टमे ओ बनावट नहि रहैत अछि।
seg.99bd4830d431.back: Pulse little by little, do not run the mixer continuously: in Andhra homes a coarse pachadi is liked, and a smooth paste does not keep that texture.

seg.27f2aaa2d25d.src: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start at 2 tsp and add more after tasting; the heat settles a little as the pachadi rests.
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.t: सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी मध्यम तीख दैत अछि। 2 छोट चम्मच सँ शुरू करू आ चीखि कऽ आओर डालू; राखल रहला सँ तीख कनेक बैसि जाइत अछि।
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start with 2 teaspoons and taste and add more; on standing the heat settles a little.

seg.5e0bf03c1b36.src: Green chilli: replace the chilli powder with 4–5 green chillies, fried with the dals.
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.t: हरियर मरचाइ: मरचाइ बुकनीक बदला 4–5 टा हरियर मरचाइ लिअ, दालिक संग भूजल।
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.back: Green chilli: instead of chilli powder take 4–5 green chillies, fried with the dal.

seg.d7301a50c407.src: Onion-tomato: fry 1 sliced onion until soft before the tomatoes go in.
seg.d7301a50c407.t: पियाउज-टमाटर: टमाटर डालबा सँ पहिने 1 टा काटल पियाउज नरम होबा धरि भूजू।
seg.d7301a50c407.back: Onion-tomato: before adding tomatoes fry 1 chopped onion until soft.

seg.bc90e2638112.src: Hotter: use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder in place of 1 tsp of the Sannam; Teja is very hot, so go slowly.
seg.bc90e2638112.t: बेसी तीख: सन्नमक 1 छोट चम्मचक बदला 1 छोट चम्मच तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी लिअ; तेजा बड्ड तीख अछि, तेँ धीरे-धीरे बढ़ाउ।
seg.bc90e2638112.back: Hotter: instead of 1 teaspoon of the Sannam take 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder; Teja is very hot, so increase slowly.

seg.aab608a427a9.src: Without garlic: leave out the garlic and add a pinch more asafoetida to the tempering.
seg.aab608a427a9.t: बिनु लहसुनक: लहसुन छोड़ि दिअ आ छौंकमे एक चुटकी आओर हींग डालू।
seg.aab608a427a9.back: Without garlic: leave out the garlic and add one more pinch of hing to the tempering.

seg.62d9491c4e58.src: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with a little ghee, or serve alongside dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.
seg.62d9491c4e58.t: गरम भातमे कनेक घीक संग एक चम्मच सानू, वा डोसा, इडली, पेसरट्टु वा उपमाक संग परसू।
seg.62d9491c4e58.back: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with a little ghee, or serve with dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.

seg.3f0b892d2728.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.3f0b892d2728.t: साफ, सुखल शीशाक बोइयाममे फ्रिजमे राखू आ 4 दिनक भीतर खा लिअ। सदिखन सुखल चम्मच लगाउ।
seg.3f0b892d2728.back: Keep in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.20425f76c6e2.src: How do you make Andhra tomato pachadi?
seg.20425f76c6e2.t: आन्ध्रक टोमाटो पच्चडी कोना बनाओल जाइत अछि?
seg.20425f76c6e2.back: How is Andhra tomato pachadi made?

seg.32ae9ac6b03c.src: Fry urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil, cook chopped tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries up, then grind everything coarsely with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard, red chilli and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.t: उड़िदक दालि, चनाक दालि आ मेथी तेलमे भूजू, काटल टमाटर हरदि आ नोनक संग रस सुखबा धरि पकाउ, फेर सभटा मरचाइ बुकनी, लहसुन आ इमलीक संग मोट पीसू। अन्तमे सरिसो, लाल मरचाइ आ करी पातक छौंक दिअ।
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.back: Fry urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in oil, cook chopped tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries, then grind everything coarse with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. At the end give a tempering of mustard, red chilli and curry leaves.

seg.2e87824684cb.src: Why is my tomato pachadi bitter?
seg.2e87824684cb.t: हमर टोमाटो पच्चडी तीत किएक अछि?
seg.2e87824684cb.back: Why is my tomato pachadi bitter?

seg.b367557bedfc.src: Usually the methi seeds burnt or there were too many. Use only ¼ tsp for 500 g tomatoes and fry them on medium-low heat, lifting them out as soon as they turn golden.
seg.b367557bedfc.t: बेसी काल मेथी जरि गेल वा बेसी पड़ि गेल। 500 g टमाटर लेल मात्र ¼ छोट चम्मच लिअ आ मध्यम-धीमा आँच पर भूजू, सोनहुला होइते निकालि लिअ।
seg.b367557bedfc.back: Mostly the fenugreek burnt or too much went in. For 500 g tomatoes take only ¼ teaspoon and fry on medium-low heat, taking it out as soon as golden.

seg.acdf33e5cc6d.src: Can I make tomato pachadi without tamarind?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.t: की बिनु इमलीक टोमाटो पच्चडी बना सकैत छी?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.back: Can I make tomato pachadi without tamarind?

seg.53fbd8949e0b.src: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need the small piece of tamarind for balance.
seg.53fbd8949e0b.t: हँ, जँ अहाँक टमाटर पर्याप्त खट्टा अछि। पकेलाक बाद चीखू; पाकल, मीठ टमाटरकेँ सन्तुलन लेल इमलीक छोट टुकड़ा चाही।
seg.53fbd8949e0b.back: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need a small piece of tamarind for balance.

seg.2938c7a0249e.src: How long does tomato pachadi last?
seg.2938c7a0249e.t: टोमाटो पच्चडी कतेक दिन टिकैत अछि?
seg.2938c7a0249e.back: How many days does tomato pachadi keep?

seg.a35105e3a4af.src: About 4 days in the fridge in a clean, dry jar, as long as the tomatoes were cooked down well and you use a dry spoon.
seg.a35105e3a4af.t: साफ, सुखल बोइयाममे फ्रिजमे करीब 4 दिन, जँ टमाटर नीक जकाँ गला कऽ पकाओल गेल हो आ अहाँ सुखल चम्मच लगबैत होइ।
seg.a35105e3a4af.back: About 4 days in a clean, dry jar in the fridge, if the tomatoes were cooked down well and you use a dry spoon.

seg.de4e2a65c3ae.src: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra tomato pachadi: tomatoes cooked down with turmeric powder, ground coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.t: టమాటా పచ్చడి. आन्ध्रक टोमाटो पच्चडी: हरदि बुकनीक संग गला कऽ पकाओल टमाटर, सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी, लहसुन आ इमलीक संग मोट पिसल, फेर छौंक लगाओल।
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.back: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra's tomato pachadi: tomatoes cooked down with turmeric powder, ground coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.

seg.03de1ac75259.src: Tomato Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.03de1ac75259.t: टोमाटो पच्चडी: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.03de1ac75259.back: Tomato Pachadi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.6357099a14e8.t: ¼ कप धनियाँ पात (मन हो तँ)
seg.6357099a14e8.back: ¼ cup coriander leaves (if you wish)

seg.3d323a4b41cc.src: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, mashed smooth and finished with a garlic tempering. It is cooked most days of the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or a pickle on the side.
seg.3d323a4b41cc.t: टोमाटो पप्पु आन्ध्रक घरक रोजुक दालि अछि: अरहरिक दालि (कंदि पप्पु) टमाटर आ हरियर मरचाइक संग नरम पकाओल, चिक्कन मसलल आ अन्तमे लहसुनक छौंक। ई सप्ताहक बेसी दिन बनैत अछि आ गरम भात, एक चम्मच घी आ संगमे अप्पडम वा अचारक संग खाएल जाइत अछि।
seg.3d323a4b41cc.back: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) cooked soft with tomato and green chilli, mashed smooth and a garlic tempering at the end. It is made most days of the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and appadam or pickle alongside.

seg.734276af9399.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder adds a red tinge and a steady, medium heat that sits behind the sour tomato. This recipe serves 4.
seg.734276af9399.t: हमर हरदि बुकनी दालिक संग कुकरमे पड़ैत अछि आ एकरा गाढ़ पीयर रंग दैत अछि। सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी हल्लुक लाल झलक आ एक समान, मध्यम तीख दैत अछि जे खट्टा टमाटरक पाछू रहैत अछि। ई रेसिपी 4 लोक लेल अछि।
seg.734276af9399.back: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder gives a light red tinge and an even, medium heat that stays behind the sour tomato. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.8c5a5da215b1.src: Total includes letting the cooker release its steam.
seg.8c5a5da215b1.t: कुल समयमे कुकरक भाप निकलबाक समय सेहो जोड़ल अछि।
seg.8c5a5da215b1.back: The total time also includes the time for the cooker's steam to release.

seg.2c1a760b1cf8.src: Pressure-cook toor dal with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder, mash it with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and finish with a garlic and mustard tempering.
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.t: अरहरिक दालि टमाटर, हरियर मरचाइ आ हरदि बुकनीक संग प्रेशर कुकरमे पकाउ, सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी आ नोनक संग मसलू, आ अन्तमे लहसुन आ सरिसोक छौंक दिअ।
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.back: Cook toor dal in a pressure cooker with tomato, green chilli and turmeric powder, mash with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and at the end give a tempering of garlic and mustard.

seg.d102a6fa5887.src: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.t: ¾ कप अरहरिक दालि ⟦1⟧कंदि पप्पु, करीब 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.back: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧

seg.258b0303a820.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes in the cooker⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.t: ½ छोट चम्मच हरदि बुकनी ⟦1⟧कुकरमे पड़ैत अछि⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes into the cooker⟦/1⟧

seg.25c2493b65be.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧goes in after mashing; up to 2 tsp for more heat⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.t: 1 छोट चम्मच सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी ⟦1⟧मसललाक बाद पड़ैत अछि; बेसी तीख लेल 2 छोट चम्मच धरि⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧goes in after mashing; up to 2 teaspoons for more heat⟦/1⟧

seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧plus ½ cup to adjust⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.t: 2½ कप पानि ⟦1⟧आ ठीक करबा लेल ½ कप⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧and ½ cup for adjusting⟦/1⟧

seg.5f7d589d9776.src: 1 tbsp tamarind water (optional) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.t: 1 पैघ चम्मच इमलीक पानि (मन हो तँ) ⟦1⟧जँ टमाटर बेसी खट्टा नहि अछि⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.back: 1 tablespoon tamarind water (if you wish) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧

seg.4efa92e0ce99.src: Wash the toor dal in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.4efa92e0ce99.t: अरहरिक दालि 2–3 बेर पानि बदलि कऽ धोउ आ पानि निथारि लिअ।
seg.4efa92e0ce99.back: Wash the toor dal changing the water 2–3 times and drain the water.

seg.3f536116a096.src: Put the dal in a pressure cooker with the tomatoes, green chillies, onion and 2½ cups of water.
seg.3f536116a096.t: दालिकेँ टमाटर, हरियर मरचाइ, पियाउज आ 2½ कप पानिक संग प्रेशर कुकरमे राखू।
seg.3f536116a096.back: Put the dal in a pressure cooker with tomato, green chilli, onion and 2½ cups water.

seg.7d012f63f2a2.src: Pressure-cook the dal with the tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder for 4 whistles. Stir the turmeric powder into the water before closing the lid, then cook on medium heat.
seg.7d012f63f2a2.t: दालिकेँ टमाटर, हरियर मरचाइ आ हरदि बुकनीक संग प्रेशर कुकरमे 4 सीटी धरि पकाउ। झाँपन लगेबा सँ पहिने पानिमे हरदि बुकनी मिला दिअ, फेर मध्यम आँच पर पकाउ।
seg.7d012f63f2a2.back: Cook the dal in a pressure cooker with tomato, green chilli and turmeric powder for 4 whistles. Mix the turmeric powder into the water before putting on the lid, then cook on medium heat.

seg.5dccba018dbc.src: Let the pressure drop on its own, about 10 minutes. The dal is done when a grain mashes completely between two fingers.
seg.5dccba018dbc.t: प्रेशर अपने उतरय दिअ, करीब 10 मिनट। दालि तखन पाकल अछि जखन एकटा दाना दू आंगुरक बीच पूरा मसला जाय।
seg.5dccba018dbc.back: Let the pressure release by itself, about 10 minutes. The dal is cooked when a grain mashes completely between two fingers.

seg.da76f4c700ad.src: Mash well; add the chilli powder and salt. Use a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle and mash while the dal is still hot, until the tomatoes and dal turn into one smooth mix.
seg.da76f4c700ad.t: नीक जकाँ मसलू; मरचाइ बुकनी आ नोन डालू। काठक घोटना (पप्पु गुत्ति) वा करछुलक पाछू सँ दालि गरम रहिते मसलू, जा धरि टमाटर आ दालि मिलि कऽ एक चिक्कन मिश्रण नहि बनि जाय।
seg.da76f4c700ad.back: Mash well; add chilli powder and salt. With a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle mash the dal while still hot, until tomato and dal blend into one smooth mixture.

seg.c1cb2443fbeb.src: Simmer 5 minutes with a splash of water. Add up to ½ cup water for a pouring consistency, and the tamarind water if using, and keep the heat on low so it does not catch.
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.t: कनेक पानि डालि 5 मिनट धीमा आँच पर पकाउ। ढारबा जोगर गाढ़पन लेल ½ कप धरि पानि डालू, आ जँ लैत छी तँ इमलीक पानि, आ आँच धीमा राखू जाहि सँ तलीमे नहि सटय।
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.back: Add a little water and cook 5 minutes on low heat. For a pourable thickness add up to ½ cup water, and if you are using it tamarind water, and keep the heat low so it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.b24472a45a67.src: Taste for salt and sourness, then stir in the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.b24472a45a67.t: नोन आ खट्टापन चीखू, फेर धनियाँ पात मिलाउ आ आँच बन्द करू।
seg.b24472a45a67.back: Taste for salt and sourness, then mix in coriander leaves and turn off the heat.

seg.6f90b7e4f66a.src: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium heat and add the mustard seeds; let them splutter.
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.t: छोट बर्तनमे मध्यम आँच पर घी गरम करू आ सरिसो डालू; चटकय दिअ।
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.back: Heat ghee in a small vessel on medium heat and add mustard; let it crackle.

seg.0d1dd3c84a64.src: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in the ghee; pour over. Add the cumin, garlic and dry red chillies after the mustard and fry until the garlic turns golden, then add the curry leaves and hing, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.t: सरिसो, जीर, लहसुन आ करी पात घीमे भूजू; ऊपर सँ ढारि दिअ। सरिसोक बाद जीर, लहसुन आ सुखल लाल मरचाइ डालू आ लहसुन सोनहुला होबा धरि भूजू, फेर करी पात आ हींग डालू, आ छनछनाइत छौंक दालि पर ढारि दिअ।
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.back: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in ghee; pour over the top. After the mustard add cumin, garlic and dried red chilli and fry until the garlic is golden, then add curry leaves and hing, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.

seg.81a1668adc10.src: Cover for 2 minutes so the tempering flavours the dal, then stir and serve hot.
seg.81a1668adc10.t: 2 मिनट झाँपि दिअ जाहि सँ छौंकक स्वाद दालिमे पैसि जाय, फेर मिला कऽ गरम-गरम परसू।
seg.81a1668adc10.back: Cover 2 minutes so that the tempering's flavour gets into the dal, then mix and serve piping hot.

seg.f904a5f14a1b.src: Mash the dal while it is hot for a smooth pappu. Once it cools, the grains set and stay lumpy.
seg.f904a5f14a1b.t: चिक्कन पप्पु लेल दालि गरम रहिते मसलू। ठंढ़ा भेला पर दाना जमि जाइत अछि आ गुलठीदार रहि जाइत अछि।
seg.f904a5f14a1b.back: For a smooth pappu mash the dal while still hot. Once cool the grains set and stay lumpy.

seg.1a8211877e00.src: Sannam chilli powder is medium-hot. Start with 1 tsp; go up to 2 tsp for a spicier pappu.
seg.1a8211877e00.t: सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी मध्यम तीख अछि। 1 छोट चम्मच सँ शुरू करू; बेसी तीख पप्पु लेल 2 छोट चम्मच धरि।
seg.1a8211877e00.back: Sannam chilli powder is medium hot. Start with 1 teaspoon; up to 2 teaspoons for a hotter pappu.

seg.d85da2ea2cf7.src: Ripe, sour country tomatoes (natu tomatoes) give the best flavour; with mild hybrid tomatoes add the tamarind water.
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.t: पाकल, खट्टा देसी टमाटर (नाटु टमाटर) सँ सभ सँ नीक स्वाद अबैत अछि; कम खट्टा हाइब्रिड टमाटरक संग इमलीक पानि डालू।
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.back: Ripe, sour country tomatoes (natu tomatoes) give the best flavour; with less sour hybrid tomatoes add tamarind water.

seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.src: Let the garlic turn golden in the tempering before the curry leaves go in; pale garlic tastes raw.
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.t: करी पात डालबा सँ पहिने छौंकमे लहसुनकेँ सोनहुला होमय दिअ; हल्लुक रंगक लहसुन काँच लगैत अछि।
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.back: Let the garlic turn golden in the tempering before adding curry leaves; light-coloured garlic tastes raw.

seg.dfd3706fe457.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu, use ½ tsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not go over 1 tsp.
seg.dfd3706fe457.t: तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी: बेसी तीख पप्पु लेल सन्नमक बदला ½ छोट चम्मच तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी लिअ। तेजा बड्ड तीख अछि, तेँ 1 छोट चम्मच सँ बेसी नहि लिअ।
seg.dfd3706fe457.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu take ½ teaspoon Teja chilli powder instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not take more than 1 teaspoon.

seg.434f1a510bbb.src: Palakura tomato pappu: add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal after mashing and simmer 5 minutes.
seg.434f1a510bbb.t: पालकूरा टोमाटो पप्पु: मसललाक बाद दालिमे 2 कप काटल पालक डालू आ 5 मिनट धीमा आँच पर पकाउ।
seg.434f1a510bbb.back: Palakura tomato pappu: after mashing add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal and cook 5 minutes on low heat.

seg.8d7a932afdbe.src: Pesarapappu: make it with yellow moong dal and cook for 2 whistles only.
seg.8d7a932afdbe.t: पेसरपप्पु: पीयर मूँग दालि सँ बनाउ आ मात्र 2 सीटी धरि पकाउ।
seg.8d7a932afdbe.back: Pesarapappu: make it with yellow moong dal and cook only up to 2 whistles.

seg.94f44314ecbb.src: Serve hot with steamed rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or avakaya on the side. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.94f44314ecbb.t: भापमे पाकल भात, एक चम्मच घी आ संगमे अप्पडम वा आवकायक संग गरम-गरम परसू। रोटीक संग सेहो नीक लगैत अछि।
seg.94f44314ecbb.back: Serve piping hot with steamed rice, a spoon of ghee and appadam or avakaya alongside. It is also good with roti.

seg.29a23e2fa864.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. The dal thickens when chilled; add a little hot water and heat through before serving.
seg.29a23e2fa864.t: बचल दालि झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे राखू आ 2 दिनक भीतर खा लिअ। ठंढ़ा भेला पर दालि गाढ़ भऽ जाइत अछि; परसबा सँ पहिने कनेक गरम पानि डालि नीक जकाँ गरम करू।
seg.29a23e2fa864.back: Keep leftover dal covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Dal thickens when cold; before serving add a little hot water and heat well.

seg.8e56f1d7c871.src: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.t: प्रेशर कुकरमे अरहरिक दालि लेल कतेक सीटी?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.back: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?

seg.562abdd39933.src: About 4 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own. Older dal or dal that was not washed well may need 5.
seg.562abdd39933.t: मध्यम आँच पर करीब 4 सीटी, फेर प्रेशर अपने उतरय दिअ। पुरान दालि वा नीक जकाँ नहि धोअल दालिकेँ 5 सीटी लागि सकैत अछि।
seg.562abdd39933.back: About 4 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure release by itself. Old dal or dal not washed well may need 5 whistles.

seg.6a800f643cf1.src: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?
seg.6a800f643cf1.t: टोमाटो पप्पु आ सांबरमे की अन्तर अछि?
seg.6a800f643cf1.back: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?

seg.05135ac52968.src: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal with a simple tempering and no sambar powder or vegetables. Sambar is thinner, uses tamarind, vegetables and a roasted spice powder.
seg.05135ac52968.t: टोमाटो पप्पु गाढ़, मसलल दालि अछि जाहिमे सादा छौंक होइत अछि आ सांबर मसाला वा तरकारी नहि पड़ैत अछि। सांबर बेसी पातर होइत अछि, जाहिमे इमली, तरकारी आ भूजल मसालाक बुकनी पड़ैत अछि।
seg.05135ac52968.back: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal with a plain tempering and no sambar masala or vegetables. Sambar is thinner, with tamarind, vegetables and roasted spice powder.

seg.19117f898a31.src: Can I make tomato pappu without a pressure cooker?
seg.19117f898a31.t: की बिनु प्रेशर कुकरक टोमाटो पप्पु बना सकैत छी?
seg.19117f898a31.back: Can I make tomato pappu without a pressure cooker?

seg.631df239c7a7.src: Yes. Soak the dal for 30 minutes and cook it in a covered pot with 3½ cups of water for about 40–45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it mashes easily.
seg.631df239c7a7.t: हँ। दालि 30 मिनट भिजाउ आ झाँपल पतीलमे 3½ कप पानिक संग करीब 40–45 मिनट पकाउ, बीच-बीचमे चलबैत, जा धरि आसानी सँ मसला नहि जाय।
seg.631df239c7a7.back: Yes. Soak the dal 30 minutes and cook in a covered pot with 3½ cups water for about 40–45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it mashes easily.

seg.b1140d6c02b4.src: Why is my tomato pappu too sour?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.t: हमर टोमाटो पप्पु बेसी खट्टा किएक अछि?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.back: Why is my tomato pappu too sour?

seg.6fb0505bf751.src: Some tomatoes are very sour. Simmer the dal a few more minutes and stir in a pinch of jaggery or a spoon of extra mashed dal to balance it.
seg.6fb0505bf751.t: किछु टमाटर बहुत खट्टा होइत अछि। दालि किछु मिनट आओर धीमा आँच पर पकाउ आ सन्तुलन लेल एक चुटकी गुड़ वा एक चम्मच बेसी मसलल दालि मिलाउ।
seg.6fb0505bf751.back: Some tomatoes are very sour. Cook the dal a few minutes more on low heat and for balance mix in a pinch of jaggery or a spoon more of mashed dal.

seg.80a51a64344d.t: టమాటో పప్పు · आन्ध्रक टमाटरबला दालिक रेसिपी | 1acrefarms

seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.t: టమాటో పప్పు. आन्ध्रक टमाटरबला दालि: अरहरिक दालि टमाटर आ हरियर मरचाइ, हमर हरदि आ सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनीक संग नरम पकाओल, आ लहसुनक छौंक। 4 लोक लेल।
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.back: టమాటో పప్పు. Andhra's tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomato and green chilli, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, and a garlic tempering. For 4 people.
