seg.9078b361da10.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Vellulli Kaaram · Lahsun Ki Sookhi Chutney
seg.9078b361da10.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · वेल्लुल्ली कारम · लहसुन की सूखी चटनी

seg.464f01dcf4e8.src: Vellulli kaaram is the garlic chilli podi kept on Andhra dining tables: red chilli powder pounded with plenty of garlic, roasted coriander and cumin, and salt. Mixed into the first handful of hot rice with ghee, or sprinkled over idli and dosa with a little oil, it is a quick meal on busy days and a staple in tiffin boxes.
seg.464f01dcf4e8.t: वेल्लुल्ली कारम लहसुन-मरचाइक पोडि अछि जे आन्ध्रक खेनाइक टेबुल पर राखल रहैत अछि: लाल मरचाइ बुकनी खूब रास लहसुन, भूजल धनियाँ आ जीर, आ नोनक संग कूटल। घीक संग गरम भातक पहिल कौरमे सानल, वा कनेक तेलक संग इडली आ डोसा पर छीटल, ई व्यस्त दिनमे झटपट भोजन अछि आ टिफिन बक्साक नियमित संगी।
seg.464f01dcf4e8.back: Vellulli karam is the garlic-chilli podi kept on the Andhra dining table: red chilli powder pounded with plenty of garlic, roasted coriander and cumin, and salt. Mixed into the first mouthful of hot rice with ghee, or sprinkled on idli and dosa with a little oil, it is a quick meal on busy days and a regular companion of the tiffin box.

seg.a9654adade5e.src: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, the way Guntur homes like it. For less heat, use half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.a9654adade5e.t: हमर तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी एकरा गाढ़ लाल आ बड्ड तीख बनबैत अछि, जेना गुंटूरक घरमे पसिन्न अछि। कम तीख लेल आधा सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी लिअ।
seg.a9654adade5e.back: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, as liked in Guntur homes. For less heat take half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.b43a6fdf4164.src: Total includes cooling the seeds and garlic before grinding.
seg.b43a6fdf4164.t: कुल समयमे पिसबा सँ पहिने मसालाक दाना आ लहसुन ठंढ़ा करबाक समय सेहो जोड़ल अछि।
seg.b43a6fdf4164.back: The total time also includes the time to cool the spice seeds and garlic before grinding.

seg.501bcac1011e.src: Roast coriander and cumin, grind them, then pulse with Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic into a coarse podi. Eat it with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.
seg.501bcac1011e.t: धनियाँ आ जीर भूजू, पीसू, फेर तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी, नोन आ हल्लुक गरम कयल लहसुनक संग थोड़-थोड़ चला कऽ मोट पोडि बनाउ। गरम भात आ घी, इडली वा डोसाक संग खाउ।
seg.501bcac1011e.back: Roast coriander and cumin, grind, then pulse little by little with Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic to make a coarse podi. Eat with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.

seg.e9ce857fe180.src: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the thin inner skin can stay⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.t: 25 टा लहसुनक कली ⟦1⟧करीब ½ कप, छीलल; भीतरक पातर छिलका रहि सकैत अछि⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.back: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the thin inner skin can stay⟦/1⟧

seg.47382aff4c0b.src: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips to make it milder⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.t: ¼ कप तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी ⟦1⟧बड्ड तीख; कम तीख करबा लेल सुझाव देखू⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.back: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips to make it less hot⟦/1⟧

seg.33ac26ca8201.t: 1 टा छोट कंचा जतेक इमली (मन हो तँ) ⟦1⟧सुखल, बीया निकालल⟦/1⟧
seg.33ac26ca8201.back: 1 small marble-sized piece of tamarind (if you wish) ⟦1⟧dry, seeds removed⟦/1⟧

seg.7bca54595a6a.src: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 tsp per serving⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.t: घी वा तेल ⟦1⟧हर परोस लेल 1 छोट चम्मच⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.back: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon per serving⟦/1⟧

seg.074d39a3f8b1.src: Peel the garlic and pat the cloves completely dry with a cloth; any water shortens how long the podi keeps.
seg.074d39a3f8b1.t: लहसुन छीलू आ कलीकेँ कपड़ा सँ थपथपा कऽ पूरा सुखा लिअ; कनेको पानि रहला सँ पोडि कम दिन टिकैत अछि।
seg.074d39a3f8b1.back: Peel the garlic and pat the cloves completely dry with a cloth; even a little water left makes the podi keep fewer days.

seg.33bb0e9eea87.src: Dry-roast the coriander and cumin seeds till fragrant; let them cool. Use a small pan on medium-low heat; this takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander should turn a shade darker, not brown.
seg.33bb0e9eea87.t: साबुत धनियाँ आ जीर बिनु तेलक सुगन्ध आबय धरि भूजू; ठंढ़ा होमय दिअ। मध्यम-धीमा आँच पर छोट पैन लिअ; एहिमे 1–2 मिनट लगैत अछि, आ धनियाँ एक रंग गाढ़ हेबाक चाही, भूर नहि।
seg.33bb0e9eea87.back: Dry-roast whole coriander and cumin without oil until fragrant; let cool. Take a small pan on medium-low heat; this takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander should become one shade darker, not brown.

seg.a2f7a86fc993.src: Warm the garlic in 1 tsp oil for 2 minutes. Keep the heat low and stir; the cloves should soften slightly at the edges without browning. Let it cool.
seg.a2f7a86fc993.t: लहसुनकेँ 1 छोट चम्मच तेलमे 2 मिनट गरम करू। आँच धीमा राखू आ चलाउ; कली किनार पर कनेक नरम हेबाक चाही, भूर नहि। ठंढ़ा होमय दिअ।
seg.a2f7a86fc993.back: Warm the garlic in 1 teaspoon oil for 2 minutes. Keep the heat low and stir; the cloves should soften a little at the edges, not brown. Let cool.

seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.src: Grind the seeds to a powder, then pulse with the chilli powder and salt. Add the tamarind with the seeds, if using, so it breaks down evenly.
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.t: मसालाक दाना पीसि कऽ बुकनी बनाउ, फेर मरचाइ बुकनी आ नोनक संग थोड़-थोड़ चलाउ। जँ इमली लैत छी तँ दानाक संगे डालू, जाहि सँ ओ एक समान पिसा जाय।
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.back: Grind the spice seeds to a powder, then pulse little by little with chilli powder and salt. If you are using tamarind add it together with the seeds, so it grinds evenly.

seg.c12763cab28c.src: Add the garlic and pulse in short bursts to a coarse, moist powder. Stop and scrape down the jar after every 2–3 pulses, as garlic sticks to the sides.
seg.c12763cab28c.t: लहसुन डालू आ छोट-छोट झटका दैत चला कऽ मोट, सिनगर बुकनी बनाउ। हर 2–3 बेर चलेलाक बाद रोकि कऽ जारक किनार सँ खुरचि लिअ, किएक तँ लहसुन किनार पर सटि जाइत अछि।
seg.c12763cab28c.back: Add the garlic and pulse in short bursts to make a coarse, moist powder. After every 2–3 pulses stop and scrape down the sides of the jar, because the garlic sticks to the sides.

seg.31358182425b.src: In a stone mortar, pound the seeds first, then the garlic with the salt, and work in the chilli powder last.
seg.31358182425b.t: पाथरक ओखरिमे पहिने दाना कूटू, फेर नोनक संग लहसुन, आ अन्तमे मरचाइ बुकनी मिलाउ।
seg.31358182425b.back: In a stone mortar first pound the seeds, then the garlic with salt, and at the end mix in the chilli powder.

seg.29ac6dd20660.src: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.
seg.29ac6dd20660.t: कनेक भात आ घीक संग एक चुटकी चीखू, आ जरूरति हो तँ नोन डालू।
seg.29ac6dd20660.back: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.

seg.b4ccc3b591dd.src: Spread the podi on a plate for 10 minutes so the steam escapes, then pack it into a clean, dry jar.
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.t: पोडिकेँ थारी पर 10 मिनट पसारि दिअ जाहि सँ भाप निकलि जाय, फेर साफ, सुखल बोइयाममे भरि दिअ।
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.back: Spread the podi on a plate for 10 minutes so that the steam escapes, then fill into a clean, dry jar.

seg.23d348ffe051.src: Teja is very hot; use half Sannam for a milder podi, or cut the chilli powder to 3 tbsp for the same garlic.
seg.23d348ffe051.t: तेजा बड्ड तीख अछि; कम तीख पोडि लेल आधा सन्नम लिअ, वा ओतबे लहसुन लेल मरचाइ बुकनी घटा कऽ 3 पैघ चम्मच करू।
seg.23d348ffe051.back: Teja is very hot; for a less hot podi take half Sannam, or for the same amount of garlic reduce the chilli powder to 3 tablespoons.

seg.948075d5f572.src: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; damp garlic makes the podi go off quickly.
seg.948075d5f572.t: लहसुन नीक जकाँ सुखाउ आ तेलमे गरम करू; भीजल लहसुन सँ पोडि जल्दी खराब भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.948075d5f572.back: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; wet garlic makes the podi spoil quickly.

seg.1a71c64c8c74.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: run it long and the garlic turns into a paste.
seg.1a71c64c8c74.t: थोड़-थोड़ चलाउ, मिक्सर लगातार नहि चलाउ: बेसी काल चलेला सँ लहसुन पेस्ट बनि जाइत अछि।
seg.1a71c64c8c74.back: Pulse little by little, do not run the mixer continuously: running it long turns the garlic into a paste.

seg.d1432fb9a627.src: Mix 1 tsp podi with 1 tsp ghee into a cup of hot rice; adjust to taste.
seg.d1432fb9a627.t: एक कप गरम भातमे 1 छोट चम्मच पोडि आ 1 छोट चम्मच घी सानू; स्वाद अनुसार घटाउ-बढ़ाउ।
seg.d1432fb9a627.back: Mix 1 teaspoon podi and 1 teaspoon ghee into a cup of hot rice; adjust to taste.

seg.bdc5e9728b98.src: With dals: dry-roast 1 tbsp chana dal and 1 tbsp urad dal with the seeds for a nuttier, slightly milder podi.
seg.bdc5e9728b98.t: दालिक संग: बेसी भुनल मेवा सन आ कनेक कम तीख पोडि लेल दानाक संग 1 पैघ चम्मच चनाक दालि आ 1 पैघ चम्मच उड़िदक दालि बिनु तेलक भूजू।
seg.bdc5e9728b98.back: With dal: for a more roasted-nut-like and slightly less hot podi dry-roast 1 tablespoon chana dal and 1 tablespoon urad dal without oil with the seeds.

seg.4d03eacf7428.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste, and eat it within a week.
seg.4d03eacf7428.t: काँच लहसुन: बेसी तेज स्वाद लेल लहसुन गरम नहि करू, आ एक सप्ताहक भीतर खा लिअ।
seg.4d03eacf7428.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper flavour do not warm the garlic, and eat within a week.

seg.21139bdcd961.src: Medium heat: use 2 tbsp Teja and 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder.
seg.21139bdcd961.t: मध्यम तीख: 2 पैघ चम्मच तेजा आ 2 पैघ चम्मच सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी लिअ।
seg.21139bdcd961.back: Medium heat: take 2 tablespoons Teja and 2 tablespoons Sannam chilli powder.

seg.bceea7c8cb4f.src: Mix with the first handful of hot rice and ghee, or sprinkle over idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.t: गरम भात आ घीक पहिल कौरमे सानू, वा कनेक तेल वा घीक संग इडली, डोसा वा पेसरट्टु पर छीटू।
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.back: Mix into the first mouthful of hot rice and ghee, or sprinkle on idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.

seg.5fd9cf1554fd.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar for about 2 weeks at room temperature, or a month in the fridge. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.t: साफ, सुखल, हवाबन्द बोइयाममे कोठलीक तापमान पर करीब 2 सप्ताह, वा फ्रिजमे एक मास धरि राखू। सदिखन सुखल चम्मच लगाउ।
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar at room temperature about 2 weeks, or in the fridge up to a month. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.c58bc6538b2f.src: How do you make vellulli kaaram?
seg.c58bc6538b2f.t: वेल्लुल्ली कारम कोना बनाओल जाइत अछि?

seg.0ecd3203de93.src: Roast coriander and cumin seeds, grind them, add chilli powder and salt, then pulse in peeled garlic cloves to a coarse, moist powder. Andhra homes often pound it in a stone mortar.
seg.0ecd3203de93.t: साबुत धनियाँ आ जीर भूजू, पीसू, मरचाइ बुकनी आ नोन डालू, फेर छीलल लहसुनक कली डालि थोड़-थोड़ चला कऽ मोट, सिनगर बुकनी बनाउ। आन्ध्रक घरमे बेसी काल एकरा पाथरक ओखरिमे कूटल जाइत अछि।
seg.0ecd3203de93.back: Roast whole coriander and cumin, grind, add chilli powder and salt, then add peeled garlic cloves and pulse little by little to make a coarse, moist powder. In Andhra homes it is mostly pounded in a stone mortar.

seg.727d415cb888.src: How do I make garlic podi less spicy?
seg.727d415cb888.t: लहसुनक पोडिकेँ कम तीख कोना बनाउ?
seg.727d415cb888.back: How to make garlic podi less hot?

seg.e4231ea5cf7a.src: Use half Sannam chilli powder in place of half the Teja, or use 3 tbsp chilli powder in all. Eating it with plenty of ghee also takes the edge off.
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.t: आधा तेजाक बदला आधा सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी लिअ, वा कुल 3 पैघ चम्मच मरचाइ बुकनी लिअ। खूब घीक संग खेला सँ सेहो झाँस कम भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.back: Take half Sannam chilli powder instead of half the Teja, or take 3 tablespoons chilli powder in total. Eating it with plenty of ghee also reduces the bite.

seg.982e854e4417.src: How long does vellulli kaaram last?
seg.982e854e4417.t: वेल्लुल्ली कारम कतेक दिन टिकैत अछि?
seg.982e854e4417.back: How many days does vellulli karam keep?

seg.a620f29950c0.src: About 2 weeks at room temperature in a dry, airtight jar, or a month in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first so it lasts longer.
seg.a620f29950c0.t: सुखल, हवाबन्द बोइयाममे कोठलीक तापमान पर करीब 2 सप्ताह, वा फ्रिजमे एक मास। लहसुन नीक जकाँ सुखाउ आ पहिने तेलमे गरम करू जाहि सँ बेसी दिन टिकय।
seg.a620f29950c0.back: About 2 weeks in a dry, airtight jar at room temperature, or a month in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first so it keeps longer.

seg.4c626acd1bdd.src: Can I use whole dried red chillies instead of chilli powder?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.t: की मरचाइ बुकनीक बदला साबुत सुखल लाल मरचाइ प्रयोग कऽ सकैत छी?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.back: Can I use whole dried red chillies instead of chilli powder?

seg.c796942589c3.src: Yes. Dry-roast about 20 dried red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.c796942589c3.t: हँ। करीब 20 टा सुखल लाल मरचाइ किछु बुन्न तेलक संग कुरकुर होबा धरि भूजू, ठंढ़ा करू आ लहसुन डालबा सँ पहिने पीसि लिअ।
seg.c796942589c3.back: Yes. Fry about 20 dried red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind before adding the garlic.

seg.c5afa85ab56d.src: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra garlic chilli podi: roasted coriander and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Mix with hot rice and ghee, or idli and dosa.
seg.c5afa85ab56d.t: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. आन्ध्रक लहसुन-मरचाइ पोडि: भूजल धनियाँ आ जीर, लहसुन, नोन आ तेजा मरचाइ बुकनीक संग कूटल। गरम भात आ घीमे सानू, वा इडली आ डोसाक संग खाउ।
seg.c5afa85ab56d.back: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra's garlic-chilli podi: roasted coriander and cumin, pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Mix into hot rice and ghee, or eat with idli and dosa.

seg.eff09f5a48ed.src: Vellulli Kaaram: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.eff09f5a48ed.t: वेल्लुल्ली कारम: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.eff09f5a48ed.back: Vellulli Karam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.2b0c8026598d.t: 1 टा छोट कंचा जतेक इमली (मन हो तँ)
seg.2b0c8026598d.back: 1 small marble-sized piece of tamarind (if you wish)

seg.3b01a30ec3ce.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge while it rests.
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.t: चिकनमे दही, तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी, हरदि बुकनी आ नोन मलि दिअ। 30 मिनट राखि दिअ। बर्तन झाँपि दिअ आ जा धरि राखल रहय, ता धरि फ्रिजमे राखू।
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.back: Rub curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt into the chicken. Keep it for 30 minutes. Cover the vessel and for as long as it is kept, keep it in the fridge.

seg.6cceb77cd01b.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.t: 500 g माछक टुकड़ा ⟦1⟧कड़ा माछ, मोट टुकड़ामे काटल: रोहु, भाकुर (बोच्चा), कोरमीनु (सौरा) वा सुरमई (वंजरम)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish, cut into thick pieces: rohu, bhakur (bochcha), korameenu (saura) or surmai (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.3248f0a2bb4b.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.t: 40 g इमली ⟦1⟧नेबो जतेक पैघ करीब दूटा गोला, 2 कप गुनगुन पानिमे 15 मिनट भिजाओल⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two balls as big as a lemon, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups of lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.6efbfa504170.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring, until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.6efbfa504170.t: बचल माछ झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे राखू आ 2 दिनक भीतर खा लिअ। पैनमे धीरे-धीरे, बिनु चलौने, गरम करू, जा धरि भीतर धरि पूरा भाप उठय एहन गरम नहि भऽ जाय।
seg.6efbfa504170.back: Cover the leftover fish, keep it in the fridge and eat it within 2 days. Heat it in a pan slowly, without stirring, until it becomes so hot that steam rises fully right to the inside.

seg.379b410c6994.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), murrel (korameenu) or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.379b410c6994.t: मोट टुकड़ामे काटल कड़ा नदी वा समुद्रक माछ: रोहु, भाकुर (बोच्चा), सौरा (कोरमीनु) वा सुरमई। काँटबला छोट माछ सेहो चलैत अछि मुदा हल्लुक हाथ सँ सम्हारऽ पड़ैत अछि।
seg.379b410c6994.back: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick pieces: rohu, bhakur (bochcha), saura (korameenu) or surmai. Small bony fish also work but have to be handled with a light hand.

seg.3af5b68fc2e1.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu in a pan with a splash of water until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.t: बचल पुलुसु झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे राखू आ 2 दिनक भीतर खा लिअ। पैनमे कनेक पानि डालि गरम करू, जा धरि भीतर धरि पूरा भाप उठय एहन गरम नहि भऽ जाय।
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.back: Cover the leftover pulusu, keep it in the fridge and eat it within 2 days. Heat it in a pan adding a little water, until it becomes so hot that steam rises fully right to the inside.

seg.b4d28033bb05.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, until tender, then fry it the same way.
seg.b4d28033bb05.t: मटन वेपुडु: 500 g बिनु हड्डीक मटनकेँ मसाला आ ½ कप पानिक संग प्रेशर कुकरमे 5–6 सीटी धरि, नरम होबा धरि पकाउ, फेर ओहिना भूजू।
seg.b4d28033bb05.back: Mutton vepudu: cook 500 g boneless mutton with the masala and ½ cup water in a pressure cooker for 5–6 whistles, until soft, then fry it the same way.

seg.04112853a660.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need 6–8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.04112853a660.t: दुनू चलैत अछि। बिनु हड्डीक जल्दी पकैत अछि आ बेसी कुरकुर होइत अछि; हड्डीबला छोट टुकड़ामे बेसी स्वाद होइत अछि मुदा अपने रसमे 6–8 मिनट बेसी लगैत अछि।
seg.04112853a660.back: Both work. Boneless cooks quickly and becomes crispier; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but take 6–8 minutes more in their own juices.

seg.d20a641bec03.src: Pack it for a lunch box or a short journey and eat it within about 4 hours. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them within a day.
seg.d20a641bec03.t: टिफिन बक्सा वा छोट यात्रा लेल पैक करू आ करीब 4 घंटाक भीतर खा लिअ। बचल भात झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे राखू आ एक दिनक भीतर खा लिअ।
seg.d20a641bec03.back: Pack it for a tiffin box or a short journey and eat within about 4 hours. Cover the leftover rice, keep it in the fridge and eat within one day.

seg.bc9078e02646.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add the turmeric last, switch off the stove right after and stir for only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice, off the heat.
seg.bc9078e02646.t: या तँ नेबोक रस पकि गेल, वा हरदि तेलमे जरि गेल। हरदि सभसँ अंतमे डालू, तुरंत चूल्हि बन्द करू आ मात्र 5–10 सेकेंड चलाउ; नेबोक रस आँच सँ उतारि कऽ भातमे डालू।
seg.bc9078e02646.back: Either the lemon juice got cooked, or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add the turmeric at the very end, immediately turn off the stove and stir only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice after taking it off the heat.

seg.c288f67fcabb.src: Pour the other cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan; a thin pan lets the ragi catch.
seg.c288f67fcabb.t: बाँकी एक कप पानि भारी तलीबला बर्तनमे ढारू; पातर बर्तनमे रागी तलीमे लागि जाइत अछि।
seg.c288f67fcabb.back: Pour the remaining one cup of water into a heavy-bottomed vessel; in a thin vessel the ragi sticks to the bottom.

seg.e87c26125f87.src: Can I use cane jaggery in ragi java?
seg.e87c26125f87.t: की रागी जावामे कुसियारक गुड़ प्रयोग कऽ सकैत छी?
seg.e87c26125f87.back: Can sugarcane jaggery be used in ragi java?

seg.a9a06390a945.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a lighter colour and a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.a9a06390a945.t: हँ। ओतबे कद्दूकस कयल कुसियारक गुड़ (चेरुकु बेल्लम) लिअ आ चूल्हि बन्द कयलाक बाद मिलाउ, जाहि सँ दूध नहि फाटय। एहि सँ रंग हल्लुक आ मिठास हल्लुक, कैरामेल सन होइत अछि।
seg.a9a06390a945.back: Yes. Take the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and mix it in after turning off the stove, so that the milk does not split. With this the colour is light and the sweetness light, caramel-like.

seg.e7cb15cc47e2.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Reheat in a pan only until steaming hot all the way through; longer reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.t: बचल झींगा झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे राखू आ 1 दिनक भीतर खा लिअ। पैनमे बस ता धरि गरम करू जा धरि भीतर धरि पूरा भाप उठय एहन गरम नहि भऽ जाय; बेसी काल गरम केने झींगा कड़ा भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.back: Cover the leftover prawns, keep in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Heat in a pan only until it becomes so hot that steam rises fully right to the inside; heating for long makes the prawns hard.

seg.ea5408ec0853.src: Can I make sunnundalu with cane jaggery?
seg.ea5408ec0853.t: की कुसियारक गुड़ सँ सुन्नुंडलु बना सकैत छी?
seg.ea5408ec0853.back: Can sunnundalu be made with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.ec48010dffbe.src: Yes. Grate the cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and use the same amount as palm jaggery. The laddus turn lighter in colour, with a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.ec48010dffbe.t: हँ। कुसियारक गुड़ (चेरुकु बेल्लम) महीन कद्दूकस करू आ ताड़क गुड़ जतबे लिअ। लड्डूक रंग हल्लुक होइत अछि, आ मिठास हल्लुक, कैरामेल सन।
seg.ec48010dffbe.back: Yes. Grate the sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and take as much as the palm jaggery. The laddus' colour is light, and the sweetness light, caramel-like.

seg.767f9e16fa95.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste; keep it in the fridge and eat it within 3 days.
seg.767f9e16fa95.t: काँच लहसुन: बेसी तेज स्वाद लेल लहसुन गरम नहि करू; एकरा फ्रिजमे राखू आ 3 दिनक भीतर खा लिअ।
seg.767f9e16fa95.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper taste do not heat the garlic; keep it in the fridge and eat within 3 days.

seg.8665687f81ce.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and use it within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.8665687f81ce.t: साफ, सुखल, हवाबन्द बोइयाममे फ्रिजमे राखू आ 2 सप्ताहक भीतर खा लिअ। सदिखन सुखल चम्मच लगाउ।
seg.8665687f81ce.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and eat within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.367798df40e3.src: Up to 2 weeks in a dry, airtight jar in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first, and always use a dry spoon.
seg.367798df40e3.t: सुखल, हवाबन्द बोइयाममे फ्रिजमे 2 सप्ताह धरि। लहसुन नीक जकाँ सुखाउ आ पहिने तेलमे गरम करू, आ सदिखन सुखल चम्मच लगाउ।
seg.367798df40e3.back: Up to 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry, airtight jar. Dry the garlic well and first heat it in oil, and always use a dry spoon.

seg.1d41be2d17f9.src: Yes. Roast about 20 dried red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.1d41be2d17f9.t: हँ। करीब 20 टा सुखल लाल मरचाइ किछु बुन्न तेलमे कुरकुर होबा धरि भूजू, ठंढ़ा करू आ लहसुन डालबा सँ पहिने पीसि लिअ।
seg.1d41be2d17f9.back: Yes. Fry about 20 dry red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool them and grind before adding the garlic.

seg.7099f7c35107.src: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery)⟦/1⟧
seg.7099f7c35107.back: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(sweet flattened rice with palm jaggery)⟦/1⟧

seg.c9c11f5b43da.src: Bellam atukulu is the 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. It is the poha offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, recalling Kuchela's gift, and it is also a quick sweet for children after school. The poha is only rinsed, never cooked in water, and then tossed in warm jaggery syrup.
seg.c9c11f5b43da.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलु तेलुगु घरक 10 मिनटक मिठाइ अछि। ई ओ चूड़ा अछि जे कृष्णाष्टमी पर कृष्णकेँ चढ़ाओल जाइत अछि, कुचेलक उपहारक स्मरणमे, आ स्कूलक बाद बच्चा सभक लेल झटपट मिठाइ सेहो। चूड़ाकेँ मात्र धोओल जाइत अछि, पानिमे कहियो नहि पकाओल जाइत अछि, आ फेर गुनगुन गुड़क चाशनीमे मिलाओल जाइत अछि।
seg.c9c11f5b43da.back: Bellam Atukulu is a 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. This flattened rice is offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, in remembrance of Kuchela's gift; and also a quick sweet for children after school. The flattened rice is only washed, never cooked in water, and then mixed into lukewarm jaggery syrup.

seg.8594fedb25dc.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives it a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness. This recipe serves 2.
seg.8594fedb25dc.t: हमर ताटि बेल्लम ताड़क गुड़ एकरा गाढ़ भूरा रंग आ भरल-पूरल स्वादक, कनेक धुआँ सन मिठास दैत अछि। ई रेसिपी 2 लोक लेल अछि।
seg.8594fedb25dc.back: Our Tati Bellam palm jaggery gives it a deep brown colour and a full-flavoured, slightly smoke-like sweetness. This recipe is for 2 people.

seg.25e28614accb.src: Prep includes 5 minutes for the rinsed poha to soften.
seg.25e28614accb.t: तैयारीमे धोओल चूड़ाक नरम होयबा लेल 5 मिनट शामिल अछि।
seg.25e28614accb.back: Prep includes 5 minutes for the washed flattened rice to soften.

seg.b9dedcd705aa.src: Soften thick poha, toss it in warm palm jaggery syrup with coconut and cardamom, and finish with ghee.
seg.b9dedcd705aa.t: मोट चूड़ाकेँ नरम करू, नारियल आ इलायचीक संग गुनगुन ताड़क गुड़क चाशनीमे मिलाउ, आ अंतमे घी डालू।
seg.b9dedcd705aa.back: Soften the thick flattened rice, mix into lukewarm palm jaggery syrup with coconut and cardamom, and add ghee at the end.

seg.04f65369bdaa.back: 1 cup thick flattened rice ⟦1⟧atukulu, about 100 g⟦/1⟧

seg.e13864ccb71f.src: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.t: ½ कप कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़ ⟦1⟧करीब 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.back: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧

seg.b78c520dca8d.src: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧white part only⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.t: ½ कप कद्दूकस कयल नारियल ⟦1⟧मात्र उज्जर भाग⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.back: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧only the white part⟦/1⟧

seg.2d6d2ff14f71.src: ¼ tsp cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 2–3 pods⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.t: ¼ छोट चम्मच इलायची बुकनी ⟦1⟧वा 2–3 टा इलायचीक कूटल दाना⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.back: ¼ teaspoon cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or crushed seeds of 2–3 cardamoms⟦/1⟧

seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.src: Put the poha in a sieve and pick out any bits of husk.
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.t: चूड़ाकेँ छलनीमे राखू आ भूसीक टुकड़ी बीछि कऽ निकालि दिअ।
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.back: Put the flattened rice in a sieve and pick out the husk pieces.

seg.b0f730c0b062.src: Rinse the poha in a sieve under running water for a few seconds, drain, and leave it for 5 minutes to soften. It should feel soft when pressed, but not wet.
seg.b0f730c0b062.t: चूड़ाकेँ छलनीमे बहैत पानिक नीचाँ किछु सेकेंड धोउ, पानि निथारि दिअ, आ नरम होयबा लेल 5 मिनट छोड़ि दिअ। दबौला पर ई नरम लागय, मुदा भीजल नहि।
seg.b0f730c0b062.back: Wash the flattened rice in the sieve under running water for a few seconds, let the water drain, and leave 5 minutes to soften. When pressed they should feel soft, but not wet.

seg.0a3e2261d7bc.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.t: ताड़क गुड़केँ महीन कद्दूकस करू, कड़ा ढेपा तोड़ैत।
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.back: Grate the palm jaggery finely, breaking hard lumps.

seg.d2b892bf70af.src: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it. Wipe the pan and pour the syrup back in.
seg.d2b892bf70af.t: ताड़क गुड़केँ 2 पैघ चम्मच पानिक संग धीमा आँच पर गलाउ, फेर छानि लिअ। पैन पोछि कऽ चाशनी फेर ओहिमे ढारू।
seg.d2b892bf70af.back: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 tablespoons of water on low flame, then strain. Wipe the pan and pour the syrup back into it.

seg.d073ead78aef.src: If you are using cashews, fry them in a little ghee till golden.
seg.d073ead78aef.t: जँ काजू लऽ रहल छी तँ ओकरा कनेक घीमे सोनहुला होयबा धरि भूजू।
seg.d073ead78aef.back: If using cashews, fry them in a little ghee until golden.

seg.62c17a0f01a5.src: Add the poha, coconut and cardamom to the warm syrup and toss gently on a low flame for 1–2 minutes, until every flake is coated. Use a light hand so the flakes do not break.
seg.62c17a0f01a5.t: गुनगुन चाशनीमे चूड़ा, नारियल आ इलायची डालू आ धीमा आँच पर 1–2 मिनट धीरे-धीरे मिलाउ, जा धरि हर दाना पर चाशनी नहि लपटि जाय। हल्लुक हाथ सँ करू जाहि सँ दाना नहि टूटय।
seg.62c17a0f01a5.back: Add the flattened rice, coconut and cardamom to the lukewarm syrup and gently mix on low flame for 1–2 minutes, until every flake is coated with syrup. Work with a light hand so the flakes do not break.

seg.d1abe3d7557d.src: Take the pan off the heat as soon as the flakes are coated; longer cooking makes them chewy.
seg.d1abe3d7557d.t: जहिना दाना पर चाशनी लपटि जाय, तुरंत पैन आँच सँ उतारि लिअ; बेसी पकौला सँ ई चिम्मड़ भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.d1abe3d7557d.back: As soon as the flakes are coated with syrup, take the pan off the flame immediately; cooking longer makes them chewy.

seg.c91ffab6359d.src: Finish with the ghee and cashews. Serve warm or at room temperature.
seg.c91ffab6359d.t: घी आ काजू डालि कऽ पूरा करू। गरम वा कोठलीक तापमान पर परोसू।
seg.c91ffab6359d.back: Finish by adding ghee and cashews. Serve hot/warm or at room temperature.

seg.544ea222a497.src: Use thick poha. Thin poha turns mushy in the syrup.
seg.544ea222a497.t: मोट चूड़ा लिअ। पातर चूड़ा चाशनीमे लेबड़ा भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.544ea222a497.back: Use thick flattened rice. Thin flattened rice turns mushy in the syrup.

seg.0f56d718ca89.src: Do not soak the poha in a bowl of water; a quick rinse is enough, or it turns soft and sticky.
seg.0f56d718ca89.t: चूड़ाकेँ बाटीभरि पानिमे नहि भिजाउ; झटपट धोनाइ पर्याप्त अछि, नहि तँ ई बेसी नरम आ लसगर भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.0f56d718ca89.back: Do not soak the flattened rice in a bowlful of water; a quick wash is enough, otherwise it becomes too soft and sticky.

seg.972f174730fe.src: Keep the syrup warm, not bubbling, when the poha goes in, so the flakes coat evenly.
seg.972f174730fe.t: चूड़ा डालैत काल चाशनी गुनगुन राखू, खौलैत नहि, जाहि सँ सभ दाना पर एक समान चाशनी लागय।
seg.972f174730fe.back: Keep the syrup lukewarm, not boiling, when adding the flattened rice, so that every flake gets coated evenly with syrup.

seg.8496cfe4aa1d.src: With milk: pour 2–3 tbsp warm milk over the finished poha for a softer sweet.
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.t: दूधक संग: बेसी नरम मिठाइ लेल तैयार चूड़ा पर 2–3 पैघ चम्मच गुनगुन दूध ढारू।
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.back: With milk: for a softer sweet, pour 2–3 tablespoons of lukewarm milk over the ready flattened rice.

seg.bb5e4ee879e6.src: With sesame: add 1 tbsp roasted sesame seeds along with the coconut.
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.t: तिलक संग: नारियलक संग 1 पैघ चम्मच भूजल तिल डालू।
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.back: With sesame: add 1 tablespoon of roasted sesame along with the coconut.

seg.25d7247d3c7b.src: Serve it as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or as a quick sweet for children after school.
seg.25d7247d3c7b.t: कृष्णाष्टमी पर नैवेद्यक रूपमे परोसू, वा स्कूलक बाद बच्चा सभकेँ झटपट मिठाइक रूपमे दिअ।
seg.25d7247d3c7b.back: Serve as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or give to children after school as a quick sweet.

seg.1170385c1b79.src: Best eaten the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them the next day; the poha firms up as it stands.
seg.1170385c1b79.t: जाहि दिन बनय ओही दिन खायब सभ सँ नीक। बचलकेँ झाँपि कऽ फ्रिजमे राखू आ अगिला दिन खा लिअ; राखल रहला पर चूड़ा कड़ा भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.1170385c1b79.back: Best eaten the same day it is made. Cover the leftover, keep in the fridge and eat the next day; when kept, the flattened rice becomes hard.

seg.6acb206e9df4.src: Which poha is best for bellam atukulu?
seg.6acb206e9df4.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलु लेल कोन चूड़ा सभ सँ नीक?
seg.6acb206e9df4.back: Which flattened rice is best for Bellam Atukulu?

seg.7cb97f8423cf.src: Thick poha (atukulu). It holds its shape in the warm syrup; thin poha turns mushy.
seg.7cb97f8423cf.t: मोट चूड़ा (अटुकुलु)। ई गुनगुन चाशनीमे अपन आकार बनौने रहैत अछि; पातर चूड़ा लेबड़ा भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.7cb97f8423cf.back: Thick flattened rice (atukulu). It keeps its shape in lukewarm syrup; thin flattened rice turns mushy.

seg.ba8eb1721096.src: Can I make bellam atukulu with cane jaggery?
seg.ba8eb1721096.t: की कुसियारक गुड़ सँ बेल्लम अटुकुलु बना सकैत छी?
seg.ba8eb1721096.back: Can Bellam Atukulu be made with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.2a1aa941db07.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam). It turns lighter in colour, with a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.2a1aa941db07.t: हँ। ओतबे कद्दूकस कयल कुसियारक गुड़ (चेरुकु बेल्लम) लिअ। रंग हल्लुक होइत अछि, आ मिठास कैरामेल सन।
seg.2a1aa941db07.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery (Cheruku Bellam). The colour is lighter, and the sweetness caramel-like.

seg.88008fa2d0e6.src: Why is my bellam atukulu sticky?
seg.88008fa2d0e6.t: हमर बेल्लम अटुकुलु लसगर किएक भऽ गेल?
seg.88008fa2d0e6.back: Why did my Bellam Atukulu become sticky?

seg.a6945e480c9a.src: The poha was soaked or cooked too long. Rinse it for only a few seconds, and take the pan off the heat as soon as every flake is coated.
seg.a6945e480c9a.t: चूड़ा भिजाओल गेल छल वा बेसी काल पकाओल गेल। एकरा मात्र किछु सेकेंड धोउ, आ जहिना हर दाना पर चाशनी लपटि जाय, तुरंत पैन आँच सँ उतारि लिअ।
seg.a6945e480c9a.back: The flattened rice was soaked or cooked too long. Wash it only a few seconds, and as soon as every flake is coated with syrup, take the pan off the flame immediately.

seg.d4c0fab65bf7.src: Why is it made on Krishnashtami?
seg.d4c0fab65bf7.t: ई कृष्णाष्टमी पर किएक बनाओल जाइत अछि?
seg.d4c0fab65bf7.back: Why is this made on Krishnashtami?

seg.51ab1914ac8d.src: It recalls the story of Kuchela, who brought a handful of poha to his friend Krishna as his only gift.
seg.51ab1914ac8d.t: ई कुचेलक कथाक स्मरण करबैत अछि, जे अपन मित्र कृष्ण लग अपन एकमात्र उपहारक रूपमे मुट्ठीभरि चूड़ा लऽ गेल छलाह।
seg.51ab1914ac8d.back: It recalls the story of Kuchela, who brought a handful of flattened rice to his friend Krishna as his only gift.

seg.5080241b3883.src: బెల్లం అటుకులు. Andhra bellam atukulu: thick poha tossed in warm Thati Bellam palm jaggery syrup with coconut, cardamom and ghee. A 10-minute sweet, with tips and FAQs.
seg.5080241b3883.t: బెల్లం అటుకులు. आन्ध्रक बेल्लम अटुकुलु: गुनगुन ताटि बेल्लम ताड़क गुड़क चाशनीमे नारियल, इलायची आ घीक संग मिलाओल मोट चूड़ा। 10 मिनटक मिठाइ, सुझाव आ सामान्य प्रश्नक संग।
seg.5080241b3883.back: Bellam Atukulu. Andhra Bellam Atukulu: thick flattened rice mixed in lukewarm Tati Bellam palm jaggery syrup with coconut, cardamom and ghee. A 10-minute sweet, with tips and common questions.

seg.4239bed21420.src: Bellam Atukulu (Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery) · 1acrefarms
seg.4239bed21420.back: Bellam Atukulu (sweet flattened rice with palm jaggery) · 1acrefarms

seg.8dafb14d8ade.src: Bellam Atukulu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.8dafb14d8ade.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलु: 1acrefarms क रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री आ विधिक संग
seg.8dafb14d8ade.back: Bellam Atukulu: 1acrefarms' recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.7c6d93848300.t: ½ कप कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़

seg.cf5b9ab6ccf1.t: आन्ध्रक मिठाइ · करीब 14 टा बनैत अछि

seg.753ec27036d4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Kobbari Undalu · Nariyal Gud Ke Laddu
seg.753ec27036d4.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · कोब्बरि उंडलु · नारियल गुड़ के लड्डू

seg.de7ddbad7bf0.src: Kobbari undalu are the coconut laddus Andhra homes make for festivals, naivedyam and an everyday sweet. They need only coconut, jaggery, cardamom and a spoon of ghee. The jaggery is melted and strained, the coconut is cooked in it on a low flame until the mix holds together, and the laddus are rolled by hand while still warm.
seg.de7ddbad7bf0.t: कोब्बरि उंडलु नारियलक लड्डू अछि, जे आन्ध्रक घरमे पाबनि, नैवेद्य आ रोजक मिठाइ लेल बनैत अछि। एहिमे मात्र नारियल, गुड़, इलायची आ एक चम्मच घी लगैत अछि। गुड़केँ गला कऽ छानल जाइत अछि, ओहिमे नारियलकेँ धीमा आँच पर तावत पकाओल जाइत अछि जा धरि मिश्रण जुटि नहि जाय, आ मिश्रण गरमे रहैत हाथ सँ लड्डू बान्हल जाइत अछि।
seg.de7ddbad7bf0.back: Kobbari undalu is a coconut laddu, which is made in Andhra homes for festivals, naivedya and everyday sweet. In it only coconut, jaggery, cardamom and one spoon of ghee are used. The jaggery is melted and strained, in it the coconut is cooked on slow heat until the mixture binds (lit. 'until the mixture does not bind', standard until-construction), and while the mixture is still hot the laddus are shaped by hand.

seg.089fb020d00e.src: Our Cheruku Bellam gives them a light golden colour and a mellow caramel taste. This recipe makes about 14 laddus.
seg.089fb020d00e.t: हमर चेरुकु बेल्लम एकरा हल्लुक सोनहुला रंग आ नरम कैरामेल सन स्वाद दैत अछि। एहि रेसिपी सँ करीब 14 टा लड्डू बनैत अछि।
seg.089fb020d00e.back: Our Cheruku Bellam gives them a light golden colour and a soft caramel-like taste. This recipe makes about 14 laddus.

seg.d9e7175cce3e.src: Allow another 15 minutes for the laddus to cool before you store them.
seg.d9e7175cce3e.t: राखबा सँ पहिने लड्डू सभकेँ सेरयबा लेल आओर 15 मिनट दिअ।
seg.d9e7175cce3e.back: Give the laddus another 15 minutes to cool before storing.

seg.80b59063a128.src: Melt cane jaggery, cook it with grated coconut till it comes together, add cardamom and ghee, and roll into laddus.
seg.80b59063a128.t: कुसियारक गुड़ गलाउ, कद्दूकस कयल नारियलक संग जुटबा धरि पकाउ, इलायची आ घी डालू, आ लड्डू बान्हू।
seg.80b59063a128.back: Melt the sugarcane jaggery, cook with the grated coconut until it comes together, add cardamom and ghee, and roll the laddus.

seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.src: 2 cups grated coconut ⟦1⟧1 medium coconut; grate only the white part⟦/1⟧
seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.t: 2 कप कद्दूकस कयल नारियल ⟦1⟧1 टा मझोला नारियल; मात्र उज्जर भाग कद्दूकस करू⟦/1⟧
seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.back: 2 cups grated coconut ⟦1⟧1 medium coconut; grate only the white part⟦/1⟧

seg.fa687abb7dd1.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.fa687abb7dd1.t: 1 कप कद्दूकस कयल कुसियारक गुड़ ⟦1⟧करीब 180 g; पहिने टुकड़ीकेँ कूटि लिअ वा कद्दूकस करू⟦/1⟧
seg.fa687abb7dd1.back: 1 cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g; first pound or grate the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.1ca2ce946869.src: 1 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧plus a little for greasing your palms⟦/1⟧
seg.1ca2ce946869.t: 1 पैघ चम्मच घी ⟦1⟧संगहि हथेरीमे लगाबऽ लेल कनेक⟦/1⟧
seg.1ca2ce946869.back: 1 tablespoon ghee ⟦1⟧plus a little to grease the palms⟦/1⟧

seg.ccf1a746b971.src: 10 cashews, optional ⟦1⟧broken and fried golden in ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.ccf1a746b971.t: 10 टा काजू, ऐच्छिक ⟦1⟧तोड़ि कऽ घीमे सोनहुला भूजल⟦/1⟧
seg.ccf1a746b971.back: 10 cashews, optional ⟦1⟧broken and fried golden in ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.15ef8686cc9e.src: Grate the coconut, leaving out the brown skin so the laddus stay light in colour.
seg.15ef8686cc9e.t: नारियल कद्दूकस करू, भूरा छिलका छोड़ि कऽ, जाहि सँ लड्डूक रंग हल्लुक रहय।
seg.15ef8686cc9e.back: Grate the coconut, leaving out the brown skin, so the laddus stay light in colour.

seg.00b442d7f507.src: Pound or grate the cane jaggery into small pieces so it melts evenly.
seg.00b442d7f507.t: कुसियारक गुड़केँ छोट-छोट टुकड़ीमे कूटू वा कद्दूकस करू, जाहि सँ ई एक समान गलय।
seg.00b442d7f507.back: Pound or grate the sugarcane jaggery into small pieces, so it melts evenly.

seg.c25e0610c714.src: Melt the jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it through a fine sieve. This catches any grit or bits of cane from the block.
seg.c25e0610c714.t: गुड़केँ 2 पैघ चम्मच पानिक संग धीमा आँच पर गलाउ, फेर महीन छलनी सँ छानि लिअ। एहि सँ भेलीक कोनो किरकिरी वा कुसियारक टुकड़ी रुकि जाइत अछि।
seg.c25e0610c714.back: Melt the jaggery with 2 tablespoons of water on low flame, then strain through a fine sieve. This stops any grit from the jaggery block (bheli) or bits of sugarcane.

seg.3eb20f2a7136.src: Return it to the pan, add the coconut and cook on medium-low, stirring, until the mix leaves the sides of the pan and holds together, 12–15 minutes. Keep stirring so it does not catch at the bottom.
seg.3eb20f2a7136.t: एकरा फेर पैनमे दिअ, नारियल डालू आ मध्यम सँ कम आँच पर चलबैत पकाउ, जा धरि मिश्रण पैनक कात नहि छोड़ि दिअय आ जुटि नहि जाय, 12–15 मिनट। चलबैत रहू जाहि सँ तरमे नहि लागय।
seg.3eb20f2a7136.back: Put it back in the pan, add the coconut and cook on medium-low flame while stirring, until the mixture leaves the sides of the pan and comes together, 12–15 minutes. Keep stirring so it does not stick at the bottom.

seg.e1985b8e5f9c.src: If you are using cashews, fry them in a little ghee till golden while the mix cooks.
seg.e1985b8e5f9c.t: जँ काजू लऽ रहल छी तँ मिश्रण पकैत काल ओकरा कनेक घीमे सोनहुला होयबा धरि भूजू।
seg.e1985b8e5f9c.back: If using cashews, fry them in a little ghee until golden while the mixture cooks.

seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.src: Stir in the cardamom, ghee and cashews. Take the pan off the heat.
seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.t: इलायची, घी आ काजू मिलाउ। पैन आँच सँ उतारि लिअ।
seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.back: Mix in the cardamom, ghee and cashews. Take the pan off the flame.

seg.d4ee96780aba.src: Let it cool till you can handle it, grease your palms with ghee and roll it into small balls. Press each one firmly so it holds together.
seg.d4ee96780aba.t: एतेक सेरयबा दिअ जे हाथमे लऽ सकी, हथेरीमे घी लगाउ आ छोट-छोट गोला बान्हू। हर गोलाकेँ कसि कऽ दबाउ जाहि सँ ओ जुटल रहय।
seg.d4ee96780aba.back: Let it cool enough to hold in the hand, grease the palms with ghee and roll small balls. Press each one firmly so it stays together.

seg.3753ea8bc7d0.src: Set the laddus on a greased plate and let them cool completely before you store them.
seg.3753ea8bc7d0.t: लड्डू सभकेँ घी लागल थारी पर राखू आ राखबा सँ पहिने पूरा सेरा जाय दिअ।
seg.3753ea8bc7d0.back: Place the laddus on a ghee-greased plate and let them cool completely before storing.

seg.fb3de84de9f6.src: If the mix won't hold a shape, cook it 2 minutes more. If it sets too hard, sprinkle in a spoon of warm milk and press again.
seg.fb3de84de9f6.t: जँ मिश्रण आकार नहि धरय तँ आओर 2 मिनट पकाउ। जँ बेसी कड़ा भऽ जाय तँ एक चम्मच गुनगुन दूध छिड़कि कऽ फेर दबाउ।
seg.fb3de84de9f6.back: If the mixture does not hold shape, cook 2 more minutes. If it becomes too hard, sprinkle a spoon of lukewarm milk and press again.

seg.71475e1a7345.src: Keep the flame at medium-low; on a high flame the jaggery darkens and the laddus turn hard.
seg.71475e1a7345.t: आँच मध्यम सँ कम राखू; तेज आँच पर गुड़ करिया भऽ जाइत अछि आ लड्डू कड़ा भऽ जाइत अछि।
seg.71475e1a7345.back: Keep the flame medium-low; on high flame the jaggery turns dark and the laddus become hard.

seg.46a2e2b2d323.src: Roll the laddus while the mix is still warm; once it cools completely it will not bind.
seg.46a2e2b2d323.t: मिश्रण गरमे रहैत लड्डू बान्हू; पूरा सेरा गेला पर ई नहि जुटत।
seg.46a2e2b2d323.back: Roll the laddus while the mixture is still hot; once fully cooled it will not come together.

seg.b277c024adad.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for darker laddus with a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.b277c024adad.t: ताड़क गुड़: बेसी गाढ़ रंगक आ कनेक धुआँ सन मिठासबला लड्डू लेल ओतबे कद्दूकस कयल ताड़क गुड़ लिअ।
seg.b277c024adad.back: Palm jaggery: for darker laddus with a slightly smoke-like sweetness, use the same amount of grated palm jaggery.

seg.7b597df04222.src: Dry coconut: use the same amount of grated dry coconut (kopra); the mix comes together faster, so watch it closely.
seg.7b597df04222.t: सुखल नारियल: ओतबे कद्दूकस कयल सुखल नारियल (कोपरा) लिअ; मिश्रण जल्दी जुटैत अछि, तेँ ध्यान सँ देखैत रहू।
seg.7b597df04222.back: Dry coconut: use the same amount of grated dry coconut (kopra); the mixture comes together faster, so watch carefully.

seg.676bca051e10.src: Kobbari burfi: spread the cooked mix on a greased plate, let it set a little and cut it into squares instead of rolling laddus.
seg.676bca051e10.t: कोब्बरि बर्फी: लड्डू बन्हबाक बदला पकाओल मिश्रणकेँ घी लागल थारी पर पसारू, कनेक जमय दिअ आ चौकोर टुकड़ीमे काटू।
seg.676bca051e10.back: Kobbari Burfi: instead of rolling laddus, spread the cooked mixture on a ghee-greased plate, let it set a little and cut into square pieces.

seg.80538d77ab41.src: Serve as an everyday sweet, offer them as naivedyam, or add them to the festival sweet plate.
seg.80538d77ab41.t: रोजक मिठाइक रूपमे परोसू, नैवेद्यक रूपमे चढ़ाउ, वा पाबनिक मिठाइक थारीमे राखू।
seg.80538d77ab41.back: Serve as an everyday sweet, offer as naivedyam, or put on a festival sweets plate.

seg.6f3252f28ef8.src: Keep in an airtight container and eat within 3 days at room temperature, or within a week if kept in the fridge.
seg.6f3252f28ef8.t: हवाबंद डिब्बामे राखू आ कोठलीक तापमान पर 3 दिनक भीतर खा लिअ, वा फ्रिजमे राखी तँ एक सप्ताहक भीतर।
seg.6f3252f28ef8.back: Keep in an airtight container and eat within 3 days at room temperature, or within one week if kept in the fridge.

seg.f232fb960e89.src: Why are my kobbari undalu not holding shape?
seg.f232fb960e89.t: हमर कोब्बरि उंडलु आकार किएक नहि धरैत अछि?
seg.f232fb960e89.back: Why do my Kobbari Undalu not hold shape?

seg.1cf59b528a13.src: The mix needs a little more cooking. Put it back on a low flame for 2 minutes, stirring, until it leaves the sides of the pan, then roll it while it is still warm.
seg.1cf59b528a13.t: मिश्रणकेँ कनेक आओर पकयबाक जरूरति अछि। एकरा फेर धीमा आँच पर 2 मिनट चलबैत पकाउ, जा धरि ई पैनक कात नहि छोड़ि दिअय, फेर गरमे रहैत बान्हि लिअ।
seg.1cf59b528a13.back: The mixture needs a little more cooking. Cook it again on low flame for 2 minutes while stirring, until it leaves the sides of the pan, then roll while still hot.

seg.9371fa8705cd.src: Why did my laddus turn hard?
seg.9371fa8705cd.t: हमर लड्डू कड़ा किएक भऽ गेल?
seg.9371fa8705cd.back: Why did my laddus become hard?

seg.ee988ba3472f.src: The jaggery was cooked too long or on too high a flame. Sprinkle in a spoon of warm milk, mix and press again. Next time, take the pan off the heat as soon as the mix holds together.
seg.ee988ba3472f.t: गुड़ बेसी काल वा बेसी तेज आँच पर पकि गेल। एक चम्मच गुनगुन दूध छिड़कू, मिलाउ आ फेर दबाउ। अगिला बेर, जहिना मिश्रण जुटि जाय, तुरंत पैन आँच सँ उतारि लिअ।
seg.ee988ba3472f.back: The jaggery cooked too long or on too high a flame. Sprinkle a spoon of lukewarm milk, mix and press again. Next time, as soon as the mixture comes together, take the pan off the flame immediately.

seg.d830316a6adb.src: Can I make kobbari undalu with palm jaggery?
seg.d830316a6adb.t: की ताड़क गुड़ सँ कोब्बरि उंडलु बना सकैत छी?
seg.d830316a6adb.back: Can Kobbari Undalu be made with palm jaggery?

seg.813bf680c8a8.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The laddus turn darker, with a slightly smoky sweetness.

seg.813bf680c8a8.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (Tati Bellam). The laddus become darker, and the sweetness gets a slight smoke-like hint.

seg.13ab70df1ad4.src: How to check chilli powder at home
seg.13ab70df1ad4.back: How to test chilli powder at home

seg.1841c397898f.src: FSSAI's standard says chilli powder must be dry and free from dirt, added colouring matter, flavouring matter and mineral oil. Its testing manual has methods for finding brick powder, added starch, added colour, colours that dissolve in oil, and the dyes Sudan III and Rhodamine B.
seg.1841c397898f.t: FSSAI क मानक कहैत अछि जे मरचाइ बुकनी सुखल हेबाक चाही, आ ओहिमे गंदगी, मिलाओल रंग पदार्थ, स्वाद-गन्ध पदार्थ आ मिनरल तेल नहि हेबाक चाही। एकर परीक्षण पुस्तिकामे ईंटाक बुकनी, मिलाओल स्टार्च, मिलाओल रंग, तेलमे घुलऽ बला रंग, आ सूडान III आ रोडामाइन B डाई पता लगेबाक विधि देल अछि।
seg.1841c397898f.back: FSSAI's standard says that chilli powder should be dry, and should not contain dirt, added colouring matter, flavouring matter and mineral oil. Its testing manual gives methods to detect brick powder, added starch, added colour, oil-soluble colour, and Sudan III and Rhodamine B dyes.

seg.a0af610174e4.src: Some of this you can check in your kitchen with a glass of water, your fingers and a few drops of iodine. Some, like Sudan dyes, only a lab can find. This guide covers both. Try the checks on any chilli powder you buy.
seg.a0af610174e4.t: एहिमे सँ किछु अहाँ अपन भनसाघरमे एक गिलास पानि, अपन आँगुर आ आयोडिनक किछु बुन्न सँ जाँचि सकैत छी। किछु, जेना सूडान डाई, मात्र लैब पता लगा सकैत अछि। ई गाइड दुनूक बात करैत अछि। जे कोनो मरचाइ बुकनी कीनी, ओहि पर ई जाँच कऽ देखू।
seg.a0af610174e4.back: Some of these you can check in your kitchen with a glass of water, your fingers and a few drops of iodine. Some, such as Sudan dyes, only a lab can detect. This guide talks about both. Whatever chilli powder you buy, try these checks on it.

seg.b356a193952e.src: ⟦1⟧Our two chilli powders⟦/1⟧Left: Sannam chilli powder. Right: Teja chilli powder. Both from chillies grown in Palnadu and Guntur, sun-dried and packed in Narasaraopet.
seg.b356a193952e.t: ⟦1⟧हमर दू टा मरचाइ बुकनी⟦/1⟧बामा: सन्नम मरचाइ बुकनी। दहिना: तेजा मरचाइ बुकनी। दुनू पल्नाडु आ गुंटूरमे उपजल मरचाइ सँ बनल, रौदमे सुखाओल आ नरसरावपेटमे पैक कयल।
seg.b356a193952e.back: ⟦1⟧Our two chilli powders⟦/1⟧Left: Sannam chilli powder. Right: Teja chilli powder. Both made from chillies grown in Palnadu and Guntur, sun-dried and packed in Narasaraopet.

seg.a574ced14407.src: Sprinkle a teaspoon of chilli powder on a glass of water and do not stir. Colour streaks running down at once point to added colour, and bits still floating after the powder sinks point to sawdust or bran. Rub the sediment: grit points to brick powder or sand, a soapy feel to soapstone. Iodine turning the powder blue points to added starch. Dyes such as Sudan I do not show in water; for those, use a lab.
seg.a574ced14407.t: एक गिलास पानि पर एक छोट चम्मच मरचाइ बुकनी छिड़कू आ चलाउ नहि। जँ तुरंत नीचाँ दिस रंगक धारी बहय तँ ई मिलाओल रंग दिस इशारा करैत अछि, आ बुकनी डूबलाक बादो जे कण ऊपर तैरैत रहय, से लकड़ीक बुरादा वा भूसी दिस इशारा करैत अछि। तरमे बैसल बुकनीकेँ रगड़ू: किरकिर लागय तँ ईंटाक बुकनी वा बालु दिस, आ साबुन सन चिक्कन लागय तँ सोपस्टोन दिस इशारा अछि। आयोडिन सँ बुकनी नील भऽ जाय तँ मिलाओल स्टार्च दिस इशारा अछि। सूडान I सन डाई पानिमे नहि देखाइत अछि; ओकरा लेल लैबक सहायता लिअ।
seg.a574ced14407.back: Sprinkle one small spoon of chilli powder onto a glass of water and do not stir. If streaks of colour flow downward immediately, this points to added colour, and particles that keep floating on top even after the powder has sunk point to sawdust or husk. Rub the powder settled at the bottom: if it feels gritty it points to brick powder or sand, and if it feels smooth like soap it points to soapstone. If the powder turns blue with iodine, it points to added starch. Dyes like Sudan I do not show in water; for them take the help of a lab.

seg.11caa5f871e4.src: What FSSAI checks chilli powder for
seg.11caa5f871e4.t: FSSAI मरचाइ बुकनीमे की जाँचैत अछि
seg.11caa5f871e4.back: What FSSAI checks in chilli powder

seg.7d346e39c41e.src: FSSAI's chilli powder standard does not allow added colouring matter. FSSAI's tests look for colours that dissolve in water, colours that dissolve in oil, and the dyes Sudan III and Rhodamine B.
seg.7d346e39c41e.t: FSSAI क मरचाइ बुकनीक मानक मिलाओल रंग पदार्थक अनुमति नहि दैत अछि। FSSAI क परीक्षण पानिमे घुलऽ बला रंग, तेलमे घुलऽ बला रंग, आ सूडान III आ रोडामाइन B डाई तकैत अछि।
seg.7d346e39c41e.back: FSSAI's chilli powder standard does not permit added colouring matter. FSSAI's tests look for water-soluble colour, oil-soluble colour, and Sudan III and Rhodamine B dyes.

seg.dab0f1b06607.src: Sudan I is used to colour oils, fats, waxes, and shoe and floor polish. The Indian Standard on quick tests for adulterants says Sudan III, much used in wax polishes, has been used to make chilli pods shine, and so finds its way into chilli powder.
seg.dab0f1b06607.t: सूडान I तेल, चर्बी, मोम, आ जुत्ता आ फर्शक पॉलिशमे रंग देबा लेल प्रयोग होइत अछि। मिलावटक त्वरित जाँच पर बनल भारतीय मानक कहैत अछि जे सूडान III, जकर मोमबला पॉलिशमे बहुत प्रयोग होइत अछि, समूचा सुखल मरचाइकेँ चमकाबऽ लेल प्रयोग कयल गेल अछि, आ एहि तरहेँ मरचाइ बुकनीमे पहुँचि जाइत अछि।
seg.dab0f1b06607.back: Sudan I is used to colour oil, fat, wax, and shoe and floor polish. The Indian Standard on quick tests for adulteration says that Sudan III, which is used a lot in wax polishes, has been used to make whole dried chillies shine, and in this way reaches chilli powder.

seg.65d2132b3a71.src: Brick powder, sand, salt, talc and soapstone
seg.65d2132b3a71.t: ईंटाक बुकनी, बालु, नून, टैल्क आ सोपस्टोन
seg.65d2132b3a71.back: Brick powder, sand, salt, talc and soapstone

seg.eaaa28049f76.src: FSSAI's household tests list these for chilli powder. The Indian Standard says brick powder is mixed in to increase bulk.
seg.eaaa28049f76.t: FSSAI क घरेलू जाँचक सूचीमे मरचाइ बुकनी लेल ई सभ अछि। भारतीय मानक कहैत अछि जे ईंटाक बुकनी मात्रा बढ़ेबा लेल मिलाओल जाइत अछि।
seg.eaaa28049f76.back: FSSAI's home-test list for chilli powder includes all these. The Indian Standard says brick powder is added to increase the quantity.

seg.591f55c64be8.src: FSSAI's manual tests powdered spices other than turmeric for added starch. The Indian Standard notes that colour is also added to chilli powder to hide added starch.
seg.591f55c64be8.t: FSSAI क पुस्तिका हरदि छोड़ि आन बुकनी मसालामे मिलाओल स्टार्चक जाँच करैत अछि। भारतीय मानक लिखैत अछि जे मिलाओल स्टार्च नुकेबा लेल मरचाइ बुकनीमे रंग सेहो मिलाओल जाइत अछि।
seg.591f55c64be8.back: FSSAI's manual tests for added starch in powdered spices other than turmeric. The Indian Standard writes that colour is also added to chilli powder to hide added starch.

seg.6cdabb4ac9cc.src: Both float on water, which is how FSSAI's household tests spot them.
seg.6cdabb4ac9cc.t: दुनू पानि पर तैरैत अछि, आ FSSAI क घरेलू जाँच एही सँ एकरा पकड़ैत अछि।
seg.6cdabb4ac9cc.back: Both float on water, and FSSAI's home test catches them by this.

seg.2ad2a1900226.src: Check 1: the water glass and the rub test
seg.2ad2a1900226.t: जाँच 1: पानिक गिलास आ रगड़बाक जाँच
seg.2ad2a1900226.back: Check 1: Water glass and rubbing check

seg.5ebb4d43f1c6.src: Sprinkle one teaspoon of chilli powder on top. Do not stir.
seg.5ebb4d43f1c6.t: ऊपर सँ एक छोट चम्मच मरचाइ बुकनी छिड़कू। चलाउ नहि।
seg.5ebb4d43f1c6.back: Sprinkle one small spoon of chilli powder from above. Do not stir.

seg.e11be0844965.src: Watch the first minute. Look for coloured streaks running down from the powder.
seg.e11be0844965.t: पहिल एक मिनट देखू। बुकनी सँ नीचाँ दिस बहैत रंगीन धारी तकू।
seg.e11be0844965.back: Watch the first minute. Look for coloured streaks flowing downward from the powder.

seg.14ad43586f91.src: Leave it until most of the powder has sunk. Look at the surface for bits still floating.
seg.14ad43586f91.t: जा धरि बेसी बुकनी डूबि नहि जाय, ता धरि छोड़ि दिअ। सतह पर एखनो तैरैत कण तकू।
seg.14ad43586f91.back: Leave it until most of the powder has sunk. Look for particles still floating on the surface.

seg.379262f468f1.src: Pour off most of the water and rub the sediment at the bottom between your fingers.
seg.379262f468f1.t: बेसी पानि ढारि दिअ आ तरमे बैसल बुकनीकेँ आँगुरक बीच रगड़ू।
seg.379262f468f1.back: Pour off most of the water and rub the powder settled at the bottom between your fingers.

seg.7455fbe1d38d.t: अहाँ की देखैत वा अनुभव करैत छी

seg.5ddc9ed4a863.t: ई किम्हर इशारा कऽ सकैत अछि

seg.9d20132af7ae.src: Colour streaks running down at once
seg.9d20132af7ae.back: Streaks of colour flowing down immediately

seg.4dd6d7d4418f.src: Added colour that dissolves in water

seg.99d03e1725f4.src: Bits still floating after the powder sinks
seg.99d03e1725f4.back: Particles floating even after the powder sinks

seg.f211ed47d57c.t: तरमे बैसल बुकनी जे किरकिर लागय
seg.f211ed47d57c.back: Powder settled at the bottom that feels gritty

seg.0778aeb79734.src: White sediment that feels soapy and smooth
seg.0778aeb79734.t: तरमे बैसल उज्जर बुकनी जे साबुन सन आ चिक्कन लागय
seg.0778aeb79734.back: White powder settled at the bottom that feels soapy and smooth

seg.92ba3085667d.src: No sign of what this check can find.
seg.92ba3085667d.t: एहि जाँच सँ जे पकड़ल जा सकैत अछि, तकर कोनो संकेत नहि।
seg.92ba3085667d.back: No sign of what this check can catch.

seg.e4f5d2924afa.src: Possible adulteration. Stop using that batch and get it tested.
seg.e4f5d2924afa.t: मिलावट भऽ सकैत अछि। ओहि बैचक प्रयोग बन्न करू आ जँचबाउ।
seg.e4f5d2924afa.back: There may be adulteration. Stop using that batch and get it tested.

seg.e5e493d4cb12.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Colours that dissolve in water leave the powder and run down as streaks. Brick powder is heavy and settles to the bottom, while sawdust and bran float.
seg.e5e493d4cb12.t: ⟦1⟧ई किएक काज करैत अछि।⟦/1⟧ पानिमे घुलऽ बला रंग बुकनी सँ निकलि कऽ धारी बनि नीचाँ बहैत अछि। ईंटाक बुकनी भारी होइत अछि आ तरमे बैसि जाइत अछि, जखन कि लकड़ीक बुरादा आ भूसी तैरैत अछि।
seg.e5e493d4cb12.back: ⟦1⟧Why this works.⟦/1⟧ Water-soluble colour comes out of the powder and flows down as streaks. Brick powder is heavy and settles at the bottom, whereas sawdust and husk float.

seg.551c97147aa3.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Dyes that do not dissolve in water stay in the powder. Sudan I is one: it does not dissolve in water, and it is used to colour oils, fats and waxes. Chilli powder coloured with such dyes can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.551c97147aa3.t: ⟦1⟧ई की छोड़ि दैत अछि।⟦/1⟧ जे डाई पानिमे नहि घुलैत अछि, ओ बुकनीमे रहि जाइत अछि। सूडान I ओहिमे सँ एक अछि: ई पानिमे नहि घुलैत अछि, आ तेल, चर्बी आ मोममे रंग देबा लेल प्रयोग होइत अछि। एहन डाई सँ रंगल मरचाइ बुकनी एहि जाँचमे पास भऽ सकैत अछि। मात्र लैब परीक्षणे पक्का कऽ सकैत अछि जे ई सभ नहि अछि।
seg.551c97147aa3.back: ⟦1⟧What this misses.⟦/1⟧ Dyes that do not dissolve in water stay in the powder. Sudan I is one of them: it does not dissolve in water, and is used to colour oil, fat and wax. Chilli powder coloured with such a dye can pass this check. Only lab testing can confirm that these are not present.

seg.5bbec3bc6fbf.src: Wash your hands after the rub test, before you touch your eyes.
seg.5bbec3bc6fbf.t: रगड़बाक जाँचक बाद, आँखि छुबा सँ पहिने, हाथ धो लिअ।
seg.5bbec3bc6fbf.back: After the rubbing check, wash your hands before touching your eyes.

seg.36726998b551.src: Check 2: the iodine test for starch

seg.3d76d0b2a476.src: FSSAI's manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric, so chilli powder can take it. ⟦1⟧Our turmeric guide⟦/1⟧ explains why turmeric is left out.
seg.3d76d0b2a476.t: FSSAI क पुस्तिका आयोडिन परीक्षणक प्रयोग हरदि छोड़ि आन बुकनी मसाला लेल करैत अछि, तेँ मरचाइ बुकनी पर ई कयल जा सकैत अछि। ⟦1⟧हमर हरदि गाइड⟦/1⟧ बतबैत अछि जे हरदिकेँ किएक छोड़ल गेल अछि।
seg.3d76d0b2a476.back: FSSAI's manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric, so it can be done on chilli powder. ⟦1⟧Our turmeric guide⟦/1⟧ explains why turmeric is left out.

seg.c7d23b036696.src: Put half a teaspoon of chilli powder on a white saucer.
seg.c7d23b036696.t: एकटा उज्जर तश्तरी पर आधा छोट चम्मच मरचाइ बुकनी राखू।
seg.c7d23b036696.back: Put half a small spoon of chilli powder on a white saucer.

seg.9b2fb67a0f9a.src: Add a few drops of tincture of iodine from a chemist.
seg.9b2fb67a0f9a.t: केमिस्टक दोकान सँ आनल टिंचर आयोडिनक किछु बुन्न खसाउ।
seg.9b2fb67a0f9a.back: Drop a few drops of tincture iodine brought from a chemist's shop.

seg.2d93dfc80312.src: Look at the colour where the drops land.
seg.2d93dfc80312.t: जतय बुन्न खसल, ओतुका रंग देखू।
seg.2d93dfc80312.back: Look at the colour where the drops fell.

seg.0db85a4ff58c.src: Points to added starch. Stop using that batch and get it tested. On red powder a faint change is hard to judge, so if you are not sure, let a lab decide.
seg.0db85a4ff58c.t: मिलाओल स्टार्च दिस इशारा करैत अछि। ओहि बैचक प्रयोग बन्न करू आ जँचबाउ। लाल बुकनी पर हल्लुक बदलाव परखब कठिन होइत अछि, तेँ जँ अहाँ निश्चित नहि छी, तँ लैबकेँ निर्णय करऽ दिअ।
seg.0db85a4ff58c.back: Points to added starch. Stop using that batch and get it tested. A slight change on red powder is hard to judge, so if you are not sure, let the lab decide.

seg.ed4a959013d8.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Iodine turns blue when it meets starch.
seg.ed4a959013d8.t: ⟦1⟧ई किएक काज करैत अछि।⟦/1⟧ स्टार्च सँ भेंट भेला पर आयोडिन नील भऽ जाइत अछि।

seg.f5e28e97055b.src: The methods in FSSAI's manual for brick powder, added colour, oil-soluble colours, Sudan III and Rhodamine B in chilli powder use strong acids and solvents such as chloroform, petroleum ether, hexane and acetone. The acids can cause burns, and several of the solvents catch fire easily. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.f5e28e97055b.t: मरचाइ बुकनीमे ईंटाक बुकनी, मिलाओल रंग, तेलमे घुलऽ बला रंग, सूडान III आ रोडामाइन B लेल FSSAI क पुस्तिकाक विधिमे तेज एसिड, आ क्लोरोफॉर्म, पेट्रोलियम ईथर, हेक्सेन आ एसीटोन सन सॉल्वेंटक प्रयोग होइत अछि। एसिड सँ देह जरि सकैत अछि, आ कतेको सॉल्वेंटमे सहजहि आगि लागि जाइत अछि। एकर जगह भनसाघर नहि, लैब अछि।
seg.f5e28e97055b.back: The FSSAI manual's methods for brick powder, added colour, oil-soluble colour, Sudan III and Rhodamine B in chilli powder use strong acids, and solvents such as chloroform, petroleum ether, hexane and acetone. Acids can burn the body [skin], and many solvents easily catch fire. Their place is the lab, not the kitchen.

seg.1e30ce9ef855.src: For a sure answer, send a sample to a NABL-accredited food testing lab. Ask it to test for added colours, including Sudan dyes, and against FSSAI's chilli powder standard. Its limits include moisture up to 11%, total ash up to 8%, and ash insoluble in dilute hydrochloric acid up to 1.3%, all by weight, with both ash limits on a dry basis. Keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack.
seg.1e30ce9ef855.t: पक्का जवाब लेल, NABL मान्यता प्राप्त खाद्य परीक्षण लैबमे नमूना पठाउ। ओकरा कहू जे सूडान डाई समेत मिलाओल रंगक जाँच करय, आ FSSAI क मरचाइ बुकनीक मानकक हिसाबें सेहो जाँचय। ओहि मानकक सीमामे ई सभ अछि: नमी 11% धरि, कुल राख 8% धरि, आ पातर हाइड्रोक्लोरिक एसिडमे नहि घुलऽ बला राख 1.3% धरि, सभ वजनक हिसाबें, आ दुनू राखक सीमा सुखल आधार पर। बुकनीकेँ ओकर सील बन्न पैकेटमे वा साफ सील बन्न थैलीमे राखू, आ पैकेट पर छपल बैच नम्बर लिखि लिअ।
seg.1e30ce9ef855.back: For a definite answer, send a sample to an NABL-accredited food testing lab. Ask them to test for added colour including Sudan dyes, and also to test against FSSAI's chilli powder standard. The limits of that standard include: moisture up to 11%, total ash up to 8%, and ash insoluble in dilute hydrochloric acid up to 1.3%, all by weight, and both ash limits on a dry basis. Keep the powder in its sealed packet or in a clean sealed bag, and note down the batch number printed on the packet.

seg.13c76694dc1e.src: How do I check chilli powder for brick powder at home?
seg.13c76694dc1e.t: घरमे मरचाइ बुकनीमे ईंटाक बुकनी कोना जाँची?
seg.13c76694dc1e.back: How to check for brick powder in chilli powder at home?

seg.3e87e1d30613.src: Put a teaspoon of chilli powder in a glass of water and let it settle. Pour off most of the water and rub the sediment between your fingers: grit points to brick powder or sand, and a white residue that feels soapy and smooth points to soapstone.
seg.3e87e1d30613.t: एक गिलास पानिमे एक छोट चम्मच मरचाइ बुकनी दऽ कऽ बैसऽ दिअ। बेसी पानि ढारि दिअ आ तरमे बैसल बुकनीकेँ आँगुरक बीच रगड़ू: किरकिर लागय तँ ईंटाक बुकनी वा बालु दिस इशारा अछि, आ उज्जर अवशेष जे साबुन सन आ चिक्कन लागय, से सोपस्टोन दिस इशारा करैत अछि।
seg.3e87e1d30613.back: Put one small spoon of chilli powder in a glass of water and let it settle. Pour off most of the water and rub the powder settled at the bottom between your fingers: if it feels gritty it points to brick powder or sand, and a white residue that feels soapy and smooth points to soapstone.

seg.f609f5773557.src: Can the water test detect Sudan dye in chilli powder?
seg.f609f5773557.t: की पानिक जाँच मरचाइ बुकनीमे सूडान डाई पकड़ि सकैत अछि?
seg.f609f5773557.back: Can the water check catch Sudan dye in chilli powder?

seg.7bd8af24de2f.src: No. Sudan I does not dissolve in water, so it cannot run out as streaks. FSSAI's manual tests for Sudan III and for oil-soluble colours with solvents such as hexane and petroleum ether, so those tests need a lab.
seg.7bd8af24de2f.t: नहि। सूडान I पानिमे नहि घुलैत अछि, तेँ ई धारी बनि कऽ नहि बहि सकैत अछि। FSSAI क पुस्तिका सूडान III आ तेलमे घुलऽ बला रंगक जाँच हेक्सेन आ पेट्रोलियम ईथर सन सॉल्वेंट सँ करैत अछि, तेँ ओहि परीक्षण लेल लैब चाही।
seg.7bd8af24de2f.back: No. Sudan I does not dissolve in water, so it cannot flow out as streaks. FSSAI's manual tests Sudan III and oil-soluble colours with solvents like hexane and petroleum ether, so that test needs a lab.

seg.d63c02ec2e5c.src: Does the iodine test work on chilli powder?
seg.d63c02ec2e5c.t: की आयोडिन परीक्षण मरचाइ बुकनी पर काज करैत अछि?
seg.d63c02ec2e5c.back: Does the iodine test work on chilli powder?

seg.01e86c518d41.src: Yes. FSSAI's manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric, and chilli powder is one of them. A blue colour points to added starch.
seg.01e86c518d41.t: हँ। FSSAI क पुस्तिका आयोडिन परीक्षणक प्रयोग हरदि छोड़ि आन बुकनी मसाला लेल करैत अछि, आ मरचाइ बुकनी ओहिमे सँ एक अछि। नील रंग मिलाओल स्टार्च दिस इशारा करैत अछि।
seg.01e86c518d41.back: Yes. FSSAI's manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric, and chilli powder is one of them. Blue colour points to added starch.

seg.75e20911cd47.src: Is bright red chilli powder a sign of adulteration?
seg.75e20911cd47.t: की चटक लाल मरचाइ बुकनी मिलावटक संकेत अछि?
seg.75e20911cd47.back: Is bright red chilli powder a sign of adulteration?

seg.dcfec3eff0b8.src: Colour alone does not tell you. The water check looks for colour that leaves the powder and runs down as streaks, not for how red the powder looks, and a lab can test for added colours.
seg.dcfec3eff0b8.t: असगर रंग सँ पता नहि चलैत अछि। पानिक जाँच ई देखैत अछि जे रंग बुकनी सँ निकलि कऽ धारी बनि नीचाँ बहैत अछि कि नहि, ई नहि जे बुकनी कतेक लाल देखाइत अछि; आ लैब मिलाओल रंगक जाँच कऽ सकैत अछि।
seg.dcfec3eff0b8.back: Colour alone does not tell. The water check looks at whether colour comes out of the powder and flows down as streaks, not at how red the powder looks; and a lab can test for added colour.

seg.54f85d34859f.src: Stop using that batch and keep the pack. Contact the seller with the batch number, or send a sample to a NABL-accredited food testing lab for a sure answer.

seg.54f85d34859f.back: Stop using that batch and keep the packet. Contact the seller with the batch number, or for a definite answer send a sample to an NABL-accredited food testing lab.

seg.0e55b39feef1.src: Hill turmeric (konda pasupu) or turmeric: the difference
seg.0e55b39feef1.t: पहाड़ी हरदि (कोंडा पसुपु) वा हरदि: दुनूमे अन्तर
seg.0e55b39feef1.back: Hill turmeric (Konda Pasupu) or turmeric: the difference between the two

seg.8b7a90a6aed6.src: Konda pasupu means hill turmeric: turmeric grown in hill country. In Andhra Pradesh that includes the agency hills of the Eastern Ghats around Araku Valley, Chintapalle and Paderu, where most tribal farmers grow turmeric. Plains turmeric grows on farmland in districts such as Guntur.
seg.8b7a90a6aed6.t: कोंडा पसुपुक अर्थ अछि पहाड़ी हरदि: पहाड़ी इलाकामे उपजल हरदि। आन्ध्र प्रदेशमे एहिमे अराकु घाटी, चिंतापल्ले आ पाडेरुक आसपास पूर्वी घाटक एजेंसी पहाड़ी सभ अबैत अछि, जतय आदिवासी किसानमे सँ बेसीतर किसान हरदि उपजबैत छथि। मैदानी हरदि गुंटूर सन जिलाक खेतमे उपजैत अछि।
seg.8b7a90a6aed6.back: Konda pasupu means hill turmeric: turmeric grown in hilly areas. In Andhra Pradesh this includes the Agency hills of the Eastern Ghats around Araku Valley, Chintapalle and Paderu, where most of the tribal farmers grow turmeric [lit: 'from among tribal farmers, most farmers grow turmeric']. Plains turmeric grows in the fields of districts like Guntur.

seg.404d008584f4.src: FSSAI's standard for turmeric powder is the same wherever it grew. What changes is the place, the variety, and how it is grown and dried. This guide covers each of those, what curcumin is, how to cook with each and how to compare two turmerics fairly. There is a Telugu section further down.
seg.404d008584f4.t: हरदि बुकनी लेल FSSAI क मानक एक्के अछि, ओ कतहु उपजल हो। जे बदलैत अछि से अछि जगह, किस्म, आ ओकरा कोना उपजाओल आ सुखाओल जाइत अछि। ई गाइड एहि सभक बात करैत अछि, संगहि करक्यूमिन की अछि, दुनूक संग कोना भानस करी, आ दू टा हरदिक उचित तुलना कोना करी। नीचाँ एकटा तेलुगु खण्ड सेहो अछि।
seg.404d008584f4.back: FSSAI's standard for turmeric powder is the same, wherever it is grown. What changes is the place, the variety, and how it is grown and dried. This guide talks about all of this, along with what curcumin is, how to cook with both, and how to compare two turmerics fairly. Below there is also a Telugu section.

seg.2e709bd87897.src: ⟦1⟧Our two turmerics⟦/1⟧Left: hill turmeric from the Araku and Maredumilli hills. Right: turmeric grown in Palnadu and Guntur. Both packed in Narasaraopet.
seg.2e709bd87897.t: ⟦1⟧हमर दू टा हरदि⟦/1⟧बामा: अराकु आ मारेडुमिल्ली पहाड़ीक पहाड़ी हरदि। दहिना: पल्नाडु आ गुंटूरमे उपजल हरदि। दुनू नरसरावपेटमे पैक कयल।
seg.2e709bd87897.back: ⟦1⟧Our two turmerics⟦/1⟧Left: hill turmeric from the Araku and Maredumilli hills. Right: turmeric grown in Palnadu and Guntur. Both packed in Narasaraopet.

seg.10eec083bb3d.src: Hill turmeric (konda pasupu) grows in hill country, such as the Eastern Ghats around Araku, where most tribal farmers grow it. Plains turmeric grows on farmland in districts such as Guntur. Both are boiled, dried and ground, and FSSAI holds both to the same standard. Curcumin, the yellow pigment in turmeric, changes with variety, soil, climate and processing, so the word hill or plains does not tell you how much a turmeric has. Cook with both the same way.
seg.10eec083bb3d.t: पहाड़ी हरदि (कोंडा पसुपु) पहाड़ी इलाकामे उपजैत अछि, जेना अराकुक आसपास पूर्वी घाटमे, जतय आदिवासी किसानमे सँ बेसीतर किसान एकरा उपजबैत छथि। मैदानी हरदि गुंटूर सन जिलाक खेतमे उपजैत अछि। दुनूकेँ उसिनल, सुखाओल आ पीसल जाइत अछि, आ FSSAI दुनू लेल एक्के मानक रखैत अछि। करक्यूमिन, अर्थात् हरदिक पीयर रंग-द्रव्य, किस्म, माटि, जलवायु आ प्रसंस्करणक संग बदलैत अछि, तेँ पहाड़ी वा मैदानी शब्द सँ ई पता नहि चलैत अछि जे कोनो हरदिमे कतेक करक्यूमिन अछि। दुनूक संग एक्के तरहेँ भानस करू।
seg.10eec083bb3d.back: Hill turmeric (konda pasupu) grows in hilly areas, such as in the Eastern Ghats around Araku, where most of the tribal farmers grow it. Plains turmeric grows in the fields of districts like Guntur. Both are boiled, dried and ground, and FSSAI keeps the same standard for both. Curcumin, that is turmeric's yellow pigment, changes with variety, soil, climate and processing, so the word hill or plains does not tell how much curcumin is in any turmeric. Cook with both the same way.
