seg.6fcc769ff4cc.src: Farms in Guntur district, where turmeric is one of the commercial crops, with cotton, chillies and tobacco
seg.6fcc769ff4cc.t: गुंटूर जिलाक खेत, जतय कपास, मरचाइ आ तमाकुक संग हरदि सेहो एकटा व्यावसायिक फसिल अछि
seg.6fcc769ff4cc.back: Fields of Guntur district, where along with cotton, chilli and tobacco, turmeric is also a commercial crop

seg.4fad87cf8112.src: The old local variety has often been left for 2 to 3 seasons, up to 18 to 24 months; newer varieties such as Roma are dug after one season
seg.4fad87cf8112.t: पुरान स्थानीय किस्मकेँ प्रायः 2 सँ 3 मौसम, 18 सँ 24 महीना धरि, माटिमे छोड़ल जाइत रहल अछि; रोमा सन नव किस्म एक मौसमक बाद कोड़ल जाइत अछि
seg.4fad87cf8112.back: Old local varieties have often been left in the soil for 2 to 3 seasons, 18 to 24 months; new varieties like Roma are dug up after one season

seg.186488dd4390.src: ICAR-IISR's general guide: a well-managed crop is ready in 7 to 9 months, usually dug between January and March
seg.186488dd4390.t: ICAR-IISR क सामान्य गाइड: नीक देखभाल बला फसिल 7 सँ 9 महीनामे तैयार भऽ जाइत अछि, आ प्रायः जनवरी सँ मार्चक बीच कोड़ल जाइत अछि
seg.186488dd4390.back: ICAR-IISR general guide: a well-cared-for crop is ready in 7 to 9 months, and is usually dug up between January and March

seg.a5d9b319040e.src: Boiled and dried by hand, which takes a lot of labour and firewood
seg.a5d9b319040e.t: हाथ सँ उसिनल आ सुखाओल, जाहिमे बहुत मेहनति आ जारनि लगैत अछि
seg.a5d9b319040e.back: Boiled and dried by hand, which takes a lot of labour and firewood

seg.9094d5bd4e83.src: The usual steps: boiled, sun-dried, then polished by hand or by machine
seg.9094d5bd4e83.t: सामान्य चरण: उसिनल, रौदमे सुखाओल, फेर हाथ सँ वा मशीन सँ पॉलिश कयल
seg.9094d5bd4e83.back: General steps: boiled, sun-dried, then polished by hand or by machine

seg.d3963fd16edc.src: The same one for both: at least 2% curcuminoids on a dry basis, and added colour is not allowed
seg.d3963fd16edc.t: दुनू लेल एक्के: सुखल आधार पर कम सँ कम 2% करक्यूमिनॉयड, आ रंग मिलेबाक अनुमति नहि अछि
seg.d3963fd16edc.back: The same for both: at least 2% curcuminoids on a dry basis, and mixing in colour [or: adding colour] is not permitted

seg.2e323e56fef7.src: Araku and Maredumilli hills. Whole hill turmeric fingers, packed as fine powder
seg.2e323e56fef7.t: अराकु आ मारेडुमिल्ली पहाड़ी। पहाड़ी हरदिक समूचा गाँठ, महीन बुकनी बना कऽ पैक कयल
seg.2e323e56fef7.back: Araku and Maredumilli hills. Whole fingers of hill turmeric, made into fine powder and packed

seg.ce4850eb3b73.src: Grown in Palnadu and Guntur. Sun-dried, stone-ground
seg.ce4850eb3b73.t: पल्नाडु आ गुंटूरमे उपजल। रौदमे सुखाओल, पाथरक जाँतमे पिसल
seg.ce4850eb3b73.back: Grown in Palnadu and Guntur. Sun-dried, ground in a stone grinder [stone quern]

seg.8c0d21f32664.src: The rows above describe each region in general, from the sources at the end of this page. Only the last row is about our packs.
seg.8c0d21f32664.t: ऊपरका पाँती सभ एहि पन्नाक अन्तमे देल स्रोतक आधार पर प्रत्येक क्षेत्रक सामान्य वर्णन अछि। मात्र अन्तिम पाँती हमर पैकेटक बारेमे अछि।
seg.8c0d21f32664.back: The rows above are a general description of each region based on the sources given at the end of this page. Only the last row is about our packet.

seg.a9e5b44e1be6.src: ⟦1⟧Hill turmeric.⟦/1⟧ ICAR-IISR's report on the Paderu agency, the tribal hill country of the Eastern Ghats that takes in Araku Valley, Chintapalle and Paderu, says turmeric is grown there by most tribal farmers.
seg.a9e5b44e1be6.t: ⟦1⟧पहाड़ी हरदि।⟦/1⟧ पाडेरु एजेंसी, अर्थात् पूर्वी घाटक आदिवासी पहाड़ी इलाका जाहिमे अराकु घाटी, चिंतापल्ले आ पाडेरु अबैत अछि, ताहि पर ICAR-IISR क रिपोर्ट कहैत अछि जे ओतय आदिवासी किसानमे सँ बेसीतर किसान हरदि उपजबैत छथि।
seg.a9e5b44e1be6.back: ⟦1⟧Hill turmeric.⟦/1⟧ On the Paderu Agency, that is the tribal hill area of the Eastern Ghats which includes Araku Valley, Chintapalle and Paderu, an ICAR-IISR report says that there most of the tribal farmers grow turmeric.

seg.736e66a0b5de.src: ⟦1⟧Plains turmeric.⟦/1⟧ Guntur district lists turmeric among its commercial crops, with cotton, chillies and tobacco. Duggirala, in Guntur, has a turmeric processing cluster that makes processed turmeric and turmeric powder. In 2022, Guntur district was divided into three districts: Guntur, Palnadu and Bapatla.
seg.736e66a0b5de.t: ⟦1⟧मैदानी हरदि।⟦/1⟧ गुंटूर जिला अपन व्यावसायिक फसिलमे कपास, मरचाइ आ तमाकुक संग हरदिकेँ गनैत अछि। गुंटूरक दुग्गिरालामे हरदि प्रसंस्करणक एकटा क्लस्टर अछि जे प्रसंस्कृत हरदि आ हरदि बुकनी बनबैत अछि। 2022 मे गुंटूर जिलाकेँ तीन जिलामे बाँटल गेल: गुंटूर, पल्नाडु आ बापटला।
seg.736e66a0b5de.back: ⟦1⟧Plains turmeric.⟦/1⟧ Guntur district counts turmeric among its commercial crops along with cotton, chilli and tobacco. At Duggirala in Guntur there is a turmeric processing cluster that makes processed turmeric and turmeric powder. In 2022 Guntur district was divided into three districts: Guntur, Palnadu and Bapatla.

seg.0f26c0785ed1.src: Turmeric can be grown either way: ICAR-IISR says it can be grown rain-fed or irrigated, from sea level up to 1,500 m.
seg.0f26c0785ed1.t: हरदि दुनू तरहेँ उपजाओल जा सकैत अछि: ICAR-IISR कहैत अछि जे एकरा बरखाक भरोसे वा पटा कऽ, समुद्र तल सँ 1,500 m धरि उपजाओल जा सकैत अछि।
seg.0f26c0785ed1.back: Turmeric can be grown both ways: ICAR-IISR says it can be grown rain-fed or irrigated, up to 1,500 m above sea level.

seg.b687346df428.src: Our ⟦1⟧hill turmeric⟦/1⟧ comes from the Araku and Maredumilli hills, and our ⟦2⟧turmeric⟦/2⟧ is grown in Palnadu and Guntur. Both are packed in Narasaraopet.
seg.b687346df428.t: हमर ⟦1⟧पहाड़ी हरदि⟦/1⟧ अराकु आ मारेडुमिल्ली पहाड़ी सँ अबैत अछि, आ हमर ⟦2⟧हरदि⟦/2⟧ पल्नाडु आ गुंटूरमे उपजैत अछि। दुनू नरसरावपेटमे पैक कयल जाइत अछि।
seg.b687346df428.back: Our ⟦1⟧hill turmeric⟦/1⟧ comes from the Araku and Maredumilli hills, and our ⟦2⟧turmeric⟦/2⟧ grows in Palnadu and Guntur. Both are packed in Narasaraopet.

seg.9a5af9e957e1.src: How each is grown and dried
seg.9a5af9e957e1.t: दुनू कोना उपजाओल आ सुखाओल जाइत अछि
seg.9a5af9e957e1.back: How the two are grown and dried

seg.e641ce21ee35.src: ⟦1⟧In the hills.⟦/1⟧ ICAR-IISR's Paderu report says tribal farmers there have grown a local variety called Chayapasupu, or Chintapalle Local, for ages. It has been common practice to leave it in the ground for two or three seasons, up to 18 to 24 months, before digging. From 2011-12, ICAR-IISR and the Horticultural Research Station at Chintapalle tested varieties for the hill zone and brought in Roma and IISR Pragati, which are dug after one season. The report says tribal farmers boil and dry their turmeric by hand, which takes a lot of labour and firewood; the project gave four farmer producer organisations turmeric boilers and polishers.
seg.e641ce21ee35.t: ⟦1⟧पहाड़मे।⟦/1⟧ ICAR-IISR क पाडेरु रिपोर्ट कहैत अछि जे ओतुका आदिवासी किसान बहुत पहिने सँ चायापसुपु, वा चिंतापल्ले लोकल, नामक एकटा स्थानीय किस्म उपजबैत आबि रहल छथि। कोड़बा सँ पहिने एकरा दू वा तीन मौसम, 18 सँ 24 महीना धरि, माटिमे छोड़ब आम चलन रहल अछि। 2011-12 सँ ICAR-IISR आ चिंतापल्लेक बागवानी अनुसंधान केन्द्र पहाड़ी क्षेत्र लेल किस्म सभक परीक्षण कयलक आ रोमा आ IISR प्रगति अनलक, जे एक मौसमक बाद कोड़ल जाइत अछि। रिपोर्ट कहैत अछि जे आदिवासी किसान अपन हरदि हाथ सँ उसिनैत आ सुखबैत छथि, जाहिमे बहुत मेहनति आ जारनि लगैत अछि; परियोजना चारि टा किसान उत्पादक संगठनकेँ हरदि उसिनबाक आ पॉलिश करबाक मशीन देलक।
seg.e641ce21ee35.back: ⟦1⟧In the hills.⟦/1⟧ ICAR-IISR's Paderu report says that tribal farmers there have long been growing a local variety called Chayapasupu, or Chintapalle Local. It has been common practice to leave it in the soil for two or three seasons, 18 to 24 months, before digging. From 2011-12 ICAR-IISR and the Horticultural Research Station of Chintapalle tested varieties for the hill region and brought in Roma and IISR Pragati, which are dug up after one season. The report says the tribal farmers boil and dry their turmeric by hand, which takes a lot of labour and firewood; the project gave four farmer producer organisations turmeric boiling and polishing machines.

seg.f93b2805162b.src: ⟦1⟧The usual steps.⟦/1⟧ ICAR-IISR's turmeric guide describes how the crop is handled after it is dug:
seg.f93b2805162b.t: ⟦1⟧सामान्य चरण।⟦/1⟧ ICAR-IISR क हरदि गाइड बतबैत अछि जे कोड़लाक बाद फसिलकेँ कोना सम्हारल जाइत अछि:
seg.f93b2805162b.back: ⟦1⟧General steps.⟦/1⟧ ICAR-IISR's turmeric guide explains how the crop is handled after digging:

seg.675a9ec4355c.src: Dig it when the leaves dry and turn light brown to yellowish. A well-managed crop is ready seven to nine months after planting, usually between January and March.
seg.675a9ec4355c.t: जखन पात सुखि कऽ हल्लुक भूरा सँ पीयर सन भऽ जाय, तखन कोड़ू। नीक देखभाल बला फसिल रोपलाक सात सँ नौ महीना बाद तैयार होइत अछि, प्रायः जनवरी सँ मार्चक बीच।
seg.675a9ec4355c.back: Dig when the leaves dry and turn light brown to yellowish. A well-cared-for crop is ready seven to nine months after planting, usually between January and March.

seg.763940881dcd.src: Separate the fingers from the bulbs and boil them within 3 or 4 days of digging, in water until soft: 45 to 60 minutes for fingers and 90 minutes for bulbs. Boiling takes away the raw smell, cuts the drying time and gives an even colour.
seg.763940881dcd.t: गाँठकेँ माँझक कन्द सँ अलग करू आ कोड़लाक 3 वा 4 दिनक भीतर पानिमे नरम होबा धरि उसिनू: गाँठ लेल 45 सँ 60 मिनट आ कन्द लेल 90 मिनट। उसिनला सँ काँच गन्ध चलि जाइत अछि, सुखेबाक समय घटैत अछि आ रंग एकसन होइत अछि।
seg.763940881dcd.back: Separate the fingers from the central bulb [mother rhizome] and within 3 or 4 days of digging boil them in water until soft: 45 to 60 minutes for fingers and 90 minutes for bulbs. Boiling removes the raw smell, cuts drying time and makes the colour uniform.

seg.a52a5947071a.src: Dry them in the sun in layers 5 to 7 cm deep, heaped and covered at night. It may take 10 to 12 days for the moisture to fall below 12%.
seg.a52a5947071a.t: रौदमे 5 सँ 7 cm मोट परतमे सुखाउ, आ रातिमे ढेरी बना कऽ झाँपि दिअ। नमी 12% सँ नीचाँ एबामे 10 सँ 12 दिन लागि सकैत अछि।
seg.a52a5947071a.back: Dry in the sun in a 5 to 7 cm thick layer, and at night heap it up and cover it. It can take 10 to 12 days for moisture to come below 12%.

seg.69d24ab1420a.src: Polish off the rough, dull, scaly skin by rubbing, by hand or in a turning drum.
seg.69d24ab1420a.t: खुरदुरा, फीका, पपड़ीदार छिलका रगड़ि कऽ छोड़ाउ, हाथ सँ वा घुमैत ड्रममे।
seg.69d24ab1420a.back: Rub off the rough, dull, scaly skin, by hand or in a rotating drum.

seg.1b7d7df8b7fa.src: Grind the dried turmeric into powder. FSSAI allows turmeric powder up to 10% moisture.
seg.1b7d7df8b7fa.t: सुखल हरदिकेँ पीसि कऽ बुकनी बनाउ। FSSAI हरदि बुकनीमे 10% धरि नमीक अनुमति दैत अछि।
seg.1b7d7df8b7fa.back: Grind the dried turmeric into powder. FSSAI permits up to 10% moisture in turmeric powder.

seg.1668650874a7.src: Fingers are the side branches of the turmeric rhizome, usually 2.5 to 7.5 cm long; bulbs are the shorter, thicker central rhizome. Our hill turmeric pack says whole hill turmeric fingers, packed as fine powder. Our turmeric pack says sun-dried and stone-ground.
seg.1668650874a7.t: गाँठ हरदिक प्रकन्दक बगलक शाखा होइत अछि, प्रायः 2.5 सँ 7.5 cm नमहर; कन्द माँझक छोट आ मोट प्रकन्द होइत अछि। हमर पहाड़ी हरदिक पैकेट पर लिखल अछि: पहाड़ी हरदिक समूचा गाँठ, महीन बुकनी बना कऽ पैक कयल। हमर हरदिक पैकेट पर लिखल अछि: रौदमे सुखाओल आ पाथरक जाँतमे पिसल।
seg.1668650874a7.back: Fingers are side branches of the turmeric rhizome, usually 2.5 to 7.5 cm long; bulbs are the short, thick central rhizome. Our hill turmeric packet says: whole fingers of hill turmeric, made into fine powder and packed. Our turmeric packet says: sun-dried and ground in a stone grinder.

seg.4a08c0de8660.t: करक्यूमिन, आ दुनू केहन देखाइत अछि
seg.4a08c0de8660.back: Curcumin, and how the two look

seg.7ef4d7667b4e.src: Curcumin is the yellow pigment in turmeric, ICAR-IISR says. FSSAI measures a turmeric powder's colouring power as its curcuminoid content, and asks for at least 2% on a dry basis. That standard is the same for hill and plains turmeric.
seg.7ef4d7667b4e.t: ICAR-IISR कहैत अछि जे करक्यूमिन हरदिक पीयर रंग-द्रव्य अछि। FSSAI हरदि बुकनीक रंग देबाक शक्तिकेँ ओकर करक्यूमिनॉयड मात्रा सँ मापैत अछि, आ सुखल आधार पर कम सँ कम 2% मँगैत अछि। ई मानक पहाड़ी आ मैदानी हरदि लेल एक्के अछि।
seg.7ef4d7667b4e.back: ICAR-IISR says that curcumin is the yellow pigment of turmeric. FSSAI measures the colouring power of turmeric powder by its curcuminoid content, and asks for at least 2% on a dry basis. This standard is the same for hill and plains turmeric.

seg.fec370db2315.src: Curcumin changes from one turmeric to the next:
seg.fec370db2315.t: करक्यूमिन एक हरदि सँ दोसर हरदिमे बदलैत अछि:
seg.fec370db2315.back: Curcumin varies from one turmeric to another:

seg.bf314e75200d.src: ⟦1⟧Variety.⟦/1⟧ ICAR-IISR's 2022 turmeric guide lists its own varieties from 4.3% curcumin (Suvarna) to 6.5% (IISR Prabha).
seg.bf314e75200d.t: ⟦1⟧किस्म।⟦/1⟧ ICAR-IISR क 2022 क हरदि गाइड अपन किस्म सभमे 4.3% करक्यूमिन (सुवर्णा) सँ 6.5% (IISR प्रभा) धरि गनबैत अछि।
seg.bf314e75200d.back: ⟦1⟧Variety.⟦/1⟧ ICAR-IISR's 2022 turmeric guide lists among its varieties from 4.3% curcumin (Suvarna) to 6.5% (IISR Prabha).

seg.cee7632d2998.src: ⟦1⟧Soil and climate.⟦/1⟧ ICAR-IISR notes that turmeric from different regions differs in quality because of soil, climate and farming practice. Its Paderu report calls curcumin content highly sensitive to changes in the growing environment.
seg.cee7632d2998.t: ⟦1⟧माटि आ जलवायु।⟦/1⟧ ICAR-IISR लिखैत अछि जे माटि, जलवायु आ खेतीक तरीकाक कारणे अलग-अलग क्षेत्रक हरदिक गुणवत्तामे अन्तर होइत अछि। एकर पाडेरु रिपोर्ट कहैत अछि जे करक्यूमिनक मात्रा उपजबाक वातावरणमे बदलाव पर बहुत संवेदनशील होइत अछि।
seg.cee7632d2998.back: ⟦1⟧Soil and climate.⟦/1⟧ ICAR-IISR writes that because of soil, climate and farming methods there are differences in the quality of turmeric from different regions. Its Paderu report says that curcumin content is very sensitive to changes in the growing environment.

seg.70b529fe0f69.src: ⟦1⟧Processing.⟦/1⟧ Handling and processing after harvest add to the differences, and boiling too long or too short affects the quality of the dried turmeric.
seg.70b529fe0f69.t: ⟦1⟧प्रसंस्करण।⟦/1⟧ फसिल कटलाक बाद सम्हारब आ प्रसंस्करण सेहो अन्तर बढ़बैत अछि, आ बेसी काल वा कम काल उसिनला सँ सुखल हरदिक गुणवत्ता पर असरि पड़ैत अछि।
seg.70b529fe0f69.back: ⟦1⟧Processing.⟦/1⟧ Post-harvest handling and processing also increase the difference, and boiling too long or too short affects the quality of dried turmeric.

seg.493187b22749.src: So the word hill or plains on a pack does not tell you a turmeric's curcumin content. A food testing lab can measure the curcuminoid content of a batch.
seg.493187b22749.t: तेँ पैकेट पर पहाड़ी वा मैदानी शब्द सँ ई पता नहि चलैत अछि जे हरदिमे कतेक करक्यूमिन अछि। खाद्य परीक्षण लैब कोनो बैचक करक्यूमिनॉयड मात्रा माप सकैत अछि।
seg.493187b22749.back: So the word hill or plains on a packet does not tell how much curcumin is in the turmeric. A food testing lab can measure the curcuminoid content of a batch.

seg.53dc21b97510.src: ⟦1⟧How they look.⟦/1⟧ Colour varies too. ICAR-IISR describes its varieties' rhizomes as ranging from reddish yellow to deep orange. Processing counts as well: boiling evens out the colour, drying in too thin a layer can spoil it, and polishing by hand leaves a rough, dull surface.
seg.53dc21b97510.t: ⟦1⟧दुनू केहन देखाइत अछि।⟦/1⟧ रंग सेहो अलग होइत अछि। ICAR-IISR अपन किस्म सभक प्रकन्दक रंग ललौंछ पीयर सँ गाढ़ नारंगी धरि बतबैत अछि। प्रसंस्करणक सेहो असरि होइत अछि: उसिनला सँ रंग एकसन होइत अछि, बहुत पातर परतमे सुखेला सँ रंग बिगड़ि सकैत अछि, आ हाथ सँ पॉलिश कयला पर सतह खुरदुरा आ फीका रहैत अछि।
seg.53dc21b97510.back: ⟦1⟧How the two look.⟦/1⟧ Colour also differs. ICAR-IISR describes the rhizome colour of its varieties from reddish yellow to deep orange. Processing also has an effect: boiling makes the colour uniform, drying in a very thin layer can spoil the colour, and hand polishing leaves the surface rough and dull.

seg.d8ece11f902a.src: Cooking with each, and keeping it
seg.d8ece11f902a.t: दुनूक संग भानस, आ राखबाक तरीका
seg.d8ece11f902a.back: Cooking with both, and how to store

seg.276f633c7a1f.src: Use either one wherever you use turmeric: dal, sambar, rasam, curries and pulihora.
seg.276f633c7a1f.t: जतय-जतय हरदि प्रयोग करैत छी, ओतय दुनूमे सँ कोनो एकटा प्रयोग करू: दालि, सांभर, रसम, तरकारी आ पुलिहोरा।
seg.276f633c7a1f.back: Wherever you use turmeric, use either one of the two: dal, sambar, rasam, vegetable curry and pulihora.

seg.ca5e9b6340f2.src: Add it on a low flame so it does not burn.
seg.ca5e9b6340f2.t: धीमा आँच पर डालू, जाहि सँ ई जरि नहि जाय।
seg.ca5e9b6340f2.back: Add [lit: put] it on low heat, so that it does not burn.

seg.7e910d4ad2a1.src: To swap one for the other, start with the amount you usually use and adjust to taste.
seg.7e910d4ad2a1.t: एकक बदला दोसर प्रयोग करबाक हो तँ जतेक सदिखन दैत छी ततबे सँ शुरू करू, आ स्वाद अनुसार घटाउ-बढ़ाउ।
seg.7e910d4ad2a1.back: If using one in place of the other, start with the same amount you always add, and adjust to taste.

seg.731001f6177d.src: Try either one in ⟦1⟧pasupu annam⟦/1⟧, ⟦2⟧nimmakaya pulihora⟦/2⟧, ⟦3⟧tomato pappu⟦/3⟧ or ⟦4⟧pasupu paalu⟦/4⟧.
seg.731001f6177d.t: ⟦1⟧पसुपु अन्नम⟦/1⟧, ⟦2⟧निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा⟦/2⟧, ⟦3⟧टोमाटो पप्पु⟦/3⟧ वा ⟦4⟧पसुपु पालु⟦/4⟧ मे कोनो एकटा प्रयोग कऽ देखू।
seg.731001f6177d.back: Try using either one in ⟦1⟧Pasupu Annam⟦/1⟧, ⟦2⟧Nimmakaya Pulihora⟦/2⟧, ⟦3⟧Tomato Pappu⟦/3⟧ or ⟦4⟧Pasupu Palu⟦/4⟧.

seg.073f63fe23e0.src: Use a dry spoon every time.

seg.b334ade49a15.src: Store it in a cool, dry place, away from light.
seg.b334ade49a15.t: ठंढा, सुखल जगहमे, इजोत सँ दूर राखू।
seg.b334ade49a15.back: Keep in a cool, dry place, away from light.

seg.ea935ed7c1aa.src: How to compare two turmerics fairly
seg.ea935ed7c1aa.t: दू टा हरदिक उचित तुलना कोना करी
seg.ea935ed7c1aa.back: How to compare two turmerics fairly

seg.dcebc75ff722.src: Compare powder with powder. FSSAI allows whole turmeric up to 12% moisture and powder up to 10%, so the two are held to different limits.
seg.dcebc75ff722.t: बुकनीक तुलना बुकनी सँ करू। FSSAI समूचा हरदिमे 12% धरि आ बुकनीमे 10% धरि नमीक अनुमति दैत अछि, तेँ दुनूक सीमा अलग अछि।
seg.dcebc75ff722.back: Compare powder with powder. FSSAI permits up to 12% moisture in whole turmeric and up to 10% in powder, so the limits for the two are different.

seg.9d14be920107.src: Read both packs: where it was grown, the batch or lot number, the best-before date and the FSSAI licence or registration number. Note the batch numbers, so you know which lots you compared.
seg.9d14be920107.t: दुनू पैकेट पढ़ू: कतय उपजल, बैच वा लॉट नम्बर, बेस्ट-बिफोर तारीख आ FSSAI लाइसेंस वा पंजीकरण नम्बर। बैच नम्बर लिखि लिअ, जाहि सँ पता रहय जे कोन लॉटक तुलना कयलहुँ।
seg.9d14be920107.back: Read both packets: where grown, batch or lot number, best-before date and FSSAI licence or registration number. Note down the batch numbers, so you know which lots you compared.

seg.fbb64b2b32b0.src: Do the water check on both, side by side, with the same amount in the same kind of glass. The steps are in ⟦1⟧how to check turmeric powder at home⟦/1⟧.
seg.fbb64b2b32b0.t: दुनू पर पानिक जाँच संग-संग करू, एक्के मात्रामे आ एक्के तरहक गिलासमे। एकर चरण ⟦1⟧घरमे हरदि बुकनी कोना जाँची⟦/1⟧ मे अछि।
seg.fbb64b2b32b0.back: Do the water check on both side by side, in the same amount and in the same kind of glass. Its steps are in ⟦1⟧How to test turmeric powder at home⟦/1⟧.

seg.bd82039194f2.src: Cook the same dish with each, with the same amount, and compare the colour and taste.
seg.bd82039194f2.t: दुनू सँ एक्के व्यंजन, एक्के मात्रामे बनाउ, आ रंग आ स्वादक तुलना करू।
seg.bd82039194f2.back: Make the same dish with both, in the same amount, and compare colour and taste.

seg.8949107c3ad8.src: Do not judge curcumin by colour alone. A brighter yellow is not a measurement; a food testing lab can measure curcuminoid content.
seg.8949107c3ad8.t: मात्र रंग देखि कऽ करक्यूमिनक अनुमान नहि करू। बेसी चटक पीयर रंग कोनो माप नहि अछि; खाद्य परीक्षण लैब करक्यूमिनॉयड मात्रा माप सकैत अछि।
seg.8949107c3ad8.back: Do not guess curcumin just by looking at colour. A brighter yellow colour is not a measurement; a food testing lab can measure curcuminoid content.

seg.1810d213ce3f.src: Konda pasupu is Telugu for hill turmeric: turmeric grown in hill country. In Andhra Pradesh it grows in the Eastern Ghats, for example in the Paderu agency around Araku Valley and Chintapalle, where most tribal farmers grow turmeric.
seg.1810d213ce3f.t: तेलुगुमे पहाड़ी हरदिकेँ कोंडा पसुपु कहैत छैक: पहाड़ी इलाकामे उपजल हरदि। आन्ध्र प्रदेशमे ई पूर्वी घाटमे उपजैत अछि, जेना अराकु घाटी आ चिंतापल्लेक आसपास पाडेरु एजेंसीमे, जतय आदिवासी किसानमे सँ बेसीतर किसान हरदि उपजबैत छथि।
seg.1810d213ce3f.back: In Telugu hill turmeric is called konda pasupu: turmeric grown in hilly areas. In Andhra Pradesh it grows in the Eastern Ghats, such as in the Paderu Agency around Araku Valley and Chintapalle, where most of the tribal farmers grow turmeric.

seg.15730f8cc6b8.src: Is hill turmeric different from regular turmeric?
seg.15730f8cc6b8.t: की पहाड़ी हरदि सामान्य हरदि सँ अलग अछि?
seg.15730f8cc6b8.back: Is hill turmeric different from ordinary turmeric?

seg.47cf644d0819.src: FSSAI holds all turmeric powder to the same standard, wherever it grew. Hill and plains turmeric can differ in where they grow, the varieties grown, and how they are grown and dried. In the Paderu hills, for example, an old local variety has often been left in the ground for up to two years.
seg.47cf644d0819.t: FSSAI सभ हरदि बुकनी लेल एक्के मानक रखैत अछि, ओ कतहु उपजल हो। पहाड़ी आ मैदानी हरदिमे अन्तर भऽ सकैत अछि: कतय उपजैत अछि, कोन किस्म उपजाओल जाइत अछि, आ कोना उपजाओल आ सुखाओल जाइत अछि। उदाहरण लेल, पाडेरुक पहाड़मे एकटा पुरान स्थानीय किस्मकेँ प्रायः दू बरख धरि माटिमे छोड़ल जाइत रहल अछि।
seg.47cf644d0819.back: FSSAI keeps the same standard for all turmeric powder, wherever it is grown. Hill and plains turmeric can differ in: where it grows, which variety is grown, and how it is grown and dried. For example, in the Paderu hills an old local variety has often been left in the soil for up to two years.

seg.925655ca4b05.src: Does hill turmeric have more curcumin?
seg.925655ca4b05.t: की पहाड़ी हरदिमे बेसी करक्यूमिन होइत अछि?
seg.925655ca4b05.back: Does hill turmeric have more curcumin?

seg.0d1b42a32899.src: The word hill alone does not tell you. Curcumin changes with the variety, the soil and climate, and how the turmeric was boiled and dried. A food testing lab can measure the curcuminoid content of a batch.
seg.0d1b42a32899.t: असगर पहाड़ी शब्द सँ पता नहि चलैत अछि। करक्यूमिन किस्म, माटि आ जलवायु, आ हरदि कोना उसिनल आ सुखाओल गेल, ताहि सँ बदलैत अछि। खाद्य परीक्षण लैब कोनो बैचक करक्यूमिनॉयड मात्रा माप सकैत अछि।
seg.0d1b42a32899.back: The word hill alone does not tell. Curcumin varies with variety, soil and climate, and with how the turmeric was boiled and dried. A food testing lab can measure the curcuminoid content of a batch.

seg.4bce9a44c11e.src: What are the types of turmeric (haldi) in India?
seg.4bce9a44c11e.t: भारतमे हरदि (हल्दी) क कोन-कोन प्रकार अछि?
seg.4bce9a44c11e.back: What types of turmeric (haldi) are there in India?

seg.4e6e7201dae6.src: ICAR-IISR says India grows many turmeric cultivars, mostly known by the name of the place where they are grown, such as Duggirala, Mydukur, Tekkurpet and Amalapuram. It has also released improved varieties such as IISR Prabha, IISR Prathibha and IISR Pragati.
seg.4e6e7201dae6.t: ICAR-IISR कहैत अछि जे भारतमे हरदिक बहुत रास किस्म उपजाओल जाइत अछि, जे बेसीतर ओहि जगहक नाम सँ जानल जाइत अछि जतय ओ उपजैत अछि, जेना दुग्गिराला, मैदुकुर, टेक्कुरपेट आ अमलापुरम। ई IISR प्रभा, IISR प्रतिभा आ IISR प्रगति सन उन्नत किस्म सेहो जारी कयलक अछि।
seg.4e6e7201dae6.back: ICAR-IISR says that many varieties of turmeric are grown in India, mostly known by the name of the place where they grow, such as Duggirala, Mydukur, Tekkurpet and Amalapuram. It has also released improved varieties such as IISR Prabha, IISR Prathibha and IISR Pragati.

seg.7f1a5999ea66.src: Can I use hill turmeric instead of regular turmeric?
seg.7f1a5999ea66.t: की सामान्य हरदिक बदला पहाड़ी हरदि प्रयोग कऽ सकैत छी?
seg.7f1a5999ea66.back: Can I use hill turmeric in place of ordinary turmeric?

seg.4ed419c2136a.src: Yes. Use it wherever you use turmeric, start with the amount you usually use, and add it on a low flame so it does not burn.
seg.4ed419c2136a.t: हँ। जतय-जतय हरदि प्रयोग करैत छी ओतय एकरा प्रयोग करू, जतेक सदिखन दैत छी ततबे सँ शुरू करू, आ धीमा आँच पर डालू, जाहि सँ ई जरि नहि जाय।
seg.4ed419c2136a.back: Yes. Use it wherever you use turmeric, start with as much as you always add, and add it on low heat, so that it does not burn.

seg.1a441b0df6de.src: Both packs list one ingredient, turmeric (Curcuma longa), and name where it was grown.
seg.1a441b0df6de.t: दुनू पैकेट पर एकटा सामग्री लिखल अछि, हरदि (Curcuma longa), आ ई सेहो जे कतय उपजल।
seg.1a441b0df6de.back: On both packets one ingredient is written, turmeric (Curcuma longa), and also where it was grown.

co.privacyNote.src: We use these details to deliver your order, send its GST invoice and support you. Who we share them with: see our {link}.

co.deliveryNote.src: We dispatch within 1–2 working days of payment (not on Sundays or public holidays). Usual delivery time after dispatch: 1–3 days in Palnadu and Guntur, 3–5 days in the rest of Andhra Pradesh and South India, 4–10 days elsewhere in India.
co.deliveryNote.t: हम भुगतानक 1–2 कामकाजी दिनमे ऑर्डर पठा दैत छी (रवि दिन आ सरकारी छुट्टी छोड़ि)। पठयलाक बाद डिलीवरीमे सामान्यतः लागय बला समय: पल्नाडु आ गुंटूरमे 1–3 दिन, शेष आंध्र प्रदेश आ दक्षिण भारतमे 3–5 दिन, भारतक आन ठाम 4–10 दिन।
co.deliveryNote.back: We send the order within 1–2 working days of payment (excluding Sundays and government holidays). Time usually taken for delivery after sending: 1–3 days in Palnadu and Guntur, 3–5 days in the rest of Andhra Pradesh and South India, 4–10 days in other places of India.

co.returnsNote.src: Cancel free of charge before dispatch. Damaged, wrong, faulty or not-as-described pack: a free replacement or a full refund, as you prefer; you never pay return shipping. Delivered later than the usual delivery time for your area (unless delayed by events beyond anyone's control, such as floods or strikes): you can refuse it or ask for a full refund. Refunds go to the original payment method within 5–7 working days of approval.
co.returnsNote.t: पठयबासँ पहिने बिनु कोनो शुल्कक ऑर्डर रद्द करू। पैकेट टूटल-फूटल, गलत, खराब वा बताओल अनुसार नहि होअय: अहाँक पसिन अनुसार मुफ्तमे बदलल पैकेट वा पूरा रिफंड; वापस पठयबाक खर्च अहाँकेँ कहियो नहि देबय पड़त। अहाँक इलाकाक सामान्य डिलीवरी समयसँ देरीसँ पहुँचय (जँ देरी ककरो बससँ बाहरक घटना, जेना बाढ़ि वा हड़तालसँ नहि भेल हो): अहाँ ओकरा लेबासँ मना कऽ सकैत छी वा पूरा रिफंड माँगि सकैत छी। रिफंड मंजूरीक 5–7 कामकाजी दिनमे ओही तरीकामे घुरैत अछि जाहिसँ अहाँ भुगतान केने रही।
co.returnsNote.back: Cancel the order without any charge before sending. If the packet is broken, wrong, spoiled or not as described: a free replaced packet or full refund, as you prefer; you will never have to pay the cost of sending it back. If it arrives later than the usual delivery time of your area (if the delay was not caused by an event beyond anyone's control, such as a flood or strike): you can refuse to take it or ask for a full refund. The refund returns within 5–7 working days of approval to the same method by which you had paid.

co.grievanceNote.src: We acknowledge every complaint within 48 hours, give it a complaint number (for example 1AF-C-0001) that you can quote at any time to check its status, and resolve it within one month.
co.grievanceNote.t: हम हर शिकायत भेटबाक पुष्टि 48 घंटाक भीतर करैत छी, ओकरा एकटा शिकायत नंबर दैत छी (जेना 1AF-C-0001), जे बताकऽ अहाँ कखनो ओकर स्थिति जानि सकैत छी, आ एक मासक भीतर ओकर समाधान करैत छी।
co.grievanceNote.back: We confirm receipt of every complaint within 48 hours, give it a complaint number (such as 1AF-C-0001), by telling which you can know its status at any time, and resolve it within one month.
